display_title: On the Way to Meet Mom
description:
One day, after being discovered in an abandoned house by a rescue team, Mori suddenly finds himself in a children's protection center. Here, he begins to learn a new way of life – one that includes grand care packages sent by a mysterious patron. But when his closest friend is reunited with her mother and leaves the center, Mori learns for the first time the existence of a mother for every child, and decides to embark on a journey to find his own. But what sort of obstacles wait along the way?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Is dying repeatedly a blessing? Enkrid's life-long dream of becoming a knight looked to be forever out of reach, until one day he died... and woke up at the beginning of that same day! Now that he has unlimited chances to train and engage in mortal combat, just how far can he go?

(Source: WEBTOON)

All Jeong wants is a second chance – for revenge! His grandfather’s gruesome death has transformed him into the bloodthirsty and ruthless Scythe Demon. He will stop at nothing until he has killed the man responsible. Yet rage and determination alone are not enough. He must train in martial arts if he ever wants to stand a chance against such a formidable foe. Will he succeed in his revenge on the murderer of his grandfather? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train
description:
Every night, Yeo-Un takes the last train home—same route, same time, same routine. But one thing keeps catching his eye: a girl with a guitar and a presence that lingers in his mind. When a shared love for the indie band Long Afternoon sparks a conversation, their late-night encounters begin to turn into something more. But Hae-In isn’t just another fan—she’s the voice behind the band, a secret she can’t afford to reveal. As music draws them closer, the truth may threaten to pull them apart. When the final note plays, will their story end in harmony… or heartbreak?

(Source: WEBTOON)

The past has changed, but like a fiery comet, he still comes. Mugi Hwa, the one without equal, slashed through Murim's skies with his sword, toppling every lord who dared to face him–even Cheonma, Mugeuk Geom’s father. But Mugeuk didn’t accept defeat. Instead, he turned to the forbidden: a time-bending ritual that hurled him into his own past. Now, retracing his steps, he races against the clock until Mugi emerges once again. But this time, it's not just about power, but mending old wounds and forging new bonds to unite his people and prepare for the bloodtide to come.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan
description:
Cecil Perdium, the Mercenary King, was killed in battle before he could avenge his family. As he faces death, he learns that Duke Delphine, the man who caused the downfall of his family, didn't work alone. Suddenly waking up as his teenage self, Cecil must work to both overcome his poor reputation and build up his strength to save his family. With their soldiers and knights defecting due to the harsh conditions they must endure, he has his work cut out for him. Can Cecil become the mighty warrior he once was and avert his family's fate? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Lim Hyeonseon has lived an ordinary life, and now, as he reaches his forties, he feels an urge to start something new before it’s too late. He decides to take guitar lessons and joins a music academy. There, he meets Cha Yeoreum, a young and passionate guitar instructor. As their friendship grows, Hyeonseon begins to rediscover a sense of vitality and excitement in his life. But life is never without its surprises. When Yeoreum starts to reveal his tender affection for Hyeonseon, their relationship takes an unexpected turn, bringing new challenges and emotions to the surface.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Socially-awkward Ma-Ru Han bombs his fifth attempt at getting a dream job in the civil service. But after a strange creature attacks him in the mountains, he finds himself recruited into the Special Civil Service for the Ministry of Environment. This secret organization is dedicated to fighting nachal, human-devouring demons who appear in clouds of yellow dust. As Ma-Ru struggles in his new job fighting nachal, he must find out why they're mysteriously drawn to him before the prophesied end of the world arrives.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Life sure is ruff, especially when you’re Gyeon Hui-Seong. Abandoned by his pack of fellow dog shifters, he is forced to become a drug runner for a gambling ring. For his final job, he comes face to face with Savage Fang, the ruthless Wolf Den enforcer Yun Chi-Young. Everything goes (nearly) according to plan, but on his way back he is attacked and forced to return to his fearsome(?) true form…a little white cottonball of a puppy! After Chi-young finds Hui-Seong struggling on the streets, he takes him in, believing him to be nothing more than a stray. Will Hui-Seong be able to escape the ruthless, terrifying outpour of love Chi-Young showers him with and escape his criminal past? Or will he be forever leashed to a life of kibble and kennels? 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

*Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.*

Hyeon-Do and Yu-Min, an ordinary man and woman in their 30s, break up with their respective partners for different reasons despite still being in love with them. Selfishly hoping to get their old flames back, the two form a plan. They pretend to date each other in hopes of provoking their former lovers. Will their selfish and foolish plan really work? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Noa has struggled with hearing unsettling voices since she was a child. But when a mysterious murder takes place, the voice in Noa’s head urges her to uncover the killer. With the police skeptical and her sanity on the line, Noa must navigate a web of fear and suspicion, guided by a ghost, to catch a ruthless killer before she herself becomes the serial killer. Will Noa uncover the murderer, or will her own mind betray her? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ha-Neul and Mincheol have been childhood friends for all of their lives, but their relationship takes on a whole new dynamic when they undergo a series of unexpected events. Although they vowed that they'd never be romantically attracted to each other, they just might be proven wrong... especially when things start to escalate and neither can predict where they'll end up.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yijae Kang seems to have the worst luck. She’s an orphan, can see ghosts, and can’t go near water. To make matters worse, she reincarnates as Hailey Duncan, a noblewoman who took her own life before her marriage to King Rodrick of Kaien--who happens to have evil spirits attached to him! To help ease his burden, Hailey's days are spent exorcising these spirits. The more they spend time together, the better Rodrick seems to feel…could he be falling for her?

(Source: Tapas)

Life isn’t always perfect, but love certainly makes it better. The exciting tale of young love continues a year following the story “Seasons of Blossom.” Bo-Mi and her university classmate Pu-Reum’s lives center around a new place, “Cafe Blossom & Nemone Art Studio,” as they navigate the joy and hardships of university and professional life. 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Gifted by the heavens yet cursed by fate, Yeonshin was born with unimaginable talent in martial arts. But this very gift condemned him to a life that would end before adulthood. With the right opportunities, he had the potential to become a legendary hero, or the reincarnation of the Heavenly Demon. Yet fate cast him into the third-rate Jeong Clan, a family of no particular renown. Now, with time slipping through his fingers, Yeonshin must find a way to defy his doomed destiny.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ujin Kang is an ordinary nobody—until one day, he gains a strange ability. Whenever he reads a script or screenplay, he’s pulled into a mysterious dimension where he can relive the character’s experiences. When he ends up showcasing a performance born from that dimension, his acting is so overwhelming that it leads to a massive misunderstanding. Mistaken for a once-in-a-generation acting prodigy, Ujin is suddenly thrust into a world of media and celebrities far beyond his quiet, insignificant life.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Trapped at Home With the Male Leads
description:
After being reincarnated into the body of a novel's wealthy heiress, Cherry Sinclair quickly realizes that the world is coming to an end, but she’s determined to survive the apocalypse, no matter what. Using the money that came with this new life, she devises a plan to create a shelter to hide from the monsters. What she does not expect, however, is for the male leads of the novel to also end up in the same house! Will all of them be able to work together to survive in this chaos?

(Source: Tapas)

Life's never quiet when you've got S-Rank Rizz.
Former S-Rank Hunter Ui-Jae, a.k.a. J, saved humanity from eldritch horrors emerging from dimensional rifts, only to time-leap 8 years into a future where he's presumed dead. Now a manager at a hangover soup joint, all J wants is a quiet life. But between selling off the relics of his past and catching the obsessive attention of Korea's #1 Hunter Sa-Yeong, peace isn't on the menu!

(Source: Manta, edited)

Twenty years have passed since the Great War, but petty theft and exploitation have taken root during times of peace. The once dazzling world of Murim is a mere shadow of its former self, but one young enigmatic swordsman has sworn to restore Jianghu to its former glory. Will the noble principles of justice and loyalty prevail over corruption and greed?

(Source: WEBTOON)

In a world of gates, monsters, and hunters galore, Soo-Ho Sung is…well, he’s just an ordinary college student. Sure, his parents went missing right before the gates started appearing three years ago, and he occasionally had a weird dream where he could beat up monsters and level up like a video game, but other than that? There’s absolutely nothing special about him. So when a sudden monster outbreak occurs on his campus, he must fight back every instinct screaming at him to run away as he takes a page out of his dad’s book and rushes to save his classmate. The chances of making it alive are looking bleak, until—PING! \[Congratulations on becoming a Player.\]

(Source: Ize Press)

How far would you be willing to go to save the ones you love? With his grandfather bordering life and death, Taesun takes on multiple jobs in order to pay a seemingly endless stack of hospital bills. On one of his odd jobs, he ascends the great mountain Geumryang, unknowingly the home of an eponymous serpentine spirit. When Taesun encounters the divine being, he too is on the brink of death, desperate for water in his slithering form. Taesun offers him a sip of water, and saves the sacred snake from certain death. Later that night, a cold-blooded body embraces Taesun and offers him an exchange: bear the ancient being’s seed, and his grandfather will live. But is all really as it seems? After all, can one ever truly trust the forked tongue of a serpent…? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

All this is for the Empire. Luca had never once questioned his dream of joining Accretia’s Imperial Guard. Not until he met Ilay, that is. The most unexpected of friends, Ilay’s personality and family background are nothing like Luca’s. However, it is through their differences that the two friends will begin to shape not only each other, but even the very planet on which they live.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Blink Master of the Magic Academy
description:
In the game Aether World, Baek Yuseol is considered the most useless character because he can't use magic like everyone else. His only skill, Blink, is a short-range teleportation ability most players consider worthless. But when he’s tasked with reaching the game's true ending, Baek Yuseol decides to use his unconventional skill to achieve this impossible goal. Can this so-called "trash" character outsmart his powerful peers, form unlikely alliances, and ultimately master the game?

(Source: Tapas)

For Paula, not a single day passed by without a reminder of her ugliness. But it was her hideous face that spared her from being sold to a brothel or dying tragically like her sisters. So when Paula's father sells her off to work at an esteemed nobleman's mansion, she realizes that peasant girls are a disposable resource. However, she finds the young Count Belunita tucked away in an annex, shamefully hidden from the curious eyes of the public. And as Paula struggles to appeal to her tyrannical master's whims, she must also embrace her role as his secret maid. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Seonghyeon Han is a victim of a violent crime that left him with impaired legs and a fear of the outside world. Now, he faces an even greater challenge: while he gained the power to create clones, he has just 24 hours before being sent to another dimension. As the countdown ticks down, Seonghyeon makes a desperate move -- he sends his clone through the interdimensional portal, and discovers his real body can remain safe at home. Thus begins the epic tale of Seonghyeon's... clones.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Regret is the bane of old men. When aging Alliance Lord Hajin Cheon of the Grand Martial Alliance reflects on his immense legacy, he finds that he recalls little of his deeds or even the lives of his closest advisors. Stricken by a mysterious ailment, Hajin suddenly passes away only to wake up in the body of Ridan Byeok, heir to the Byeok Clan of swordsmen. The only problem is, Ridan is a well-known wastrel, the polar opposite of the virtuous and stern Hajin. Righting the wrongs of his predecessor, Hajin begins to uncover the truth behind his death…

(Source: WEBTOON)

Romance, flowers, and dates-- once upon a time, that was the perfect description of Hae-Su and Min-Cheol. Now, all Hae-Su has is the ashes of their marriage and a mountain of debt. But her world shatters completely when Min-Cheol cheats on her with a young coworker. Hurt and betrayed, Hae-Su finds herself drawn to Tae-Ha, a young man who seems desperate for her affection… and may be hiding more than he shows.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

After her parents died, Sami gave up her life of fortune to live independently, doing odd jobs to make ends meet. When she starts to get involved with two of the most popular boys at her high school, Sami faces twists and turns — Chan is her neighbor, and Pyo-Jun makes her have conflicted feelings. Things get more complicated when she finds out that Chan has feelings for Pyo-Jun as well! With her mom’s only keepsake in hand to keep her feet on the ground, Sami navigates obstacles that she wasn’t prepared for — and aren’t even in her budget! 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Former archery prodigy Yoo Sanghyun was destined for greatness until an injury forced him to quit. Though his coach helped him secure a stable job, he never felt like he belonged. Frustrated, he leaves it all behind to pursue game streaming. Leveraging his incredible archery skills and the charm of his noob character, he quickly rises to fame as "Almond." Now, he's determined to dominate the gaming world, but will his virtual success translate into something greater in real life? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Peaceful Camping Life in Another World
description:
Star chef Lee Kang-Hyeon, who has lost his sense of taste, retreats to a peaceful countryside to escape the public eye. In his grandfather's rural home, he stumbles upon a portal to another world. Taking advantage of his escape, he decides to enjoy a relaxed camping life in this new world. However, the inhabitants of this world keep showing interest in him. Will Kang-Hyeon be able to live a peaceful life? 

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

A terminally ill orphan is gifted a second chance when she is reborn into her favorite novel as Princess Isabelle Bilothian. Despite being born with a curse that will kill her at age 21, she eagerly embraces the opportunity to relish two decades with her loving family and friends. However, as she tries to cherish her borrowed time, the story takes unexpected turns, putting her in a series of dangers. Can she overcome these threats and make the most of her limited days to live in happiness?

(Source: Tapas)

In the shadowy heart of Seoul near Cheonggyecheon Stream lies a sinister mansion whose porch only fools would dare tread. Welcome… to the house of the Ki sisters: Jang-nyeo, Sal-gyo, Jae-rim, and Jenny. Homeschooled and raised in isolation, the four sisters and their inadvertently menacing demeanor may strike terror into the faint-hearted, but don’t judge a book by its cover: the youngest, Jenny Ki, is a scary-- I mean, starry-eyed hopeless romantic who’s out to find love! The problem is… everything she knows about love is from romance novels. Will Jenny put the Ki in “kiss” or “kill”? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yang-Cheon Ku, born to the virtuous House of Ku of Sanseo, the Little Star and next Head of House. Status: The world’s most hated demonic martial artist. Cause of death: Defeated during the Virtuous-Demonic War, tortured upon capture. Or so he thought. Moments after dying in the arms of his childhood friend, the Heavenly Sword herself, Seol-ah Wi, he finds himself back in the past. Already things have changed, but is it enough to ensure his second chance at life doesn’t end with the same regrets? 

(Source: Tapas)

Chef Kim, Korea's legendary sashimi master, is transported into the world of Blessing M, a mobile game he once played. But instead of being a hero, he finds himself as Geomma Kang, a mere background extra. Forced into a new life, Geomma discovers a new power: the Blessing of the Blade God. Now, to survive in this game-like world, he must slice through challenges and enemies alike. Will his unmatched skills in the kitchen be enough to carve out a new destiny? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

*"My name is Song Gi-Tae. I’m 20 years old. That’s all I remember."*

Gi-Tae wakes up in a windowless room, with no memory of how he got there—only the steady rhythm of three meals a day delivered by the ever-gentle Cha Ji-Hun to hint at the passage of time. No matter how cold or cutting Gi-Tae becomes, Ji-Hun only responds with warm smiles and tender concern. But trust is a luxury Gi-Tae can’t afford. Not when the man bringing him food…is the same one who cut off his foot.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.*

Kill monsters, save your neighbors, and expand your domain, all from the comfort of your couch. When his city becomes infested with monsters, Jae-Hyeon discovers an ability that makes him the absolute master of his apartment building. But his ability comes with a catch -- he cannot leave his apartment. Now, he must arm his neighbors and lead them beyond their building to survive the post-apocalyptic world they find themselves in.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Fabre, a famous million-viewer streamer known for his daring encounters with venomous creatures, is bitten by a black mamba while filming in Africa and wakes up in the mystical world of Murim. To his surprise, the jungles of Murim offer him a peaceful farming life in which he enjoys cultivating various poisonous species. But his tranquility is short-lived when he crosses paths with members of the Tang Clan, the masters of poison and devious tactics.

*"I see potential in you. Become a part of our family."*

(Source: WEBTOON)

In a world where humans enslave non-human species, the powerful wizard Leppenhardt creates an empire to safeguard these beings. However, his reign ends when he's defeated by the brutally strong Tesron, the "King of Fists." But death isn’t the end, because Leppenhardt awakens in Tesron's young body! Now armed with incredible strength and a new identity, he sets off to free the non-human races again. Can the new King of Fists reshape the world for all, or will his second chance slip away? 

(Source: Tapas)

When the king offers Aerik Cladinae his own sister's hand in marriage for his meritorious deeds in battle, he didn't expect to get saddled with a limping, drooling woman like Miesa Esquillre. Driven insane by her brother's physical and psychological torture, Miesa rolls around on the ground, spills food all over herself, and screams unintelligibly as a way of communicating. But sometimes, Aerik catches a flash of shrewd understanding behind those vacant eyes. Is Miesa truly as mad as everyone thinks... or is she hiding something?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Aaron Hunter’s got it all. Looks, talent, and he just won the award for best actor. He does have one issue though: trouble sleeping. The only thing that’ll get him to fall asleep is a certain song by a certain someone. And when they finally meet, this is Aaron’s chance to get him to write a new song. But will the mysterious singer accept this deal? And will past traumas become illuminated by their newfound relationship…? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Theo Ragnar, the 31st son of the mighty Grand Duke of Ragnar, was born without the legendary Ragnar Gift—a fatal flaw in a family where might is right. Labeled the “Ragnar Defect,” he and his mother were betrayed, meeting a brutal end at the hands of those they trusted. But death was only the beginning. Reborn at 17, Theo awakens not only with the Ragnar Gift, but with powers far beyond imagination. Fueled by vengeance and a second chance, he sets out to claim the glory he was once denied.

(Source: Tapas)

For seven years, Seo Hyeon-Jin, a Korean literature major, has nursed a secret crush on his upperclassman Soon Jeong-Wook. Unfortunately, Jeong-Wook only sees him as a cherished junior, leaving Hyeon-Jin’s love life at a standstill. Everything changes when Heo Chan-Yeong, who perfectly matches Jeong-Wook’s type, transfers in. To make matters worse, Chan-Yeong boldly confesses his feelings for Jeong-Wook to Hyeon-Jin, explaining that he wants to sleep with him. As if that weren’t enough, Chan-Yeong even asks Hyeon-Jin to help him win Jeong-Wook’s heart. Determined to protect the man he loves, Hyeon-Jin finds himself caught in a battle of wits against Chan-Yeong, who only wants Jeong-Wook out of curiosity.

But when Hyeon-Jin realizes Chan-Yeong’s “interest” might not be so fixed after all, he starts to wonder…could the rival he’s trying to fend off become something else entirely?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

When the hand that used to so lovingly hold Annette Rozenberg ends up being the one that causes the downfall of her family, Annette demands that Heiner Waldemar give her a divorce. But Heiner refuses, stating that he must see her miserable by his side, no matter what. At odds, the two continue a precarious relationship, only to be met with wounds of the past that bring them tragically together. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

*Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

She just wants to start fresh so she can graduate in peace. She just wants to leave behind all the bad memories — her sleepwalking, the trauma from being bullied at school — all of it. She did everything she could to keep to herself, but the class president, Hae-On, just won't leave her alone. One day, when Seul-Bi visits the local lake Hae-On recommended, she comes across something she never imagined seeing in her wildest dreams: a wild, dark mermaid. 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

*Note: Includes one extra.*

After humanity triumphs over the dangerous gates, a fragile peace is restored, yet the immense powers of espers become a dangerous double-edged sword. At the heart of this turmoil is Esper Zero, Michael, teetering on the edge of destruction. Enter Adam, a retired soldier haunted by the fractured bonds between espers and their guides. In a bold act of redemption, Adam offers Michael a second chance and a new identity: "Eve," symbolizing a fresh start and a spark of hope. But is peace truly possible for a person created for war…? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a life of hardship as an orphan, Ji-A Han finally achieves the dream of homeownership... only to have her moment of jubilation cruelly cut short. While indulging in her guilty pleasure--a riveting soap opera--she experiences a sudden, piercing chest pain and meets an untimely demise. But when she wakes up, she finds herself not in the afterlife, but within the very drama she was watching and as none other than its villainess! In a realm where a glance sparks a scandal and a step triggers a landmine of emotions, what fate lies ahead for Ji-A? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

On his first day at Nakseong High, Lee Jun enters more than a new environment. After a status window warns him of the school's horror stories, he is killed in a wave of gore and sent back to his first day. This time, Jun ignores the ominous window and tricks fate, only to be killed again three years later, forced to restart high school, and lead a brand-new horror story club. Pulled into this life-and-death game, can Jun rewrite the Nakseong urban legend once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)

Woo-Yeon never liked Alphas, not before, and definitely not after he manifested as an Omega. The only person who ever made him feel seen was his tutor, Do-Hyun. Years later, Woo-Yeon follows him to university, hoping for a fresh start. But when they meet again, Do-Hyun doesn't recognize him. Woo-Yeon, however, never forgot—not his voice, his kindness, or the way Do-Hyun still makes his heart flutter. Then he learns the truth. Do-Hyun is an Alpha...

(Source: Tapas)

DJ, drop the beat! When 18-year-old K-pop stan Su-Hyeon gets his heart broken, he turns to his actual true love, girl group sensation MainTainA–especially his bias, the group’s main dancer, Hailey. Leaving his bittersweet first relationship behind to transfer to Seoul, Su-Hyeon finds not only a spitting image of his bias in the school dance club member Hye-Eun, who is supposedly Hailey’s younger sister, but also a new love in the most unexpected of places: the art of street dance! While helping Hye-Eun overcome her stage fright, Su-Hyeon finds there may be more to life than love!

(Source: WEBTOON)

After trouble child Kiana Ellie Freley leaves home to pursue her passion, she is satisfied living the academic life as a professor of magical engineering. That is, until her family is wrongly accused of treason and sentenced to death! In a last-ditch effort to reverse their fate, Kiana's cousin Melissa turns back time by one year, but only Kiana retains her memories. With just her summoned creature Chirpy by her side, can Kiana amend relations with her family and prevent their unjust end?

(Source: Tapas)

A one-night stand turns into a messy love story.
Josh, a brilliant lawyer and obsessive neat freak, is coping with a broken engagement. The only upside? His firm changed cleaning services. But when the new cleaner is Angel—his one-night stand from last night—chaos ensues. Is this love or just a messy disaster waiting to unfold?

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

display_title: My Fantasies Are Cumming to Life?!
description:
Park Seojin is the very picture of a ladylike woman. She’s elegant, modest, and works harder than anyone at her successful job at a large corporation. Or, at least that’s the image of herself that Seojin has carefully crafted in order to indulge in her actual hobbies: reading hardcore smut! In reality, Seojin is just your average 'otaku,' fangirling and obsessing over steamy romance novels every night. Lately, her new obsession has been the one man in her life who remotely resembles a male lead in her romance novels - her boss, Yoon Taehyun! However, Seojin knows that her fantasies are destined to stay just that - fantasies. They're employee and boss, and nothing could change that. But when Yoon Taehyun discovers a crack in her perfectly curated persona, could their relationship potentially change into something else?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: The Dang Clan’s Swordmaster Heir Just Wants a Normal Life
description:
The Dang clan of Sacheon, once renowned for its poison and hidden weapons, is now on the path to its demise. That is, until Yeonmyeung Dang, an outcast boy of the clan, awakens by recollecting the memories of his past life as the 'god of swords' who devoted his life to mastering the sword. Will the boy be able to protect his family and fulfill his dream of living a normal life?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Reborn Young Lord is an Assassin
description:
Cyan Vert, illegitimate son of the Duke and the empire's greatest assassin, is betrayed by the righteous brother whose shadow he's always lived in. But just before the fatal blow strikes his throat, Cyan awakes to find he's just a boy again. The young lord has been reborn, and this time, he's not going to live in anyone's shadow! 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Spring, 1995. Messy-note business major and campus hottie Jinwoo needs someone to rewrite his essays so that they are at least somewhat legible. Perfect-penmanship P.E. major Daehan needs dating lessons so that he can stay in a relationship for at least two weeks. So when the two end up living under the same roof, it seems like the perfect opportunity to help each other out... but after a few fated run-ins, it might be more than just skills that they're swapping! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Baekya is childhood friends with Jichan, a well-known trash magnet. It has been and always will be Baekya's job to console Jichan after every one of his bad break-ups. One day, as Baekya was consoling Jichan yet again, the most popular boy in school, Lee Hyeon, appears in front of them. Knowing Hyeon's infamous streak of break-ups and bad boy stories, Baekya tries to stop Sichuan from falling for Hyeon when Jichan falls for him head over heels. Jichan even boldly asks Baekya to become friends with Hyeon just so he could set them up with each other. Baekya begrudgingly accepts and tries his best to become close to Hyeon, when one day Hyeon approaches him first and asks "Don't you think you're making it too obvious? I know you like me, but think you can stop it now?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

On the day of a group project presentation, college senior Lee Seung-Hyeon is falsely accused of sexual harassment on the subway, causing him to miss the presentation and fail the class. Desperate to salvage his GPA before graduation, he scrapes together enough money to enroll in summer classes, only to find himself stuck in another group project. To his horror, one of his groupmates, Seo Chae-Jun, turns out to be the very person who accused him of sexual harassment. Now, during what should have been a peaceful summer break, Seung-Hyeon is forced to confront his worst nightmare.

 *"What did I do that was so wrong to deserve spending this precious summer break of my senior year dealing with this lunatic?"*

(Source: Lezhin US)

Logan MacLine, a middle-aged knight fighting for the independence army, is intent on getting revenge against the empire which took over the kingdom and executed his brother when he ends up dying in battle. But when he wakes, he is a young man again, and has yet to be disowned for his terrible behavior. Using his experience and knowledge from his past life, Logan recruits a few talented individuals to develop new weapons, build an army, and make enough money to fund it all. But will he be able to make amends with his family and stop the empire's march? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Agnes Saint is a princess with a reputation for cruelty and an unhealthy obsession with the dashing Captain Raymond. But when her personality changes overnight, it baffles everyone around her. The secret? The soul of a fangirl replaced Agnes in the middle of the story. Now, fueled by a stan’s unslakable love, she’s turned her eye to Kylo Grey, a side character with humble origins and her number one bias. Can she rewrite Agnes’ story to ship herself with the man of her dreams?

(Source: Tapas)

Huimin Seo happened to read a tragic BL novel where the two main characters had both his name and even his best friend’s name, Iheon Cha. But rather than remaining as an incredible coincidence, this book becomes a new reality for Huimin. Before he knows it, he is transmigrated right into a major scene in the novel where Huimin Seo, a rare dominant omega, gets bought off in an auction by Iheon Cha, a powerful dominant alpha. Aware of the complications in this love-hate relationship that he cannot escape from, Huimin must tread carefully to turn things around entirely. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Chapter count includes eight side story chapters.*

As a self-proclaimed expert on archdukes of the north, Krisha has one goal in life. To marry one. However, all her plans are immediately overturned when she finds out she's already married to the emperor. To make matters worse, he wants a divorce! If that happens, not only will she become a divorcee at age 21, but she'll be banished from the mainland for the next 10 years. Though she sets out to give the emperor a piece of her mind, little does she know he's not the only obstacle to her dream...

(Source: Tapas)

Binge-reading my favorite romantasy novel is my one and only solace after late-night shifts at my part-time job. I was just reading my novel while walking home from yet another long shift, when suddenly a truck…! Huh? Delivery truck driver Taek-Jin’s struggle to return back to Korea after waking up in a strange world begins!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Qi, swords, martial artists… and robots and spaceships?! The year is 3077, thousands of years after the heyday of the martial arts realm. Humanity inhabits the stars, governed by interstellar martial arts organizations who kept the old ways of the realm alive: might makes right! For bounty hunters like Seryeong, Robert, and Sunja, this means trouble is good for business, except when they bite off more than they can chew. After venturing to the irradiated wasteland of Earth for a top bounty, only to find a 2,000-year-old martial artist instead, they realize their fortunes are about to change…

(Source: WEBTOON)

In the Era of Adventure kickstarted by the spawning of Gates, marked by absolute hopelessness, destitute, desperation, and despair, everyone had given up their hope and lost their courage to continue fighting - except one adventurer that refused to go down until his last breath. "You are the only one left, Last Adventurer Elpam." As the history of adventurers was forced to come to an end, the Last Adventurer returned to where this story all began.

(Source: WEBTOON)

An unknown actress's life is ruined when she wakes up as Cha Yeryeon, the villainess of a daytime drama. Determined to avoid an antagonist's fate, Yeryeon works to nudge the story toward a different ending. But as her actions threaten to upend the lives of other characters, Yeryeon has to figure out how to get her satisfying story while also protecting the people she cares for. Will Yeryeon flip the script and change the drama for the better? Or will she be stuck playing the bad guy forever?

(Source: Tapas)

“I shall destroy the factions of justice and avenge the deaths of my comrades!” Jeonghwa, the captain of the Black Serpent Squad, loses everyone she grew up with when the lawful factions betray them after the battle against the chaotic factions. On the verge of death herself, she must now claw her way up to deliver true justice to the so-called justice factions. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Leo Lombardi’s a hotshot L1 racecar driver for Team Zeus. He’s young, good-looking and has the driving talent to make anyone jealous. And sharing in that success is Leo’s boyfriend, J.J., who just so happens to be a mechanic on Team Zeus. All signs point to a clear lane for Leo to take home the championship for a second year in a row. But when J.J. suddenly breaks up with Leo, things start going south. With Leo’s fortuna (good luck charm) gone, his professional (and personal) life starts to suffer. How will he get rid of this monkey wrench in his plans and reclaim the driver’s high he once had…?

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes 12 side story chapters.*

Pania Elarona, an average elf with the special ability to see people's status windows, idolizes the infamous lone wolf Naos Shalia. When a new law forbids solo dungeon adventuring, she volunteers to pair up with him. Reluctantly, Naos agrees, but a hidden lust demon curse triggers in the dungeon, trapping him in a passionate haze! Pania checks his status window, and a mission appears saying... he needs to get off?! Can these elves conquer the curse, or will the lust be too strong to overcome?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Genius Wants an Ordinary Life
description:
A man who has everything and yet nothing. The only thing successful corporate executive Jin-Hyeok Son ever really wanted was an ordinary life with a beloved family, a desire arising from the tragic death of his parents when he was a child. This all changes after he finds himself back in his nine-year-old body after an accident -- to a time when his parents are still alive, to the very life he had longed to return to! Can Jin-Hyeok change the past and finally fulfill his dream of an ordinary life?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hyunseung Min earned his reputation as a genius composer through hard work and raw talent. All it cost him…was his family. After his father passed and his sister declared she never wanted to see him again, Hyunseung died mysteriously only to find himself back in his teenage body—before he began his career and before his father died. This time, he'll use his skills to support the family he took for granted in his previous life and show them just how much he loves them. 

(Source: Tapas)

When Lee Chae-Rin kicks the bucket, she’s whisked into a dark fantasy novel as Rose Estania, a chambermaid at the mercy of the tyrant crown prince, Kalix Forsman. Armed with nothing but her real-world hotelier skills and a diary from the real Rose full of cryptic hints but no escape route, she's forced to navigate a dangerous world teeming with Kalix's enemies. Can she keep his wrath in check, evade death, and find her way back to reality before it's too late? 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Gi-ryeo has a secret: he's really an alien from another world! As High Wizard of the planet Alpha Uri, Gi-ryeo slaved away day in and day out working his soul crushing job. But, after perfecting his transmigration magic, Gi-ryeo escapes into the body of a starved Hunter on Earth. On a new planet, surrounded by more magic than he's ever known, can Gi-ryeo adapt and keep his identity hidden from those seeking the High Wizard? 

(Source: Tapas)

S-class Hunter Kim Yiyoung can’t wait to leave the novel she woke up in. She gets the chance after defeating the story’s final boss, but instead of returning home, she’s sent into another novel! Yiyoung becomes Lady Renee Markious, a petty villainess who’s just been framed for murder. Fortunately, Yiyoung has a secret weapon nobody knows about… her skills from her past life! Can Yiyoung clear Renee’s name and find her way back to her own world? Or will she be trapped in this tale for good?

*Source: Tapas*

display_title: A Child Who Looks Like Me
description:
A surprise pregnancy sends Jeong-o, a college junior, into a panic. Her supportive boyfriend Jiheon plans a loving proposal, but a car accident erases his recent memories, including their romance. Seven years later, they reunite unexpectedly—but Jiheon has no recollection of Jeong-o or the fact that they share a precious daughter between them.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A hero should never kill anyone, not even the worst of villains. Gangyu could never understand why his team of heroes lived by those words, but he tried his best to do the same… until the villain who wiped out his squad killed his brother in prison. Gangyu breaks his vow and enters Ruculus with permission to kill as the prison’s executioner. Now, he must fight his way through the villains to kill the worst of them all. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

The Devon family sits on a mountain of debt and they are on the brink of bankruptcy. This is no fault of hers of course, but Courtney Devon has always been the one painted as the villain in her family. However, the family is in dire straits and they have to do something, anything, to raise some money and get out of this situation. But then one day, news arrives from the Imperial Palace that His Royal Highness the crown prince has decided to make Courtney the crown princess. Seemingly a typical prince on the outside, His Royal Highness is actually quite a troublemaker with a dark side. Will this arrangement end up solving Courtney Devon’s problems or just complicating things further? Will a love against all odds bloom or will someone end up in the doghouse...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

At age 3, Calypso Aquasiadel is the most outstanding genius her family's ever seen, and no wonder... She's actually a modern girl who's been reborn into the same novel thrice! This time around, Calypso's determined to harness the powers of the mysterious dragon duke and send herself back home. The only problem is, she'll first need to earn the respect of her hardened family to survive until then! Can Calypso win their approval and even their hearts? Or is this life doomed for another do-over? 

(Source: Tapas)

Is my cursed husband's fate up to me? 

Madelyn's husband Ian was left broken after the war, and in turn, made her life a living hell. Fleeing her doomed marriage, she meets a tragic end. But when she opens her eyes, she finds herself at 17 again. The war has yet to start, and Madelyn can still change her fate. But what about Ian? 

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
description:
After a lifetime of bloodshed, the Heavenly Demon longs for peace. In his final moments, he uncovers the truth about his power and yearns for a different life. He wakes up in the body of Tae-San Byeok, the frail second son of a powerful merchant family, barely clinging to life. Using his knowledge from his life as the Heavenly Demon, Tae-San must navigate a world of temptation and corruption to survive. As his martial arts reputation grows, new enemies emerge to disrupt his quiet life. Yet, Tae-San is determined to live on his own terms, despite the chaos around him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Princess Siana quietly endured her parents' abuse for years, but when Crown Prince Rashid of the nearby empire conquers her kingdom and kills her entire family, she refuses to die without standing up for herself. Siana begs for her life, and Rashid allows her to be a maid at the palace, where she thrives in her simple life of service... until that new life is threatened by Rashid's interest in her. Can Siana finally enjoy the peace she deserves, or will Rashid's fascination disrupt it all? 

(Source: Tapas)

Mumyeong Heo’s grandmother passed away years ago. But when he visits her home to spend some time in the quiet countryside, he notices that someone kept it clean all this time. His new neighbors aren’t exactly thrilled by his visit. In fact, most of them don’t want him around. But that’s when his nasty neighbors go missing one by one… for better or worse. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Byul, a popular alpha and a first-year high school student, once trained to be an idol but has since left that path to attend school like a regular kid. His world takes an unexpected turn with the sudden birth of a younger sibling, introducing new challenges to his daily routine. Byul's childhood friend, Siwoo, has secretly harbored feelings for him for years. However, both being alphas, Siwoo has kept his emotions hidden. 

As the two navigate their growing closeness after a period of time apart, Byul faces adolescence head-on, grappling with friendships, family relationships, and his sense of identity. Along the way, he rediscovers his passion for music and begins to mature through these transformative experiences. 

(Source: Lezhin)

Edele Lancaster is the perfect noble lady who has been groomed for the job. But when her husband whom she married reluctantly commits treason, she is branded a traitor and becomes a slave. Distraught, she tries to kill herself to preserve honor as a noble lady, but her new master, Count Laslo Krissus prevents her from doing so. Will Edele be able to find freedom and happiness in her new life as Count Krissus’ maid?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Baby Prisoner of the Winter Castle
description:
The last survivor of the Grezekaiah royal family is biding her time as a prisoner waiting to die… too bad everyone finds her absolutely adorable. When Clarisse became the youngest prisoner of Duke Maximilian Sheridan, she never expected her captors to be the family she’d always wished for. With an execution date set for her eighteenth birthday, will her emerging powers, bubbly personality, and cute face save her from her fate? 

(Source: Tapas)

Jae-Won, a small-time DIY trader, wins the lottery, but wakes up inside a web novel after a car crash. To return home to his prize money, he must help the male and female leads get their happily ever after, but why do all the handsome male lead candidates seem more interested in him than the heroine?

(Source: Manta)

Gyeono Kang, a lucky high schooler, used to enjoy the mutual love he shared with the prettiest girl in his class, Chanbi Baek. She was always all about him until an accident wiped her memories of the past year, and just like that, she no longer had feelings for him. But what about Gyeono, whose heart still beats for her? Is it even possible to win her back? Did she really like him back to begin with?! Somebody help!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ganghyeok is ruined. His gym business is failing and there's no way he can pay off his debts. But one night, while reading his favorite author's latest webnovel, he gets sucked into a world of martial arts fantasy and wakes up as a child monk in the Shaolin temple. There, he must apply his knowledge of modern fitness to survive their strict training, juggle the friends and enemies he makes along the way, and find a way to get back home.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: A Breath in the End of Verdure
description:
After a cosmic accident lands her in another world, Jiwoo Seo is resigned to living as a whole new person. She has spent the past five years purging her new world of demonic energy as Akarna, a being who must sacrifice her blood and her freedom for the empire. But when the man she loves gets engaged to someone else, Jiwoo flees from her gilded cage. Rescued by a stranger from a clan of beautiful, otherworldly men, they concoct a plan to keep her safe—by having her marry them all.

(Source: Tapas)

Jin Yu-An is a shy, sweet-faced sub who’s never actually tried any real SM play. He’s never had a partner or a lover—mostly because he’s way too busy, kind of a scaredy-cat, and hasn’t found anyone who fits his taste. One day, while browsing a BDSM app, he stumbles upon a profile that makes his heart race… only to realize the guy hasn’t logged in for years. Still, hoping against hope, Yu-An starts sending him cheerful messages. And then—a reply.

\[You got a death wish?\]
\[Can’t you see my age?\]

Oops. He missed the guy’s age. And the terrifying attitude in the response? Yikes. But somehow, Yu-An gets stubborn and insists on meeting him. The guy is exactly his type—intense gaze, scary tattoos, and an aura that screams danger. BDSM? More like organ theft?? 

Still… should he give this scary-sexy dom a shot?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Chan Lee thought his life hit rock bottom when he lost his office job. Then he started working at a convenience store connected to another world. With customers ranging from dog men to goblins and dragon girls, every shift brings new chaos. Between supernatural mishaps and late-night shifts, Chan soon builds an unlikely community of loyal regulars.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hye-Seong, a boy living on a remote island, and Yun-Hae, a mysterious mermaid, become each other’s only friend. But soon after they meet, they’re separated after Hye-Seong moves away. Six years later, Yun-Hae develops a mysterious power and finds Hye-Seong again. Unfortunately, too much has changed, and Hye-Seong can no longer dedicate all his time to her as he did in their childhood. He tells her they are too different, but Yun-Hae’s attachment to Hye-Seong slowly transforms into an obsession... 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Yongjin is a struggling orphan–a blunt realist with no time or money to spare on superstitious nonsense. But on his 16th birthday, he finds his life taking a dramatic turn when his classmate Huisu, whom he had never interacted with before, suddenly asks to be his girlfriend. For the first time, Yongjin isn’t alone–but his new company isn’t exactly the kind he had always wished for, as he finds himself being chased by spirits instead! Though this wasn’t quite the sweet sixteen he had in mind, Yongjin must now navigate through a new world he never thought existed. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

*“When the apocalypse comes, the world will be ridden with bloodshed and screams of anguish. In the end, none but ashes will remain.”* 

He has been locked up in an underground prison his whole life. He does not know his name. He does not know when the world will end, nor if the world really even will end. The only thing he knows is that he has been imprisoned... by his own father. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jin-Ha, an overworked developer, gets the worst news of his life—he’s a recessive Omega! He’s now extra sensitive to alphas, and the only thing that calms him is his boss Hyun-Joon’s pheromones. This is a nightmare, especially since Jin-Ha’s been stashing money in a “murder for hire” account to cope with how annoying Hyun-Joon is. As if that’s not enough, a creepy stalker starts showering him with pheromones. Now, Jin-Ha’s stuck under the protection of his infuriatingly handsome boss!

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.*

display_title: Turning the Mad Dog into a Genteel Lord
description:
Diarin, a priestess without any noteworthy family background or connections, always gets the toughest assignments. So when her boss tells her to help Ceres, a war hero, reintegrate into society, she decides to stop being a pushover and get as much as she can out of it, including a juicy promotion. But upon reaching Ceres’ manor, she’s greeted by a growling hound instead of a human. Tasked with the impossible job of turning the mad dog into a proper gentleman, she dedicates herself to caring for him. But his unexpected obsession with her was never part of her plan. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

For two blissful years, So-Ryung's world revolved around her husband—until he vanished without a trace. In her search for answers, she learns the heartbreaking truth that he was never hers to begin with. But she’s not about to let him slip away, even if he is a black ops agent with a hundred faces…

(Source: Manta)

Suit up! Jian is an Italian soccer league benchwarmer who needs to convince his childhood friend that he's a star player. A lucky goal or two might do the trick, but how long can he keep up the ruse? Unless, unbeknownst to him, Jian really is a genius...

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: The Dragon Slayer's Regression on Another Level
description:
Zeke Draker was the first of House Draker to fail his Awakening. And for that, he was cast out. Forced to survive in a brutal world, Zeke rose from disgrace and earned the name Phantom of the North. On a mission to stop the emperor from obtaining an ancient relic, Zeke was hunted and killed by imperial forces. But fate had other plans. Zeke awakens as a 12-year-old boy back in the Cradle, House Draker’s elite training ground. Given a second chance, Zeke’s determined to rewrite his fate.

(Source: Tapas)

The Exorcism Agency is a state-run secret organization whose mission is to protect humans from demonic possession. Taehee Yoon, an exorcist from the Execution Department, is looking for a "genius" who can see and hear ghosts to be his new subordinate. While operating undercover at a high school he meets a mysterious boy...*

"By the way, how old are you, buddy?"*

(Source: Manta)

Ga-Jun and Sun-Woo, students with supernatural abilities, are trapped in a time loop during their school trip. After witnessing their friends’ deaths, Ga-Jun realizes Sun-Woo’s death triggers the loop. He becomes fiercely protective, while Sun-Woo, confused, tries to protect Ga-Jun in return.

(Source: Manta)

After waking up in the middle of the woods, on a rainy night, and in the body of a novel's villainess, Ophelia Lizen just wants one thing... a divorce! But she is married to Duke Sylvester Lizen, who genuinely seems fond of her and lets her do anything her heart desires — even if that's stalking the crown prince. Wanting to shed her wicked ways, Ophelia tries to turn over a new leaf, but how can she when Sylvester's one divorce condition is for her to seduce the crown prince who despises her?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Villainess Captured the Grand Duke
description:
When I transmigrated into a novel, I did what anyone would do—propose to my favorite character, Grand Duke Reigrein. I mean, he’s the perfect man, so who wouldn’t want to marry him? As Schueur, I was supposed to be the villainess, but I’d rather save my honey! His Highness’s special ability consumes his emotions every time he uses it, so my goal is to awaken feelings in him. So far, I’ve only caused him irritation and annoyance, but one day I’ll make him notice me! 

(Source: Tapas)

300 years. That was how long it had been since he had last been opened. For 3 whole centuries, the mysterious book of magic, also known as Grimoire, has been stuck on the shelf of the Le Temis Royal Academy Library. Just then, an apprentice mage opens the Grimoire, only to die in a freak accident. As the dismayed Grimoire awaits his teleportation to a new location, the library door creeps open and a mysterious girl, Riley, approaches and opens the Grimoire, becoming his new contractor. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

*The best guys are where you least expect them.* 

One lonely night, Julia finds an odd boy named William in her wardrobe. They quickly become friends, and soon he begins appearing whenever she needs someone to talk to. As the two grow closer, Julia falls for this mysterious boy, igniting a magical love story that transcends time and space.

(Source: Manta) 

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

display_title: The Legendary Hero is an Academy Honors Student
description:
In the Age of Catastrophe, five heroes saved the world from a primordial evil. One of the heroes, now reborn as Leo Plove, is excited to revisit his glorious past—only to find his name erased from history. Determined to uncover the truth, he joins Lumerne, a hero military academy, unaware he's about to discover dark secrets surrounding his reincarnation. Why are his past records hidden, and who wants to keep them that way? Will Leo be able to set things right and reclaim the credit he deserves?

(Source: Tapas)

Deserting the battlefield, Enoch Rubinstein flees with his newborn daughter Lilith to a small village to raise her disguised as James Brown, a regular, doting single father. But when the order of knights returns to drag Enoch back to the capital, Lilith finds that her father was secretly one of the empire's greatest heroes. As her father's daughter, she also discovers that she holds great potential. Will Lilith be able to keep her family safe? Or will the secrets lurking ahead overpower her?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Reincarnation of the Hero Party's Grand Mage
description:
The warrior Lista heard the rumors about the great magician Rin, hailed as a genius for becoming the youngest 4-star mage. Lista recruited him to join her party to fight the forces of the void but, right before the final battle, Rin’s body succumbed to the void’s dark poison. As he drew his last breath, Rin cast an immortality spell, encasing his body in ice and promising Lista that he would return. Rin kept his promise and returned after 300 years--but reborn in the body of a noble boy. 

(Source: Tapas)

Han-Eul, self-proclaimed campus flirt, has big dreams of landing a relationship in college. But one day, he stumbles upon a grim-looking man in what seems to be a shady drug dealer—and bolts in terror. Fate, however, has other plans. Han-Eul runs into the supposed drug dealer, Choi Da-Jeong, once again in a club he only joined to follow his crush. But before he knows it, he ends up at his place! A fluffy, sweet whirlwind romance between the slightly airheaded Han-Eul and the unexpectedly charming Da-Jeong unfolds!

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Trapped With the Male Lead in a Horror Game
description:
As an NPC stuck in the horror game, Charlotte sees a chance for freedom with the arrival of the handsome male lead, Dietrich. Desperate to escape, Charlotte aims to help Dietrich beat every level and unlock the final room. However, she is also forced by the game system to hinder him by obeying its mysterious and cruel demands. Can Charlotte's growing feelings for Dietrich break her free from her passive NPC role and escape the deadly game, or will her story lead to a chilling Game Over? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Countdown of My Death Is Spamming My Status Window
description:
The Repentance Before Death is a webnovel widely hated for its awful quality. This never kept Yul-jeong Kwon from loving the series...until the author decided to kill off her favorite character. Ready to fight for her fave, Yul-jeong borrowed a backhoe to wreck the writer’s house. Unfortunately, she met with an accident and, when she opened her eyes, found herself in the world of her favorite webnovel as Mitchelle Nephthys, one of its most notorious villains.

(Source: Tapas)

Kim Gitae looks like your typical college student—aside from his killer looks and strangely eerie vibe. But there's one thing that sets him apart: he can see ghosts. Spirits swarm him day and night, desperate to possess his body, and the only way he can fend them off... is by jerking off every night. Yeah, it’s as exhausting as it sounds. All Gitae wants is a normal life—but things take a wild turn when a naked ghost named Lee Serin suddenly appears with an offer he can’t ignore. If he agrees to sleep with her, she’ll use her powers to protect him from other spirits. A ghostly hookup for a shot at peace—what could possibly go wrong? Gitae’s not-so-average college life just got a whole lot weirder.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Some things are thicker than water. Kwak Jahyung lives his life surrounded by hot women - too bad they just happen to be his sisters, as his playboy father has more children than he can count. But boys will be boys, and Jahyung is no exception. After his older sister Hanna gives him a potion meant to screw him over, the two find themselves in a sticky situation that goes to show family can be closer than you’d ever imagine…

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

display_title: The Video Game Store Under the Barbershop
description:
High school freshman Mi-So is enthralled when she sees her classmate Hyo-Jeong playing a retro handheld video game on the train. Hyo-Jeong’s always seemed kind of intimidating, but the way her eyes sparkle as she plays makes Mi-So want to learn more about retro games, and muster up the courage to befriend her. When Mi-So and her older brother Min-Jun head to the old video game store in their town, not only do they find that it's run by Hyo-Jeong and her older sister, they also discover a nostalgic portal to the past… 

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Born into a cursed noble family, Claude Ambrosia grows up to become the villain who destroys the empire in the novel “Flower of Darkness.” Enter Sarah Millen, the writer of this story, who is determined to change Claude’s tragic ending as his new nanny. Though cold to her at first, Claude slowly opens up to Sarah, who encourages the young boy to see his distant father, Duke Ethan Ambrosia. Can Sarah help this father and son heal? Or will the curse that haunts this family spell doom for them all? 

(Source: Tapas)

Katisha Ainsley's adoptive grandfather dies and leaves her with a grieving heart... as well as an incredible fortune! Katisha's grandpa was actually the former Duke Blasco, the head of a villainous family. Fearing what the Blascos would do to get the inheritance, Katisha joins them to reverse the will. But as they work together, she begins to like the evil family, and they start finding her too cute to hate. Can Katisha safely return the Blascos' riches, or will she stay the villains' heiress? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Hiding a Warehouse in the Apocalypse
description:
Imagine you are stuck inside a warehouse while the world is experiencing an apocalypse. That’s exactly what’s happening to Jeong-gyeom, except he suddenly awakens a very odd but powerful ability to store anything in a parallel dimension, giving him the tools to defeat the creatures wreaking havoc on the world. But as he ventures into the ravaged city of Seoul, he realizes there is more to this apocalypse than meets the eye as he encounters other survivors and mysterious monsters on his quest to find his family. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

How far would you be willing to go for love? The unavoidable temptation to destroy one’s deepening love is an age-old dilemma for many. This provocative collection of love stories will show you how dangerous passion can sometimes be.

(Source: WEBTOON) 

Stories included:
1. **Bulgeunbamui Yeonindeul** (붉은밤의 연인들, The Lovers of Crimson Night)
2. **Relivable-ui Ice Cream** (리리버블의 아이스크림, Riri Bubble's Ice Cream)
3. **Dohwa♡Jupasu** (도화♡주파수, Love Frequency )
4. **Gocheungbildingeseo Tteoreojin Geu Gaemineun** (고층빌딩에서 떨어진 그 개미는, The Ant that Fell from a High-rise)
5. **Orange Scandal** (오렌지 스캔들)

When a zombie outbreak overruns Seoul, the government abandons the city to its fate. Amid the chaos, ex-special forces bodyguard Shin-U fights to protect his skittish charge, Te-Bek. But as every day brings them closer to death, their bond grows harder to resist. Can love survive an apocalypse?

(Source: Manta)

display_title: I Became the Young Villain's Sister-in-Law
description:
Reborn as an amnesiac extra, Elia craves a simple life in the forest. But fate intervenes when she rescues a child who uncannily resembles her lost brother... and is the story’s villain. Suddenly thrust into the main plot, she fights to lift a fairy curse off the villain’s brother and even enters a contract marriage. Elia is beginning to wonder… is she the cause of all this trouble? 

(Source: Tapas)

In a cynical world where love has lost its luster, 37-year-old Ha-Yeong Kim is merely a shell of her former self. But in a twist of fate, she’s catapulted back in time, inhabiting the body and vibrant spirit of her 17-year-old self, Seon Kim, and reliving an era of passionate love and limitless potential. Empowered by her knowledge of what’s to come, Seon embarks on a mission to reshape her friends’ destinies. Bouncing between past and present, orchestrating grand changes, Seon begins to discover that altering others’ lives might be the key to rediscovering love, purpose, and the courage to dream again. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Disaster is Always By My Side
description:
Everything seems perfect in Da-Mi Yun's life. Her career prospects look bright, and her childhood crush Ho-Won even moved back to Korea to confess to her. But her world turns upside down when an anonymous letter leads her to a mysterious house, where she ends up trapped for three hours… except in the outside world, a decade has passed and Da-Mi has been declared dead! Can Jae-Nan, the mysterious, surly god and owner of the home, help her navigate this chaos? Why does disaster strike wherever she goes? And why is this unhelpful god having prophetic dreams about them being together?! 

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

One day, completely against his will, Kim Namju finds himself hexed by a sparkly fairy named Seobi—and just like that, he becomes the unwilling mascot of a team of magical girls. Their mission? To defeat the Demons of Desire, monsters born from the collective lust of humanity, who are now plotting to take over Earth. So far, so weird—but then comes the kicker. To truly purify these lust-fueled demons, Namju has to help the magical girls and monsters fulfill their wildest desires. Yes, all of them. Cue awkward moans, questionable missions, and Namju screaming,

*“This is NOT what I signed up for!”*

Now stuck between sparkles and sin, Namju must somehow save the world, preserve his sanity, and—if possible—not die of embarrassment. Saving Earth has never been this extra.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Anything and everything—Unhwi Yeon, heir apparent to the Heavenly Demonic Cult, owes his master at least that much. Unable to learn who is backing the cult members who betrayed them both, Unhwi is forced to flee into the body of Unhwi Dang with the help of forbidden magic. Isolated, alone, years into his future, moving from one assassination attempt to another—but capable of cultivating Naegong for the first time in his life. Anything necessary to protect his master is as good as done.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Obsessed With Hazel the Sweet Witch
description:
Waking up in a fairy tale she illustrated, Hazel is rumored to be a wicked, man-eating witch. In truth, all she wants to do is bake sweets and share the kindness. So when the adorable Luna and Luca show up at the door of her gingerbread house, Hazel is determined to care for the siblings. However, things go awry when their guardian and brother, Grand Duke Elliot Blaine, show up, accusing her of kidnapping them. Now, with her charm and cooking skills, Hazel must prove she is indeed a sweet witch! 

(Source: Tapas)

Children--pure, innocent, and ready for a new beginning with their foster parents. But here at the Dead Mansion, those seemingly innocent features become lethal assets. Our orphans are schooled under the finest instructors, ensuring they meet your highest expectations and are sure to impress. However, these guardian angels come with a steep price tag. Perfection, after all, is a cruel mistress. Would you like to see the catalog now? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

The strength of a Valhalla warrior comes from the Saga, a magical power born from the feats and achievements of their past life. Although Taeho was the world's greatest pro gamer and not a warrior, his character, the valiant Karstedt, was a legend in the world of Dark Age. Taeho must now begin a new saga to end Ragnarok and prevent the world from being destroyed.

(Source: WEBTOON)

There are people in the world who particularly catch others' attention. Jun Kang, who lived as the 'good model student' while secretly hiding his miserable one-sided love, finds himself entangled with Yohan Go, a classmate he now shares a class with in the second year... What if he had liked Yohan Go instead? 

*"Jun, how is it? The taste of first love."* 

(Source: Mr.Blue)

The great house of the Azure Mountain Yeon clan was annihilated by forces that conspired against them. The only survivor was Yeon Hojung. Left alone in the uncaring expanse of the central plains, Hojung turned to the path of darkness for survival and ruthlessly chased power to become the Dark Emperor. After a long, bloody battle that ended in his demise, Hojung reawakens to find himself 26 years in the past with his beloved Yeon Clan and a second chance at life. 

(Source: Tapas)

Harem life begins for James, a returning college student, with a stable of foxy cougars!

*"Were older women supposed to be this sexy?!"*

(Source: DAYcomics)

display_title: This Wasn’t in My Adoption Plan!
description:
I spent a decade cleaning up after Duke Havenik Brauno’s mess only to be murdered by him? Reincarnated as Aerin Brauno, an illegitimate child of the Brauno family, she’s horrified to find her adoptive father is none other than the man who killed her. This time, Aerin refuses to let him control her fate. Armed with the knowledge from her past life, she’s determined to escape his grasp and find a new path. Can she rewrite her destiny, outsmart the deadly Duke, and maybe even save the Brauno family?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: I Was the Real Head of the House
description:
Born powerless in a family of water awakeners, Riarte Elheim was sacrificed for her twin brother and met an untimely death. Reborn three years before her tragic end, she vows to abandon the family that betrayed her. With Mikhail Virche, the cunning heir of the Virche family, by her side, Riarte begins a new life—but will her second chance lead to freedom or ruin? 

(Source: Tapas)

How would you win over an enemy who just won't stop killing you? Laila thought she had escaped death by figuring out how to turn back time, but her assassin finds her again... and again... and again! All because her sadistic villain of a father had to murder his entire family... When all her evasion plans fail, there's only one option left: coddle her enemy through his childhood and hope he'll spare her when he comes back to exact his revenge. But why is this wacko so pigheaded?!

(Source: Tapas)

After retiring from gymnastics, Han Ji-Won thought his biggest challenges were behind him. Turns out, winning Olympic medals was easy compared to surviving university as a painfully shy ex-superstar. Enter Kwon Jung-Woo—campus heartthrob, basketball star, and a whole new world of trouble wrapped up in a perfect smile. But just when Ji-Won thinks he has Jung-Woo figured out, he discovers a surprisingly sweet side beneath that cold exterior. Can this unlikely duo overcome their differences and stick the landing on their budding romance? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes nine extra chapters.*

Yeong, nicknamed “Contest God” for her middle school wins, faces a chaotic start to high school when a contest with a huge prize is announced. The catch? It requires a six-person team. After a class project forces Yeong, her best friend Hana, and four unlikely teammates together, Yeong learns about the challenges of teamwork. But when the prize money doubles, the mismatched group decides to enter, sparking drama and unexpected bonds. Will they find success -- and maybe something more?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: To Whom It No Longer Concerns
description:
Exploited by her brother, betrayed by her sister, and killed by her husband. So ended the tragic story of Ariana Lopez--until, at the moment of her death, she suddenly finds herself back in the past. Now that she has a chance to do it all over again, she enlists the help of Duke Dante Heigenberg, the most feared and desired man in the entire empire, to take revenge against her family and reclaim what’s rightfully hers. But strangely, the duke seems to want Ariana more than just for her extraordinary musical talent...

(Source: WEBTOON)

Gi-Hu, a high schooler with a passion for photographing the sky, dreams of entering a photography contest. However, the contest requires a portrait photo, which he’s terrible at. He enlists the help of Ha-neul, a mysterious new transfer student who accidentally appears in one of Gi-Hu’s sky photos. Despite his struggles, he finds himself wanting to take more photos of her. As they prepare for the school festival, Gi-Hu becomes more intrigued by Ha-Neul, while she, initially misjudging him, helps him out of guilt after realizing she underestimated his abilities. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

To regain his peace, Gangchan must welcome his blood-curdling, smoking neighbor and her housemates into his home.

(Source: Toomics)

Waking up in a novel is bad enough, but being the villainess Daphne Peregrine is even worse! Knowing the doomed character's fate, Daphne starts mending her strained relationship with her family, hoping they'll let her move to a peaceful land. Since she'll need money, Daphne asks the enigmatic Archduke Luciel Gresbel to go into the antidote-making business with her so she can use his noble connections. Will the original Daphne's past misdeeds ruin her plans, or can she dodge her untimely death?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: There Are No Bad Warriors in This World
description:
Hyeonseok Choi finally becomes the undisputed heavyweight MMA champion of the world, but gets hit by a truck, and dies. A fairy, Rahel, appears and convinces him to fight as a hero in the afterlife, but accidentally sends him to the side of the demons. Stuck in the demon world, he sweet talks his way into positions of power, but slowly discovers this battle between good and evil isn't as clearcut as it seems.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Mistaken as the Monster Duke's Wife
description:
When Lia Dellis comes across a dying man in need of help, she never could have imagined a curse would drive him to attack her. That's why she hits him over the head with a rock! Feeling guilty, Lia nurses him back to health only to realize that he's Dillian Synaize, the ruthless monster duke. To make matters worse, Dillian has lost all his memories and inexplicably thinks Lia is his wife. Can Lia escape the grasp of this so-called monster before he remembers that she was the one who hit him? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: My Virtual God is a Teenage Girl
description:
From good looks, brains, hot body, wealth, and a gorgeous family. It seemed like Jumin’s life was god perfect. Until he realized that his world was merely a simulation controlled by… well, a teenage girl! With just a click of her mouse, Jumin loses everything and returns to high school! Will he break free from the program and reclaim what he lost? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

As a fellow aspiring saint with healing powers, Belze spent her whole childhood being compared to the ever-so-perfect Diana. So when offered the chance to expose her rival's family for treason, she doesn't think twice... But it all turns out to be a trap that only gets herself and her benevolent sponsor framed and executed! Luckily, she's given a second shot: She wakes up at the age of 5 again, determined to repay her benefactors this time. But turning a new leaf is easier said than done... 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I Couldn't Care Less About the Original, I'm Just Trying to Survive
description:
In my past life, I was Soonjung Lee, but I died from overwork. When I awoke in the novel I’m Choosing the Sub Male Lead in This Life!, I swore that I wouldn't suffer again--I'd get rich and live as I pleased! But the side character I transmigrated into, Penelope, is nothing more than the widowed baroness of a poor territory. I need to do better--I must become wealthy! But, unfortunately, to reach my goal I'll need the lord of the magic tower's help, and he’s not exactly the nicest guy... 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Dragon's Guide to Defying Death
description:
After suffering from an illness that cut his life short, Royce wakes up to find himself as a character from the story he read until his last moments. As a dragon hatchling, he believes his long life is just beginning. That is, until Royce realizes he's the son of the dragon who goes berserk due to his untimely death! Now, Royce is looking to race against the clock, even if his every move leads to a near-death experience. Will he be able to change his fate, or will he get stopped in his tracks? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I Became the Squirrel That Saves the Villain
description:
Of all the things to wake up as, a squirrel is the last thing she expected. Sure, she’s technically a divine beast from a novel, but she’s a squirrel all the same. Determined to make the best of it, Momo—Inky—whatever her name is now—gets to work. And while she thought a little kindness would be enough to keep Yohan from villainy, she didn’t think it would lead to a new human life as Yurika, a caring family, love... or the kind of secrets that could change everything the world has ever known.

(Source: Tapas)

When defective omega and skilled mercenary Erad Nox is hired to find a runaway alpha mage and bring him back to the Tower of Mages, he thinks it'll be the easiest job he's ever done in his life. Little did he expect that upon meeting Lucian, the mage in question, he'd suddenly enter his heat cycle - something that hasn't happened in the past 11 years. Intrigued by this strange phenomenon, Lucian asks him to stay and become his research subject. As they spend time together, Nox finds himself drawn to Lucian's compassion and bashful kindness, while Lucian begins to fall in love with Nox's fearless strength and integrity.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Liana Le Merdi, the last remaining pyromancer, hopes to avenge her family's murder by the great Alseid Hallias. At death's door, she is given a second chance at life by the fire god... as her three-year-old self? When she stands in front of Hallias again, instead of being killed, she ends up being adopted! She must now work with her enemy to uncover the truth behind her family’s death while escaping those who want to abuse her power. How will she survive when she can’t even pronounce her r’s? 

(Source: Tapas)

Was there ever a greater tragedy than love turned to hate? Such is the tragic downfall of Emperor Ludwig of Berzantium, as he is betrayed and murdered in a fiery blaze by his empress. Olive Charleterre was once a bright young debutante, until her spirit was broken by the emperor’s cruelty. Yet when Ludwig opens his eyes, he finds he has been sent back in time to his childhood. Whether he uses this boon to reclaim his lost love and forge a new path away from his villainous future -- only time will tell. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

As a new transfer in his second year of high school, Gu Do-Hun faces relentless bullying for no clear reason—but his eyes are set on only one person: his quiet classmate, Jeong Yu-Won. Yu-Won tries to keep his distance, but Do-Hun’s strange, unreadable pull draws him in until a sudden, devastating incident rips them apart. Years later, they reunite as team leader and subordinate. Yu-Won tries to keep things professional, but the past refuses to stay buried...and neither does Do-Hun’s gaze. Something about him feels familiar yet entirely different. Has he changed…or was he always like this?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: I Possessed a Villainess, but I Wanna Raise Cats!
description:
Seo Eunsu was only looking for her lost cat when she was hit by a truck. The next thing she knows, she's in the body of Lewayne Rarsel, a villainess from a novel! She's the cruel paramour of the emperor and has nothing but contempt for therianthropes, people with animal forms. Now, the only way to avoid her fate of becoming the emperor's consort is to marry Duke Dimitri de Blua, a feline therian. But can the duke forget her notorious reputation and realize that Lewayne just wants to raise cats? 

(Source: Tapas)

A one-night mistake brings Yesol to the doorstep of Hanrim, a cold yet familiar face from his high school baseball team. Only now, Hanrim isn’t just cold—he’s holding a grudge. What exactly happened between them, and why can’t Yesol remember? 

(Source: Manta)

All Colonel Kang Hajeong wants is to retire peacefully from the Esper & Guide Special Forces, but his plans are ruined when he’s partnered with a powerful new esper named Kim Muhyeok. Worse yet, a sudden ambush cuts his life tragically short… or does it? Waking up in the hospital years later, he finds himself in the body of Sergeant Kang, a different person who happens to share the same name. But that’s not the only mystery to be solved. Strange things are happening at the Esper/Guide center, and his old partner, Kim Muhyeok, still needs his help…

(Source: Tappytoon)
