display_title: Camellia: Mastering the Three Kingdoms as Alice
description:
Dong-Baek’s life takes an unexpected turn when a mysterious crow pulls her from the modern world into ancient China. Trapped in the Three Kingdoms era, she must disguise herself as a man and gather allies from each kingdom in order to survive. Amid heavy political intrigue, she also faces a rival determined to defeat her. Can Dong-Baek outsmart this enemy and navigate the dangerous world she now inhabits?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*"I'm gonna live a normal life!"*

Cho-Eun, the heir to the powerful underground clan, Hongsal, has entered university. Her only wish? To make lots of friends and enjoy a peaceful, ordinary college life. But who are these four mysterious guys constantly hanging around her?

 *"Are you my enemy? My ally? Or... do you like me?"*

Thrown into a whirlwind of emotions at twenty, can Cho-Eun finally achieve the campus life she's always dreamed of?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Gyeong-Bok Lee possesses a gift that grants him a sixth sense and supernatural foresight -- however, this ability comes at a steep price, debilitating him each time it is used. But when Gyeong-Bok tries virtual reality gaming for the first time, he makes a startling discovery: not only could he leverage his psychic ability to gain a significant advantage in the virtual world, but he was also entirely free from its afflictions. Seizing this opportunity, Gyeong-Bok sets out to become a legendary video game streamer, turning his curse into his greatest asset. 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Song Jeong-Won is an active member of the BDSM community, offering guidance and advice to newcomers. One day, he comes across a distressing post from Kang Hoseob, a beginner who has fallen into the hands of an abusive dom and is seeking help. Realizing that Hoseob lacks even the most basic knowledge of BDSM, Jeong-Won steps in—not just to rescue him but to personally guide him as his temporary dom.

*"Master, I'll be good...I promise."*

Jeong-Won takes on the challenge, but can he truly teach Hoseob the foundations of trust, consent, and desire before it's too late?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jeong Ji-Heon, a once-promising swimmer, retired early due to an injury and now works diligently at a sports agency. The hottest topic in the sports marketing world is none other than Kwon Jae-Kyoung, and agencies are fiercely competing to win him over. Ji-Heon’s boss orders him to secure a meeting with Jae-Kyoung at all costs. Using a trivial connection from a decade ago when they briefly trained at the same aquatic center, Ji-Heon miraculously succeeds in arranging a meeting. However, when they finally meet, Jae-Kyoung shows no interest in contract terms and instead seems strangely fixated on Ji-Heon’s genetic traits…

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Genius Grandson of the Loan Shark King
description:
Mu-Hyeok Kim, grandson of the legendary "Loan Shark King," has done all of the family's dirty work for 30 years, only to be betrayed and killed by his uncle's orders. Mysteriously, he wakes up in 1990, in his first year of high school, just in time to save his grandmother on his father's side from a heart attack. Now in need of money to pay for her hospital bills, Mu-Hyeok goes to his mother's family to ingratiate himself with the Loan Shark King, but this time, he plans to take his money and get revenge.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Due to her terminal illness, Princess Juliet has spent her entire life inside the Rozenta Kingdom's palace without any peers to talk to. So she's delighted to meet a kind young servant named Lete who provides her with much-needed company. However, their pleasant strolls end abruptly when Juliet is suddenly told to marry the archduke of Herventel, Enoch Letrachi. What comes as a greater shock is that Lete is actually Enoch, and that he has refused to see Juliet until she signs the marriage papers! Can Juliet find happiness when her trust in her husband-to-be has already been shattered? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Melt, the sheltered daughter of a notorious mob boss, has spent her life like a fragile flower trapped in a gilded cage. On her 20th birthday, instead of receiving a gift, she is kidnapped by a mysterious man named Budd. Together, they are thrust into a citywide chase, with hitmen, hounds, and every thug in town hot on their trail. But why is Melt the most wanted woman in New Jersey? As secrets unravel and bodies pile up, this gritty noir tale spirals into a storm of love, murder, and betrayal. Melt Bless You!

(Source: Lezhin US)

The teachers' struggle to send Si-Yun Min, the son of the chairman of the IR Group, to a prestigious university begins! With a $1 million performance bonus at stake, it's no easy task due to Si-Yun's indifference toward studying. In the end, the teachers dedicate themselves fully to the challenge.

*"Si-Yun, are you curious to see what's underneath my panties...?"*

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

This isn’t the life I wanted!!! After reliving high school as Jin-U, the boy he once bullied, An-Cheol is now a new person. But his new life takes an unexpected turn. Once again, he is sent back in time to live as Jin-U. But this time, Jin-U is also back... as An-Cheol!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

display_title: The S-Class Guide as Sweet as Honey
description:
Jin Hyoseop is an S-class guide whose powers leave him aroused and smelling as sweet as honey. In order to hide his embarrassing secret, he joins a C-class guild on the condition that he only does the minimum guiding required to heal his esper guildmates. It shouldn’t be an issue since the guild’s kind and understanding commander Andante assures him that they don’t handle any dangerous jobs. But then, why does everyone keep coming back injured and in desperate need of guiding? Little does Hyoseop know that he has just stepped into a lair of criminal S-class espers!

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: The Roguish Guard in a Medieval Fantasy
description:
In a brutal medieval world where innocence means life and guilt means death, Aron, captain of the castle guard, enforces order within the fortress. But when demons begin to corrupt men’s hearts, violent events erupt, including repeated attempts to assassinate the lady of the castle. As Aron hunts the culprits, he encounters a demon that marks him, granting incredible strength but tainting his body with dark magic. Now, with his mind clouded and powers growing, Aron must unravel the mystery before the castle and his soul fall to ruin.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Going to Bed With My Hater
description:
One moment, critic Hee-Su is posting hateful comments about top actor Do-Hyun. The next? She's waking up naked in his bed! As if fated by a cruel joke, Hee-Su is forced to co-star with Do-Hyun in a new reality show called, "Going To Bed With Your Hater." With the cameras rolling, Do-Hyun's aggressive advances feel all too real, and Hee-Su's pure hatred begins to melt into a dangerously sizzling passion. Can she resist the enemy she's accidentally falling in love with?

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Changing the Genre From Angst to Heartwarming
description:
I've been reincarnated. Into a novel I used to enjoy in my past life, no less! My name is Renatis, and I'll be playing the part of little sister to the female lead in this dark, tragic whirlwind of a story where a beastly bad boy shatters my sister's hopes, dreams, and her life. My sister is too good and too beautiful, and I'm not about to let that happen to my perfect sister. So, I'm taking charge. I shall turn this dark, tragic story into a heartwarming tale of healing. I will save my sister.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Seol Ipsae likes to keep things simple and clean: relationships never go further than physical, and one night per guy is the standard, and only the best will do. So when he runs into the big, bumbling himbo Jeong Han-Eum, he can’t believe his eyes; at first, it’s because the dude’s such a nerd, but then it’s because this nerd is hiding a big, uh, “secret.” Huge, in fact. Massive. One of the biggest Ipsae has ever seen. Y’know, maybe nerdy boys aren’t so bad after all…

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes six side story chapters.*

There’s a convenience store that feels uncomfortable but somehow keeps drawing you in. One day, a new night-shift part-timer appears at the small convenience store -- his rugged looks fill everyone with unease, but soon he brings about a refreshing change to this small convenience store. He helps not only his coworkers but also customers, resolving their worries and troubles. Who is this mysterious night-shift part-timer?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Shuelina has only ever wanted to be loved as she grew up in an orphanage. But after her birth father rejected her in a previous life, she tries to find a family who will accept her in this one. Luckily, Archduke Bylot and his sons fall for her indomitable spirit, and they shower her with the love she has longed for. But once they find out she's the long-lost imperial princess, can she be a part of their family? Or will she have to go back to the people who sent her away in the first place?

(Source: Tapas)

Jun-Won, a perfect man, and Ju-I, a woman who knows her abilities and charms, strike an unusual deal: they will date with one strict condition—no falling in love. What starts as a simple arrangement soon becomes complicated as unexpected feelings begin to surface. Can they stick to their promise, or will emotions get the better of them? Dive into a world where love is both the goal and the enemy, and find out if their hearts will follow the rules or break free. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

*Note: Includes nine extra chapters.*

Hell? Far from it. After all, isn't this what you wanted? After choosing to end his own life, Hui-Seo Yun awakens adrift on a wooden raft in a bleak, desolate ocean. Attacked by a monstrous creature that defies reality, he questions if it's a dream... but his instincts scream otherwise. Just when all seems lost, he is rescued by a mysterious woman who resembles a grim reaper. As he catches his breath, Hui-Seo asks: am I in hell?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: A Second Chance for the Outcast Prince
description:
In a nation where alphas and omegas hold all the power, being born as a beta is a terrible fate for Prince Renato El Fleuret. His life is a string of tragedies leading to a cruel end… until he is reawoken in the past! Determined to make the most of this second chance at life, Renato enlists the help of Kalid, a prince from a neighboring kingdom with a complicated backstory of his own. Together, they must do everything in their power to fight for their own happily-ever-after… 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Sleepless nights, haunting dreams, and a desperate wish bring college student Choi Woo-hyuk face-to-face with an unexpected visitor—an impossibly handsome incubus who claims to have been summoned by his own desires. But when fantasy and reality blur, Woo-hyuk’s restless nights take a steamy, surreal turn he never saw coming!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Actor Yoo Haek-Yeong has been in love with his spoiled friend Seo Kwon-Yeong for more than 10 years. Not only is it a hopeless love, but it’s downright abuse as Kwon-Yeong takes complete advantage of Haek-Yeong’s feelings to constantly boss him around. Haek-Yeong just can’t help letting Kwon-Yeong string him along… until he connects with his crush’s older brother, Kwon-Lim, the top actor in Korea. Unlike his manipulative brother, Kwon-Lim is thoughtful and kind—and incredibly handsome. As Haek-Yeong grows closer to Kwon-Lim, the dynamic between him and his old friend begins to shift—and so do Haek-Yeong’s long-harbored feelings… 

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Ian the Illegitimate Son Was an Emperor
description:
Betrayed and on the brink of death, Ian Verocian, a mage and the emperor of the Variel Empire, is sent a hundred years back in time by a forbidden spell. He wakes up as Ian Vratz, a margrave's illegitimate son, and soon learns he's about to be sent off to a desert tribe as part of a political treaty. Now, Ian must use his wits and powerful magic to gather allies and figure out the plots lurking around him. The question is... can this young mage change his fate before time runs out once more? 

(Source: Tapas)

After dying in an experiment, Anisha wakes up in the past at the orphanage where she was sold to a mad scientist. However, things take a different path when she is adopted by Duke Aubrey to replace his late daughter, Annette. Though having to live as someone else, she decides to enjoy her new freedom while plotting revenge on the scientist. But as she starts to recall facts unknown in her former life, Anisha wonders if it's a side effect of the experiments or if her past holds deeper secrets… 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I Want to Prey on You
description:
Ordered into a political marriage with a northern tribe, Princess Eun-Woo wanders out in distress and encounters a massive tiger with an injured paw. As she treats the tiger’s wound, she tells the tiger that he may “eat her” out of despair. Baek Hwi, the king of the tiger clan, is lost for words but is ignited with a different kind of hunger. Unable to forget her, the tiger king begins relentlessly pursuing Eun-Woo, determined to make her his mate…

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: The Villainess Just Wants to Live in Peace!
description:
I quit my terrible job and set off on a trip, only to die in a plane crash! I woke up to find myself reincarnated as Tanasia Breloff, the villainess of a novel I once read. Tanasia was scheming to harm her sister out of jealousy, but I’m not interested in villainy; I’m content being a beautiful, wealthy noblewoman! But wait… don’t I eventually get killed in the novel? I must prevent my death—so I can live the peaceful life I’ve dreamed of! This series contains themes regarding abuse and may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Gi-Ju is highly competent, but when it comes to love, she always seems to choose the wrong guy. This time, she thought things would be different. But again her faith is betrayed, and during a heated argument, she ends up falling down a flight of stairs. When she awakens in the hospital, she starts seeing suspicious ‘relationship reviews’ of others! ‘Love reviews written by their former exes…?’ 

Could this strange phenomenon be able to save Gi-Ju’s love life? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

*Note: Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.*

*"Cheong-Un, parry the attack! Move faster or the obstacle course will kill you!”* 

The progenitors of the great Wudang sect and the mighty Shaolin encounter post-ascension issues when they find themselves reduced to servants in the godly realm. Their only hope and escape from their divine chores lie in the hands of less-than-average Cheong-Un, who can hardly beat his peers in the sect. Can the masters raise an average boy into a master of martial arts and finally relieve themselves of their menial chores?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Once there was an emperor’s vassal who journeyed abroad to discover the secret of immortality. A lifetime went by, and the emperor and empire fell to dust. The vassal, now known as Chief, returns to the realm, bringing with him a boy of mysterious origin and immense power named Asura. In this unfamiliar world, Chief and Asura must reckon with peril and unrest among martial arts sects ruled by the nefarious Fort Sovereign. One thing, however, is for certain: the realm will never be the same.

(Source: WEBTOON)

When brawler Kang Ji-Hwan is forced to transfer schools, the last thing he expects is to rely on the top student in class. But after accidentally tearing model-student Han Yu-Seong’s uniform, and discovering the fierce tiger tattoo hidden on his back, Ji-Hwan offers a deal: he’ll keep Yu-Seong’s secret if Yu-Seong becomes his tutor. To push Ji-Hwan away, Yu-Seong turns up the heat with bold, intimate teasing… but the closer he gets, the more Ji-Hwan finds himself drawn in. Between hidden claws and rising tension, two boys with tiger hearts may be getting far too close for comfort.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Season 2 is rated R19.*

Jaerim, a.k.a. the “Executioner”, the most fearsome villain of all, is about to marry his civilian girlfriend! But before they can say “I do”, he has to survive life with her family, who just so happen to be the most powerful superhero clan. Can he keep his identity a secret and convince them that he’s the perfect son-in-law?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Lia, a penguin-turned-human, hides her anthropomorphic self from her dad for fear of abandonment and hatred. Fleeing her home, she’s discovered by Souradel—a killer whale anthro with a thing for penguins. His obsession with her fluffy belly leads to wild misunderstandings, mistaken kisses, and hilariously tense encounters. Now, Lia must dodge his affections while keeping her identity secret.

(Source: Tapas)

Lee Jeonghyo, daughter of a legendary S-rank hunter, despises dungeons. After quitting her job, she plans to open a cafe in a beach town to honor her late father. But stepping into the old motel she bought, she unexpectedly awakens as a hotelier-class hunter! Now, she’s juggling hotel management with aiding stranded hunters in her dungeon hotel. Things get even trickier when her old classmate and S-rank hunter, Han Wuhyeon, checks in. Can she handle the chaos while reconnecting with her past? 

(Source: Tapas)

*I could kill you if I wanted.* 

Hale Windsor was a renowned hitman until he is betrayed and loses the love of his life. With nothing left to live for, he begins a war of revenge on the very organization he used to work for. That is, until he meets Marine, a girl who brings color back into his black and white existence. 

(Source: Manta)

When Hae-Il drowns saving a boy at sea, his final thought is of Pa-Do, the childhood crush he could never forget. Instead of sinking into darkness, however, Hae-Il wakes up with an impossible second chance. But this new life is far from perfect—Pa-Do is cold and distant, and Hae-Il's body dissolves into seafoam with every sting of rejection.

(Source: Manta, edited)

display_title: Leave Your Divorce to a Professional Lawyer
description:
Natasha, a sharp divorce lawyer in an empire where divorce is gradually losing its stigma, thrives on high-paying cases. Driven by her love of money, she's ready to tackle any challenge—whether it's freeing clients from infidelity or helping them escape their fate in a doomed romance fantasy novel. With her assistant Ivan by her side, Natasha navigates the complex, secretive lives of nobles, uncovering hidden truths and securing divorces while always standing firmly by her clients' side.

(Source: Tapas)

Namjoo moves into a new home, only to discover that his next-door neighbor, Juhee, is no ordinary woman. Like a real-life gacha game, her face and body transform at random! And the only way to revert to her original form? Multiple orgasms. When Namjoo accidentally stumbles upon her secret, Juhee strikes a deal—they'll be fuck buddies. They say a man’s ideal type is a woman he’s never seen before... but what if she changes every time? A thrilling, unpredictable romance begins with the ever-changing "Gacha Girl" next door!

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The New Hire is the Demon Lord
description:
Dullahan, the demon lord who once terrorized the world, finally revives in modern-day Korea, eager to take revenge against the hero who defeated her centuries ago. But all she can find is his descendant, Yong-Rae Kim: a hapless, incompetent office worker with no prospects and no joy in life. Ending his life now would only be doing him a favor, so Dullahan decides to improve his life first… but Yong-Rae's two-timing girlfriend and his many strict superiors at work stand in the way. Can Dullahan crush the office hierarchy and awaken Yong-Rae's dormant hero abilities to make her revenge more satisfying? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Jun-Yeong helps Ji-Yun who gets lost in campus. When Ji-Yun starts to think about meeting Jun-Yeong again, they meet again in school retreat. Through the secret cupid game and the help from her classmates, Isabella slowly changes. First encounter and kindness in college, and my secret cupid.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

display_title: The Villain’s Daughter Plans to Run Away
description:
I'll make my evil dad good and survive this time! 

I was killed for being the villain's daughter, but when I opened my eyes, I was 14 years back in time. Too young and penniless, I decided to wait to escape... But why should I have to run away?! What if I train my dad to be good instead? 

(Source: Manta)

display_title: One Too Many Supporting Male Leads
description:
Drained of life after being sick for so long, Eun-Jae closes her eyes only to open them again as Roella Clemend, the female lead of the web novel she was reading in her final moments. While she may have gotten a second chance at life with a healthy body, there’s a catch. Roella has exactly one year to find “the true male lead” of the story to be able to continue living in this new world. But unfortunately for Roella, this task may be like trying to find a needle in a haystack…

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

A prosecutor-turned-royal must race against the clock to solve a string of serial murders… before she becomes the next victim! When an overworked criminal justice employee is suddenly reborn into a novel as the rebellious Princess Charlotte, she also finds herself engaged to the handsome Duke Adler. However, there’s one big problem: according to the novel’s synopsis, Charlotte is doomed to be killed on her wedding night, and the duke is the prime suspect. Now this princess must go undercover to capture the culprit behind the series of sinister crimes… and maybe capture some hearts along the way!

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

Possessing a character in a fictional story is one thing, but possessing a character in your own story is another… especially when you’ve become a dramatic villainess in a typical K-drama series. The only way Mi-So can escape from this world is to live through all of the episodes, but she has to deal with cliché tropes such as an arranged marriage with the male lead and an unnecessary rivalry with the female lead. Will Mi-So be able to break away from this predetermined destiny and find another happy ending for all of her characters? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Commoner orphan Julia Arte is cursed with repeatedly dying and being reborn on the same snowy mountain trail. Now on her ninth life, she is determined to break the curse by getting revenge on her former lover Vasily Marjoram, who not only left her to die but sent assassins to kill her. After becoming the second lady-in-waiting to House Marjoram's sworn enemy, Prince Lewisia Ortega, Julia pulls out all the stops to take down Vasily. But will her scheming bring more trouble than she bargained for?

(Source: Tapas)

When delinquent transfer student Ban Tae-Hyeon, rumored to be the brawler at the center of a schoolyard fight, walks into class, the strict and upright Kang Hyeon-Beom makes it his mission to keep him in check. Determined to reform Tae-Hyeon into a model student, Hyeon-Beom starts watching his every move… only to find himself slowly drawn into Tae-Hyeon’s orbit. As the line between discipline and friendship starts to blur, could Hyeon-Beom really be the one getting “reformed” instead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Princess's Guide to a Perfect Life
description:
After a fatal accident, Sia is transported into a historical drama as the baby princess of a lowly concubine. All she wants is to live peacefully with her new mother, but Sia's strength and intelligence gain her the favor of the crown prince and the king. Soon, she becomes a pawn in the hotly contested selection of the new queen. With the competing head concubines and their sons using her in their race to the throne, can baby Sia save herself from falling prey to this royal charade?

(Source: Tapas)

Junsu is an ordinary college student who spends an extraordinary amount of time trying to beat a pay-to-win hero collector game called Arcane Seoul. All his hours of painstaking gameplay finally pays off when he lands Cheonma, one of the ultimate SS-ranked characters in the game, seconds before a truck runs him over. Now, he finds himself as Jeonsa Kim, a basic tutorial-stage character who can learn any skill. Can he use his gaming knowledge to survive the godforsaken, magic-driven, and monster-ridden alternate world of Arcane Seoul?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Born from the legendary love between humans and dragons, the hybrid race known as Drik looks human but carries the strength, regeneration, and instinct of dragons, including a powerful heat cycle that returns again and again. Among them, Sieric Lorence stands apart, his bloodline so rich with dragon power that he has become an unrivaled knight. Sent by royal command to rescue researchers trapped in ancient ruins, Sieric crosses paths with Jahid, a petty thief trying to steal his sword, a blade forged from dragon bones. As Sieric prepares to punish him, fate strikes cruelly. His heat arrives unexpectedly, and without suppressants, he is left dangerously vulnerable. Noticing his condition, Jahid makes a bold offer. As a fellow Drik, he can help Sieric endure the heat, but only in exchange for his freedom.

In the heart of forgotten ruins, surrounded by danger and desire, a risky bargain is struck that could change both of their fates forever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jaheon comes from a lineage of omegas. Omegas who have raised the children of their branch families, only for them to be offered to the Snake God, Lord Mugo, every 12 years. Though it is said that Mugo handpicks his sacrifices no one in the head family believes such an old tale anymore. However, Jaheon knows that Lord Mugo came to him when he was a child and picked him to be the sacrifice, and even remembers the events of the day. 

Even though Jaheon has prepared himself, both body and mind, for as long as he could remember, upon entering Mugo's lair he quickly realizes that he doesn't want to be eaten as a sacrifice, at least not after finding out the "Lord Mugo" he adored was just one of the snake god's three personalities. Will the Snake God take pity on his sacrifice? Or will Jaheon be swallowed whole? 

(Surce: Lezhin US)

In a world where hunter rank is everything, Rank F Yun Seo-Ra is lucky to even have a job at the Hunter Association. But when she's trapped in a dungeon, she yells at the system, blaming her inability to escape on her low rank. Out of pity, it offers her an exclusive contract, which Seo-Ra accepts, soaring to Rank S! She begs the system to keep this a secret until she can earn enough money to quit her job. Can Seo-Ra resign with riches, or will her fellow Rank S hunters track her down first? 

(Source: Tapas, edited)
Side story chapters for Mad Dog (Haribo).

Shy and reserved Lee-Won has admired the charismatic Seo Han-Gun for years, but their unexpected friendship blossoms into first love during middle school. Torn apart by reality, they lose touch for eight years—until a chance reunion in Busan forces them to confront old wounds and lingering feelings. Can love overcome the pain of the past?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

*"You look like you'd be fun to mess with."*

These senior girls treated me like a pet, humiliating me every chance they got. But the tables have turned, and now they find themselves completely submitting to their junior.

*"I'm going to turn this whole relationship upside down. Get on your knees."*

(Source: DAYcomics)

A girl who has been alone her whole life stumbles upon a VR fantasy dating simulator that allows her to be who she always wanted to be — someone loved by everyone. She chooses a character named Crocetta Gaetani, who grew up neglected by others just like her. Now she’s stuck permanently in the video game world until she can win over one of the game’s male leads and beat the game. Will Crocetta be able to marry one of the male leads and finally return to her reality, or will she be stuck in this VR nightmare forever? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: No, I Only Charmed the Princess!
description:
As if dying from overwork doesn’t suck enough, imagine being reincarnated as a minor novel character who will also meet a pitiful end soon. With nothing to lose, Adelia makes the perilous journey to become the empire’s first white mage in 300 years. Why? To have the crown prince marry her so she can have the power to get revenge on her abusive family, of course! And once she becomes a member of the imperial family, Adelia can live happily receiving the love of her favorite character, Princess Ariana. But wait, she never asked for Crown Prince Lucian’s affection too...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: My Very Own Tower Strategy Guide
description:
15 days until the apocalypse happens. That's what Ho-Yeong Lee, a 29-year-old office worker, learns when he takes the mysterious medicine he got for saving a goblin from a bear trap. As it turns out, it allows him to level up more easily and provides him with a strategy guide! Everyone in the world is forced into groups to conquer the mysterious Apocalypse Tower, and Ho-Yeong has to find a way to work with his teammates so that everyone makes it to the top alive. Will his ability give him an advantage, or will it end up spelling out his doom? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

display_title: My New Family Is Too Nice to Me
description:
I was adopted into a new family after being rescued from my abusive family. Having a famous actress as a mother, an older pro golfer sister, and a younger idol sister was too good to be true on its own. But they're being way too nice to me.

*"Seon-Hu, I'll help you with your desires tonight."*

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

If there was a closet inside a closet, Joohwan would hide there. He's that desperate to hide that he's gay. Still, he's doing a pretty good job at hiding his sexual orientation, on his way to a promotion at his job, and has everything going great...right until he crosses paths with Sihyun during a major presentation for work. Unfortunately, Sihyun is devastatingly attractive. Perhaps attractive enough to drag Joohwan out of the closet...

(Source: Lezhin)

Have you ever been so angry that you wanted to break the laws of physics and throw down with a cosmic being? Well, you might if you’re Great—no, not “great”; I mean Great the Executioner. On planet Graymark, where the law decrees that all sinners must die, Great makes a name for himself butchering criminals in their thousands. Except now the law is no more, and Great must stand trial before the King of the Cosmos, Lohumlagaha. Enraged by fate, Great takes up his sword. It's just one last time… Or is it?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Hari Jeon is a high school student with a heart condition. One day, she is struck by a curse that causes her to zap everything and everyone around her whenever her heart races for Jeong-won, her secret crush. Yura Baek, a brash and sharp-tongued classmate who mysteriously knows about her curse, offers her a deal—he’ll help her keep it under control if she lets him use it. Can Hari find the courage to confess her feelings to her crush? Or will she stay in the safe zone of friendship? Get ready for Hari’s electrifying first love story! 

(Source: WEBTOON)

What could make a romance fantasy superfan happier than getting pulled into a fantasy world? But Daline Este’s dreams of being the protagonist in her story come crashing down when reality sinks in. She hasn’t been pulled into one of her favorite novels like she dreamed—instead, she's landed in a world on the cusp of crisis as several novels tangle together and threaten to tear it apart. Now, Daline must use her expertise to set the stories straight before her happy ending goes up in flames. 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I Will Protect My Tyrant Dad!
description:
Sien is your average adorable kid living in the country with her kind dad... or so she thought. It turns out her dad is actually an heir of a grand duke banished from an evil family! Sien will do anything to protect her innocent dad from the wickedness that awaits them. Join Sien on her adventure to keep her tyrant dad safe!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Gyu Park is a survivor who predicted and prepared for the coming apocalypse. In this ruined world, he is willing to do anything and everything he can to protect the comforts of his bomb shelter. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jin-Hyeok can't accept the sudden death of his boyfriend, Do-Seong, who passed away in a tragic accident two months ago. One night, he writes a letter to Do-Seong before falling asleep...and wakes up to find him standing right in front of him.

A heartfelt and mysterious story unfolds as Jin-Hyeok tries to hold on to the love he thought he'd lost forever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Bomtoon’s and Lezhin’s Saekgwi Danpyeonseon (색귀 단편선) Short Story Collection or Dirty Demon Collection in English.*

At a college welcome party, Kang Ju-Yeong overhears a juicy rumor about Choi Hyun, a popular student from the Physical Education department—apparently, he accepts professions of love from almost anyone, even strangers. As the drinks flow, the conversation escalates into a daring bet: whoever confesses their love to Choi Hyun wins 100 dollars. Uncomfortable with the vibe, Ju-Yeong leaves the party, only to run into Choi Hyun as he's breaking up with someone. Seizing the moment, Ju-Yeong blurts out:

*"Go out with me too!"*

But unlike the others, Ju-Yeong’s profession isn’t just a spur-of-the-moment gamble—he’s been secretly in love with Choi Hyun since high school. With Hyun caught off guard and no way to take it back, the two start dating that very night. Will Ju-Yeong’s long-time crush turn into a lasting relationship, or is this love destined to be just another fleeting romance?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Princess Soria has been cursed to live in her dilapidated kingdom as a chicken for the last century. Her curse can only be broken through true love with her Prince Charming. Unfortunately, the only fitting candidate for her comes in the form of Emperor Lenok, who doesn’t know a thing about romance! He also needs her help to save his empire from a long-term drought, a problem that can only be solved by breaking her curse and restoring her kingdom. But how is a poultry princess supposed to fall for such an unattractive ruler?!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ban Yuwon just wanted to get into college. But instead, he was summoned to an academy in another dimension. There, every student must climb the legendary Tower of Babel, built by Yuwon's own ancestor. Armed with the "Babylonian Code," an ability that lets him absorb and manipulate all languages, he sets out to conquer the tower and reclaim his family’s lost honor. However, with deadly monsters, hidden traps, and ruthless rivals from across dimensions, can Yuwon survive the climb?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Let Me Kidnap the Male Lead!
description:
Following a carriage crash, our heroine recalls being reincarnated as Vivian in a novel called "The Bloody Flower." Poor Vivian now knows she's a side villain who dies after kidnapping the male lead. But if she doesn't kidnap him and guide him to the female lead, the demon will destroy the world anyway! Unfortunately, the male lead was only described as "handsome," and this world is crawling with handsome men. Thirty kidnappings later, all Vivian has is a handful of good-looking fans who loved their luxury hostage experience. If only someone could point her to the man she's looking for...! 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Eliano, the daughter of a powerful duke, marries the seventh prince of Jakador, and they fall in love. But their happiness is short-lived when the prince ascends to the throne. After suffering a miscarriage, she is cruelly poisoned by her husband and dies. Eliano miraculously wakes up to find herself 21 years old and is now determined to avoid the tragic future she once lived. Will she be able to find happiness in this new life?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: A Ranker's Guide to the Good Life
description:
In a world filled with towers, dungeons, and monsters, some people have awakened with special powers. While these hunters risk their lives in battle and climb the world rankings, Jio Gyeon is happy to just sit back and enjoy a simple life of leisure. But Jio has a secret—she’s the strongest hunter in the world. But when a time traveling stranger warns her of humanity’s bleak future, will Jio finally take action? And what enemies are waiting for her to reveal her true identity? 

(Source: Tapas)

While livestreaming about his struggles, Si-Woo receives a donation with a strange request. He agrees, only to discover it came from Limen, the goddess of Eden, who has suddenly tasked him with defending her world from seven demon rulers. Ten years later, Si-Woo returns to Earth as the pope of Eden, only to find it overrun by monsters. The demon rulers show signs of reappearing, and to maintain his divine power, he must spread Limen’s faith across Earth. Can Pope Si-Woo complete his holy mission?

(Source: Tapas)

The first year of university is hard, but so is registering a fake marriage to a random alpha to score admission to a top university. It’s even harder keeping that marriage a secret from your classmates while doing just enough sexy stuff with your fake husband/roommate to prove your marriage is legit. But for Yidam, the hardest part of all is keeping his hands off the stranger he married.

(Source: Tapas)

Cha Yiseul is rich, reckless, and completely unapologetic about it. With her looks, money, and an endless roster of casual flings, life is one big party—until her mother cuts her off and kicks her out. Just as she hits rock bottom, a mysterious woman named Kang Sori appears, offering her a lifeline…and stirring up blurry memories of a drunken night they may—or may not—have shared. Who exactly is Sori, and why does Yiseul keep thinking about her?

(Source: Lezhin US)

As a young boy, Tae-Ha Jin’s life is turned upside down when an attack during a family yacht trip robs him of his parents and future as heir to the Cheon-Gu Group–Korea’s leading conglomerate. Uncovering the dark truths behind the accident–one of vicious power struggles and family betrayals–he escapes to Italy, vowing revenge. Seventeen years later, Tae-Ha is finally back in Korea. A man driven by vengeance, he can’t wait for the sweetest revenge as he makes those who robbed everything from him pay dearly. The stakes are high, and the battle with Cheon-Gu begins!

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Adopted by a Murderous Duke Family
description:
After ten years of being exploited by Duke Gerwehr for her healing powers, Agnes meets her death in a dungeon. When she wakes up, she finds herself in her uncle’s house before she was sold to Duke Gerwehr in the slave market. Desperate for her past life not to repeat itself, she lets Duke Rodwick adopt her and starts her new life with a new name, Tuariche Rodwick. Will she be able to keep her healing powers secret in this notorious family of assassins and find true happiness and love in her new life? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Eunri Dam was only a child when she found Gyeol's bloody body in the river by her home in Je. Back then, she didn't know his real name was Segyeol Yiheon or that he was the crown prince of Sayuta...Je's enemy nation. Gyeol knew that Eunri was to be engaged to the crown prince of Je, but even that couldn't stop him from falling for her. Before returning to his homeland, Gyeol promised Eunri that he would marry her one day. After that...everything went up in flames.

(Source: Tapas)

The year is 1887 in the rolling hills of the French countryside. The estate of Viscount de Rougemerle gently basks in its verdant glory, a beacon in the twilight years of the aristocracy. With the return of the viscount’s wayward son Cameron, however, the tranquility of this stately home threatens to shatter into scandal. It falls upon Edgar O’Grady, an Irish butler in service of the Rougemerles, to maintain decorum in the household, all the while protecting his childhood friend June and his master’s daughter Lady Victoria, as each furtive glance gleams the emerald green of envy… 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Flower That Swallowed the Beast
description:
A bargain for her life, to escape a tragic future. When Iris Whittle is murdered by her sadistic husband, she is sent back in time to when she was 20 years old. As the unwanted daughter of a duke, Iris realizes she can leverage her status and foresight to secure a better life this time around. Thus, Iris makes a daring marriage proposal to the fearsome Count Keibrandt Green, the most eligible bachelor of Gavizar Empire, whose gruff and stern demeanor hides the fangs of a wolf.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Civil Servant of the Sword Returns
description:
The nation's buzzing about Ahn Su-Ho, the newly awakened player who's giving up a life of riches to become a civil servant. They don't realize that Su-Ho's been a civil servant before... in his past life before he was killed by his own team! Now, Su-Ho's out to save the country from the worst of its criminal scum by gaining the strength to stop them before they can strike. Can Su-Ho power up and protect the nation, even if it means starting over completely? Or will justice be thwarted once more?

(Source: Tapas)

Terminally ill Miena Sidus has the ability to enter other people's dreams. Knowing her time will be up soon, Miena decides to use her power to gather money for her loving parents as a last gesture of gratitude. But as she navigates the dreams, she finds herself involved with a mysterious boy, a young lord, and a great dragon. Moreover, they all seem to need her help and are intent on saving her as well. Will these new relationships change Miena's fate and give her a ray of hope in life?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Why You Shouldn't Enter a Haunted House
description:
Hyeon may seem like a normal high schooler, but he can see and interact with spirits. While he tries to live a quiet life, everything changes when he meets Jeseung, a classmate obsessed with live-streaming in haunted houses. Soon, Hyeon finds himself visiting eerie places and uncovering a sinister mystery--someone is manipulating spirits, promising to bring them back to life. As he confronts dangerous forces, Hyeon must navigate a dark world he never expected to be part of. Will he uncover the truth before it’s too late?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: I Became a Ruined Character in a Dark Fantasy
description:
Ian Hope was once a normal gamer who downloaded the latest dark fantasy game, Aquilonia. The problem is he downloaded it illegally, which he believes is why he was transported into the game's world! Now, as his game character, he has to survive this cutthroat place full of corruption and betrayal. But that won't be easy since his character has already been ruined with skills that won't help him as the game progresses toward an apocalypse. Will he survive this dark fantasy? Or is all hope lost?

(Source: Tapas)

The Song family's true biological daughter appears, shaking Ju-Ha's world. Seeking an escape from an unwelcoming home, Ju-Ha embarks on a series of blind dates until she meets Sa-Hyeon, who boldly suggests setting a wedding date within minutes of their first date. Just as Ju-Ha starts to develop feelings for him, her cunning younger sister—who has already taken everything else from her—declares her intention to marry him instead. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Eileen Hamilton’s brother, Stephan, is at a loss to find her a match. No suitor can overcome her love of reading or insistence on marrying for love. But Eileen has a secret—she’s an author of erotic romances, and finding a cure for her inexperience and chronic writer’s block is far more pressing than her prospects. Certain everything is ruined when her secret is revealed to her brother's friend Alexander, she’s shocked when he offers to help. How could she refuse her crush?

(Source: Tapas)

Shin-Woo Cho's got money and looks, but Yu-Ju Lee knows he's arrogant and scandalous. He’s also her brother’s best friend, so waking up in his bed after way too much wine was… not ideal. Yet the more Yu-Ju tries to pretend it never happened, the more Shin-Woo seems determined to remind her it did!

(Source: Manta)

High school student San-Ho, blessed with extraordinary intuition, finds himself caught in a battle between monsters only he can see, nearly losing his life. He awakens in a world where monsters keep humans as pets. Now trapped as a pet himself, San-Ho desperately searches for a way to escape and return home. Will he be able to find his way back home?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: I Became the Duke’s Male Servant
description:
In the original story, Roselia was a maid in the duke’s household, used as a mere pawn in his schemes before being executed by the crown prince after being framed as a traitor. But this Roselia is different. The heroine, now in the body of the doomed maid from the novel and fully aware of how the story ends, is determined to change Roselia’s fate—disguising herself as a man to avoid the duke’s attention. But wait… why is she still being taken?! Somehow, Roselia still ends up in the duke’s estate—not as a maid, but as a manservant! 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

One would think Asina has it all as the daughter of Cromwall's archduke, but a serious case of the travel bug has her ditch her comfortable estate for the beautiful but deadly desert. Unfortunately, the first person she meets there happens to be Sihad Zain Behdad, the king of Cromwall's enemy nation, Pesian. First, he throws her in prison because he finds her suspicious. Then, he captures her when she breaks out and throws her in his harem! Can Asina hide her identity long enough to escape from the Sihad, or will she fall prey to the aloof king's unexpected charm?

(Source: Tappytoon) 

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

Gang-In Na wakes up in the year 2024 in the middle of South Korea with no memory of where or who he is. Upon hearing a voice that sounds strangely familiar, he comes face to face with a robot named ACE (Autonomous Combat Entity), who informs him that he was once part of the Earth Federation Forces in the year 2082 and possesses a wide array of skills. Gang-In decides to join forces with ACE to recover his lost memories and adapt to life on Earth, but the two look to be in for a bumpy ride.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Trapped inside the world of "Praesepe in a Cage", Ju-Yeon Yun becomes the game’s female protagonist, Praesepe, and must navigate a tangled web of romance and danger to escape. After completing all five male protagonists' storylines, she’s thrust into "secret mode," where everything changes. The characters she thought she knew are acting strangely, and Praesepe begins uncovering secrets—memories, death, and a mysterious new ally named Grand Duke Fenrick. As she gets closer to finding the "real" male protagonist, Praesepe must decide who to trust, and whether escaping the game is truly the freedom she desires. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: I'll Give You the Most Rotten One
description:
Ten years of relationship go down the drain when Haeru discovers that her loving boyfriend, Se-o, spent the night with another woman. What begins as a series of small misunderstandings snowballs into something much bigger as the college sweethearts wade through love, temptation, and workplace drama. Well, what better way to get back at her cheating boyfriend than to take the most rotten revenge ever? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Enter the world of Hajun Lee, just your average delivery guy trying to make ends meet. But when he's summoned to Olympus for a special delivery, his life takes an unexpected turn. Suddenly, he's the personal delivery man for the gods, earning big bucks and upgrading his gear with each risky delivery. Follow his daring escapades through dungeons and battles with monsters as he learns to outsmart them all. From one divine job to the next, Hajun faces it all with wit and guts. But can he keep up the hustle of being a regular delivery guy while also serving the mighty gods?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Joo Yeomin, a diligent college student burdened by an unjust debt, struggles to make ends meet through multiple odd jobs while evading persistent loan sharks. His wary nature around strangers is understandable, especially when he keeps encountering one in particular! Enter Yeon Tae-seo, the privileged chaebol heir. To Tae-seo, Yeomin appears at the most inconvenient times, sparking suspicions of paparazzi. Determined to put Yeomin in his place, Tae-seo initiates a high-stakes game of cat and mouse. But what happens when both players risk getting caught in their own trap? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Se-Ju lives every day weary as a member of a crime ring that he joined to avenge his younger sister’s death. However, one day, he encounters a boy, Se-Jin, and reminded of his dead sister, takes him in. From there, what was supposed to be a temporary arrangement grows into something far more.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The Regressed Demon Lord Is Kind
description:
Zich Moore, the fearsome Demon Lord, is struck down by the hero Glen Zenard. As he dies, he hears Glen's request: for him to be a good person if he is ever reborn. Miraculously, Zich awakens in the body of his younger self and resolves to be a better individual. But the problem is... he has no idea what it means to be good! Can the former Demon Lord truly learn what it means to be kind? Or will his old habits and misconceptions about virtue and goodness make redemption difficult?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: You Can’t Kill Me: The Secret Bride of the Black Wolf
description:
Yeon-U Chae, a talented yet lonely composer from Korea, finds herself and her family trapped in the underworld after a car crash. In her first life, she marries Hyo-Jo, who ultimately kills her. In her second life, she takes revenge by taking her own life in front of him. But despite her desperate wish for an end, she’s given another chance at life. However, this time, instead of encountering Hyo-Jo, she is discovered by Hwi-Ta, a mysterious man with a black wolf as his guardian spirit. Can Yeon-U break the cycle and find true safety in this treacherous underworld? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

display_title: Monster Princess of the Snowy Mountain
description:
Valerie Beloff, a princess in exile, decides to take her own life on her 19th birthday. Abused by her own mother and exiled for her mother’s crimes, she had to live in the freezing Makleroad palace by herself, and she somehow acquired the powers of an ancient monster - the power to freeze things. Hopeless, she seeks an escape in death… only to find herself before her cruel mother, yelling at her once again. Is she dead? Is she reliving a memory? When her mother strikes her, the throbbing pain lets her know that this is neither a dream nor a memory! This series contains themes regarding child abuse that may not be suitable for all readers.

(Source: WEBTOON)

One day, Ji-O is horrified to witness his girlfriend, Mi-Ho, devouring human flesh. How could this be happening? He's struggling to understand the events that transpired when Mi-Ho killed his close buddy. Ji-O flees in panic, only to run into his friend—whom he was sure was dead—still alive. Ji-O grapples with doubt, struggling to maintain his grip on sanity. Is Mi-Ho really the monster, or is everything just a horrible nightmare? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Juyeong is in a juvenile detention center for the attempted murder of his father, Gang-ryong. He clings to hope, dreaming of a future in Seoul with his childhood friend, Dayeon. But everything shatters when Dayeon is tragically killed by a rogue truck, and the devastation deepens when Juyeong learns that his father was behind the wheel. In a cruel twist, Gang-ryong regains consciousness and offers Juyeong an ultimatum: “If you want revenge, become the king of this detention center!” Now, Juyeong must navigate the treacherous world of prison politics, determined to rise to power and avenge his friend.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Do-Hun has been secretly in love with Ye-Jun since middle school. They were always together through high school and college, and Do-Hun believed they would stay by each other’s side forever. But one day, Ye-Jun suddenly got married, shattering Do-Hun’s quiet hopes. Even after years of trying, he couldn’t shake off his endless, frustrating one-sided love. Determined to move on, he decides to take a solo trip. Just as he’s about to leave, he hears the news, Yejun is getting divorced after just three years of marriage. That very night, Ye-Jun unexpectedly shows up at Do-Hun's door and asks him... 

*“Can you take me on that trip?”

*(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Hello, viewers! Welcome to the world of monsters, where certain people are awakened with specific characteristics and can become hunters. But our MC, Si-U, was awakened with absolutely no characteristics. How useless! Just when he'd lost hope... Ding! “Subscribe to gods' channels and get god-like characteristics.” Now, with the skills of the gods, Si-U, a used-to-be nobody, is making his name heard throughout hunter society. Like and subscribe to see if he’ll be able to pull this off! 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

display_title: I Thought My Husband Was Supposed to Die?
description:
Alice was a chef living in Korea when an explosion transported her into a novel. Having worked so hard in her previous life only to die young, Alice wants to live this new life in peace. There’s only one problem: her mother-in-law is trying to frame her for the murder of her husband. Using her knowledge of the novel, can Alice subvert the original plot into something that might allow her to live in peace, or is she doomed to live as the caretaker of a comatose husband until her death? 

(Source: Tapas)

Harry has fallen hard for his boss, Susan. He knows they can't be together, but their body's think otherwise.

(Source: Toomics)

Chosen by the last remaining Seabird, Lott has been cursed with a target on her back. After the notorious Woohoppiage pirates pillage her village and kidnap her sister, she embarks on a perilous journey to get her back. And she’ll do whatever it takes to make that happen, even if that means joining the Black Ocean crew and pretending to be a man. But she's not the only one with a secret on this pirate ship…

(Source: WEBTOON)

Luna wakes up one day to realize that she has been reborn into a novel as the childhood friend of the male lead, Fersen. To make matters worse, the guy is a clueless idiot! Luna wants to end their friendship to escape being bullied by the other ladies, but Fersen won't leave her alone no matter what she does. Things only get more complicated when she becomes entangled with the novel's villain, who hates Fersen even more than she does. Will Luna manage to get away from this dumb male lead? 

(Source: Tapas)

Burnt out and buried in work, Isaac Schrader drowns his stress in drinks with his only friend, James. The next morning, he wakes up in a hotel bed—hungover, disoriented, and far from alone. Lying next to him is Theodore Donovan, his charming yet insufferable roommate from their boarding school days… a man who vanished without a word years ago. Their reunion is anything but ordinary—and Theodore’s sudden return feels far from innocent. 

What is he really after?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

Lee Lina, resident of the dystopian world Tolka, plays the VR dating sim Raison D’Etre with the pain setting at zero. After her 99th playthrough, she is gifted a new patch for completing all the endings. However, as she begins her 100th game, and her favorite characters start acting oddly affectionate to her in an unfamiliar storyline, Lina wonders if the reward is more of a glitch. Will Lina be able to unlock a new ending before shocking news back in Tolka makes it impossible to ignore reality? 

(Source: Tapas)

*“Let the Survival Game Begin!”*

Designated as a disruptive species in the universe’s ecology, humanity must now participate in the ‘league’ under the watchful eye of the universal administrators. Jae-Hui Jin, sent back in time during the final stage of the game, arrives at one conclusion - only Sion Kang has the power to lead humanity to victory.

(Source: WEBTOON)

I was pushed around by others in my previous life. So this time, I will do whatever I want. When I see a pretty girl, I am going to fuck her. I will conquer every female I see!

(Source: DAYcomics)

Cheoldu, a barbarian raised on Earth, lives a mundane life with his best friend Jintae. But when he sees an alien creature from his planet on the news, everything changes. Thrown into an apocalyptic challenge, Cheoldu and Jintae must adjust their lives in Nova, a savage world filled with goblins and ogres. Will the two conquer Nova’s perils and uncover the secrets that could change Earth’s fate? An epic tale of friendship, survival, and untamed adventure awaits.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Villain Fiancé is in My Way of Happiness
description:
Thisbe was tired of being the Saintess of Prophecy from day one. Years after being reincarnated into a novel, she navigates a new timeline where, instead of being a murderous has-been Saintess, she chooses peace. And yet she somehow still ends up framed for murder--by her own fiancé, no less! Determined to prove her innocence, gain her freedom, navigate her love life (and maybe help save the world in the process), Thisbe will clear her name not as a Saintess, but as the main character! 

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

display_title: The Duke's Family Is Not My Problem
description:
After being cast out as a child over suspicions of illegitimacy, Perrianne was adopted by the queen of the neighboring kingdom and has been her loyal spy ever since. She's very happy with her new life when she suddenly hears perplexing news: Duke Exer's long-lost daughter has finally returned... except that's supposed to be her! Tasked with unmasking the imposter posing as herself, she's determined to just get the job done and get out of there. But will her family let her go so easily this time?

(Source: Tapas)

There's more to her than meets the eye... Having always been a good girl, Shushu is horrified when she's suddenly framed for murder and locked up in an all women's prison. To survive, she becomes the prison wife of her intimidating yet beautiful cellmate, Minicat. But is Minicat all that she... or he appears?

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes nine extra chapters.*

Sung Ha-Gyeom is a rich, spoiled omega who aimlessly cruises through life, leaving chaos in his wake with his carefree behavior. But when a scandal complicates everything, his father forces him to live in the countryside with Doh Do-Hoon, a humble, beta gardener who owes him a favor. At first, Ha-Gyeom is bored out of his mind, but then he catches a glimpse of Do-Hoon's naked, muscular body, and the boredom vanishes. Will Ha-Gyeom's wily charms win Do-Hoon over, or will Do-Hoon's rose garden heal the unruly Hagyeom?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After transmigrating into the body of a terminally ill villainess, Ibellin decides to find a peaceful life and a happy ending instead. Rather than selling off the main villain, Raven, to get the expensive medicine needed to treat her illness, Ibellin decides to heal the boy and then quickly send him on his way. But when Raven's father comes to seek her out, Ibellin is given a choice she's never imagined before. Will she accept it, or will she decline in hopes of finding happiness elsewhere?

(Source: Tapas)

On her wedding day, Hana Gu realizes her relationship lacks love and flees the ceremony. During her escapade, she runs into her ex-boyfriend, Gawi Nam who helps her by using his mysterious ability to time travel into the past. Determined to erase her unwanted marriage, she uses this ability to try and change her fate, but the future proves less malleable than expected. Amid repeated failures, she finds solace in Gawi, who is also trapped in the past, facing similar struggles. As they fight fate together, old feelings from their first love resurface, making Hana question -- does she truly want to change her fate?

(Source: WEBTOON)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

display_title: Lady Solea Just Wants to Go Home
description:
Lady Solea's family can't figure out how she lost her memories or why she keeps raving about her "jackpot." They don't realize she's actually Yoon Jiyoon, a lottery winner who was suddenly brought into their world! Determined to return to her reality and claim her riches, Jiyoon sets off a series of shenanigans to send herself home. Yet when Solea's family proves more fun than expected and distracts her from the mission to leave, Jiyoon begins to wonder if family is worth more than a fortune... 

(Source: Tapas)

On the day of my wedding, I found out that my lover was cheating on me with my best friend. I died because of their betrayal, and when I opened my eyes again, I returned to the past. I thought this was a blessing from God, a chance to take revenge. But this return was neverending as I kept dying either from their betrayal or in an accident. After my repeated death, I realized that accidents did not cause all of my deaths but that I was being murdered. So this time, I faked my death and left everything behind to catch the murderer, who was killing me repeatedly and to take my revenge finally. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Regression of the Yong Clan Heir
description:
Hwalin Yong, once the shattered heir of a fallen martial sect, is thrust back in time-- but he isn’t alone. A monstrous darkness lingers at the edges of his mind, constantly whispering, waiting to claim him. Can Hwalin resist its pull, or will he surrender to the shadow? As the battle within intensifies, he uncovers a dormant power that could reshape his destiny and the fate of his sect.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After proposing to his girlfriend, Do-Jin wakes up the next morning in a strange house with no memory of how he got there. When he asks about his fiancée, her brother Ju-Yeon gives him a chilling answer: “She’s dead.” But Do-Jin can tell immediately that Ju-Yeon is hiding something. Stranger still, Do-Jin has been having vivid, recurring dreams in which he and Ju-Yeon share a bond that goes far beyond a typical in-law relationship. As he digs deeper, the secrets Ju-Yeon reveal will turn Do-Jin’s entire understanding of his love and his life on its head.

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: The chapter count includes 4 extra chapters.*

Mu-Ryoung, a prodigy exorcist born into a famous family, begins taking small jobs in high school. But when he meets Hwan-Young, a classmate cursed with misfortune, their bond drags him into a dangerous exorcism unlike any other.

(Source: Manta)

The extremely hideous Joonyoung finds himself duped into an unfair contract with a mischievous succubus. To survive, he must seduce women, a daunting task for someone like him. However, he’s granted a unique superpower to aid in his mission: the ability to become invisible! With this newfound skill, Joonyoung navigates a world of unseen opportunities and challenges, all while trying to outsmart the supernatural forces at play. Can he master the art of invisibility and turn the odds in his favor, or will the succubus's game prove too dangerous?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A romance of temptation and trepidation. Eun-Ha, a peasant girl, is asked by a blind nobleman, Ji-Hak, to become his reading assistant. Though reluctant, she accepts the shady Ji-Hak's offer in hopes of earning enough money to free her sister from the courtesan life. And thus begins a dangerous romance of hidden intentions and passion.

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

No one understands why local lowlife Lord Aden Remes suddenly acts like the upright knight he was meant to be. The truth is, Aden's been possessed by Aden Albireo, the empire's hero who died after defeating the villainous Underlord and facing betrayal by his closest friends. Now, Aden's out to get revenge on those who killed him with the help of a few new allies and none other than the Underlord himself! Can Aden and his gang buckle down and power up? Or is the lord hero fated to fail once more?

(Source: Tapas)

Staying alive is a new form of entertainment.

When Do-Kyung, disillusioned by the harshness of life, finally resolves to call it quits, a bored demon, Hwamyung, appears before her with a particular offer. Will Do-Kyung, having entered into a contract with the Demon of Disillusionment, be able to flip her disastrous life upside down?

(Source: Manta)

Amidst a zombie apocalypse, Vin Yeom, an exterminator, finds a new purpose as an undertaker, specializing in funerals for the infected. Within the walls of the quarantine zone, he and his team navigate a treacherous world, providing solace to grieving families. Their company offers a unique but costly service that bridges the gap between life and death, allowing for one last goodbye. But in this world of death and despair, secrets linger, and the very loss that led Vin down this path may unearth a conspiracy that will shock the world and perhaps... help him find his way back.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jun-Ho finds a job in a company run by his first love and her daughter. He can't keep his hands to himself when his crush lets her guard down...

*"I ended up doing it... With a boy who is as young as my daughter..."*

(Source: DAYcomics)

display_title: Becoming A Family With The Duke and His Dear Son
description:
After being transmigrated as Ibellia the Villainess, Soyoon strives to twist the plot in order to survive in her favorite web novel. Her plan is to break off the engagement with Duke Cassis Adelhardt and live a quiet life on her own. However, the Duke and his young son Lucius would not let her go so easily. 

*“Lady Ibellia... Will you be Lus’ mommy?”* 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

Tae-Gyeong is reborn into a world where women are dominant and male hunters are rare. After awakening as a Lust Manager of Female Hunters, he discovers an outrageous way to grow stronger. He has to satisfy frustrated female hunters and earn points from sex.

*"Fine. I'll be a manwhore if that's what it takes... I'll fuck them all!"*

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

The Hunters League is a sport where only those with supernatural powers may compete, promising fame, glory, and incredible prizes. Changhyeon Lee had it all, but faces an abrupt downfall during his slump. Cast aside by even his own team, his world crumbles… but fate deals him an unexpected hand when a fatal encounter with a 10-ton truck ends his life, only to send him back in time to the day he discovered his powers. Armed with a second chance, Changhyeon is determined to reclaim and transcend his former glory in the Hunters League. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Everything Jae-Chan did was driven by his selfish one-sided obsession over his partner esper, Woo-Jin. It's only in his dying moments after a dangerous mission that he regrets getting in the way of Woo-Jin's happiness. So when he's sent six years into the past by an unexpected supernatural event, Jae-Chan decides to use his knowledge of the future and his guide powers to help Woo-Jin from behind the scenes. But the more Jae-Chan tries to distance himself from Woo-Jin, the less the esper will leave him alone! Can Jae-Chan truly give up on Woo-Jin and succeed at his selfless mission?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Luce Kaisel is commander of the 3rd regiment of the Crimson Knights. But it has been a tough road to get to this position for him. Being the son of a woman of ill repute, Luce had always wanted to escape the judging gaze of his family and succeed on his own terms. One day, he is thrust into the position of serving Ayle Linus, the Crown Prince. Luce is commanded to play the part of Ayle’s lover, but just for a short while. But what was supposed to be a fake affair, may create even more madness than anticipated... 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: High School Return of a Gangster
description:
A gangster dies saving a bullied teen — and wakes up in the boy’s body. Living the school life he always dreamed of, he vows revenge for the boy’s suffering. But when the boy's long-time crush begins to suspect he’s not who he says he is, things start to spiral... 

(Source: Manta)

*“This version allows you to take direct control of the team and train the players. Would you like to install it?”*

A secret training session begins between the underdog professional women’s volleyball players and their junior staff.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Keith, a legendary con artist who made a career out of swindling mafias and criminal syndicates, finds himself cornered by the police. To avoid capture, he hides in the most unlikely place—prison. But the temporary safety of his self-imposed confinement is short-lived when he catches the attention of the prison's ruthless warden, Della, the most feared guard in the joint. Now, Keith must navigate a new power struggle where he might be forced to lose more than just his freedom.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The leader of the demonic cult is a formidable entity that everyone is afraid of. However, while the demonic cult members expect him to exude great violence, the new Demonic Cult Leader, Do Yu-Gang, wishes to live a simple and peaceful life. Will his modest wish be granted in the end?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Everyone knows Kang Su-hyun. The Class president, social butterfly, the kind of guy who shines in every corner of campus life. But even the brightest star has shadows.His secret? He runs a private “alt account,” an anonymous SNS page where he draws and posts scandalous 19+ art. It’s his hidden world, one that absolutely no one can ever discover.At least, that was the plan.One day, his double life is accidentally exposed to the very last person he’d want: Lim Ji-ah, the school outcast who barely talks to anyone.“Wait… sunbae, you’re that famous lewd artist? Hehe… guess I’ve got some leverage now, huh?”From that moment on, Su-hyun’s carefully maintained image as Mr. Perfect begins to crumble.Stuck between bribes, blackmail, and the most awkward partnership imaginable, can a campus golden boy survive having his NSFW alter ego in the hands of an unlikely accomplice?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Making It in a Comic Book World
description:
Follow the adventures of a side character in an adult comic world, where the wildest stories often unfold offstage!

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: I Became the Magic Civil Servant in Isekai
description:
After casting a spell to posthumously fix his mana growth in a previous life, Seonal Hae now works at the Special Department of Different Species’ Civil Affairs. He now uses his powerful new magical abilities to help anyone who has been maligned because of who they are… even if they’re a medusa, centaur, or vampire!

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Love is a Sport: Proposal Scandal
description:
The first thing popular swimming star Claude says when he finally meets his idol, Olympic archery champion Nari, is "Will you marry me?" Ever since watching her compete on TV four years ago, Claude has been her biggest fan. He even earned a spot on the national swimming team just to get the chance to meet her someday. But his dramatic proposal quickly becomes the talk of the training center. As the awkward incident brings them closer, Claude’s admiration begins to grow into something much deeper.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.*

display_title: Reborn as the Overpowered Genius Lord
description:
When war-orphan-turned-warrior Agrick dies on the battlefield, his last regret is that he never got to fully develop his talents. The next moment, he's reborn... into a family of geniuses! Now, as Dane Sogress, he has to choose to be a spearman like his father, an assassin like his mother, or a summoner or mage like his sisters. But instead of picking, Dane decides to learn it all! Can Dane finally become the master of skills he was meant to be? Or will his take two at life end in failure again?

(Source: Tapas)

Nobody said being a parent was easy. It’s especially hard for Belphegor Verscios, the adoptive father of an exceptionally gifted human girl who insists on becoming a warrior someday and defeating the Demon King — who, unbeknownst to her, happens to be him. But when you’re a doting father like Belphegor, what else can you do but try to support her dreams while simultaneously making sure she never reaches her goal? It’s a fine line to walk, but he must succeed at any cost, or suffer the worst fate he could ever imagine… disappointing his daughter. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ju-Yeong Nam, the boss of a multinational corporation, has been doing his best to defy the fate of a super-rich male lead, only to be swept off his feet by a princess falling from the sky! Will he succeed in returning this princess, with her strange hair color and even stranger personality, to her world safely?

(Source: WEBTOON)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

As Yuria takes her dying breath, she realizes she had just lived through the events of a novel she read in her past life. She laments that she didn't remember early enough to change her fate, so when she wakes up having returned one year in the past, Yuria vows she won't meet the same end again. This time, she will expose the female lead of the novel, her half-sister Lilica, for the true two-faced villainess she is! Will Yuria be able to outsmart Lilica? Or will she lose everything once again?

(Source: Tapas)

Shunned as the weird kid at school, Han Siha wakes up one morning to find he is not quite himself anymore. Instead, a former vet intern who died from overworking has taken over Siha's body! But this story isn't like the novel he read in the "real world." With status windows popping up, feisty dragon partners, and classmates meant to be his future enemies, Siha is unsure if his skills are up to snuff. Will this mage make it to graduation? Or will he find that this story has an abrupt ending?

(Source: Tapas)

The Seo family is cursed with short lives, but Seungjoo seems to defy fate. That is, until a drunken night with his lifelong neighbor, Kim Muheun, changes everything. Awakening beside Muheun, Seungjoo discovers he can suddenly see ghosts. As the eldest son of a prestigious exorcist family, Muheun vows to protect Seungjoo at all costs, even if it means facing deadly spirits. Bound by a deep connection that feels almost predestined, their intertwined fates lead them on a perilous journey of exorcism, danger, and the fight against an ancient curse.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Guide Heo Yoon-Jae thought he was done with the field after losing his esper to a brutal rampage, but fate seems to have other plans. On a trip to the Guiding Center for a one-day commission, Yoon-Jae finds himself faced with Woo Sang-Hyuk, an A-rank esper with a god complex and a reputation for blowing through guides like tissues. But Yoon-Jae isn't just any old guide, and he refuses to let an uppity young esper call the shots. Once Sang-Hyuk gets a taste of real guiding, he'll be putty in the palm of Yoon-Jae's hand. Or so he hopes, anyway.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hayool was supposed to be a genius mage and the next head of his clan, but when he turns out to be incompatible with magical AI, his friends and family expect him to give up on his dreams. Too determined to abandon his ambitions, he discovers a book written by the founder of magic itself, and it teaches him to do magic without AI. Suddenly much more powerful than his classmates and school bullies, it seems he might have a bright future after all—if he can survive the secret plots against him.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I Grabbed the Leash of the Blind Beast
description:
When an average twenty-something wakes up in the battered body of a nameless extra from a romance novel, all she wants is to go home. But first, she’ll have to see the story through as Rona, the maid of Grand Duke Ileon, the novel’s hero who was blinded by poison. She just has to make sure the heroine restores his sight with a special flower so they can have their happy ending -- easy enough, right? With a plot gone awry, Rona’s dangerous past, and the grand duke’s affections, can Rona stick to the story?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hyeol Yu is a third-rate warrior feared more for his menacing appearance than his actual skills. Branded by false rumors and endless misunderstandings, he has long been an outcast in the world of martial arts. But everything changes when Seolhwa, the woman he once vowed his life to, reappears before him as a true martial arts master. From that moment on, Hyeol is thrust into chaos, his name weaving its way through the ranks of warriors, sects, and factions. As his unwanted reputation spirals out of control, he is pulled into a conflict far greater than he ever imagined.

(Source: WEBTOON)

All Margo wanted was some peace and quiet, even if she had to kill her husband to get it. She thought she’d gotten away with it too. She never expected the snowstorm or to be trapped in her house with suspicious eyes watching her every move. Margo’s fate lies in the hands of a strange maid, Peggy, who catches her in the act of destroying evidence. But what will Margo do when the touch of those hands makes her tremble with pleasure? Will she find her respite, or be forced to kill again?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I Think My Friend's Going to Become the Demon King
description:
Sacher Blythe, desperate to live a long and peaceful life, fails to avoid the future demon king, Phelan Exa Drozen. But Phelan knows more than he should…he recognizes Sacher as an "outsider”--someone from another world who knows the future and wants to kill him. So Phelan proposes a truce and Sacher agrees, hopefully preventing him from becoming the demon king. But this agreement keeps Phelan closer than Sacher would like...and their reluctant friendship is quickly turning into something more.

(Source: Tapas)

Ophedelia, the kingdom's famed "Silver Knight," returns from war a hero only to be forced to marry the jealous king who has long feared her popularity. Instead, she proposes to marry the king's brother, Prince Aiden, but behind their vows lies a secret: Ophedelia is plotting a coup, while Aiden is out to expose her treason.

(Source: Manta)

The only way out is through.

In the midst of a disastrous monster attack fated to end the world, a strange device throws Hee-Jae back in time 20 years where he meets the students of his foster father, Seok-Young. Now it's up to him to take them under his wing and stop the apocalypse so he can finally set off for a peaceful life.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The Gardener in a Hunter World
description:
Ji-ha, the weakest labor-class hunter with neither skill nor fighting ability, made a living by running a store while holding the lowest hunter rank.

But one day, his life as a hunter changed when he entered a garden from a different dimension through his dream...

<You have obtained Friendly Plant Lv.1> <You have obtained Blessing of XXX Lv.1>

'I gained a skill just by planting one twig...?'
