His unique adventure as the sole gardener in the hunter world begins.

display_title: Country Life With His Sexy Majesty
description:
Rienna Fonde was meant to marry a crown prince, but after he cast her aside for the so-called saint, she was disowned by her own father. Abandoned and alone, she moves to Fostine, a lush, peaceful countryside, where she puts the knowledge from her past life to good use. After years of country living, Rienna has become a renowned farmer and loves her new life. But then, a mysterious farming tool brings a tall, handsome man to her doorstep. Will this man ruin her country life or enrich it?

(Source: Tapas)

In a world where alphas and omegas are the stuff of urban legends, Do-Ha is a rare dominant omega who usually deals with his heat cycle through casual one-night stands. One day, he uses a matching service and gets paired up with an alpha named Ji-Hwan. Things get unexpectedly intense. Overwhelmed by pheromones, Do-Ha forgets about precautions and ends up knotted, leaving him in shock. However, Ji-Hwan seems entirely unfazed by the situation and boldly suggests they meet again, saying, "Don't tell me you're scared because I'm an alpha..."

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes nine extra chapters.*

"Mr. Esper, I told you already. I’m a B0-grade guide." 

Lee Yeoni, a powerful dual-blood, has spent years hiding his striking looks and exceptional abilities while working in a quiet, rural town. But when circumstances force him to transfer to the capital, he finds himself entangled with Tae Hajin—an elite grade-S+ Esper with an intense, domineering presence. 

Sensing that Yeoni is hiding something, Hajin becomes determined to uncover the truth. Using every trick at his disposal, he digs deeper into Yeoni’s secrets, setting off a tense battle of wits and wills. 

Desperate to protect his identity, Yeoni resists Hajin’s pursuit—until he realizes he can turn the tables. If he must be exposed to danger, why not use Hajin as his shield? And so, he makes a bold decision…to become Hajin’s exclusive guide. 

A gripping story of hidden power, dangerous attraction, and the fine line between hunter and hunted. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: My Childhood Friends are Trying to Kill Me
description:
I was reborn into my favorite novel as Lelia, a tragic side character. Sent to a royal academy as a decoy, I befriend four princes fated to slay a dragon. Years later, they return as heroes, only to accuse me of murder! How can I reclaim their shattered trust?

(Source: Manta)

Jin-Wol Ma, better known in the martial realm as the ‘Mad Demon’, once stained the earth with blood in his pursuit to become the pinnacle of all living things. That was until his final battle with the Five Supreme Masters, where the leader of the Fire Dragon sect sealed him away using the Demon-Sealing Sword. Now, three thousand years later, Jin-Wol awakens, but he is no longer on Earth. Instead, he finds himself surrounded by hostile alien civilizations. Will Jin-Wol rise once again to aim for the peak of all living creatures? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Young Ruan, the little lord of House Marcellion, has never had an easy childhood. With his older brother constantly feigning illness, the burden of the harsh heir’s training falls squarely on his small shoulders. One day, unable to take it any longer, Ruan dashes out of the mansion and loses himself in the forest. There, he stumbles upon a boy his own age. They don’t exchange names, and yet none of that seems to matter. With him, even nibbling on grass becomes an adventure. Ruan finds himself laughing, playing, and perhaps for the very first time, feeling free. Day by day, his thoughts drift further from the rigid lessons of succession and closer to the warmth of that kindhearted boy. But gossip spreads quickly, and soon even the stern Count Marcellion hears whispers of his son’s wandering heart… 

Could a simple forest friendship change the path of an heir? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.*

display_title: I Became a Childhood Friend of the Obsessive Sub Male Lead
description:
Born with memories of the novel How to Survive as an Ordinary Lady, Princess Rietta Lise is next in line for the throne of the Kingdom of Lise. But after being sold to the empire by her father, a king who lives in luxury and pleasure, she enters the ducal Mayer estate. Upon realizing that Noel, the duke’s second son, is the sub-male lead of the novel, she’ll try to repay the dukedom’s favor by making him the real male protagonist!

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: V-Card Raider: Collecting the Male Leads
description:
Drunk after her latest heartbreak, lazy game addict Sylvia buys a mysterious game called V-Card Raider. However, before she even gets to play, she dies of alcohol poisoning and finds herself transported into the game world. There, she is told by a god that she is on the fast track to hell unless she sleeps with the main characters, collects the seeds of the World Tree, and saves the game universe! Is there a catch? Who cares?! Who wouldn't want to enter heaven by committing the sin of lust?

(Source: Tapas)

Tae-Jin suddenly gains the ability to perceive others’ hidden desires. Overwhelmed, he’s first faced with the desire of his aunt, who raised him as if he were her own…

*“I wish Tae-Jin would look at me as a woman…"*

(Source: DAYcomics)

Yoo Sera, who once secretly indulged in the R-rated, grimdark captivity reverse-harem game "Who Trapped Our Lady?", suddenly finds herself thrown into the world of that very game. Not only is she forced into the body of the villainess Sera Ebott, but she’s also trapped under the same roof as the male leads who despise her. The condition for escape? Uncover the identity of the one who imprisoned her. To survive and gain the information she needs, Sera must seduce those very men with her own body…!! Will Sera find a way out and return safely?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a disastrous office romance, Hyojun quits his job in a fit of rage and opens a café…only to find himself serving more dust than drinks. Business is dead, and desperation sets in; with no other option, he decides to sell the matching couple ring from his ex. The sale goes through quickly, but on the day of the meetup, something unexpected happens: the café is suddenly packed. It turns out the buyer is a stunningly handsome student, and word of his looks has drawn a crowd. Watching people fawn over the mystery heartthrob, Hyojun makes a snap decision that will change his life forever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Daniel and Sarah are complete opposites: one is an outcast, and the other is the school’s queen bee. However, they have one thing in common… they’re both virgins.

(Source: Toomics)

What’s worse than someone who leaves you on read? How about someone who doesn’t know when to end the conversation? Mira Hexen is cursed to always be the last one to reply for a whole year or she will be turned to stone. But that’s a bit difficult when you’re the chief of a company that produces a massively successful messaging device. Mira’s latest VIP client is Euryx Deyra, an extremely friendly duke who feels the need to respond to every little thing she says. If only she could just tell him to shut up already...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes seven extra chapters.*

A-Jin is a carefree high school girl interested only in baking and is a loyal friend who values her bonds above all. Despite her ordinary appearance, she garners the interest of Jun-U, one of the most handsome guys at her school, adding a newfound excitement and unpredictability into her life. Will they be able to overcome the jealous manipulations of others and realize their feelings for each other?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Immoral Duke Needs to Be Homeschooled
description:
Estella Margaret Montiel is a dedicated governess for House Bertha. However, she is currently facing more pressing matters than math or grammar. She knows her pupils' half-brother, Duke Diego Bertha, plans to kill everyone in his family! Determined to protect her students from a tragic fate, she sets out to reform the charming yet dangerous duke. Can her resolve and guidance truly transform the devilish Diego and teach him the value of family? Or will her class be dismissed much too early?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: CHILDREN OF VAMFIELD by DARK MOON
description:
Seven boys live under the care of Ms. Marge at Vamfield House. Their peaceful lives are shattered one day after they stumble upon a secret room...

(Source: WEBTOON)

Riv Roydes, a tutor turned secret nude model, poses to pay for her sister's medicine, believing her identity to be safe. But when a painting reveals her profile, she is drawn into a forbidden romance with the enigmatic marquis Dimus Ditrion.

(Source: Manta)

What’s a little fondling between best friends? After accidentally grasping Baek-Gyung’s silky smooth sack, Jeong-Min can’t get the sensation out of his head. To him, the obvious solution is to create increasingly absurd situations where his hands might get to hold his friend’s luscious goods. Meanwhile, Baek-Gyung is enjoying Jeong-Min’s attention in a way he can’t quite pin down, but he’s sure there’s a legitimate, wholesome reason their relationship is suddenly so...intimate.

(Source: Tapas)

After countless reincarnations as doomed villainesses, Ms. Transmigrator gets her final chance to rewrite fate–as Ciani Felicité, the woman who drove the male lead to madness! Instead, she plans to rescue Redian, the male lead trapped in her family’s Subterranean Castle, nurture him, and then escape. But why is his intense gaze fixed on her? With so much attention, can she really navigate this reincarnation to a happy ending? 

(Source: Tapas)

In 2018, monsters swarmed Seoul, and heroic “players” saved the city. Fast forward a decade, Hyukjin Kim, stuck in a seven-year rut after failing to become a player himself, gets a do-over. Zapped back to 2018, Hyukjin seizes his chance to rewrite history. With knowledge from the future and his re-awakened player talents, Hyukjin battles beasts and conquers dungeons in a pulse-pounding quest for redemption and survival! 

(Source: Tapas)

Evan was a slave. That is until the demon blood in him awakened. With his new-found power as an incubus, Evan brings women who wronged him one by one to submission.

(Source: DAYcomics)

The academy where Amon was assigned as a new teacher has gone bankrupt! The principal is addicted to gambling, the teachers are no-goods, and the students are lethargic! How will Amon tread forth as he stands at the crossroads of escape and success? A comedic fantasy series that will make your sides hurt from laughing!

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Fangs That Pierce the Heart
description:
Born as the illegitimate second son of Loxollum’s king, Iblonde is sacrificed by his pagan mother to ensure that one day, he sits on the noblest seat in the kingdom. A few years later, Iblonde has started a new life as Abel, a serf of a baron’s domain. Aside from his tragic past, Abel harbors many secrets, including the fact that he is actually a girl. But the greatest secret of all is that Abel’s resurrected body is now occupied by Belial, the seventh king of hell, who has come to slowly plague the land... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

As an intern at a marine research institute, Hyo-Seo finds himself overworked and overlooked. He's given the job no one else wants: caring for the aggressive orca everyone else fears. Hyo-Seo finds quiet comfort in the beast's presence, but after he starts speaking to it, strange things begin happening at the facility...

(Source: Manta)

display_title: I'm Not Letting My Duke Die!
description:
Three years ago, Hui-Yeon was just your average otaku living in South Korea when she was thrust into the world of At the End of the Abyss, a novel she thought was trash. Hui-Yeon is now Ella Rein, a talented monster hunter. One day, she meets Clive Winterock, the female lead's brother and the man Gerard Aselenus--her favorite character and the gorgeous male lead--wants dead. Although she's a Gerard fan, Ella can't let anything happen to Clive because he's just too handsome to die!

(Source: Tapas)

Dowon chose to be a freelance guide for the freedom to do other things, but his cold and demanding esper, Kwonwoo, calls him for guiding every day without fail. Although he thinks he has his hands full already, he's proven wrong when Kwonwoo loses eight years of his memories and his powers due to an accident on the job. Now it's up to Dowon to restore both by giving the mentally 20-year-old Kwonwoo the kind of intimate guiding he always refused before. But surprisingly, this cheery and affectionate Kwonwoo seems all too eager to take things to the next level... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

After her husband, Duke Arphad, and his knight sacrifice themselves for her, Princess Agnes flees King Sebastian's murderous conquest, only to be captured and suddenly sent three years back in time to her wedding night! Faced with reliving the past, Agnes is determined to save herself and the duke from the king's clutches. With nothing but a daring new scheme and a fierce resolve, can this formerly pampered princess rise up to become the Arphad family's royal savior?

(Source: Tapas)

Ever since his eighth birthday, Yeonwoo has been the target of cruel bullying by his classmates. It was a well-known fact that he was poor, smelly, and living with his grandma. But with the new transfer student Seongwoon’s dramatic appearance, he gains his first real friend. Just as Yeonwoo starts getting used to his new happy life, Seongwoon and his parents are in a tragic accident that leaves him orphaned with no memories. Now, it’s Yeonwoo’s turn to take care of the precious person who gifted him so many of his “firsts”—even, if Seongwoon doesn’t remember a single one. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes six side story chapters.*

Prosecutor Hyeon Taesik is assigned to the infamous "Haemu Serial Murder Case," the same case in which his twin brother, Hyeon Minsik, was brutally killed. During the investigation, Taesik encounters Mu Inhui, a priest and the prime suspect. Despite his growing suspicions, Taesik finds himself inexplicably drawn to Inhui. Unbeknownst to him, everything has been orchestrated by Inhui—and Taesik is walking right into his trap...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jung-Woo is a Tamer in the MMORPG Karel's Hymn. While selling off items after deciding to quit, he meets a newbie, "Charongrong," who swears loyalty even if "she" becomes popular. He thought it was just a brief, passing connection—but he shouldn't have taken those words lightly.

(Source: Manta)

A decade after the fall of Shin Oktaro, Frey, a back-alley thief, stumbles upon a clue to the sibling he lost long ago. But when Koo Ilyeong, the enigmatic CEO of SNT, crosses his path, a dangerous offer is made. Under the guise of benevolence, Koo dares Frey to earn his redemption, pushing him into a game where the rules are never clear, and the stakes grow darker with each move. What is Koo's true intent, and how far will Frey go before he's consumed by the shadows of his past? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Born under the ominous sign of "Ultimate Yang Obstruction," Dang Soun faced a turbulent life from the outset, destined to die before the age of thirty. Abandoned by his father and orphaned, he endures harsh conditions, resorting to begging and eventually gambling for survival. Despite narrowly escaping death on numerous occasions, Soun's fate takes a drastic turn when he is suddenly informed by his long-lost father and younger brother that he will become the concubine of the Demonic Sect. With his life constantly in jeopardy, survival becomes Soun's sole focus, even if it means becoming the Demonic Sect's Leader's concubine for a chance at a peaceful end.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eighteen-year-old U-Ri Chae is just a normal high schooler who loves reality dating shows—until she unexpectedly lands a spot on "Love in Session" alongside her childhood crush, U-Jin Hyeon. Frantic to win his heart, U-Ri throws herself at the opportunity. But her mission quickly becomes complicated: U-Jin is mysteriously absent, one participant hates her, and she finds herself unexpectedly attracted to others on the show. As romantic tensions rise, U-Ri must navigate her feelings and the show’s drama. Can she untangle her heart and find true love amid the chaos?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

When Sahui’s quiet life at Yeonghwadang, a secluded shaman house where she spent her whole life, is disrupted by imposing CEO Tae-eon Jeong, she wants nothing more than to keep her distance. Scarred by abandonment and a childhood accident, she has no interest in love. Yet Tae-eon’s arrogance, charm, and relentless attention begin to break through her defenses, stirring emotions she thought she had buried for good.

(Source: WEBTOON)

"Imae," born to a human father and an Imae mother, endures various persecutions and grows up without ever obtaining a name. One day, the notorious Black Martial Emperor, the merciless king of the Baedal Kingdom, destroys the Imae village. After his beloved mother dies at the hands of the cruel emperor, he is determined to seek revenge, posing as a painter to paint his portrait…

(Source: Lezhin US)

This time, it's my turn to save you. 

After being freed from a painful existence with the help of her ex-fiancé Prince Vicente, Elena wakes up inside the body of Evelyn, an orphan girl. 2 years later, Elena discovers that Vicente has been locked up in a palace for her death. With this, she who was once saved now seeks to be the savior. 

(Source: Manta)

Getting ghosted is the worst way to break up, no contest. After years of heartbreak, Eun-Kyo finally gets to enjoy a quiet life running a café with her best friend. But peace shatters when Jae-Heon, their new basement tenant, barges into her life. Wild, handsome, and maybe a bit of trouble, he begins to test Eun-Kyo's resolve to swear off dating.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: I Didn't Sign Up to Be a Nanny!
description:
While working the regular shift in a supermarket, Ailene finds herself waking up in the body of a nanny within a fantasy novel. Knowing this character dies at the hands of the twin princes at the beginning of the novel, Ailene vows to raise these boys to be kindhearted and avoid their dark storyline. She fits right into her role and things seem to be looking up until the empire’s “mad dog” Duke Kasar stumbles into her life and asks her to pretend to be his lover. Will Ailene make it through the fantasy novel alive?! 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

After his shaman grandfather passes away, Yoon Dam suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts—a gift he would rather not have. The only solution? The power of a goblin. Enter Lee Do-Han, who claims to be exactly that. But there’s a catch: every time Do-Han tries to harm Yoon Dam, mysterious wounds appear on his own body instead. Intrigued by this bizarre connection, Do-Han proposes a deal: “Why not just let me be your tutor?” Bound by strange circumstances and their own hidden agendas, the two set off on a journey neither of them could have imagined…

(Source: Lezhin US)

To save her noble family from a massive 100 million debt, Ariana Astaroth marries the wealthy commoner Rowen Green, making him the new Count Astaroth in exchange. But after five years of marriage, he impregnates her best friend, and Ariana demands a divorce, stating that she'll pay him back. She goes to a guild run by a man named Rowen for help, who promises to help her escape the marriage. Can Ariana divorce her disloyal husband, or will the overwhelming debt crush her in the end?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Beast of Bahal Never Misses its Prey
description:
Jarn comes to the capital to search for his missing aunt - and somehow ends up employed at the estate of the mysterious Duke Ordin. His job? Feeding the unidentified “monster” locked in the basement. Uh, sure. Things take a sharper turn when he accidentally sleeps with the Duke, and now Jarn’s juggling monster-sitting, sneaking around for clues about his aunt, and…discovering some very unexpected pleasures as a late-blooming virgin. Between horny dukes and basement creatures, Yarn’s hands are both metaphorically and physically full, and he has no idea what truths are waiting for him at the end of it all…

(Source: Lezhin US)

In this Holy War, who is the real enemy? While delivering a sword to the Captain of the Holy Knights, Léa accidentally discovers a secret. Escorted by a knight named Baltha, Léa returns home to find her parents have been slaughtered and her sister is missing. Now she must survive in this harsh world while seeking out her sister. 

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Ending This Marriage for Your Happiness
description:
Having forced her husband, Alfonso, into a loveless marriage, Charlotte accepted when he sought solace from another woman. So when she wakes up in the past with a second chance, Charlotte hopes to sever ties while uniting him with his true love. To her dismay, however, any attempt to guide him away leads him right back to her! With Alfonso's gaze shifted to her, Charlotte is stuck between fixing her past regrets and shaping this new present into the future she had once hoped for with Alfonso.

(Source: Tapas)

Yoo-Joo has a specific taste when it comes to men: they must have broad, beautiful chests. She’s never met her ideal chest before, until she finds it on Dojin, her next door neighbor since childhood. After a drunken night where Yoo-Joo gets to have a taste of Dojin’s deliciously perfect pecs, she earns his forgiveness by being his errand girl and promising to let him do the same to her if she ever lays hands on his chest again. But there’s no way it will happen again, obviously. Or so she thought…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Hyun-Jae Moon, a beta, has been in a loving relationship with alpha Shin-Hoo Lee for seven years. But all this changes when Shin-Hoo sacrifices himself to save Hyun-Jae from a terrible accident. When Shin-Hoo wakes up in the hospital, he doesn’t recognize Hyun-Jae or have any memories of their time together. All Shin-Hoo wants now is a man who can handle his intense desires, but does a beta have the stamina to keep up with him? With their relationship in shambles, how can Hyun-Jae win Shin-Hoo back?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Youngest Must Become an Idol
description:
Taeyoon Bong is a webnovelist infamous for writing the most tragic endings for his characters. Taeyoon believes this is due to what happened five years ago--back then, he was an idol trainee ready to debut with his hyungs. That all changed when a drunk driver ran into their car and shattered their reality. Taeyoon was the only survivor. One night, he answers a mysterious call from a hyung he long thought dead, throwing him back to that fateful night...

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: A Cat, Adopted by a Wolf Family?
description:
Kittia is a young but brave kitty who wants to avenge her mom’s wrongful death. But with no one left to rely on, she seeks help from the powerful Gritwolfs by pretending to be an orphaned wolf pup. To her relief, they completely fall for her act... Well, they fall for her cuteness anyway. Despite realizing Kittia is a cat at first sniff, the Gritwolfs decide to take her in as the family’s youngest daughter. Totally oblivious to the fact that she has already been found out, Kittia will try her best to be the most convincing wolf ever...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Are you into that kind of thing?
description:
A nerd Jin-U and a school star Chae-Yeong found out about each other's sex fantasy that could end their college life. Here's their fresh but unpredictable love story.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

A landlady offers her friend's younger brother a tempting deal. But when more people enter the picture, things get more complicated.

(Source: Toomics)

Everyone's shocked when 9-year-old prodigy Adelia Ester suddenly refuses to enroll in the elite knights' academy. They don't know that Adelia was magically sent back in time after wasting her life on the battlefield and suffering an early death! Now, Adelia's out to protect her peace from her ex-boss, the evil future emperor, by setting her ally on the throne instead. Will Adelia succeed in one last mission and finally retire for good? Or will she find herself forced to be a hero once more? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Cup of Vengeance Is in Your Hands
description:
Princess Eudith’s story begins when her cruel brother, the king, sells her off to the neighboring kingdom to marry the queen’s powerless stepson, Prince Franz. Eudith becomes a pawn in the queen’s plot to discredit Franz and place her biological son, Krald, on the throne. Desperate, Eudith attempts to end her misery but wakes up on the day of her fateful journey. Armed with knowledge and experience from her past life, Eudith seizes the chance for revenge by helping Prince Franz take his rightful place on the throne. Will Eudith succeed in her revenge and find happiness? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Orange cats have a reputation for chaos, but not Big Cheese! This clever feline has a mission: play matchmaker and help two clueless souls find love.

(Source: Toomics)

First-year Gil-Su Lee transfers schools to run from the bullying and violence. And the new place seems almost perfect. Everyone in his class is friendly and kind, and no one is bullying anybody. Violence? No, we don’t do anything like that in this school. That’s what the “Arena” is for. Don’t forget, Gil-Su. What happens in the ring stays in the ring!

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Do It for the Fans, Not Me!
description:
For Yoo Jae-Min, debuting as an idol is everything, but his skills are outshined in particular by Jung Woo-Hyung. The other boy's laid-back attitude, especially toward their fans, irks Jae-Min, but their dynamic shifts when they become roommates and Woo-Hyung starts noticing cute sides to Jae-Min that he hadn't before. The fans notice this change and Jae-Min focuses all his attention on them and their love, which bothers Woo-Hyung. Will their group, 4ever, hit it big, or will Woo-Hyung and Jae-Min's tumultuous relationship lead to its downfall?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Nick Stockton, ex-mercenary and now head of a top security firm, has never once lost control—until he crosses paths with Owen Rose, the stunning CEO of Rose Biotech. The moment their eyes meet, Nick is hit with an overwhelming surge of pheromones. He knows instantly: Owen is his Omega. When terrorists launch a sudden attack on Owen, Nick steps in without hesitation. Grateful and intrigued, Owen invites Nick to his secluded estate. But Owen harbors a dark belief—that he’s a “monster Omega,” ever since a childhood incident where he injured his Alpha cousin. He’s spent his life in strict control… until Nick’s bold, relentless (and a bit reckless) pursuit shatters his defenses. As their bond deepens, Nick begins investigating the attack—and uncovers a chilling truth. This wasn’t just a strike against Rose Biotech. Someone is after Owen himself. And Nick will stop at nothing to protect what’s his.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: I'll Take That Marriage This Time
description:
Adored by her noble family, Saina Devof had a perfect life until one night ruined her societal debut, her family’s honor, and her future in one fell swoop. Determined to fix her mistake, she chooses to marry the man from that night, only to find herself trapped in a nightmare that ended with her lonely death. Then, she woke up. 18 years old again with a second chance at life, Saina swears off marriage for good. But her plans change when he appears:

*“I want to be your choice.”*

Enter Duke Constantine—the man determined to rewrite her destiny.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Nina has carefully crafted an image for herself, but will sex ruin everything?

(Source: Toomics)

After falling victim to a deepfake scandal, Tae-Ri seeks justice at the police station. There, she meets Prosecutor Chi-Kyung Park — a man as composed and calculating as he is impossible to read. But when she refuses his settlement offer, his calm begins to unravel, and a dangerous obsession takes hold.

(Source: Manta)

Cheongha Kim, a legendary swordswoman from the Joseon era, awakens centuries later in the body of Dajin Park, a quiet high school student. Armed with deadly combat skills, Cheongha must face school bullies, navigate the chaos of modern-day life, and find her place in a world far different from her own. The halls of Juwon High are about to meet a warrior unlike any they’ve seen before. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Our High School Music Genius is Paganini's Reincarnate
description:
They called him the Devil’s Violinist in another life, but now he’s just a student trying to blend in. As a reincarnation of Paganini, Juwon has spent years suppressing his extraordinary talent to live as an ordinary teenager. But when a twist of fate lands him in an arts high school, his silent strings begin to scream for attention. Surrounded by rivals and expectations, the genius who was once forced into silence must decide if he is ready to reclaim his throne. The legend has returned, and the world isn't ready for his encore. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Blood ties bind, but vengeance severs, and in the heart of a heartless man, a fire ignites. Pil-Du Kang, a prosecutor born into a legacy of corruption, uncovers his family's harrowing involvement in his mother’s murder. Now, a chilling vendetta awakens the monster within, drawing out the primordial urge he has long sought to contain. Will he rely on the law to be his ally on this treacherous path, or will he become the judge, jury, and executioner?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Find love and…500 million won?! Three women are about to take on a special challenge to escape their “forever alone” status. The “airhead” Jurim, the “trash collector” Seona, and the “devout Christian” Chaeyul are ready to compete for both money and love for the first time ever. Who will take it all?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

The transfer student Ye-Bom was jealous of Eun-Ho, an honor student everyone liked. Many years later, Ye-Bom’s life feels hopeless and bleak when one day, she finally learns about the reason behind Eun-Ho’s death that occurred a long time ago. Ye-Bom, filled with regret, returns to the time when she was 18 and faces him once again. What drove the seemingly perfect boy to death? Ye-Bom is finally ready to hear Eun-Ho’s story. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

*Note: This series contains themes regarding suicide and bullying that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.*

Enter Heilbronner: gentleman thief! The main villain of a novel, who fought against the heroes, steals from the rich at night, but by day takes on the identity of Ludger Kassen, the philanthropic son of a duke, more interested in history than politics or power. As commander of the ragtag Ruby Knights, isekai’d knight Clara has no choice but to get involved in the Heilbronner case. However, in doing so, and in working alongside Ludger himself, Clara learns he secretly has far grander motives... 

(Source: Tapas)

For ten years, Hong Su-Rim has been confined, hidden away by the powerful Baek family. Why? He’s suspected to be “Illishine”, a mythical figure said to bring either ruin or salvation to the clan. On his twentieth birthday, the mark of Illishain finally appears on Su-Rim’s body, and his fate is sealed. He is dragged into the cold world of the Baek family, where he’s placed under the control of Baek Woo-kyeong, the aloof and calculating son of the family head. Su-Rim, having endured years of isolation, has no illusions about love or trust—he plans to use Woo-Kyeong to survive and gain some control over his life. But things don’t go as planned. Woo-Kyeong, at first wary and indifferent, begins to feel drawn to Su-Rim’s strange charm and hidden vulnerability. As the two navigate a maze of family politics, supernatural legacy, and growing attraction, their fates become more entangled than either of them expected. Is Su-Rim truly the cursed savior of the Baek family—or just a pawn in a dangerous game of power and prophecy? In a world where nothing is as it seems, can love be more than just an illusion? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Living Unmarried With My Time Bound Lover
description:
Ines Eledine is known far and wide as the God of Investments, using her secret ability of reading others’ misfortunes to choose wisely–that is, until her ability vanished one day. Thinking her investing days were behind her, Ines is shocked to discover that her ability returns whenever she touches the handsome, broody master of the demonic sword, Calad Arsdeon. To keep him around, she asks him to be her fake lover…but this arrangement might not be the safe investment she thought it was. 

(Source: Tapas)

Childhood friends Do-Jin and Hyun-O end up at a group blind date, where they get heavily drunk and unexpectedly spend the night together. While Hyun-O clearly remembers what happened, Do-Jin seems to recall nothing... However, following this Do-Jin starts pursuing Hyun-O without hesitation. 

Does he actually remember...?

(Source: Manta)

*"The kind of play I prefer is a little too hardcore for newbies."*

Seo-Ha, a university lecturer, is a natural submissive with deeply ingrained masochistic tendencies. Yet, fear of being outed has kept him from ever pursuing a real partner, leaving him to indulge only in fantasies. When the fellow professor he has been secretly admiring announces their engagement, Seo-Ha is devastated. In a moment of impulsive rebellion, he turns to a BDSM community to find a one-night play partner, hoping to finally experience the domination he’s always craved. But this leap into the unknown may lead him down a path far more intense—and dangerous—than he ever imagined

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: My Child Will Have a Different Father
description:
“Fate, save my unborn child…!” These are the last words of Princess Hinael as she plummets to her death at the hands of Count Chetaire, her unfaithful husband. Little does Hinael know that destiny will grant her a second chance, as she awakens two years in the past, shortly before her marriage. With her knowledge of what’s to come, Hinael attempts to rewrite the stars for herself and her future child. And what better way to achieve her ambitions than to court her kingdom’s former enemy, the dark and stern Prince Lutz of the Empire of Triekas?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yeon finds herself as an extra in her own novel. To make the most out of the bizarre event, she goes on a quest to find her handsome male lead Chang. However, who she finds is none other than the younger, frail version of the antagonist Bi. Yeon finds that the "antagonist" Bi is being pushed through the narrative of a villain -- can she stay by his side through it all?

(Source: WEBTOON)

With the press of a button, Yu Sol’s life is about to turn upside down. When a mysterious post with the power to transport the user to their favorite fictional universe pops up on his feed, Sol clicks “share” and falls asleep…only to awake the next day as a round, winged puffball! Try to speak as he might, he can only mutter one word- er, sound: “Peep!” With his new avian appearance, Sol must navigate the land of Sevon under the guiding hand of his new (strikingly handsome) owner, Karhan Barthés, while trying to find a way back to world from which he came.

(Soure: Lezhin US)

Time travel is the bread and butter of romance fantasy novels, but the reader who wakes up as Liberata has had enough after the first 19 times. Sure, she's the villainess of "The Highs and Lows of Leonie's Life," but she keeps getting killed even when she's not trying to be evil! Not expecting anything to change in her 20th life, Liberata gets blackout drunk at a party... only to wake up next to the novel's male lead, Archduke Gerlach Cygnus! And the more Gerlach falls for Liberata after their one-night stand, the more the world around them starts falling apart... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Kwon Ji-Hyeok, a good-for-nothing who’s lived his whole life relying solely on the handsome face he inherited from his parents, finds himself kicked out of his girlfriend’s house with nowhere else to go. While wandering in search of his next place to freeload, he stumbles upon a mansion with its door left open and decides to sneak in. But inside, he’s greeted by the horrifying sight of a dismembered corpse. Sensing imminent doom, he tries to escape, only for the missing homeowner to appear right then and there. One look is all it takes for Ji-Hyeok to realize it: this guy definitely has the face of a serial killer. 

For someone who’s always coasted through life on his looks, this is the biggest crisis he’s ever faced. To survive, Ji-Hyeok might have to pull his most desperate move yet, using his charm to seduce this psychopathic killer. Because if he fails, it won’t just be his pride that gets pierced.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

After waking up inside a game, Minervina discovers that she has the ability to see information screens for everything within her new world. Unfortunately, she has also been given a quest to destroy this world, but she’s ignoring that. While Minervina wishes to use her near-omniscience to live a comfortable life, she’s continuously swept into chaos and political ploys. Her key to preserving the peace might be Exarch, the incorruptible Grand Duke. He seems to favor her, a trend that continues with everybody else, including the main system. Will Minervina be able to protect this world that loves her?

(Source: Tappytoon)

I am the icon of absolute power, master of all, the ultimate necromancer king who controls death: Lord Karnak. But what’s the point of a life like this when I’m nothing but bones? Enjoying a gentle breeze, warm sunlight, human warmth, or even a decent meal are all out of the question! My loyal servant Baroth and I have tried vampirism and spiritual possession, but neither worked on ultimate transcendental beings like us. So perhaps being human again is the answer! Surely nothing will go wrong…

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Grand Duke of the North
description:
Yumi, an actress with no experience in love, is terrified when she wakes up in a dark romance as Selene Belias on her wedding night! Yet instead of confining her like in the novel, her husband, "Monster Archduke" Varas, brings her gifts and takes her on outings. She falls for him... but then discovers he thinks she's a witch and is searching for the real Selene! Can this actress convince her first love that she's really his wife? Or is she to be cast out of this role that's not rightfully hers?

(Source: Tapas)

*"Kill me, as you promised."* 

When her twin sister Leyla, the Holy Maiden, suddenly disappears one day, the ordinary Elena finds herself having to marry Crown Prince Kyle, a man infamous for his ruthlessness, in her stead. After a dreadful marriage ceremony, Kyle demands that a certain promise be fulfilled, to Elena’s confusion. 

(Source: Manta)

For indie band vocalist Hoyeong, music is everything—his passion, his life, his identity. But when the charismatic CEO of a famous fashion label, Lee Yijun, approaches him with an unexpected offer to model for his brand, Hoyeong’s world is turned upside down. As their creative worlds of music and fashion collide, Ho-Young finds himself drawn into a whirlwind of emotions, desires, and unexpected connections that challenge everything he thought he knew about himself. In the tension between fame and authenticity, will Hoyeong be able to find his true voice?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: I Raided the Demon God's Treasure Trove
description:
The peace of the world collapses after a war between the gods and demons, leading to the downfall of humanity—except for one person. Sewoon, the sole survivor, is determined to rewrite the ending of this tragic tale. While searching for Kronos' hourglass to reverse time, he discovers the treasure trove of the Demon of Greed, filled with items that can aid him in achieving his goal. With these demonic treasures at his disposal, can Sewoon stop the war and secure lasting peace in the world?

(Source: Tapas)

"Gamemaster," a high school streamer, dedicated his life to beating the supposedly unbeatable game "Hero's Destiny." Finally succeeding after ten years, the realization that he's wasted his life is short-lived, as the game asks him to keep playing—only for him to wake up inside the game after he agrees, in the body of Callix Szcecin, the meek young son of a count. Together with Lyla, the maid and assassin hired by his stepmother who failed to kill him, Russel, the loyal knight, and Kraut, a young knight with much potential, Callix must survive the game again, in person.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: The Mighty Master Is Crazy About Me
description:
For her sister's happiness and happy ending, Charlotte decides to bring home the knight who holds her sister's heart. However, that means getting to the Black Dragon Order, where the mysterious Archduke Ludovika lurks. With rumors of the archduke's penchant for men, Charlotte dons a wig and becomes Charcharl, a new squire of the order! Despite trying to lay low, she keeps drawing the archduke's eye and suspicions. Can Charcharl keep up the act till the end, or will her cover get blown?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Your Grace, Please Fail for Once!
description:
Nellie Pepper, land steward to the paranoid psycho Duke Lionel Alterwood, dies from overwork after three years of torture. As she closes her eyes, her final wish is to get revenge. Miraculously, she soon wakes up on her first day of work again! Ready to sabotage her cruel boss, she embarks on all sorts of wicked plans. However, every attempt hilariously backfires, and she ends up improving the duchy instead! Will Nellie be able to enact her revenge and finally make the duke fail for once? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Merman Trapped in My Lake
description:
Servaine Noxirel grew up hearing stories from her great-grandfather—tales of the grandeur their noble house once enjoyed and the madness and obsession that ran through their bloodline. The strangest story of all, however, was about his sickly young niece and the merman she owned—a boy whose beauty and allure inspired a possessiveness that kept him locked away in a tank. Despite bearing a striking resemblance to her namesake, Servaine dismisses everything as just a fairy tale. That is, until Servaine’s return to her ancestral manor dredges up Mel, the merman—who believes his Servaine has finally come back for him. But has he been waiting all this time out of love? Or for revenge…?

(Source: Ize Press)

Sohyun knows all about the grind. She's dedicated herself to crawling up the corporate ladder by any means necessary, but a girl's got to blow off steam sometimes! Speaks fly when Sohyun meets a handsome stranger during after work drinks, and their resulting one-night stand scratches an itch. But will it remain just one night? 

(Source: Manta)

After getting scammed with his apartment, Hyeon-U needed quick cash. After getting an offer from his close friend, he starts working as a delivery man of . He thought it was going to be a regular delivery service, but his first customer grabs "His part".

*"Did it get big because of me?"*

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Abandoned as an infant in the mystical Siuta Forest, Freya knows nothing of her past. Driven to uncover the truth of her origins, she becomes a priestess and embarks on a pilgrimage back to the forest. There, she begins dreaming of a red-haired man named Aran, whose appearance mirrors the kingdom's legendary hero from an ancient mural. As the dreams repeat, Freya starts to suspect they may hold a deeper meaning. Who is this man, and what is the truth behind their mysterious connection?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Overflowing Elixir of the Fallen House
description:
Ryeon knew from the moment she was born that her life was a cursed one. Born sickly in a martial arts family meant she had nothing else to do other than wait for death. And when that icy embrace came, it delivered not peace but a second chance at life! Regressed to her days as a child, Ryeon resolves to cure herself and live a long, healthy life for the sake of herself and her family.

(Source: Tapas)

K-pop idol Yoon Eden has wasted away for years under a mediocre label with an incompetent CEO. He is disillusioned and on the verge of quitting when he's sent back in time to the day of his debut. Now, Eden is determined to use his songwriting talent to rewrite his career and gain some well-deserved fame. Despite his CEO still pushing cheesy songs and tacky concepts, can Eden, with the help of his group members, truly reignite his spark and become a sincerely dazzling idol?

(Source: Tapas)

*"The world has ended now, so how about I try keeping human pets?"*

I don't know why, but the world has come to an end. People don't hesitate to murder their friends and family as survival and desire are the only values that rule over them. All the survivors of this new world were given a single skill of their choice. Seong-Cheol, suffering from insomnia, chose the skill "sleep." Using his skill, he begins to hunt women and rape them after he puts them to sleep!

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Working at a small company is tough... Even worse when you work with two incompetent women. Well, guess what. I'm the boss now.

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: The Deviless's Impression of a Princess
description:
How to catch a knight? Impersonate a princess! Lilith the Demon Queen longs to meet a knight like the ones she reads about in books. In order to lure one to her castle, she kidnaps a princess and waits. Much to her delight, the knight who shows up is exactly as she pictured him! She decides to disguise herself as the princess to capture his heart...

(Source: Manta)

*“Would you really let them have their way with you?”*

The sweet scent and gentle touch of my first love, the one who once comforted me… And now, that very person is standing here, wearing nothing underneath her shirt?

(Source: DAYcomics)

display_title: I'm Going Through Time to Meet You
description:
Master sorcerers are rare. Fewer still deal with space and time. So when the empire comes for Eleanor, she escapes to the past with plans to befriend her still-living mother. But the past isn’t what she hoped—she can’t enroll in the academy, her mother is aloof, she’s at odds with the only person willing to help, and they’re also plotting to overthrow the throne. With no way to know what secrets she’ll uncover, at least one thing is clear: getting involved is the only way to keep her mom safe.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: For Sale. Ruined Lady. Not Used.
description:
It’s been three years since I became a character in the game. After I turned the ruined lady into my finest sex slave, my harem life in this world began. 

*"Show me your affection and cherish me... Master!"*

(Source: DAYcomics)

From archenemies to fictional lovers! 

Tae-Yeon is horrified when she finds herself co-teaching an after-school writing class with her college nemesis, Yong-Jin. Little does she realize that the worst is yet to come. They're in for a wild ride when they get sucked into a novel written by 8-year-olds, where absurdity becomes reality! 

(Source: Manta)

As a child, A-Rin is adopted by the wealthy Chairman Moon, but is shunned by his family. Although her adoptive mother, Anna, hates her guts, her snooty remarks only make A-Rin's attachment to her stronger. When A-Rin grows up and discovers her ability to turn men into her minions by kissing them, she comes up with the devious plan to hold her brothers hostage and get what she wants from Anna. What results is a scandalous power struggle that threatens to topple the Moon Family's legacy! Will A-Rin succeed in taking over the family that once treated her like dirt?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

*Note: This comic contains suggestions of incest. Reader discretion is advised.*

His friends betrayed and abandoned him in a foreign country, and now he aims to take everything away from them. The unstoppable revenge of a tough guy begins!

*"As expected, a successful man's woman is delicious. I'll enjoy her from now on."*

(Source: DAYcomics)

Years after losing Matthew, the friend he secretly adored, retired soldier Jaden still battles lingering PTSD. Hoping to clear his head, he drops everything and sets off on an unplanned adventure. His travels lead him to a charming town where he meets Diego, a man who looks astonishingly like Matthew. At first unsettled, Jayden soon finds himself drawn to Diego’s warm, lively spirit. As they grow closer, Jayden begins to rediscover joy, laughter, and maybe even love. Could this unexpected encounter be the fresh start he’s long needed and the chance to finally heal his heart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Su-Hyeok and Seo-Ha secretly like each other, but when Seo-Ha plans to move out, it's her mom who makes a move on Su-Hyeok.

(Source: Toomics)

Having lost his parents at a young age, Se-Hyun finds his life endlessly miserable. But when he meets Yu-No, a mysterious boy who magically appeared before him, the two quickly find solace in one another. As Yu-No visits Se-Hyun every week, their feelings gradually become more complex as they grow up. With rain pouring down on Se-Hyun's dating life and dark clouds shrouding Yu-No's family life, will they each find what they need once the skies clear? Or will the storm wash away what could have been?

(Source: Tapas)

Veronica lost everything—her home, her family, and even her humanity. Her monstrous red eyes see only horror until Leon, a renegade holy knight, presses a kiss to her lips. Could he be her only hope for salvation?

(Source: Manta)

Han Boreum just wanted answers about his mysterious illness—not a death sentence. But the shaman he visits drops a bombshell:

*“You’re overflowing with dark yin energy. If you don’t sleep with a man full of yang energy, you won’t live long.”* 

Desperate to survive, Boreum sets out to find his “yang-guy,” and right on cue appears Joo Tae-Yang—campus heartthrob, top business student, and nicknamed “Apollo” by his admirers. Perfect, right? Except... he’s a two-faced jerk only when it comes to Boreum. Still, with his life on the line, Boreum launches a clumsy, tear-filled operation to seduce his moody match. Between awkward attempts at flirtation and unexpected sparks, Boreum starts to wonder— Could survival turn into something a little sweeter?

A one-sided love? A healing romance? Or just a very chaotic medical emergency? Either way, he’s not going down without a fight!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

After being reborn in a novel, Renee Blair is determined to transform her reputation as "the villainess of the century," which will prevent her death at the hands of Sir Dywen the dragon slayer! But then she learns that the original Renee had been controlled by a pop-up game system of daily missions that forced her to either commit evil deeds or face painful penalties for declining. With this system continuing to affect her as well, can the new Renee outsmart the game and reset her evil legacy?

(Source: Tapas)

Despite the barriers between them as servant and master, Dean and Lady Sarah have always been close, and lately, their relationship has been warming up even more. But everything is disrupted when Sarah’s family pushes her into an engagement with the wealthy and chauvinistic Count Van Der Sar, who only wants an innocent virgin for a wife. Sarah is determined to do whatever it takes to dissuade him from marrying her. Unfortunately, the ensuing love affair threatens to bring about not only her own ruin, but that of everyone she holds dear. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

In a war against demons for the fate of the world, even three chances at life may not suffice. Such is the fate of Lady Sacred Beryl, a divine maiden tasked with rooting out demonic corruption, only to be murdered and travel back in time -- twice. Upon her third attempt, Beryl realizes the truth: Her only hope to purify the realm is to face the fearsome House Vine, a lair of demons in mortal guise. Can Beryl survive in the domain of Duke Beleth von Vine, or will she find nothing but death and damnation once more?

(Source: WEBTOON)

A girl just can't catch a break!

Having wished to live an unconventional life, Emily gets accepted into her dream school, where nobles and commoners are equals. But when she meets her fellow students and gets roped into a crazy love triangle with a prince on her first day, she begins to realize her wish may have already come true.

(Source: Manta)

"After surviving a car accident that left him in a months-long coma, Lee Soo-han wakes up with no memory of his past. Standing by his side is a mysterious man who claims to be his husband—Jo Yeon-seo.

Although they’re supposedly married, the emotional distance between them feels insurmountable. Soo-han grows wary of Yeon-seo, yet he can’t help but be drawn to the man’s steadfast devotion.

Just as Soo-han begins to feel a connection, Yeon-seo shatters his expectations with a shocking revelation: he’s ready to give Soo-han a divorce—for his own good.

The more his young husband pulls away, the more genuine Soo-han’s feelings become. Determined to break through Yeon-seo’s guarded heart, Soo-han takes matters into his own hands."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Failed horror writer Gong Chan-Hyuk’s BL webtoons are wildly popular—but he hates writing them. Then superstar Lee Hyeok-Su, his secret crush, shows up to pitch a drama adaptation. When an old tablet with steamy fanfic about Hyeok-Su falls out of Chan-Hyuk’s closet, things get… complicated. Hyeok-Su suggests they reenact the story—and their “casual” affair begins. But when Chan-Hyuk overhears a suspicious conversation, everything threatens to unravel.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sensing shifts in mana, successfully manifesting it, and attending the most prestigious school at the top of his class at a young age, Ruin Ardell is on track to become a great mage. Everything was going smoothly until he discovered that he had a condition preventing him from expelling mana. Ruin’s tumble from grace gave those jealous of him the opportunity to toy with him. But in the depths of his despair, he discovers a miracle in the form of a system message.

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Chapter count includes one extra chapter.*

Eun-Seo Lee and Si-Hwa Kang have been friends all their lives. One day, Eun-Seo shatters their comfortable relationship by asking Si-Hwa out, and Si-Hwa moves away soon afterward. Eun-Seo tries her best to forget him until they meet in a college class six years later. He seems to know about her unrequited love for him, and to make matters worse, he moves in with her family after running away from his hostile home environment. Can Eun-Seo cope with his sudden reappearance in her life? And is it possible that Si-Hwa loves her back? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Seong-Ha seeks a big man to fulfill his desires. At a freshman retreat, he meets Mu-Beom — a big guy with glasses that make his eyes tiny. Impervious to seduction and a total square, Mu-Beom puzzles Seong-Ha. Seong-Ha hates alphas, and Mu-Beom has a thing for pheromones. How will this odd pair turn out? 

(Source: Manta) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

In the shadows of Mt. Bukhan, a lonely tiger spirit discovers the corpse of a man and seizes the chance to live among humans in his body. Dreaming of love but armed with raw instinct, he stumbles through human life until he meets Suhyeon, a quiet young man with a shaman grandmother who sends him to confront the unruly spirit. But when a protective charm breaks, the tiger’s suppressed desires explode, and he becomes fiercely obsessed with making Su-Hyeon his mate—promising to protect him for life, no matter what. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

display_title: The Youngest Disciple of the Hwasan Sect
description:
Biyeon always hoped to be a baby in a romance fantasy webtoon and live idly if she were ever reborn. So she's shocked when she gets her wish... but as an infant in the world of martial arts! Nevertheless, despite brutal training and harsh realities, Biyeon tries her best to form new relationships and become a true member of the Hwasan Sect. With the knowledge from her past life and the support of Hwasan disciples, can Biyeon rise to the top and find the life she dreamed of in this world? 

(Source: Tapas)

Born into privilege and raised like a princess, Oh Ro-Ji looks spoiled on the outside, but underneath the theatrics is someone painfully soft-hearted. To live a “normal” life, she’s spent years pretending to be the perfect girlfriend, forcing herself through a relationship that finally ends when her hopelessly bad-in-bed boyfriend pushes her past her limit. One night, Ro-Ji wanders into a women-only bar…and locks eyes with Lee Jin. Instant attraction. A spark she’s never felt before. And when Jin shows her what real desire feels like, Ro-Ji discovers a world of pleasure that she can only share with her.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Thirty years ago, Lynn embarked on a quest to destroy the Orb of Evil, but she was betrayed and sacrificed by her companions to seal the orb. Now, she has woken up in the body of a young girl, only to find out that she was framed as a traitor and is now remembered as such in history. To make matters worse, the child whose body she's borrowing appears to have been traumatized by years of abuse. Lynn is determined to set the record straight... But first, she'll avenge this little girl!

(Source: Tapas)

*"If only I could live like in an eroge even in real life... that would be fun."*

After finishing his military service, Jin-Seok Lee went back to enjoying his usual eroge. But one day, the powers from his games suddenly appeared in reality?!

*"With this ability, I can make anyone do whatever I want."*

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

*"I'll become a perfect loser and punish you."*

Eun-Hyeok returned to his high school days when he was a loser. He trembled with anxiety at first, but he started taming the bullies, armed with his past.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

*"I thought of my tremors as an ability, not an illness!"*

Yu-Jun begins using his vibrating body to pleasure various women he encounters throughout his life.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

What would you do when you've transmigrated as the most-hated villainess in the story? In the case of Marso, she tried hard to change the storyline by performing good deeds and taking care of the female lead. However, things are not going as she had hoped for—every character in the story still hates her! It seems no matter what she does she cannot seem to change her fate. Tired of trying, Marso declares that she'll stay home and do nothing—for the rest of her life. 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Stacy and I have a mutual agreement... to "help" each other when in need... What could possibly go wrong... right?

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: The Possessive Tyrant and His Sleepy Cat
description:
I've found myself trapped in a mature-rated novel as a cursed cat, whose mere existence is believed to be harmful to the empire. This place has killed every cat in every alley all because of one prophecy... The moment anyone finds me will be my last moment in this life. 

*"What's this?"* 

Before I could even think of escaping, the male lead, who's fated to become a mad tyrant, effortlessly snatches me up. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Hiding her identity as a Snow Maiden demon, Seol-Ha has carved out a life in disguise among humans. However, her life changes forever when she catches the interest of the Northern Prince, a man known for hunting down and killing demons, and agrees to become his bride. Will these two be able to overcome their differences and live happily ever after?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: My Childhood Friend Is a BL Novel Protagonist
description:
Mina wakes up inside an R18 BL novel as Sofia, the childhood friend of the main character, Aiden, and she’s thrilled to have a front-row view of his reverse harem. But for some reason, the handsome male leads start to take an interest in her instead, leaving Aiden feeling somewhat... jealous?

(Source: Manta)

After discovering that his wife was cheating on him, Seong-Tae finds himself sent back to the time before their marriage. Determined to get revenge, he decides to use the secret of his mother-in-law, who once cherished him like her own son, to make his unfaithful wife pay.

*"Seong-Tae, you can't do this..."*

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

display_title: Even Though the Duchess Wants To
description:
Lariela was living an idyllic life until an ashwood box arrived at her doorstep brimming with gold--a gift from high society’s most eligible bachelor, Duke Elmano. High-ranked, well-bred and, best of all, incredibly handsome, Lariela knows that she’s in for a whole new life when he asks for her hand. But even more than the pressures of the imperial court's inner circles, it’s the Duke himself that surprises her most—when he leaves her cold and untouched on their wedding night.

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.*

During a terrorist attack, CEO Jung-Hoon is saved by a soldier named Ha-Yoon Jang. Determined to find her, he hires ex-special forces Ji-Woo as his secretary. As they clash and grow closer, a hidden truth and a corporate plot threaten everything. Can Ji-Woo protect Jung-Hoon while keeping her secret?

(Source: Manta)

Yoo-Joon is a good boy. That's why he was destined to fall head-over-heels for the handsome and charismatic Ji-Ho. When Ji-Ho says "Jump," Yoo-Joon asks "How high?" And as the pair become more inseparable by the day, they solidify their master-dog dynamic. But little do they know, each boy is harboring his own dark secret. Ji-Ho, who suffers from severe apathy resulting from childhood trauma, is using Yoo-Joon as an expendable toy, and Yoo-Joon is intensely and obsessively in love with Ji-Ho. Despite that, can the two boys successfully remove each other's masks and break the cycle of abuse?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Harang is a rising star in women’s handball… until she isn’t. Unexpectedly sidelined by a devastating shoulder injury, Harang tries to return to her daily grind as a student. But life has a way of throwing huge curveballs, and she finds herself a part of the women’s futsal team at her high school along with passionate, determined teammates. Women’s national league, here we come…?! 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Stone Thrown in the Lake
description:
A villainous queen sacrifices everything for her brother, only to be betrayed. Reborn in the past with a chance to right her wrongs, she must confront the tangled web of love and family that once destroyed her.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Executed for failing to save the emperor, Serena Vincent wakes up again and again on the day she’s assigned as his physician. Azaid Khan Krothen, the emperor's bastard son from a lowly maid, was cast aside at birth. But he now sits on a throne others want to control. As Serena races to cure his mysterious illness, each failure ends in her death. Trapped in a deadly loop, she must find the cure to the emperor's illness... before her next death is her last.

(Source: Tapas)

After more than ten years together, Seojin’s boyfriend walks out without warning, only to announce he’s engaged to her boss’s daughter. When her life feels completely dried out, a man appears and pulls her into a one-week summer romance she assumes will fade like a dream. But the real shock comes later: that same man is introduced as a CEO at her new job. A thrilling adult office romance between guarded secretary Hyeon Seojin and her bold, relentlessly straightforward new boss, Chae Juwan.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Ahjin is a crippled boy doing house chores under insomniac gang boss Seokju. Unexpectedly, they make two damaged sides of a good pair. Unfortunately, fate has other ideas for them, and as their lives spiral downwards, one question remains: are they damned to this destiny, or can they find a happy ending? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

After being returned to the past multiple times, Lyatte finally succeeds in escaping execution by murdering her treasonous husband. The only catch is that each time she returned, it cost her half of her remaining lifespan, and now she has less than two years left. Determined to live the rest of her short life to its fullest, Lyatte decides to hold a contest to find a new husband. Will the competition be a success, or will Lyatte's time run out before she can experience true love?

(Source: Tapas)

In a world where names mysteriously appear on skin, pianist Do-Hwa "Eden" Ye-On finds Tristan Locke's name etched on his body. But after tracking the reclusive nobleman to a forest manor, Eden learns his name isn’t on Tristan. As his life ebbs without Tristan's touch, Eden clings to a man who stubbornly rejects him.

(Source: Manta)

Beloved idol Yoon-Jae Ahn, renowned for his impeccable charm and striking appearance, secures a coveted spot on a popular variety show, boosting his solo career. Just as he’s savoring success, his forgotten past resurfaces, threatening his celebrity status. Can Yoon-Jae shield his career from the looming secrets? With stakes at their highest, will his charm and unwavering determination prove sufficient to conquer the ghosts of his past? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

When the ruthless Lord Tiwakan seizes the kingdom of Nauk, Princess Liene Arsac faces an impossible choice: marry her captor or watch her homeland crumble. But Lord Tiwakan isn’t just after power; he desires Liene, and his devotion stirs a mix of fear and undeniable attraction within her. With her former betrothed, Lafitte, still missing, Liene must decide whether to trust Tiwakan's promises or hold out hope for a rescue. As dangerous secrets come to light, Liene’s decision could change the fate of Nauk—and her own heart—forever.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Dennis keeps getting dumped. He’s popular and sexy, but his girlfriends always fall for his classmate, Evan. They’re not the only ones charmed by Evans’s handsome face and thoughtful ways, though. Even Dennis is having a hard time remembering he hates Evan, and Evan seems way too flirty for a rival. 

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

display_title: Hacking to get closer to streamers!
description:
One day, a hacking app gets installed in Seon-U's phone by chance. With the app, he finds out about the secrets of female streamers, and starts using the secrets to approach them.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: Living Out My Deadline as the Tyrant's Wife
description:
When she wakes up as an extra in a fantasy novel, married to a villain and destined to be poisoned to death, Lea knows she must change her fate. Her strategy? Get rid of the booze and men in her harem, soften up her tyrannical emperor husband by being kind and gentle with him, and make him fall in love with her for real! But he’s been trained his whole life not to feel anything at all... Hopefully, that pesky prophecy about an emperor with feelings bringing doom to the empire isn’t true! 

(Source: Tapas)

Meet Ido Noh, a shy first-year high school student with a severe stutter that makes talking to people nearly impossible. Her life changes when she meets Se-i Ryu, a robot with a mysterious past and a quest to reclaim his lost memories. Can Ido find her voice with this unlikely friend, and will Se-i uncover the secrets of his origin?

_Source: Webtoon_

*"Shove it inside your hole while I watch. It's an order."*

The ruthless revenge of a man who was bullied in high school began with the kidnapping of the delinquent girl who drove him to near death.

(Source: DAYcomics)

After fleeing from his home during a family feud, Boris Jineman is left with only his brother and Winterer, the family's treasured sword. But when his beloved brother sacrifices his life for him, 12-year-old Boris becomes the sole guardian of Winterer in a world where this sword is coveted by all. As Boris struggles to fend off those who are after his family blade, his heart only grows colder and stiffer. Will this young boy be able to survive this winter to reach the spring that awaits him? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I'm the Tutor of the Twin Highnesses
description:
Sara Popo was a highly-regarded elementary school teacher in her past life. Reborn into a new world, she becomes a sought-after tutor for aristocratic children. Her unique methods quickly earn her praise--and the Emperor’s attention. He asks Sara to tutor his notorious twin siblings, infamous for their wild pranks. While a daunting challenge, she can’t refuse the Emperor’s generous offer.Winning over the twins might be her specialty, but can she handle the Emperor’s irresistible charm too? 

(Source: Tapas)

After a bus accident, Lim Mari awakens to find herself in a novel as an odd-eyed cat named Marie. Mistaken for a spiritual animal, she's gifted to cold Emperor Klaus von Bismarck. While Klaus slowly warms up to Marie, she is focused on finding a way to turn human... until she stumbles upon an assassination plot targeting Klaus! Despite being powerless and unable to tell anyone what she knows, can this cute ball of fluff find a way to save her new owner? And will she ever become human again?

*Source: Tapas*

People live their lives hiding their personal desires and circumstances in silence, but deep down, they all long to bloom one day.

*"Let me strip away your skin, your sweat... your scent, and every breathy moan."*

(Source: DAYcomiccs)

Su-a, a college freshman in Creative Writing, struggles to understand and express her emotions, leaving her isolated from those around her. When she meets Taeyang, a second-year Sports Coaching student who can sense emotions through touch, their unexpected connection sparks a journey of discovery. Paired for a class assignment that involves a "date," their bond deepens. This is a story about a man who feels too much and a woman who feels too little, and their journey toward emotional growth. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: D.I.L.D.O: Droid for Immersive Libido Dynamics Optimization
description:
For Seo Jae-Yun, a seemingly innocent game of Secret Santa is about to change his life. After unwrapping his special gift, he is shocked to find a dildo - and one that can come to life, at that! The dildo will do anything to please his master, and try as he might, Jae-Yun can’t find it in himself to kick his newfound companion out. Instead, perhaps they can work together find the greatest gift of all...deep, deep inside.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Kang Yohan, plagued by endless misfortune, turns to the supernatural to change his luck. Too broke for a proper summoning ritual, he settles for a ""Do it Yourself"" version and ends up with Chung—a so-called ""cost-effective"" god.But life doesn’t come cheap. Yohan is about to learn two hard truths: you get what you pay for, and nothing comes without a price. Now, he must fulfill Chung’s bizarre conditions to finally escape his cursed fate!

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.*

After a messy breakup, beta Hae-Min swore off alphas for good… until a reckless one-night stand with dominant alpha Seong-Han turns him into an omega overnight. Now stuck needing a regular partner (doctor’s orders!), Hae-Min bites the bullet and proposes a deal with Seong-Han, who just so happens to be his newest coworker. One weekly “appointment” turns into sparks flying - but just when things start to look sweet, who should show up as their new boss but Jin-Tae, the ex who dumped Hae-Min for being a beta?! From awkward office deals to tangled love triangles, Hae-Min’s love life is about to get a lot more complicated.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Despite standing by Black Dragon Akelans’ side for 14 years as his loyal vassal, Hasolan was never accepted as his mate, her love left unrequited until the day she took her own life. But upon opening her eyes, Hasolan finds herself back in the past on the day she first awakened Akelans. Though she tries to change her fate in this life, she ends up in the merciless dragon’s clutches once more. Except this time, there’s something different about him. To Hasolan’s shock, Akelans acknowledges her as his mate right away. But at this point, it may be too late... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ho-Yun, a cynical, jaded office drone, is roped into housing Ju-Ho, an annoyingly upbeat college freshman he once knew as the kid next door. Now, instead of quiet mornings, Ho-Yun wakes up to home-cooked meals and a giant puppy of a housemate who can't stop looking at him like he's the best view in the house.

(Source: Manta, edited)

 *Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

Kang Yui lost his parents in an accident, and has been blaming himself ever since. As bad things keep happening to those who try to get close to him, he decides to shut himself off from the rest of the world and live a life of solitude. But then comes the effervescent Lee Hyun, his new roommate at university: with his motto of “never give up,” Hyun is determined to wiggle his way into Yui’s heart, one way or another. But is Hyun bound to be beaten in this battle? Or is there still room for love in Yui’s life? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

After her first molt reveals red feathers symbolic of a curse, Lindsey Raniero of the Eagle Clan is shunned by her family and dies alone. She awakens in the past, only 7 years old. Wishing to escape her fate, Lindsey takes her bird form to run away and makes a deal with the rival Wolf Clan: She will wed their ailing heir and heal him with her clan's power in exchange for their protection. But surrounded by wolves and with her family now on her tail, can this little bird live to spread her wings?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I Swear I'm Not a Scammer!
description:
Yeon-Woo's an author but his work isn't going so well and there's the slight problem of his stalker (aka his ex). When he looks for a new place to live, the landlord of the apartment is suspiciously young and way too handsome...but desperate times call for desperate measures!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Achoo! Love is in the air - and it’s causing Ki Je-Yeon a real headache. As a dominant omega, she has the power to help alphas heal through a process known as “guiding.” The only problem is, she’s allergic to others’ pheromones. Luckily for her, she has her childhood best friend and recessive alpha, Cha Jae-Heon, to help her through all her symptoms! But wait, why is she starting to sneeze every time Jae-Heon’s around her now? That would mean he’s releasing pheromones, which would mean… Oh… Oh no…

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes nine extra chapters.*

Writing a manual on lovemaking seems to be the only way Sungjae can leave the Joseon era and get back to his original world! But can he really do it?!

(Source: Toomics)

Copywriter Seon Jaewon has been losing his mind over a rival social media account that keeps parodying his creative ads. He’s ready to kill whoever is behind it, but not before he’s “killed” in bed by his hot neighbor, Lee Hyeonjin. After an impulsive first night together, the two men quickly hit it off, and Jaewon feels like he might finally see some sparks fly in his loveless life. Well, as long as this perfect man doesn’t turn out to be his worst enemy or anything. But what are the chances of that... right?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Min-Ho ends up living with his two childhood friends after his dad asks one of them to tutor him for his college entrance exam.

(Source: Toomics, edited)

display_title: I Became a Level 999 Demon Queen
description:
The terminally ill daughter of a poor family is given a new lease on life when she is granted the chance to be reborn as anyone she wants. But her plans go awry when she accidentally wishes to become the wrong character of the video game she likes—Raina Rubellite, the final evil boss that torments the righteous main character of the game “The Power of Love”. Now, our protagonist finds herself reborn as an evil devil queen with overpowered dark magic powers, but she won’t let the video game’s plot stop her from living the life of her dreams!

(Source: WEBTOON)

A rumor is going around in a college town that a yogurt lady is going around drinking the yogurt of the male college students. Jun-U, curious to get to the bottom of the rumor, asks his yogurt lady about the rumor.

*"I want to eat your yogurt, Jun-U."*

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

As the best arcane swordsman, Hildegart's feats made House Acaraxia the greatest noble family in the empire, amassing both wealth and prestige. But after being tasked with sealing away the Demon God, Hildegart was forced to sacrifice her life. In a twist of fate, she wakes up in the body of her 12-year-old great-great-grandniece 80 years later, where, much to her shock, her family has fallen into total ruin. Can the reincarnation of the first Hildegart restore her family to its former glory? 

(Source: Tapas)

After a life of family abuse and betrayal, Lumina Lanchoux, a supernatural Leggion being, is saved from the brink of death by her half-brother Endymion. Just then, her healing powers awaken, and she is discovered by Duke Hart, the most powerful living Leggion. He sends her back in time to age 12 with the mission of saving his son Karajan from death by his own superpowers. Under the care of House Hart, Lumina is set for a peaceful second life. That is until she learns of the duke's deadly secret. 

(Source: Tapas)

Han-Byuk isn’t thrilled when his new neighbor turns out to be the cold, aloof Yeo-Min. After hearing Yeo-Min moaning through their too-thin apartment walls and having an awkward interaction the next day, Han-Byuk gets a glimpse of his neighbor with his guard down. He's shy. Cute, even. Han-Byuk decides to double his efforts to befriend his neighbor and, surprised by each other and themselves, they grow closer until the lines of their friendship blurs into something...more.

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Chapter count includes one side story chapter.*

Yi-Jae, an ambitious small town cop, discovers that his first love, Jun-Hyuk, is involved in the band of criminals known as the Black Goat Gang. Forced to pose as lovers, they must navigate danger and desire. Can their fake romance help put the bad guys behind bars, or will their tangled past blow their cover?

(Source: Manta)

Humanity’s once peaceful world was turned upside down when monsters suddenly emerged from a portal in the sky. When all hope was lost, special people with powerful abilities called “attributes” appeared—they called themselves Hunters. To survive, humanity turned to education, creating academies to produce the best Hunters. Though his attribute is low-level, Yusung Shin is determined to rise to the top of Gaon Academy—the best Hunter Academy in the world.

(Source: Tapas)

Chase feels uncomfortable at home because his foster family hates him, but not everything is what it seems.

(Source: Toomics)

Flynn is an upbeat fox selling homemade beverages to make money.
