While he’s looked down upon as a petty vendor from a cunning species, Flynn is determined to live an honest life while searching for his long-lost brother. However, when he catches the eye of the wealthy dragon Hugo, Flynn finds himself forced to become a pawn in a game of political chess where his brother’s life is on the line. Now, Flynn must give up his honest life and trick Hugo into a sweet trap… But can he really outfox the skeptical dragon?

(Source: Tappytoon)

In the not-so-distant future, humanity faces extinction, not from war or disease, but from a total lack of action between the sheets. With AI doing everything (including flirting), people have stopped dating, marrying, or even having sex. Enter the Onnuri Sex Culture Laboratory, humanity's last, horny hope. Their solution? A time machine. Their mission? Study the golden ages of getting it on. Meet Garam, an awkward grad student turned chronosexual researcher, who's now zipping through history under the wing of the mysterious and seductive Professor Eun Ahyeon. From ancient orgies to disco-era hookups, Garam must document sex culture and harvest the elusive energy source known as... Orgasium. History class has never been this NSFW.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A downtrodden security guard embarks on a quest for power and dominance, using hypnosis to transform his life.

(Source: Toomics)

Acknowledged for his skills, Kang-Cheol is hired by a group of lovely women. But when faced with their alluring temptations, he ends up crossing the line...

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

After a painful breakup with her first love, Eunpyeong returns to campus still haunted by the past and burdened by a secret fantasy she’s afraid to reveal. When Nyeok, a younger guy, discovers her secret by chance, he responds with unexpected acceptance. Their bond deepens, but complications arise when another girl enters the picture, and Eunpyeong learns Nyeok has been denying their relationship. What will become of their romance, trust, and life on campus?

(Source: WEBTOON)

At the start of the summer monsoon season and after serving nearly six years for a failed murder attempt, Seoha is released and finds refuge at Maison de Menthe, thanks to an old prison acquaintance, Choi Minyeong. But soon, a man unexpectedly enters Seoha’s life—the very neighbor Minyeong warned him about.

*"There's a lunatic living next door... He's a creepy perv who's always trying to get me to sleep with him."*

Blunt and unapologetic in his desires, the man becomes Seoha’s one escape from a past filled with nightmares—the only thing that makes her feel alive again.

*"Why don't we keep hooking up, then?"
"Why?"
"They say people only realize that they're alive when they feel the warmth of another..."
"..."
"Cause I'm trying to keep you alive, pretty girl."
"Fine..."*

Little by little, the emptiness in Seoha’s life begins to be filled with Kwon Yiheon. But there's something fishy about this man…

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Stuck in Class With the Crazy Male Leads
description:
Just when Hayeon thought her luck couldn't get worse, a freak accident lands her smack in the middle of the trashy romance novel she wrote back in high school. But this isn't some fun fantasy—it's a nightmare. From the calculating psychopath Sunwoo to the obsessive, love-starved Yihan and the terrifying stalker Chanseung, every one of these male leads is a walking disaster. Is this second chance the miracle Hayeon’s been waiting for, or will she regret ever writing this chaos into existence? 

(Source: Tapas)

In a world of hunters, monsters, and dungeons, Ina is just an ordinary Korean woman--and she wouldn’t have it any other way. Ina was a spiritualist in her previous life, but now she can finally enjoy a peaceful world... or so she thought. One day, after touching a mysterious egg found in a dungeon, Ina reawakens her S-rank spiritualist ability! With her new spirit companions, a couple of troublemakers named Iz and Rika, will Ina ever fulfill her dream of living a quiet life?

(Source: Tapas)

Doo-San and Tae-San were inseparable as teens, just two boys, side-by-side at their favorite arcade. Now reunited as adults, nothing’s changed…and yet everything has. Their bond is as tight as ever, but lately, the air between them crackles with something more. Doo-San can’t stop overthinking every glance, every brush of skin, every heartbeat. Just when he thinks he can keep burying those feelings, someone new shows up, ready to drive a wedge right through whatever’s been building between them. Unless Doo-San can work up the courage to face his own feelings, that is...

(Source: Lezhin US)

All Seong-a Myeong wants to do is spend her life playing video games. Unfortunately, after defeating a streamer in an online game and taking his money, she realizes that he is actually a boy in her class named Hanjun Kang, who also happens to be a terrifying delinquent! Determined to keep her identity a secret, she decides to request a class transfer, only to run into Tae-ui An, another classmate who looks exactly like her game character! Can she spend time with Tae-ui while keeping Hanjun from discovering who she really is?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Thirty-year-old Gang Nak-Kyeong is a boiler repairman by day and a dog-loving shelter volunteer in his free time. He’s more than happy to enjoy his simple, ordinary life until twenty-four-year old Nam Ji-Ha comes crashing into his life, calling him out for late night repairs and animal advice. Is Nak-Kyeong ready to let another stray into his heart, or will Ji-Ha have to keep searching for his forever home…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

 *Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.*

For two decades, Actress Kang Seo has been haunted by terrible nightmares. Then, out of the blue, San Han, the man who always rescued her in those dreams, appears before her in real life as her personal bodyguard. Will Kang be able to uncover the true identity of this mysterious figure?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Min-Chan has lived his whole life as part of the elite top 1%—an Alpha who always wins. Bored with his perfect life, he accepts a friend's invitation to join Fight Club, a brutal underground arena where only fighting skills matter. What starts as a casual thrill quickly escalates when Min-Chan begins competing himself—and winning easily, just like always. But just as victory starts to feel hollow, he faces an opponent he can't beat: Tae-Wook, a smaller, seemingly fragile Omega. Crushed by his first-ever defeat, Min-Chan is furious—and obsessed. He approaches Tae-Wook, only to be met with complete indifference, a blow to his pride he can't ignore. Then one night, fate strikes: Tae-Wook enters his heat cycle, and Min-Chan doesn’t miss his chance. Pride, instinct, and raw attraction collide—

In this fight, winning might mean losing everything Min-Chan thought he knew.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Minji may seem like an ordinary girl, but she has a secret no one knows—she’s living a double life. By day, she’s an awkward, introverted outcast, but by night, she transforms into Eunha, a stunning social butterfly. Her secret life takes an unexpected turn when a mysterious man known as "Black" approaches her with an offer:

*"If you want to become a member of our secret club, you must pass a test. You must sleep with two men you are already acquainted with."*

Determined to enter the exclusive club, Minji sheds her shy persona and steps into her Eunha identity, seducing everyone from a childhood friend to a sunbae at her college—even her landlord. But will Minji— or rather, Eunha— succeed in gaining entry, or will her carefully constructed double life come crashing down?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kwon Sehyeon is both an alpha and omega who enters the beta dorm at his university to hide his unusual trait. Since his omega side awakened late and is unstable, he needs to avoid alphas at all costs. But as it turns out, his kind roommate and old friend, Seo Junhoo, also entered the beta dorm hiding the fact that he is an alpha. Once he learns the truth, Sehyeon knows he should change rooms and stay away from Junhoo. However, an unexpected heat cycle has the two friends crossing the point of no return... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

When Jade Browen wakes up inside a dark cabin, she thinks her enemies have finally defeated her. After all, a talented young fire mage is bound to be targeted. And ever since her parents’ death, Jade’s family members have had their sights set on her claim to House Browen’s title as well as her life. Now that she’s been abandoned in a remote forest that nullifies all magic, she’s forced to rely on her mysterious rescuer, Axel. But as she tries to escape her predicament, the forest starts to unravel some dark past secrets...

(Source: Tappytoon) 

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by AniList standards.*

David is transferred to a small rural branch of the company he works for, where he meets the coworkers of his nightmare.

(Source: Toomics)

A cute guy with an angelic face? Check. A cold and aloof outsider with a cat? Check. A class full of vampires? Check... Wait, what? All her life, Seon-Ha Shin has lived in the shadow of her sister, Seong-Hye, who is one year older than her. Luckily, there is one thing Seon-Ha does better than her sister -- donating blood! When Seon-Ha gets special admission into a prestigious university as a blood donor, she finally starts to feel like the main character of her life. Little did she know she'd be surrounded by vampires!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

The gold dragon has taken many human forms over the years in his games. His last game ended in “death.” But when the human he’d befriended in his last game summons him, both are surprised. Mikhail can’t unsee his dead friend Adrian in the dragon, while the dragon feigns ignorance, agreeing to help Mikhail find Adrian’s body. While pondering his past lives, the dragon lingers on memories with Mikhail at the academy. But Mikhail isn’t the only one from a past game to catch up with him.

(Source: Tapas)

*"How much do I cost?"*

Tim was an average office worker until the crypto he had stashed away skyrocketed in value. Soon he discovers that his coins can be used to purchase more than just objects!

(Source: DAYcomics)

When gifted fortune teller Park Do-A dies, she transmigrates into the body of Bunnie, a curse absorber for the daughter of an archduke. As the new Bunnie, she befriends Demian, a boy prophesied to bring ruin to the empire. But when Bunnie reads Demian's fortune, she learns that, actually, he has the potential for greatness and prosperity, so she decides to shape him into the next emperor instead. Will these two be able to defy destiny and rewrite their futures? Or will the curse of fate prevail?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Soo-Hyeon’s peaceful life in the countryside, running a quaint general store and tending a garden, is upended when rumors spread of a luxury hotel project—and the arrival of Tae-Yeon, a gruff yet oddly charming director from S.W. Construction who looks more like a mob boss than a businessman. Despite warnings from the village grandmas to steer clear, Soo-Hyeon isn’t intimidated, even as Tae-Yeon’s attempts to “bribe” him with sweet treats start melting his defenses. But when an unexpected moment reveals Soo-Hyeon’s biggest secret, what starts as a clash of personalities turns into a tangled mix of sweetness, spice, and chaos that neither of them saw coming. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

“Could you sleep with me?” The moment Min Seolha accidentally lets that question slip to her boss, Cha Jeongmu, she believes she is done for. Yet to her surprise, her superior and crush of three years agrees, even adding on a condition that they won’t have a limit to the number of nights they spend together. And so begins the CEO and secretary’s steamy love affair after work hours. But unbeknownst to them, a shared tragic past could end up jeopardizing their already-risky romance... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: One Last Night With My Soon-to-Be Ex-Husband
description:
Bellia, the unfortunate Grand Duchess fated to die at the hands of her dangerous husband, planned to endure her loveless marriage just long enough to get a divorce. But before she could leave, one unexpected night changes everything.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: How to Put Your Savior on the Throne
description:
When Ines is sent back in time, she vows revenge on the man who betrayed her. But just as she’s consumed by vengeance, she crosses paths with Carson — the man who once saved her life in her previous timeline. Drawn together, they find that saving each other may be the key to healing themselves.

(Source: Manta)

Since childhood, Do-Kyung has been plagued by lingering spirits drawn to his strong yin energy - a curse that only worsens with age. Cornered by malicious ghosts, he’s saved by Yoon-Je, a powerful spirit radiating yang energy. But Yoon-Je doesn’t offer his help for free. “I’ll share my energy with you if you share yours with me.” Caught in an unusual pact, Do-Kyung must navigate this strange exchange while fending off the feelings that begin to creep into his heart. Can their balance keep the darkness at bay?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Bomtoon’s and Lezhin’s Saekgwi Danpyeonseon (색귀 단편선) Collection or Dirty Demon Collection in English.*

Lee In-Woo will do anything for his family - no matter the consequences. After learning about a potential plot to leak sensitive information, In-Woo travels back to Korea to track his brother’s last known location. His search leads him to Dr. Kang Do-Woon, a doctor with connections In-Woo is dying to get his hands on. But, as the two grow closer, both of them fall deeper and deeper into a tangled web of deceit and mystery that neither of them could have anticipated... Chasing this rainbow is bound to lead to something much less pleasant than a pot of gold. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ju-Won is a new hire in the product development team of a tea manufacturing company, quietly nursing a crush on his handsome and composed supervisor, Assistant Manager Yul. Content to admire from afar, Ju-Won keeps his feelings to himself—until one day, Yul suddenly frowns and asks, “Did someone wear perfume in the office?”

Ju-Won denies it, but Yul insists there’s a scent that only seems to linger when he’s around. Intrigued, Yul starts leaning in close, sniffing Ju-Won during every encounter under the guise of a “smell check.” What begins as an awkward misunderstanding turns into a daily ritual—one that leaves Ju-Won flustered, especially as his body begins to react to Yul’s warm breath and closeness. Caught between the sweetness of unspoken affection and the thrill of their strange new routine, Ju-Won wonders…

Could Yul be picking up more than just a scent?

(Source: Lezhin US)

My boss is thoughtful, and his wife is gentle and beautiful, but I'm committing embezzlement under their noses. While doing so, I ended up sleeping with my boss's wife against my will.

*"D-Do you really think he'll like this?"*

(Source: DAYcomics)

That song… It sounds like my brother’s unreleased track! Just before his untimely death, Su-In’s beloved older brother recorded an album dedicated to him – a final gift that was soon forgotten in a desk drawer. Years later, Su-In hears one of those tracks on TV, and it’s being claimed by his brother’s former bandmate. Now, Su-In must take the stage, beat the competition, and take back his brother’s songs… all through music.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: The Sweet Savior of the Immoral Beast
description:
Sold as a slave at a young age, Lee's life is a series of cruelty and violence until he meets Asha, a maid sent to his master on an errand. Horrified by his fatal wounds, Asha uses her healing powers to save Lee and helps him flee. Touched by her warmth, Lee vows to serve and guard Asha, while she promises to protect him. But with danger lurking everywhere for this doting duo, can Lee adapt to Asha's innocent world and keep his identity a secret? Or will he ultimately endanger his sweet savior?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Spy Life in the Demonic Sect
description:
Iseo Jang, the Murim Alliance’s prodigy spy, has spent 14 years deep undercover in the Demon Sect, earning the ruthless title of “Rabid Dog” for his work as their counterintelligence agent. But his newest mission is his most absurd yet: make the Sect’s laziest, most notorious delinquent -- Wu Ma -- the next Cheonma. To pull it off, Iseo ditches his post and applies to be Wu Ma’s official aide. In a world of betrayal, martial arts, and political games, can even a talent like Iseo turn a hopeless young master into an heir?

(Source: WEBTOON)

The warrior Erquanna wakes in a casket and hears people making light of her death. When she shocks them by opening her eyes, she realizes she’s now in the frail body of Erne de Medina, a well-known dimwit from the empire. Erne made a deal with a demon (and died in the process) that Erquanna must now fulfill. She must fall in love with one of the three strongest men in the empire—and have them fall in love with her—before her time is up and her soul is taken as payment.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: In the Shadow of the Spring
description:
Cha-Hui finds herself being forced to return to her hometown of Cheongna, where she practically ran away from after graduating high school. The reality of her family's poverty and misfortunes begin to overwhelm her, all while her first love and ex-boyfriend U-Kyeong insists on coming back into her life. She was the one who broke his heart, but he seems to still have feelings for her, flirting with her incessantly and making her waver. This is a story about Cha-Hui's heart-wrenching first love that she has no choice but to turn her back on.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

After missing the village bus, Da-Eun sets out on foot to reach her village in the remote mountains. As she stumbles wearily along, her sweaty clothes flapping in the midsummer sun, a man stops his car and offers her a ride…for a price. In the heat of the moment, Da-Eun makes a choice that will take her on the ride of her life.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

*Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.*

When Gavin becomes caretaker of his family’s apartment building, his parents joke that he should marry any tenant he falls for. On day one, he meets five stunning women, including his childhood crush. Living together has never been this tempting. 

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: Matched with My Bully on Random Chat
description:
Do-Hyeon thinks the girl he matched with might be the same one who used to torment him. But this time, he's the one holding the power, and with it, he plans to bring down his old bully, her friend... and even her family.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

display_title: How to Save the Terminally Ill Young Master
description:
I was reborn as Heraise Lorca, the cherished daughter of a viscount and nothing more than an extra in a novel—or so I thought. Life was calm until my father told me to become the playmate of Zenon Lianeric, heir to the house we serve. At first, I thought I would just keep him company, but no, he’s a complete lunatic who plays with magic and uses his friends as toys! Then I found out that he’s terminally ill—and if I can’t save him, I might not survive either!

(Source: Tapas)

Zany alchemist Rebecca O’Klein is far from a typical noble lady. At 24, she is still unmarried and spends her days cooped up at the workshop practicing her craft rather than attending lavish balls. Unfortunately, her eccentric lifestyle is jeopardized by her family pressuring her to quit her profession and finally find herself a husband. But who would want to marry “The Oddball Lady of High Society”? Enter Carlyle Rowinster, a duke who’s also reluctant to settle down. He suggests Rebecca enter a contract engagement with him, and in exchange, he’ll help her become the greatest alchemist ever! 

(Source: Tappytoon)

In a world where destiny is branded on their skin, Sepia, the human empress of the beastkin empire, is threatened by a new rival: Titié, a white deer, with Demios the emperor’s name emblazoned on her chest. Amidst Titié’s malicious attempts, Sepia clings to her role as empress and the Star of Ishtar, determined to fulfill her destiny as the empire’s savior. Enter Roxan, a wolf beastkin and cousin to Demois, whose allure stirs Sepia’s feelings. In a web of love, loyalty, and deception, can Sepia reclaim her power and discover the truth of her heart?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Seonjoo was a guy–a GUY–chillin’ in South Korea until pizza-kun sent him to Shirley-Pleehen, a game-like world. Summoneds from all universes run amok, using their Systems to adventure in dungeons for cash. But Seonjoo was summoned by the dragon god himself… into a genderless angel?!@?! He’s a GUY, I swear!! Say hello to Shirley-Pleehen’s first-ever healer class—equipped with a fairy, blessed by a dragon, and comfortable with violence! This petty fighter isn’t your average angel. 

(Source: Tapas)

One day, Lillian Sergenev bumps her head and realizes she's been reborn into a hardcore tragic romance simulation game! As the sister of the game's protagonist, she decides then and there that she's going to change the game by preventing her sister from being locked up by the crazy, obsessive male lead. She is determined to keep the two from meeting at all costs, but what is she supposed to do when said male lead suddenly turns up on her doorstep... as a gift from her father?!

(Source: Tapas)

Top idol Zetty’s rare photocard - if Siwu doesn’t buy it now, he’ll regret it forever! After finally tracking one down, Siwu rushes to meet the seller, only to run into a little cash emergency. Hwiyeon agrees to give it up for a discount, but there’s a catch. Siwu’s gotta give it up, too…and we’re not talking about photocards here. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

At the scene of a fire, Vincent meets the Karnan: the esper mastermind of this arson. He is mesmerized by Karnan's presence, which blazes on even more intensely than the flames. While interrogating his captor, Vincent makes Karnan a heated offer he can't refuse... 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Choi Ji-Hu works as secretary to Jung Da-Won, the CEO of Seungjin Corporation. On the surface, he seems like just another ordinary employee, but he’s hiding a dangerous secret - he’s received an offer promising an enormous sum of money in exchange for a damning video that could jeopardize Da-Won’s inheritance of the company. Hoping to make a big break, Ji-Hu carefully collects evidence in secret. But one day, he gets caught…by Da-Won himself! However, instead of reacting with anger, Da-Won jumps to an unpredictable conclusion: “Secretary Choi, do you love me?" Panicked, Ji-Hu blurts out a response without thinking: “Yes! I love you!” Having fallen head-over-heels for his secretary, Da-Won is about to show Ji-Hu what it means to be loved until you’re dog-tired!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three side story chapters.*

Eun-Yu’s first love was like hay fever — tingly and impossible to ignore. At 25, she gave up on her dreams and herself, hoping never to see Jae-Ha again. But when he returns colder and more dangerous, he shatters her peace, reigniting a fire she thought had long been gone.

(Source: Manta)

Jinsoo lives in a boarding house, away from his parents. Luckily for him, he’s got two hot housemates to keep him company, who are more like family than family. But as more and more guests start filling the boarding house, Jinsoo’s life is about to get a whole lot harder - in more ways than one!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Haechan dreams of becoming a hero, saving Korea from the deadly Calamities. But as a powerless guard, he is seen as a weakling. That is, until he meets Miro, a mysterious girl who offers him immense power in exchange for his help in destroying the sacred Seal Talismans—the true source of the Calamities’ wrath. Now, Haechan must embark on a dangerous mission to free the world from its torment, all while living a double life filled with secrecy, betrayal, and a growing conflict between heroism and villainy.

(Source: WEBTOON)

They called him the Calamity Sword—a rogue Mudang elder feared by the arrogant and revered by the common folk. Jeong-Hyun, once the scourge of corrupt warriors, now lives a quieter life after the death of his old friend, Mu-Baek Son, the Heavenly Demon and ruler of the Temple of the Radiant Heaven. Entrusted with Mu-Baek’s granddaughter, So-Jin, Jeong-Hyun gains more than just a ward—he gains a second chance at life and purpose.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Young Emperor is Obsessed With Me
description:
When a royal kiss fails to wake the sleeping beauty in the forest, young Prince Cedric figures a knife to the throat should do the trick. Lucky for Ariel, she awakens from her long slumber just in time to avoid a funeral at the age of 1000. Unlucky for her, she has now become the object of the twisted prince’s obsession. Though she manages to banish him from the forest for a decade, Cedric finds his way back stronger than ever as the emperor. After setting her home ablaze, he has just one thing in mind: “Let’s get married, Ariel.”

(Source: Tappytoon)

Laura, the last heir of a fallen noble house, carries a duty passed down for generations — helping those lost in time and space find their way home. It's just that nobody has shown up for the past 500 years. And now, three clients arrive at once! Can Laura handle restoring her fallen house and babysitting time-traveling bachelors?

(Source: Manta)

Seven stories. Seven sparks. One crime each time.

From pickpocketing to voyeurism, the boys in this BL omnibus break more than just laws. A smooth-talking scammer, an obsessive stalker, and a shameless cyberbully drag the objects of their desires into a world where danger fuels lust and every dirty secret is a turn-on. When one crosses the line, the other’s already hungry for more. These stories prove that the hottest crimes are the ones you don’t get caught for. After all, bad boys are irresistible.

(Source: Tappytoon)

 *Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

Mariel Peridenver can’t wait to attend the emperor’s birthday party—but not because she cares about the emperor. Her only goal is to confess her love to the man of her dreams, the dashing Sir Resnor, and have her way with him! But when the clock strikes 10, something strange happens: Mariel is seized with uncontrollable desire, making her desperate to jump into bed with someone… anyone! Can Mariel satisfy her lust, shake off this raunchy curse, and still achieve a happy ending with her dream guy?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.*

An overworked game developer dies and is reincarnated as the weakest character in the game he created himself. Challenged by Jaeseokcheon, the ruler of the game universe, he must complete a series of quests to survive and prevent a second death. Epic battles between monsters, celestial beings with magic powers, and Jaeseokcheon ensue. In this tug-of-war between the omniscient game designer and the hidden mastermind ruler… Who will win? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

If you got a second chance at life, what would you do differently? If Ignette's life was a Shakespearean story, the genre would be a tragedy. But when her death triggers a do-over for some of her life's most significant events, she is determined to approach each choice carefully, and with the most informed intentions. But with so many obstacles in the way, will she succeed in creating a different life than her last? Her pursuit of happily-ever-after with the Grand Duke is only about to begin.

(Source: Manta)

After marrying her dream man and ascending the throne, Empress Adrisa seems to have everything. But, no matter what she tries, she can’t capture the emperor’s heart. Emperor Rothbart never forgave Adrisa for the conniving that brought her to his side, tormenting his wife as revenge for his fate. But in a parallel world, the couple’s destiny is far different. On the brink of madness after the loss of his wife, there is another Emperor Rothbart who would do anything to be close to Adrisa again. 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Will You Marry Me Under Contract, Your Highness?
description:
Jenesia, a brilliant sorcerer, was murdered after witnessing an affair between her fiancé and her best friend. With her final breath, Jenesia managed to use her magical powers to turn back time. Reliving her past, will Jenesia finally be able to find happiness?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

*“I will marry you, but I have no intention to share a bed with you.”* 

The charismatic princess of Bashar meets the sharpest sword of the empire! The life of the two newlyweds united for alliance is a battle in itself. The tingling thriller of a romance between two brave and beautiful individuals who have never loved unfolds! 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Beauty, brains wealth—Duke Claude Winterville had it all, except one thing: sleep. Then April Renoen, a healer-barista, walks in and cures his insomnia with a single cup of her coffee. As they grow closer, Claude discovers that it's not just her coffee that captivates him, but the woman herself...

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Don't Try To Tame a Wild Spirit
description:
With her feisty temperament and unyielding attitude, Katherina Smirnoff is labeled a villainess by the men around her. Tired of the smug suitors trying to change her, she decides she'd rather not marry at all. While striving to escape their pursuit and stand up for herself, Katherina crosses paths with Nikolai de Bassily, the feared Grand Duke of Blood. To her surprise, he seems drawn to her and understands her for who she is. Could this be a chance at true love for the free-spirited Katherina?

(Source: Tapas)

Ryeong is the only one in her exorcist family without powers—she can only see ghosts. One night, during the village festival, she encounters Yuseong, a young man possessed by a mysterious ghost. The ghost asks Ryeong to help uncover his lost memories and break the grudge that binds him to the living world. Desperate to escape her family's cruelty, Ryeong seizes the chance to enroll in Mujang-gak, the elite martial arts school run by Yuseong’s family. As a female student in a male-dominated world, she faces relentless challenges. Can she survive and uncover the truth to free them both?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Choi Kwon is haunted by nightmares and cursed to watch those he cares about face tragic fates. Wracked with guilt, he isolates himself, until one day he decides to take a chance - only to see his classmate get hit by a car right in front of him. Though Shin Yooyoung survives, he now claims they were married in a past life—and that breaking this curse is within Kwon's reach. Faced with a strange new reality, Kwon must decide what to believe and just how far he'll go to end his torment. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

One moment, world-famous celebrity Juliet Karenina is on top. Next, she wakes up in another world as Rubetria Diolus, a noble girl abused and cast aside by her own family. With Wisht, the Spirit of Wishes, she relives Rubetria’s memories and learns her step-grandmother spent years ruining her life to seize her house, name, and future. Now that she knows the truth, Juliet refuses to suffer in silence, and she’s ready to launch Rubetria into a dazzling new life as the empire’s brightest celebrity!

(Source: Tapas)

Jin-Tae Seo and his younger sister Ji-Na, a purple-eyed albino, are separated after being kidnapped by human traffickers. After two years of torment, Jin-Tae is rescued by an assassin named Shin Kim. After years of training, Jin-Tae, now an assassin himself, follows a lead to Hong Kong to find his sister. After accidentally getting involved in a gang war, it is revealed that Ji-Na is apparently an assassin working for Kai Liu, another albino, who is rebelling against the Triad, and claims that Ji-Na is his half-sister. Can Jin-Tae stay alive long enough to reunite with her?

(Source: WEBTOON)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

Torn between love and loyalty, May is haunted by betrayal and guilt. On a wedding night that was never meant to be hers, she resolves to flee from the heartache. But Shin So-Gyung, her secret lover and the newlywed groom in a strategic marriage, finds her. Together, they share a night that could be their last.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Why I Quit Being the Demon King
description:
Demiurgos DCLXVI, or Deus, is the 666th resurrection of the Demon King, fated to battle a warrior of the Pure Blood clan every 100 years to liberate his fellow demons from hell. But instead of waiting, Deus escapes 20 years early to forge a new identity among the humans. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Seyden is the captain of the Paladin’s Order, and it is one of his duties to protect Bellota, the Saintess of the Empire. However, his feelings for her go beyond what duty demands from him. When he discovers that Bellota has been cursed to need a man’s seed in her every full moon, he volunteers to be the one to spend those nights with her. Although Bellota treats Seyden coldly, his determination to protect her and find a way to lift the curse remains unchanged. Will he be able to break this curse before it breaks Bellota’s spirit?

(Source: Tappytoon)

It’s time! Introducing, in the “powerless” corner, the former undisputed MMA champion Gwangho Hwang, with a professional record of 49:1 and a reputation for all kinds of dirty tactics, returning fresh from a supposed ‘permanent’ suspension. And in the “powered” corner… well, folks, let’s just say it’s a murderer’s row of deadly opponents with an array of special abilities. Welcome to the octagon, the ultimate showdown between a league of enhanced super-fighters going up against Gwangho’s brawn and his manager Seyeon’s brains! The bell rings for Round 1. Touch gloves, and face the pain! Here… we… go!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Eun-Seol Jeong and Yu-Sin Ma have been inseparable since they were children, but lately, something has shifted. Returning from his army service, Yu-Sin is often sought after by girls in Eun-Seol’s orbit, all while he has been quietly shielding Eun-Seol from guys interested in her. When their families go on vacation together, Eun-Seol and Yu-Sin find the boundary of their friendship tested. Together, they’ll have to decide – what if their relationship was never just friendship?

(Source: WEBTOON)

On Dahlia Belohr's first day as handmaiden, she simply receives one instruction: Whatever you do, do not, under any circumstances, go to the annex. But when an errand meant for another maid falls on her lap, Dahlia reluctantly finds herself walking through the very doors she was forbidden from entering and meets...him. The ghost of the annex. A permanent stain on the duke's legacy. The cursed bastard boy. What blooms is an unexpected connection that heals the pit of loneliness in both their hearts, despite the constant outside threats wanting to keep them apart. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

Narin and Danwoo are in an arranged marriage, and on their wedding night, they simply sleep side by side without any intimacy. Narin tries not to think about it, but she can't help wondering if she lacks appeal. One day, while exploring a bustling market full of curious items, she purchases a mysterious incense burner recommended by a vendor. The seller claims that lighting incense in it will instantly enchant whoever smells it. Eager to test it, Narin lights the incense, and Danwoo, inhaling its scent, feels an unfamiliar heat rising within him. Sensing the moment, Narin approaches him, only to be grabbed from behind by someone else. Turning around, she is shocked to see another Danwoo standing there.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

display_title: Becoming Best Friends With the Icy Male Lead
description:
After meeting a sad death as a Korean teenager in her past life, nothing could be better than being reincarnated as Livia Hote, a beloved princess of the fire kingdom. A life of only luxury and peace awaited her as the novel's supporting character. However, she eventually realizes that she must learn to control her ever-growing fire powers and she can only do so with the prince of the ice kingdom. Thus, Livia will now have to deal with new uncertainties and relationships that could disrupt her plans to live a peaceful new life… 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Working as a servant for the handsome Duke, Theodore Winston, was dreamy enough, but Alois is determined to win his heart. He has tried every trick in the book to seduce his master, only to be met with a fatherly pat on the head. When rumors of a new Duchess threaten his dreams, Alois makes a desperate plea to the heavens. The magic works a little too well by bringing a youthful and ruthless version of the Duke across time and into his arms. Now that the tables have turned, will Alois finally get the love he has been craving?

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: The Villainess Tames the Crazed Devil
description:
Making a deal with a demon is a small price to pay for a chance to enact revenge on the man who accuses you of having been seduced by one. This is the choice Isabella makes when her father unjustly has her and her mother burned at the stake for being witches. After returning three years into the past, Isabella starts fulfilling her half of the bargain: freeing the demon queen’s tragically beautiful son, Kaiden, and unleashing his inner demon. Isabella has one year to avenge her mother’s honor, and she’ll definitely make good use of her new demon husband. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

When Cha Yoonwoo intentionally gets arrested in order to smuggle drugs into prison, the last thing he expects to find out during intake is that he's pregnant. With no other option, he requests a meeting with Nam Soohyeon, the manipulative prosecutor who knotted him. But Yoonwoo's incarceration takes a surprising turn when none other than the man who put him up to this whole thing shows up in handcuffs. Just how will Yoonwoo make it through his sentence with such an unlikely cast of inmates, no alpha by his side, and a baby on the way? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yuujun Shin, a wealthy crypto investor, spends his time mastering a little-known game and purchasing all the best perks to dominate. When the game unexpectedly merges with reality, Yuujun finds himself in the game world with access to his massive virtual inventory. Now, with his amassed power and resources, he is more than ready to navigate this new reality...or is he?

(Source: Tapas)

Jinseong streams the online action game Dungeon and Fighter for a living, and while assisting a ranger, he ends up doing exactly what the player warned him not to—helping him fight the boss. Little did Jinseong know that the ranger was a person sucked into the game world, and was now dead for failing his mission. Transported into the world of DNF to take responsibility, Jinseong must work his way through the quest line as a Dark Knight to stop the contamination from leading players astray and destroying the world of Arad. Will he make it through alive?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Every night, a man comes to Seyeon’s dreams, but who is he? Four years after losing five months of her memory, Seyeon is haunted by a faceless man who appears strong, tender, and intoxicatingly passionate. Who is this man who visits her every night? Is he her lost lover? The father of her child? Or just a stranger? How far will she go to uncover the truth?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Roel Linthea is a timid, fragile girl who has been mistreated by her adoptive family. She's shocked and worried when she's sent away to marry Asran Hycariel, the son of a powerful yet infamously cruel ducal family. But to her surprise, she soon learns that none of the rumors are true, and everyone there is nothing but kind. And strangely, Asran seems to have known her since a long time ago... Will Roel be able to find happiness with her loving in-laws, or will the past come back to haunt her? 

(Source : Tapas)

Ye-Seul’s arrival at her new school is anything but perfect. Not only does she make a terrible first impression, but she immediately becomes a target for bullying when the most popular girl in school, So-Hui, notices their strikingly similar appearance. Despite being bullied and harassed every single day, Ye-Seul is determined not to back down. She knows that she’s just as attractive as So-Hui… and that it’ll be a breeze to steal everything from her. 

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

*"I only have the body as a collateral, but I better make sure it checks out."*

Do-Hyeon Nam, loyal to his organization, used to indulge himself by fucking indebted women whenever he wanted. He then decided he wanted to live a normal life. By a stroke of luck, he met a nice woman and began dreaming of a modest future together... When one day, he was framed, stripped of everything, and executed by his boss.

*"Even if I die... I'll take you with me!"*

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

After being joyfully reunited with Jin-Han Ryu, the best friend of her brother, Ha-Yeon Ji’s day immediately takes a turn for the worse as the two witness her boyfriend with another woman, right in front of them. After a series of awkward, coincidental encounters between the two, Ha-Yeon and Jin-Han begin to get reacquainted with one another. But after spending some time together, Jin-Han seems to begin seeing her as more than his friend’s little sister.

(Source: WEBTOON)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Trapped in a game where she’s a spy tasked with seducing the men of the Empire, our protagonist finds herself in a twisted reverse harem scenario with no way out.

*“Did I log in to the game last night? But I don't remember logging in...”*

What started as an immersive gaming experience for her day off quickly turns into a nightmare when she realizes she’s stuck inside. Now, surrounded by irresistibly handsome men and intense encounters, she desperately wants to escape. But there’s one problem: the game doesn’t plan on letting her leave anytime soon!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*“Please don't push your disciple away anymore, Master..”*

Ryu Jang-Jin lives an ordinary life, finding his only escape in web novels during his daily subway commute. But one evening, on his way home, a mysterious man suddenly breaks through his apartment window—from the third floor, no less! The intruder, Sa Wi-Hyeon, claims to be Jang-Jin’s disciple, insisting that their true home isn’t Earth, but a place called Honwon. He has come to take Jang-Jin back where he belongs. As an avid reader of isekai and wuxia novels, Jang-Jin is tempted by the fantastical idea—but reality calls, and he has work in the morning. Ignoring his protests, Sa Wi-Hyeon insists that Jang-Jin is only refusing because he has lost his memories. Before Jang-Jin can argue, he finds himself kidnapped and dragged into another world…

(Source: Lezhin US)

*“How can it be that pink…?”*

One accidental glance was all it took. Ever since catching a glimpse of her younger brother’s friend...down there, Yoo Eunha can’t look away from Seo Woogyum’s very rosy member. But when her guilty secret is exposed, Woogyum doesn’t back off. Oh no, he leans in.

*"You’re the only one who’s seen my body, right? Don’t you think it’s only fair I see yours too?"*

From one wrong look to a very, very wrong turn…things are about to get heated.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes four side stories.*

display_title: The Knight Becomes a Black Flower
description:
Diana Lesley, a renowned knight of the Agripana Kingdom, is killed by her rival Cornelius Heimann in the war against the Heverunia Empire. However, when she wakes up, she finds herself at 10 years old and decides to pursue the life of a proper lady instead of a knight—much to her family's disapproval. After becoming Princess Juliana's lady-in-waiting, she must contend with conniving noblewomen, the threat of oncoming war, and the affections of Cornelius who, in this life, dreams about her past life and falls for her. Can she keep her loved ones safe and live in peace?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Min-Seong became a landlord at just twenty. When he visits the house to check on it, he's shocked to find three gorgeous sisters already living there. What starts as a simple arrangement slowly turns into something far more dangerous... and irresistible.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Kyung-Jin Min, a cheerful new hire, expected a normal office life—until she was assigned to Jun-Woo Jung, the ruthless workaholic known as Hades. No one lasts under him, but Kyung-Jin won’t back down. When unstoppable optimism meets immovable perfectionism, sparks fly in this fiery office romance!

(Source: Manta)

When lifelong criminal Seungji finds herself betrayed by her old boss, she joins an upstart smuggling business to lay low. Her goal is to find the opening to take advantage of the business to score cash and flee the city, but a wrench by the name of Yeongwon is thrown into her plans. Inexperienced and naive, Yeongwon is working in her aunt’s stead as Seungji’s superior. Falling in love is a luxury for people in their line of work, but Seungji’s desire for financial gain might be changing into a desire for something that she can’t afford...

*"I heard you're the master at sex."*

His friends call him Dr. Sex, but in reality, Jin-Yeong is still a virgin. However, he lies to his sister, Bom, and acts like he has experience. However... He didn't expect Bom to sneak into his room asking him to teach her about sex every night!!!

(Source: DAYcomics)

display_title: When the Mad Dog Bites the Leash
description:
The noble daughter of house Dew, decorated knight of the Asellan kingdom, and undefeated warrior... is the second prince Ethan's 'mad dog,' Adrian Dew. Her foul mouth and fouler personality may have been the cause of countless headaches to her father, prince Ethan, the king, the princess... basically everyone she came into contact with, but Adrian is fiercely loyal.

Determined to ensure the throne for Ethan instead of his powerful, well-backed sister, princess Della, Adrian fights tooth and nail to win as many victories in battle in his name. But not even her prince can defend her for what she did in her last battle in the rocky plains of the East.

"You will assist the regent of Jolkyacarta for five years..." banished in all but name to a newly conquered kingdom, Adrian must serve her sentence before she can return to prince Ethan who is powerless without her. Five years among a different people, different customs, and different god... all of which hate her and her people, Adrian must survive.

Yet one set of eyes regards her with mysterious curiosity.

*"Have I seen you before?... in a dream?"*

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Being an orphan, Vanessa never imagines that she'll attend the prestigious Vamburgh Academy. But when a mysterious sponsor spots her magic talent from afar, he sends her there on the sole condition that she write him letters about her school life. And so, the chatty Vanessa picks up her pen to tell him everything, from trying to get along with the rich students to battling the mountain of schoolwork and the rogue monster on campus! As her sponsor's kind replies get her through the hard times and make her happy moments stronger, Vanessa's curiosity about her secret benefactor only grows... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Hee-Do, fragile yet dangerously obsessive, locks debt collector Woo-Rak in his basement after a violent outburst. Demanding affection, Hee-Do blurs love and desperation. As captive Woo-Rak’s defenses crumble, obsession and tenderness twist their bond until the line between captor and captive vanishes.

(Source: Manta)

Yeoeul Baek, a humble C-class guide, desires nothing more than a quiet life with a stable income. But her plans are turned upside down when an extraordinary 89% match with Yi-Hyeon Han—the world's most powerful S-class esper—forces her into a full-time role she never expected. Now, Yeoeul must navigate a world where her once ordinary life is anything but…

(Source: Manta)

Gi-Woo just needs a job, and almost any job will do…but he gets more than he bargains for when he stumbles into a position at Cha Seon-Jo’s Battle Cafe. Not only is the owner of this top-tier PC cafe so handsome it’s nearly criminal, he’s also hiding a secret that's actually criminal…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Haunted by guilt, detective Jeong Hae-Il flees his past in Daegu, seeking refuge in his hometown of Seoul. But the city isn't as forgiving as he'd hoped. Soon, he's forced to confront the ghosts of his trauma when he crosses paths with his old flame, Jun-Seon, now tangled up in a dangerous new drug. Just when things couldn't get more complicated, a mysterious ally named Han-Gyeol emerges from the shadows—but can Hae-Il really trust him? In a city filled with secrets, can any of them overcome the odds?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After his wife leaves, a man moves in with his mother-in-law and sister-in-laws, where tensions start to rise.

(Source: Toomics)

Lee Woogeon, the Vice Chairman of Korea Electronics, is a man consumed by his demanding career. However, at his grandfather's request, he agrees to meet an important person. To his shock, the person awaiting him is Yeon Rieul, a 22-year-old woman who is set to become his wife. With no belief in love, How will Woogeon handle the trials of marriage with such a young wife?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Just before becoming a god of the Higher Realm, goddess Seirene is betrayed by her friend Arwen and loses all her "Human Entertainment Points." To earn them back, she’s reborn as the daughter of Targa, an imperial bastard prince, and is on a mission to make him none other than the next emperor!

(Source: Manta)

Kang Hoe-Yoon is the most captivating storyteller in all of Joseon. Wherever he goes, crowds gather to hear his thrilling tales. But he feels self-conscious whenever he notices the handsome Shin Eun-Ro in the audience, an aristocrat he harbors a secret crush on. However, one day, Eun-Ro approaches Hoe-Yoon with a bizarre request. Eun-Ro wants him to teach his future wife the "art of love," fearing she’s too innocent for marriage. 

Will this be Hoe-Yoon's chance to get closer to his crush, or will it be a disaster that leaves him heartbroken?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Iris Sabrina sets out from home to the capital to fulfill her dream of becoming a knight. However, her journey takes an unexpected turn when she’s mistaken for her twin sister—whom she never knew existed—Arke Bright, a notorious villainess who’s been missing for months. As Iris struggles to navigate life in the capital and prove she’s not her sister, she meets a family she never knew she had and a handsome prince who helps her unravel the truth behind her sister’s dark past.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: We've Already Broken Up, Your Majesty
description:
After a fatal carriage accident, Rumiere Lashantia wakes up disoriented and is diagnosed with amnesia. While her identity and distant memories remain intact, her recent memories seem to have been erased. In her journal, she finds a chilling entry: “You can’t love him.” The man in question is Carl Winger, her ex-lover, whom she broke up with days before. Despite not remembering him, Rumiere is drawn to Carl and is determined to uncover the truth about the nature of their relationship. 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I Became the First Love of My Stepson
description:
Eve Jenna, a poor noblewoman from the countryside, had only her beauty and practical mindset to rely on. In pursuit of financial stability, she became the fourth wife of Count Hound, hoping for security, if not love. Three years into their marriage, her seemingly stable life is shattered when her husband abruptly demands a divorce. That same night, Eve receives an unexpected visit from Azazel, her husband’s eldest son, who had always kept his distance. Without a trace of humor, he makes a shocking proposal: after her divorce, she should marry him. Stunned by the audacity of his offer, Eve dismisses it as mockery, but his next words leave her speechless—he’s always desired her. What began as a contract marriage soon spirals into a series of events Eve could never have foreseen.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Luciel, a Crystal Fairy skilled in crafting jewels from her emotions, returns to the past after a life cut short by betrayal. Armed with the knowledge of a grim future, she proposes a contract marriage to the empire’s most villainous family. What begins as a desperate strategy to escape her fate soon becomes an adventure filled with unexpected warmth. Can Luciel rewrite her story, or will her past come back to haunt her?

(Source: TappyToon)

display_title: The Cafe Owner is an S-Class Guide
description:
A newly awakened guide slash cafe owner fights an uphill battle trying to protect her business from a handsome yet explosive esper, who finds both her and her powers as addicting as caffeine.

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: The Villainess Is Too Busy Baking Bread!
description:
After overworking myself in my past life, I reincarnated as Rachel Leseltein, the villainess in a novel. I had no regrets, but I never got to chase my dream of opening a bakery. Unfortunately, every business the original Rachel touched crumbled, and she was ultimately destroyed by the story’s heroine. But this time, I’m changing my fate! My father and brother don’t support my idea, but I’ll whip up sweet recipes, knead my way to success, and maybe attract a handsome duke with a sweet tooth.

(Source: Tapas)

Sell me! I'll be the most expensive lady to obtain. While scheming to get out of an arranged marriage, Cesare runs into Adele, a shoeshine girl from the slums. The two make a 3-month deal to help Cesare elude marriage. However, Adele is so different from the women he's met before that he can't help but be drawn to her. 

(Source: Manta)

Kwon Ji-Sung had no interest in dating until his casual sex partner suddenly became his colleague.

(Source: Toomics, edited)

Back in high school, Hyeon Ji-Woo was the ace of the legendary Seongeon High baseball team—and secretly dating his younger teammate, Choi Seon-Ho. But their sweet first love came to an abrupt end when Seon-Ho suddenly left for the U.S., breaking up with Ji-Woo without warning. Fast forward 10 years: Ji-Woo has buried all his desires and emotions under a mountain of work, living a quiet, no-nonsense life… until Seon-Ho shows up again. Not as a successful returnee or old flame, but as a temp worker—causing a scene with a bottle of whiskey in hand! Cue the chaos: awkward reunions, unresolved tension, and one very confused adult trying not to fall all over again. He was Ji-Woo’s first love, first heartbreak… and possibly, his newest headache. 

Is this a second chance at love—or just a second round of disaster? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five side story chapters.*

Aylah Goldwyn’s destiny had been determined since her birth: she was to marry the crown prince. However, on the day after her wedding, the prince asks for their marriage to be dissolved. Now, she suffers from near-constant headaches and insomnia, made bearable only through the embrace of a man. One night, she discovers a man who can make her headaches disappear entirely with nothing but a touch. But the next morning, she discovers that he left without a word, and she doesn’t even know his name. Will she be able to find this mysterious man, her “cure”?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: I Want My Bad Happy Ending!
description:
Yuri Elrose is the heroine of a dating simulation game... with a deadly twist. If she ends up with any of the four charming male leads, the final boss starts a war, and she dies. Her solution? Aim for the “bad” ending: raise everyone's affection evenly, stay single, and live a quiet, solitary life. But the more she keeps her distance, the more they seem to gravitate toward her. And now, even the mysterious final boss seems interested…! Can Yuri manage to get her boring, disaster-free ending?! 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Forged in Flames: The Piece Maker
description:
It’s red, hot, and burning with flames! Sage is a young boy from a small village who dreams of becoming a renowned Piece Maker like Edmond Dantes. But when his antics to help others with crafting skills get him in trouble with the local mercenary gang, a trio of rowdy blacksmiths who call themselves the Red Pepper Guild show up and come to his aid. He joins the Red Pepper Guild in their quest to solve the mystery of strange dungeons and mana stones, but can he survive the battles and the blazing dishes his eccentric guild master cooks up?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

8th year student, Holden Pilgrim has gone missing. As head of Gabriel House, it is Jade Devon’s duty to see to it that he’s found. But when the affable yet mysterious Lei gets involved, is he trying to help or hinder the investigation? Jade has seemingly caught Lei's eye but is this just an innocent attraction or is something more sinister lurking beneath the surface...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a tragic accident resulting in her death, Ms. Yeo is transported to the Cleaf Empire... for the second time! With her new identity as Yureia Cratia, she sets out to reclaim the guild she had built from the bottom up and uncover who was behind her previous murder. However, while hiding her true identity and searching for answers, she only comes up with more questions. Will she be able to find her killer before they discover that she has returned, or is she doomed to face death once again?

(Source: Tapas)

One day, Yun-Hyeok suddenly finds himself with a younger brother—Yun-Jae, a sickly child diagnosed with an incurable disease. Determined to protect him, Yun-Hyeok takes on the role of Yun-Jae’s guardian, raising him with unwavering devotion for the next 15 years. But as Yun-Jae grows older, he begins to push the boundaries of their sibling relationship. Then one day, through the security cameras Yun-Hyeok installed to keep an eye on Yun-Jae, he witnesses something he was never meant to see…

(Source: Lezhin US)

No one was prepared when the massive towers known as dungeons appeared, crawling with monsters and threatening calamity for the entire world. After she receives extraordinary culinary powers, the quiet and humble Ji-Eun is compelled to join some of the most skilled monster hunters in the world, seeing things and going places she never dreamt of before! Now, she’s making friends, having exciting adventures, and cooking up some of the tastiest dishes the dungeon has to offer!

(Source: Tapas)

The moment he was about to die, Axel was transported to another world where he is the long-awaited half-dragon.

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: The Little Saint and the Grand Duke of the North
description:
Everyone knows Duke Windzorice is a cold, powerful man, but for the young saint Lilliette, he's a kind adult and just the person to save her from the Temple's abuse! After healing his eyes, Lilliette is granted a home at Windzorice Castle, but the Temple's not willing to let her go. That's when the duke comes up with a foolproof plan to keep her by his side... They'll say she's his daughter! Can this fake family vanquish the Temple and live in peace? Or will the little saint suffer once more?

(Source: Tapas)

*“Miss Shin, please work your night shift at my house from now on.”* 

The workaholic vice president Jehu asks his secretary Yu-Na Shin four days after their company bans the night shift. Just like that, the two of them begin working together at night, but it doesn’t take long before their attention turns toward each other instead of work.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jeong Yigon, CEO of Seongso Group, has absolutely no desire to become the future chairman. His ambitious brother, however, wants nothing more than to sideline Yigon and take the top spot – no matter the cost. In a strategic move to fend off his brother's aspirations, Yigon concocts a plan to spread a rumor about himself being in a same-sex relationship, a situation sure to be despised by his traditionalist grandfather. To execute this plan, Yigon seeks out Shin Tae-kang, the heir to the Hanje Group, as the ideal candidate for a fake relationship. Tae-kang readily agrees, under the condition that Yigon does anything Tae-kang desires. It seems like Tae-kang is the one who holds all the power in this con of theirs, but could there come a time when Yigon manages to turn the tables? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seok-Jun only wanted one thing: peace and quiet. Tormented night after night by the nonstop sexcapades of his new neighbor, Ye-Chan, he reaches a breaking point and prays for the man’s “precious equipment” to disappear. The next morning, the moans are gone...and so is Ye-Chan’s manhood. Shocked by the eerie coincidence, Seok-Jun feels guilty enough to try to help…but Ye-Chan seems more interested in using him as a solution than finding one. What begins as a bizarre curse quickly spirals into a chaotic, heated romance between the man who wished it away and the man desperate to get it back.

(Source: Lezhin US)

For most, kumdo is just a hobby. Practitioners are there to entertain and Si-ho Ye is the best entertainer of them all. Quicker, more agile, and more experienced than most, he was a force to be reckoned with in the kumdo world. Si-ho was content living his life as the best at something that barely mattered until the day his sister died. Convinced she was murdered and determined to take revenge, Si-ho sets out to show the dark underbelly of Korea why swordsmen were once revered…and feared.

(Source: Tapas)

Cherry Blossom Empire, known among players as "the weak princess game," is a game with the objective of keeping Princess Tatiana alive until her 18th birthday. That's easier said than done since Tatiana dies just from eating cake! So when an avid gamer who's finally cleared this frustrating game is reborn into it as Tatiana, she has to do it all over again, starting as a baby... But with a potential death ending lurking at every corner, will Tatiana's gaming skills be enough for her to survive?

(Source: Tapas)

Arthur is a sex addict who can't help but seduce every woman he comes across. He begins seeing a therapist as advised by his friend.

(Source: Toomics)

Baek Ji-Hwan is used to being alone. Gay, kinky, and unapologetically himself, he never fit anywhere easily. When Seo Jae-Rim enters his life, Ji-Hwan thinks he’s finally found the perfect partner. Until the truth comes out: Jae-Rim is straight, has a girlfriend, and wants Ji-Hwan’s help learning BDSM for her sake. Ji-Hwan rejects him immediately, but Jae-Rim keeps coming back. 

Unseen by everyone else, Jae-Rim becomes the one presence Ji-Hwan can’t ignore… his invisible partner.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Life as the demon king was going well until he was resurrected as the descendant of his rival! After a battle with Rakan the Warrior, the powerful mage Saemon was killed. He was dead, or so it seemed, until he unexpectedly awakened in a new body 500 years in the future! Now pretending to be Lord Luke de Rakan, Saemon needs to help his citizens, pay his kingdom’s debts, and convince his servants he isn’t crazy… at least until he can regain his true power and avenge the love of his life!

(Source: Tapas)

Ho-Seok is a tiger who wants to make and sell cute desserts in peace. While he was once a member of a shady syndicate, he makes the decision to wash his hands of that life and instead follow his dream of opening his own dessert shop! But this new life isn’t as easy as it sounds. Can Ho-Seok overcome the prejudices his neighbors have against him and make his dream come true? A slice-of-life story to warm your heart!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Daniel Park is betrayed by his boss and killed. But instead of dying, he now possesses the body of a famous celebrity, Daniel Wu. Using his new body, Daniel vows to take revenge on his boss.

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: Please Get Out of My Family
description:
Favey Croshe founded her house on an agreement with elemental kings, giving her descendants elemental affinity...all except Winadella, that is. When Winny is kicked out of the house for being useless, Favey awakens from a 300-year death to possess Winny and help her get revenge on the family who cast her out like trash. Luckily, one of her old pupils, the half-dragon Wallika, is willing to help his master humble the arrogant elementalists and...maybe even offer Winny a new home.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: A Hookup Gone Wrong in the Best Way
description:
All we had was a one-night stand—nothing more! Gaeul never expected to sleep with the wrong guy. But the real shock? Her one-night stand turns out to be none other than Seo Dohyeon—her older brother’s boss. Encouraged by a friend to try a casual fling, she takes the leap, never imagining it would spiral into a total disaster. But… was it really a mistake? Dohyeon is handsome, successful, and undeniably skilled in bed. He’s the full package. And if she’s being honest, she doesn’t exactly hate the way he keeps blurring the lines between them. Just when her heart starts to waver, Dohyeon finds out the truth—her real age. And suddenly, he pulls away.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes 9 side stories.*

Yu Eunha is the unfortunate heroine of the erotic BDSM novel The Demon’s Vivace, where she endures daily beatings from the male leads. Her miserable existence seems never-ending—until the author suddenly announces an indefinite hiatus. Desperate to keep her story going, Eunha decides to take matters into her own hands: if the male leads won't continue to torment her, she’ll make them suffer instead. But when the Demon King, who’s supposed to be her cruel master, refuses to harm her, Eunha flips the script and embarks on a mission to train him into the perfect sadistic lord. Can she turn this reluctant villain into the ruthless master she needs, or will her twisted plan backfire spectacularly?

(Source: Lezhin US)

All Isaac the beta wants is to live a normal life as a slightly unskilled florist and leave his turbulent past behind. That dream quickly goes out the window, however, when the infamous arms dealer Felix waltzes into his shop and takes a liking to him. It just so happens that Isaac's family needs protection from a mysterious enemy, and luckily, Felix is more than willing to provide it in return for Isaac's body. The more Felix falls for the reserved florist, the more he wants to unlock his many secrets. And as things heat up in the bedroom, Isaac finds it harder to resist the handsome alpha and his powerful pheromones. Meanwhile, the secret about their shared past hangs in the air like a ticking timebomb... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Rixie is a succubus often masquerading as a service provider who visits homes, whether it to be checking the gas valves, the water pipes, or the internet connection. But that’s just a front for her to find humans to feed on. One day, she finds the perfect prey: Puhr, a boy who seems rich both financially and in energy to devour. Unfortunately, she has no idea who the predator really is until Puhr shows his true colors…

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Write Me, Touch Me, Read Me
description:
In an era where romance between hybrids and humans is taboo, Kang Seok-Won finds himself crammed into an overcrowded subway on his way home from work. There, he keeps brushing against a large-built young man who gets his heart racing. Seok-Won, who has the ability to read others’ thoughts through physical contact, is suddenly overwhelmed by a flood of indecent ideas…and to make matters worse the subject of those indecent thoughts is…him?! A clumsy love story between the reclusive and socially anxious hybrid, Jin Dal-Lae, and the telepathic team leader, Kang Seok-Won begins! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Five years into their relationship, Gong Min-Jae and Yoon Jae-Hyun are still in love, but Jae-Hyun can no longer be satisfied by ordinary intimacy. When a reckless encounter sparks something new, Min-Jae draws him Jae-Hyun into bolder, more provocative experiences, as he discovers a pleasure that’s impossible to resist. As their desire intensifies, so does the thrill of crossing lines. Is it wrong to want this much... or is love meant to be shameless? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

Ji-An, an S-rank guide in Korea who isn't compatible with any espers, people gifted with superpowers, finds herself on a strange continent one day. There, she meets Duke Wisrode, an esper she can finally guide. However, her excitement is short-lived when she discovers that she is the only guide in this land, which is full of espers, and the duke wishes to keep her to himself. Will Ji-An be able to find her way back to her own dimension safely? Or will she be stuck here as the lone guide forever?

(Source: Tapas)

Sojin and Jeongho have been friends for years, but she never knew he was keeping a secret…and a big one, at that. But when she hears talk around campus about how her best friend is packing quite the surprise, she just wants one little peek. Or two, or three…

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.*

Finally, Byeokwu has mastered it—the Sacred Art of Grand Clarity, one of the most precious arts of the Gonryun Clan. But nothing he learned in seclusion could’ve prepared him to understand the state of things one hundred years later. Leaving his clan behind, Byeokwu starts a new life as a chef at the Gonryun Tavern, determined to help the owner turn a profit. And if his noodles are good enough to tempt the Divine Demon of the Bloody Heaven into changing his ways? Surely, there are worse things. 

(Source: Tapas)

After a failed marriage, Camilla returns to the grand estate where she once worked as a maid—only to find that Mika Aberdeen, the young master she used to care for, has grown into a flirtatious playboy, constantly surrounded by women. He teases her relentlessly, igniting a desire in her to turn the tables and toy with him instead. But just as she’s about to strike, she stumbles upon a shocking secret—Mika is still a virgin?! As Camilla finds herself caught in a whirlwind of teasing and temptation, things take an even messier turn when her ex-boyfriend, Felix, suddenly returns to the estate…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Tae-Beom, the campus custodian, is a self-proclaimed expert at spotting - and "handling" - the sexually inexperienced. With a 100% success rate and dashing good looks, he sets his sights on Chae-Yi, a hunky physical education student who seems like the perfect target. But when his usual charms lead to a hilariously dramatic breakdown instead of a smooth conquest, Tae-Beom realizes he’s met his match. Now, the hunter becomes the pursuer as Tae-Beom chases the elusive Chae-Yi to protect his flawless reputation.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: A Flower Blooms on the Wall
description:
*“Of course I recognized you. You’re my first love.”* 

Living a life of being stalked by her first love, Dam Do is visited by her brother’s friend Yun Oh. No longer the boy next door who used to follow her around like a puppy, Yun is now a man, and he acts strangely aloof around her. While Dam has found herself resenting her first love, Yun is secretly quite excited to be around his first love once again. As the two become reacquainted after their time apart, they may be in for a lesson on what love really is.

(Source: WEBTOON)

 *Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

A new town, a place of new beginnings... and as one of the very few delivery riders, I'll make sure it's worth my while.

(Source: Toomics)

Despite his hard work, Lee Eunho finds himself laid off due to company downsizing. Before he can even consider what's next, ominous messages appear, claiming Earth has been bought out. Now, only survivors of life-or-death missions will make the cut, turning even friends into foes. As all hell breaks loose, humanity must decide between using one another to get ahead or working together as a team. Can Eunho survive Earth's sudden downsizing, or will the pressure to move up leave him in the dust?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: How To Reject My Obsessive Ex-Husband
description:
When Yu Seo-Hyeon sacrificed her life to save her first love, Ciel de Leopart, she never expected to wake up as Irene de Closhe in a world straight out of a book. Amidst this bizarre twist, she reunites with Ciel, who has now become a supporting male lead destined to betray the crown prince. As her unique guide abilities resurface, Seo-Hyeon is haunted by Ciel's intense, madness-filled gaze, a stark contrast to the man she once knew. Tangled in a web of past love and new identities, Seo-Hyeon must navigate a treacherous path where past and present collide.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

Former national archer Hwang Jung-Ho was forced to retire after an injury turned his shoulder into a hypersensitive weakness. Avoiding touch and attention, he now lives quietly as a delivery driver. That is, until a delivery brings him face to face with rising archery star Kang Jun-Hyuk—who grabs Jung-Ho’s shoulder and triggers an overwhelming reaction.

 *“If this is because of me... I’ll take help you...!”*

What kind of “help” is Jun-Hyuk offering—and can Jung-Ho resist him?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

Chansol, a rising star in the all-alpha idol group 4α, hides a dangerous secret: he's actually an omega, masking his scent with potent suppressants. When he collapses on stage, the doctor warns that only physical contact with an alpha can save him now. When desperation forces Chansol to turn to the only senior who knows his secret, their clandestine meetings are discovered by none other than a fellow member. As suspicions brew and tensions rise, Chansol's hidden identity threatens to unravel the group's perfect image... Can he find a remedy, or will this be the final note in his career? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

After breaking off her engagement to her douchebag fiance, the last thing Jae-Eun expects is to start sleeping with her boss, Seo-Kwon. But when an intimate night of drinking leads to a heated tryst at a hotel, the unlikely pair learn that they have unmatched chemistry in the bedroom. This then sparks a passionate coworkers-with-benefits relationship that puts more at risk than their reputation at the office. With Seo-Kwon being a single father and Jae-Eun's recent breakup, they both know bringing feelings into the mix will only complicate things. Still, keeping things purely physical proves easier said than done... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: The Wife of the Dragon Duke
description:
Anthia spent years saving lives on the battlefield. With the war finally over, all she wants is peace, but her father’s debts threaten to destroy any chance of that life. Desperate, she answers a strange advertisement for a contract marriage to a duke seeking someone eerily similar to her. But upon arrival, she’s met by Al, a mysterious man tasked with “preparing” her for the duke. As their physical bond intensifies, so do her suspicions about him, the duke... and their dragon-blooded lineage.

(Source: Tapas)

Gods have descended upon the world, and Da-il's ready to drag them all to hell. After the lives of his loved ones were taken by the gods, Da-il offers his soul in exchange for the powers of the very killer of gods, the Void. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Ari is a headless grim reaper who has been guiding souls to the afterlife for hundreds of years. She has always felt unseen and unloved because no one can see her face. That all changes when she encounters Ucheol, a popular actor who can see her head and agrees to help her search for it. Will Ari find her missing head and reclaim her identity, finally freeing herself from a lifetime of loneliness?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: Master of the Martial Arts Library
description:
As an inept martial artist and a bastard son of the great Ha Clan, Ha Sochan had no choice but to become a vagabond. But his wretched life takes a turn when a mission brings him to the Martial Arts Library, a place filled with the secret techniques of the martial world. There, Sochan is accidentally bound to the library and sent back to when he was 12 years old. Now armed with the library's martial knowledge, he vows to make a name for himself in not only his clan but also the world!

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: This Duck Wants to Fly Solo
description:
Welcome to the world of Delcato, where people have powers and embody animals.

"My deepest apologies! I'm breaking things off!" the man sobs... but who is he? Wait, am I Serena Ethereol?!
Serena is an unlucky duck, dumped three times while engaged, and just a side character in the original novel. It couldn't get any worse. But then, the male lead wants to get engaged. Not again... I just want a peaceful life! How can I shake him off...

Will she duck out of this marriage? Or take another quack at love?

(Source: PocketComics)

display_title: Some Day You Will Give Birth To Me
description:
Evanna is the orphaned daughter of the Holy Empire's second prince and Lyngena Granger, a powerful sorceress. She is taken advantage by her uncle Levlius who forces Evanna to ascend the throne. As an Empress, Evanna is ridiculed and scorned for being the daughter of a sorceress and is subjected to abuse in order to pray the magic in her away. However, upon discovering her mother's grimoire, Evanna turns back time only to return as a toddler. Her mission is to bring her parents together so that they may give birth to her and lead them to a happier future.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Just four years ago, Rustica Genas was the most gifted knight in the Caleta Empire and one of the emperor's most trusted servants. But after challenging his will one too many times, all of her fame, glory, and power were stripped from her. Then what can poor Rustica do but shamefully fade into obscurity? Well, when the rival empire's ruler sets his sights on winning her heart and freedom, she might have a chance to reclaim more than just her reputation. What could be waiting for her just beyond the Great Barrier?

(Source: Tappytoon)

In a world filled with monsters and magic, a cat and a hunter named Hawk begin their adventure with different purposes but with the same goal in mind: to protect something precious and seek revenge.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: I'm Just a Side Character, but I Became the Guardian of the Marquess Family's Heir
description:
I should have died in the accident, but when I woke up, I found myself inside my favorite novel...To make matters worse, I'm just a side character?! According to the story, the duke and duchess have disappeared, and all the servants are about to be fired...I've made up my mind. I'm going to live as I please! Or so I thought. Somehow, I've ended up as the guardian of two orphaned twins?! This wasn't supposed to be my role, but how could I abandon them? Just as I resolved to take the twins on their journey...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Kim Anon, a superior demon with murderous intent, barges into Jae-Kyung's restaurant, demanding what is rightfully his.
