Powerless before such a prestigious demon, Jae-Kyung can only submit and oblige the stranger. First, the stranger takes his money, then his food, his shoes, and more and more with breathtaking entitlement. Even so, Jae-Kyung finds himself dreaming that this stranger will take also take him!

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: An Extra, Yet the Duke's Only Daughter
description:
Reincarnation Life Cast by Dice, aka "ReLife," is a mobile game that I transmigrated into. The objective is to help the main characters save the world from the evil demon king, with each character classified by how crucial they are to the plot. I awoke in the body of Alyssa G. Dravein, a side character who dies by her father's hand when she turns nine years old. But, my dad seems to love me so much--where did it all go wrong? Can I change my fate and live to see ten? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: A Fairy-Tale Ending for a Fake
description:
Adopted into a ducal family, Odette Grizelle is merely a “fake” daughter, a stand-in for the duke’s long-lost real daughter. Bullied by her brothers and looked down on by the maids, life isn’t easy for Odette. So when the duke’s real daughter Beri is found, Odette thinks it's finally time to make her exit. But surprisingly, Beri is thrilled to have her as a sister, and Odette now sees she has more supporters than she thought. With their help, can this fake find a real-life fairy-tale ending? 

(Source: Tapas)

From the moment Princess Raha's eyes turned blue—the color symbolic of the imperial heir—she has wanted nothing but death. After her brother seized the throne, he sent her an endless stream of bedchamber slaves captured from conquered lands, but none emerged alive. None until Shane Hildes.

(Source: Manta)

Kwon Yeong has been rejected by Yun Jeyeong six times, each dismissal wrapped in gibberish that he can't make out. But the real problem isn't just the heartbreak; it's that every time he's rejected, he's transported back to the first day of the new semester when he first met Jeyeong. Stuck in this endless cycle, Yeong's confessions always take him back to square one. Frustrated and fed up, Yeong declares, ""I'm not gonna like you anymore! Never again!"" Just when Yeong decides to give up, the loop restarts. But this time, something begins to change in their relationship. 

Dive into the mysterious and heartwarming journey of ""Love on a Loop,"" where every reset brings new possibilities for love and self-discovery.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prolouge and two side story chapters.*

display_title: The Youngest Is Trying To Prevent the World From Ending
description:
After hitting my head, I remembered my past life and realized I was in a novel. Ugh, why do I have to be Diana Cartier, the bratty child brainwashed to do evil deeds and destroy the world?! I won’t let that happen. I’ll stop the end of the world with my own hands and save my brothers! Wait, why is the novel’s protagonist lying on the street? And oh, aren’t those animals so cute? Make way for the cute youngest who’s trying to save the world!

(Source: Tapas)

Ha-Jin has suffered relentless torment from a stalker ever since he was outed… Pushed to both the metaphorical and physical edge, he sees no way out. Just as he’s ready to give up on life, an unexpected savior appears: an angel named Kael. But this isn’t your typical heaven-sent rescue. Kael offers a shady deal: he’ll get rid of Ha-Jin’s stalker, but in return, he wants Ha-Jin’s soul. With nothing left to lose, Ha-Jin agrees...only to learn firsthand what “touched by an angel” really means.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Love is a Sport: Our Golden Promise
description:
Judo star Joo-Young and Taekwondo star Do-Yoon have been rivals and best friends since childhood. Now, they stand on the world’s biggest stage at the Olympic Games. After clinching her gold medal, Joo-Young decides it’s time to bury her long-held unrequited love for Do-Yoon once and for all. Using a childhood bet as her excuse, she asks him for a single night together to create one final memory. She expected a polite rejection or a simple favor, but Do-Yoon’s intense reaction suggests he has been waiting for this moment even longer than she has. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note:
\- Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.*
\- includes three extra chapters.

To treat his sensitivity issues, Do-Won agrees to be part of the blindfolded kissing booth at the school festival. He thought he’d only get a few meaningless pecks, but ends up making out with a mysterious guy whose kiss is so intense, it makes him hard! Do-Won becomes obsessed with finding the other man, but he never imagined it’d be Jun-Hyeon, the otaku nerd from school who's a total jerk! Will Do-Won be able to accept that his body reacts to this nerd, or will Jun-Hyeon's secretly sexy side be his undoing?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a fatal tragedy, our heroine wakes up as Aurora, a character from a novel she once read. While coming to grips with her new reality, she’s sent to marry the Duke of Ettica, a.k.a. infamous piece of trash. This trash duke knows no bounds! 

*"Could you punch me right now?"* Not only is he a scumbag, he's a perv too?! 

*"If I end up falling for you, I will become your loyal little dog."* What has Aurora gotten herself into? 

Perhaps it’s the start of a puppy love…? Or perhaps it’s leading to something more… 

(Source: POCKET COMICS) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Eun-Yu never had any reason to talk to, much less eat with, her manager, Ki-Jo Baek. Understandably, she's caught off guard when she's suddenly invited to lunch by her charismatic boss. And she's even more taken aback when that boss suddenly confesses his feelings for her! Unfortunately for Mr. Baek, this new crush of his is actually employed by his mother and looking to blackmail him!

(Source: Tapas)

Childhood friends Ahn Do-Hun and Woo Ik-Su have been inseparable since elementary school, bonded by their shared love for the mid-tier baseball team, the Dolphins. But when Ik-Su decides to go to the team’s home opener with someone other than Do-Hun, the foundations of their friendship begin to crack. With this curveball, their relationship takes an unexpected turn…and as the Dolphins edge closer to a championship, Do-Hun and Ik-Su can’t seem to get one another off their minds. Will their relationship be able to make a comeback in the final inning? Or did Ik-Su’s foul play ruin his chance at scoring with Do-Hun forever…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes eight side story chapters.*

After another wild night of clubbing, rich brat I-Su is forced to decide between working as an intern or having all his credit cards canceled. He begrudgingly chooses to become a sales intern, but one of the team leads at his company is Jin Hyuk, the same handsome guy he had a one-night stand with! Though tries to use his sex friend, Ye-Jun, to forget about Hyuk, it unlocks a possessive and jealous side to Ye-Jun that I-Su's never seen before. With his new workload, Hyuk, and Ye-Jun to worry about, will I-Su ever catch a break?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Masters of Heaven and Earth
description:
The tales of the heavens are no different from those on earth. Tongmi just wants to live an ordinary, peaceful life. However, with new kinds of thugs appearing left and right every day, it seems like the world has other plans for him – plans that involve him becoming a legend.

(Source: WEBTOON)

By imperial decree, Duke Tristan receives his bride from the Kingdom of Haniel to form a marriage alliance between the two nations. After they consummate the marriage, his bride reveals that she's just a maid sent to test if he can do his business in bed...

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: No Reverse Harem for the Demon Lord
description:
After nine thousand years in the demon realm, Horang Baek returns to Earth as the Demon Lord and reunites with her only surviving family member. Time amongst demons taught her to act swiftly without mercy, but looking monstrous to her brother scares her more than death. As Horang reacquaints herself with earthly customs, she finds one thing hasn’t changed–random guys throwing themselves at her. And if she thinks any left behind in the demon realm are history, she’s in for a surprise.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I Saved the Villain with Money After the Ending
description:
Daphne Serenade Bukater, an ultra elite born with a silver spoon and dubbed Secradion’s Red Rose, remembers her past life and the tragic fate awaiting her. Reborn as the villainess of a popular novel, she knows how the story ends—with her death. To escape such a destiny, Daphne makes a bold choice—save Celestian, the brooding sub male lead destined for execution, and steer her life away from the path that leads to Romeo, the obsessive male lead and her former fiancé.

(Source: Tapas)

Jae-Yoon Kang has finally decided to find a new place to live because he just can't keep up with the noise. But little did he know, it was quite challenging to find the perfect place in his budget. His last hope is Young-Han Seo, competent realtor with the looks. When Mr. perfect is helping for studio apartment hunt, Jae-Yoon realizes that he's more interested in him than the property hunting. Now, Jae-Yoon is ready to attract Young-Han's attention, by any means necessary.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: The chapter count includes 3 side stories.*

display_title: Before the Real Heroine Steps In
description:
Once bitten, twice shy. That is Anastasia's motto when she awakes with a second chance in life as the Empress in her favorite novel. After realizing that even true love cannot change destiny, Anastasia attempts to help her husband, the Emperor, find his happy ending with the female protagonist--the true heroine of the story. However, it seems that the Emperor has other thoughts. She pushes him away so they can both live, but the Emperor is unsure if he wants to live without his queen.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

display_title: Will My Doting Husband Love Me Again?
description:
How do you win over your husband... while in another woman's body? That's precisely the task at hand for Adeline Tiaget - formally known as Charlotte Valerian. When Charlotte's step-father's incessant scheming leads her to be poisoned to death, she is given a chance to live on in the body of the most beautiful woman in the empire. Now, all there's left to do is exact her revenge and make her former husband fall in love with her again. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

Lee Ho-Yeon, known in-game as "White Jack," starts playing the MMORPG Lunatic with a skilled friend but quits after struggling with controls and losing motivation. Years later, frustrated by repeated university entrance exams, he logs back in for stress relief and unexpectedly meets the game’s top-ranking player, Kim Hee-Ho ("Monaka").Despite his foul temper and aloof reputation, Hee-Ho helps Ho-Yeon improve. When Hee-Ho leaves his guild due to conflicts and joins "21," the small guild Ho-Yeon inherited, their ranking quickly rises. Rumors spread that they are dating since Hee-Ho is uncharacteristically warm toward Ho-Yeon.

To gain a game bonus, they register as an in-game couple, but no one believes it is just for the rewards. When a rival guild challenges them to a war, even the usually support-focused Ho-Yeon is forced to fight. He agrees to meet Hee-Ho offline for training but instead receives a real-life confession. They begin dating. The twist is that Ho-Yeon has been using a female avatar. When Hee-Ho proudly introduces his in-game partner, the truth comes out, sparking rumors that Ho-Yeon was pretending to be a girl.

What started as a game partnership turns into a real relationship. But between guild conflicts, public scrutiny, and real-life pressures, Ho-Yeon struggles to keep up. With Hee-Ho’s unwavering support, he fights to protect both their guild and their growing bond.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ci Yunye is an unruly yet clever servant at the Gansu Xie Clan. Xie Xiufan, the eldest son, is the only one he respects and fears despite their differences. But when the clan head's new wife schemes to take over the house and harm their loved ones, the two set out to gain power and get revenge on her. As they strive to do so, they find themselves on the Heretical Path, away from orthodox martial arts. Their skills may be called evil and demonic, but Yunye and Xiufan will bring justice with them!

(Source: Tapas)

I ended up in the body of a demon king who gains power through sex. So, I have to corrupt every heroine to return to my reality?

*"I wonder if they'll be able to keep that proud look on their faces after getting fucked."*

(Source: DAYcomics)

Dominica, a vampire hiding her true identity while living among humans, finds herself attacked one night by a vampire hunter named Aran. But instead of being his victim, she overpowers him—and ends up spending an unexpectedly thrilling night with her perfect match. Just when she thought their encounter would be a one-time thing, a string of mysterious incidents began to unfold in her territory. As Dominica hunts for the truth behind these events, she keeps running into Aran, and their fates become increasingly intertwined...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Burning fingers or mending hearts?

There are too many cooks in the kitchen! Dogun Yoon's head chef spot is threatened by total stranger Jung-Woo Choi. As they battle it out, Dogun's phobia of being touched is as strong as ever… But why is it okay with him? Will their saucy arrangement lead to love, or will things boil over?

(Source: Manta, edited)

Seo Eun-Il has had a one-sided crush on his childhood friend Nam Je-Heon, now the CEO of IDBIO, for nearly a decade. As Je-Heon's personal secretary, Eun-Il spends plenty of time with him but struggles with his unspoken feelings. When Je-Heon chooses to spend his birthday with someone else, Eun-Il is left with an uneaten cake and unexpectedly encounters Je-Heon's twin brother, Nam Pil-Woo, who has just returned from the United States. With secrets and long-held feelings bubbling beneath the surface, Pil-Woo seizes the moment to seduce Eun-Il, sparking conflict in the heart of Eun-Il. As old memories resurface and hidden desires collide, Eun-Il finds himself at the center of a tumultuous love triangle.

In this battle of hearts, may the best brother win…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Being the only wingless princess of Tilmun, Seraphine led a lonely and miserable life among winged royals. After being killed by her own father, she wakes up 500 years later as Lady Seraphine, a young noblewoman infamous for her rare condition and wild behavior. This time, she has wings, but they are draining her mana and killing her. As more secrets surface and people from her past appear, will Seraphine finally find peace? Or will she merely remain a villainess cursed with wings?

(Source: Tapas)

In a world where humans and vampires coexist, a starving vampire Jess is trapped by humans and imprisoned beneath a slave camp. The warden tortures Jess, seeking a cure for his own disease, but Jess fails to heal like most vampires. Desperate, Philip locks Johan, a former doctor turned slave, underground with Jess to nurse him. As Johan works to gain Jess’s trust, he finds himself dangerously drawn to the enigmatic vampire. Sensing Johan’s feelings, Jess pretends to return them, planning his escape. But if they break free together, can they ever truly reclaim their old lives and escape this darkness?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

Si-Wu doesn’t do relationships — just low-maintenance hookups with no strings attached. So when Hui-Won, a younger classmate with no apparent sex drive, a great body, and a frustratingly handsome face, starts hanging around, Si-Wu figures he’s found the perfect arrangement.

 *“Hyung, you’re more good-looking in my eyes... You're so handsome…”*

But Hui-Won barrels in without hesitation, and the emotional walls Si-Wu built so carefully don’t stand a chance. As Hui-Won keeps crossing lines and closing distance, Si-Wu keeps telling himself the same thing:

*"It'll be like taking care of a stray dog... I'll just offer him foster care until someone better comes along."*

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: This Time, I Will Survive Until the End
description:
Adette Berse keeps getting reborn but never survives past 30, always after trying to get married. Determined to break the cycle, she vows to stay single and instead focuses on earning money for her family. In a society that frowns upon working women, she disguises herself as a man to invest in a business with Duke Mateilo. Intrigued by Adette's audacious maneuver, the duke eschews business talk for continuous meetings. With her future on the line, can Adette outwit him and survive until the end? 

(Source: Tapas)

After graduating from the Korean National Police University and becoming a detective, Ji-Yong is assigned to investigate a suspicious report and comes face-to-face with a nationwide jeonse scam. As he confronts criminals who slip through the cracks of the legal system without proper punishment, Ji-Yong begins to question the rules of vigilante justice he once set for himself. While pursuing the scam’s ringleaders, the four vigilantes receive a threat from someone who knows their true identities and begin to sense the looming presence of a far greater evil.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ja-Yeon, a recessive omega, gets into Hankuk University to find the mysterious "Gong Ju" who saved him when he was in middle school. He immediately finds Gong-Ju, but it turns out his savior has a twin! Ja-Yeon tries to figure out which alpha twin helped him and believes it to be Gong Ju-Eun. Convinced of his savior’s identity Ja-Yeon asks Gong Ju-Dan to help him win over the icy twin, but Ju-Dan won’t do it for free.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*"You were the most worthy opponent I had... Farewell, Beatrice."*

Sierratica Tiar Yerphinen, my sworn enemy. I died by his sword... until I didn't?! 

Beatrice Shelle Marcean wakes up five years after the day of her death in a new kingdom—a new body, in a new family. She has gone from duchess to princess—and the man from her past, Sierratica Yerphinen, barges into her land to offer a treaty. He is now an emperor, seeking a bride from her new bloodline! Now living as princess Shroina, our female lead must do whatever it takes to push away from his pull. She won't repeat the same mistake twice.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

 *Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

In an era of chaos, with the throne left without a ruler, the five great houses fell into a brutal civil war for dominance. Enraged by the blood spilled in the name of ambition, the god cast a curse upon the foolish: the creation of Alpha and Omega traits. To seek forgiveness, the five great houses agreed to hold a hunting tournament and offer sacrifices to the god. Onyx, the newly crowned matriarch of the First House, finds herself deeply troubled by the upcoming tournament. Her nemesis, Kairo, the Alpha and patriarch of the Second House, has suddenly declared his intention to participate. For Onyx, who has risen as an Omega leader in a house that traditionally refuses to accept Omegas as heads, Kairo’s presence is far from welcome. Where will their clash, fueled by mutual hatred and undeniable attraction, ultimately lead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Yongyongjukgetji Danpyeonseon (용용죽겠지 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: Lady Baby Is a Revenge Maker
description:
The Allegros are about to get what’s coming to them. My family barely remembers my name (it’s Sephiel!), but I’ve written all of their names on my revenge list. Now that I’m engaged to Elgar from the powerful Remdragon family, I’ve got the allies and influence to make it happen. I’ve definitely got to be careful that these half-dragons don’t catch me in a lie (or kill me themselves), but I’m sure my cuteness and cunning will keep me alive. 

(Source: Tapas, translated)

display_title: The Acting Empress Still Spends the First Night
description:
Zelda von Trova never wanted the title of Acting Empress, but when she's forced to wed the Emperor of the Raphion Empire in place of the runaway princess, she has no choice. Yet after sharing the first night with him, her divorce plans begin to waver. As their attraction grows, Zelda’s heart is torn-- will she be able to walk away when the time comes, or will love unravel all her plans?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yujun, a loyal member of the Hwaseo Gang, goes undercover in the rival Gangho Gang to retrieve a secret ledger that contains incriminating evidence against his boss, Congressman Jang Seok-jun. Successfully catching the eye of Gangho’s ruthless boss, Kwon Jaeha, Yujun tries to secure his position by pleading for his life and offering to do anything Jaeha asks. But when Jaeha responds with a chilling demand, “Strip down,” Yujun realizes that survival in this dangerous game demands more than just loyalty—it requires total submission. This gripping story explores deception, power plays, and the price of betrayal. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

After losing his mother to the mafia, Ro-Wan goes undercover to destroy the organization from the inside. But things take an unexpected turn when he meets its enigmatic leader, Raphael Valentino…a man he should loathe, but can’t seem to ignore. Determined to bring the seedy underbelly of New York down - whether as Rafael’s hunting dog or as someone powerful enough to crush it from above - Ro-Wan spends years as a member of his gang. But the more time they spend together, the harder it becomes to draw the line between duty and desire. In a world built upon lies and vengeance, can this tangled relationship end in love…or will it all fall apart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

My husband, Karlotian, loved the empire's saintess. All that was left after my ugly jealousy was the false accusation of cursing the saintess. And when I finally gave up everything in despair, I transmigrated into the body of the villainess who had actually cursed the saintess...and things are not going as planned.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Prince Flynn of Albion is adored for his charm and good looks-but the endless dating rumors? Not so much. Tired of the gossip, he proposes a bold idea to his secretary, Drew: pretend to date him to control the narrative. It’s all for show…until Drew starts seeing Flynn in a different light. Can a staged romance turn into something real?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Determined to escape her fate in the novel of being sold off to a loathsome man by her father, Beatrice Arosha runs off to the second male lead, Duke Ruslan Etenas, and proposes a contract marriage. After he immediately agrees, Beatrice moves into Etenas Castle, built on a sealed spirit gate and staffed by ghosts! But as she grows closer to the duke and experiences visions of the original Beatrice, she begins to realize the haunted castle may not be the strangest thing about her marriage…

(Source: Tapas)

After Tae-Yoon's ex-boyfriend sends a package to his old address, he quickly rushes to get it before anybody sees it. There, he unexpectedly runs into Jae-Min, a former high school classmate with whom he shares a tense and complicated past. Tae-Yoon flees quickly, hoping it will be their final encounter, but fate insists on intertwining their paths again. To confront his lingering guilt, he offers Jae-Min a sincere apology, only to be met with a shocking suggestion—that they meet five more times. What seems like a simple request leaves Tae-Yoon both confused and anxious, as he begins to wonder what Jae-Min’s true intentions might be. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

A regular employee is belittled by his boss, but when he uncovers her secrets, he gets a chance for revenge.

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: Youngest Daughter of the Ultimate Martial Master Namgung Family
description:
Hui-Ran used to be the disgrace of House Namgung, shunned by all, including her siblings. But after political intrigue destroys her family, Hui-Ran dies trying to avenge them. All seems lost until she reawakens in the past... as an adorable baby! But how can she help anyone in a baby’s body? And why are her siblings being so nice to her? Time has been reset—using her knowledge of the future, Hui-Ran must rewrite history and thwart the sinister dissidents who seek Namgung’s downfall.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

With a pure mind and innocent heart, Xuan Jin-Yu has lived a diligent life as a mother for her daughter Song-Yan. Even her encounter with the vengeful Mr. Spirit, a soul possessing a broken sword, cannot shake her entirely. But when Jin-Yu’s husband sells Song-Yan to make money for gambling, Jin-Yu is forced to work alongside Mr. Spirit to find her daughter. Will Xuan Jin-Yu be able to use martial arts to save the day? Or will the dark thoughts from the malicious spirit consume her mind? 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

It’s been years since Haemin first began craving blood…and only his brother’s will do. Something uncontrollable has called out to Haemin since he was a young boy: an animalistic urge that won’t quell until he’s had his share of blood. Despite this, his younger brother Dogun will do whatever is necessary to keep him safe…and that includes lending him a hand (or vein) whenever his thirst takes over. On top of this, as an elite agent, Dogun needs to fight off the mutants that have begun to invade the world. As the two brothers try to survive in a world full of ravenous beasts and calculating figures disguised in shadows, they uncover secrets that were meant to stay hidden far below the surface. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yerin who died trying to save her student is reincarnated into Fiora a villainess from a story she is familiar with. In the original story, Fiora secretly torments the children of Duke Baridas the man she is engaged to, but later gets exposed and ends up being dumped and executed. Yerin, now in Fiora's body, plans to stay out of trouble and just take good care of the lovely children until the female character that ends up becoming the Duke's true love comes along. Her ultimate goal is a clean breakup that will land her some alimony so she can open a daycare center in this universe. But can she live this life as a character that veers off the set fate and most importantly don't end up dead? 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

display_title: Breaking News: I’m Married to the Grand Duke?!
description:
Libelle Ibella, a viscount's daughter, works undercover as a reporter to repay her father's gambling debt. ⁤⁤While covering a story, she accidentally discovers her fiancé's love affair. Devastated and heartbroken, she drunkenly proposes to Systain von Diranta, a stranger at a bar. ⁤⁤To her surprise, she wakes up with a marriage approval letter signed by the grand duke himself. ⁤⁤Overnight, Libelle finds herself thrust into the role of grand duchess, struggling to balance her new duties with her secret life as a reporter. ⁤⁤And little does Systain know that she's the reporter behind a scandalous article questioning his manhood... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*"I want a divorce."*

The arrogant Christoph believed Marianne would eventually return. That she'd left home on a whim. After all, the facts had always said he was right. Well, he couldn't have been more wrong. Filled with regret, he tries to bring Marianne back, but she refuses to change her mind. Can Christoph earn Marianne's forgiveness and win her heart again? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: I Was Just Taking Care of My Sick Father
description:
Evrielle Solgren is devastated by the death of her father. Living in the capital with her tutor, she didn’t even get to see him one last time before the north was sieged by monsters from beyond The Curtain. It was almost too much for a 14-year-old to bear...before she was killed and woke up in her five-year-old body. Now that she has been given this opportunity, Eve will do everything in her power to save her beloved father and stop The Northern Curtain from falling.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I'm the Final Boss Villainess He Must Kill
description:
Hongyeon Kim has spent her afterlife generally being bored. So when a new program is introduced to entertain the dead, Hongyeon jumps at the chance to be transported into her favorite novel. However, when she finds herself in the body of the villainess, the demon princess Bella, she attempts a spell to speed up time to the end of the novel. Instead, she finds herself ten years in the past. Now, she must wait fifteen years to escape all while living with demons and raising the main character!

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Lady Blue Bird of the White Lion Family
description:
Used as a bargaining chip to protect the House of Eagles, Shupena, a tiny blue bird, finds herself betrothed to the heir of the House of Lions, Ricador Chadwick. As the villainess who is later tossed aside once he meets the real female lead, she hopes to keep her distance until a divorce can happen. But when Ricador shows much warmth and attachment for Shupena, will it still be possible to resist the temptation of getting closer? Or will the winds carry her into the arms of her new husband?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Cursed Prince and His Clairvoyant Maid
description:
When her mother vanished 15 years ago, she told Giselle to mark her words. "Never leave the imperial palace no matter what." Hoping that her mother would one day return, Giselle continued to work as a maid in the Moonlight Palace as a lonely outcast. One day, she was ordered to move to the Sun Palace where she would personally serve the crown prince. Giselle is concerned as Levan Klonitzsche was a fickle character known to fire his maids often. What would happen to her once she got fired? Would she have to leave the palace forever losing her chance of reunion with her mother? But much to her surprise, the crown prince, the man whom he sees in her prophetic dreams, takes a liking to the purple-haired girl. Giselle is not only a beautiful girl who speaks her mind, but unlike the previous kowtowing maids, but her touch also magically seems to relieve his pain, a curse which has been tormenting him all his life. Will Giselle be the one to forever free him of his affliction?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

After moving into a share house, Hanbyul finds himself becoming a boyfriend for rent.

(Source: Toomics)

Yun Hyeok, a convenience store clerk who's been single his entire life, never expected much from life—until he hits the jackpot, literally. Winning the lottery and becoming a wealthy landlord overnight, he finally works up the courage to confess his feelings to his longtime crush. But there’s a catch—she’s only into men who wax. Determined to become her ideal type, Yun Hyeok heads to a waxing salon run by his old classmate, Lee Ha-eun. What starts as an awkward grooming session takes an unexpected turn when Ha-eun, noticing something…impressive, makes a shocking offer:

*"Would you like me to take care of this for you?"*

(Source: Lezhin US)

My girlfriend and I are at a stage where we're getting bored with our relationship... The only thing that can respark that... is another one...?

(Source: Toomics)

After completing all 200 endings of her favorite game "Nayla", a girl is given a 201st playthrough. She accepts and wakes up in the game as Claudia, Nayla's wicked sister who always meets a grim fate. Desperate to survive, she proposes a marriage contract with the cursed prince, Nathan, to achieve the goal of making a pact with five spirits. Meanwhile, the seemingly virtuous heroine Nayla is determined to frame Claudia as evil. Is Claudia truly the villainess, or is there more to her story?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Maid’s Secret Tea Recipe for the Prince
description:
In the bustling royal palace, Erica, reborn into nobility with a passion for tea-brewing from her past life, finds her future steeped in drama. Her exceptional tea-making skills quickly catch the court's attention. Navigating the tricky politics of tea time, Erica must charm the demanding Crown Prince with her unique blends. Each cup she crafts could bring her closer to her dream of opening a teahouse in the capital or spell disaster. Join Erica in a delightful mix of comedy, romance, and royal intrigue, where every brew has the power to shape her destiny and uncover secrets. 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Eun-Su's prescient dreams show him an apocalypse which is confirmed by his awaking powers. To survive, he bonds with Jae-Young, a hidden powerhouse and seemingly guaranteed survivor. As monsters invade and the world unravels with gods, betrayal, and chaos, they must fight to stay alive—together.

(Source: Manta, edited)

I thought I lost everything to my best friend, Valietta, but I didn’t expect I’d lose my husband to her as well. I, Sierra Brilloxen, was too naive to see that her copying me wasn’t affection—it was obsession. I shattered and decided to end it all. But somehow, I was given a second chance—seven years in the past. This time, I won’t let her get rid of me. I’ll take back everything she stole and show her no mercy for the pain she caused.

(Source: Tapas)

Kang Ha-Ru is a poor college student who works many part-time jobs to support his younger sister and pay off family debt. One day, while making a delivery, he's given a card that says "Puppy Wanted." Misunderstanding, Ha-Ru finds a dog and brings it up to the hotel room Min Do-Woon is staying in, but he is shocked to see Do-Woon having sex with someone. Ha-Ru runs away, but Do-Woon happens to become a visiting professor at his university. Do-Woon hires Ha-Ru as his secretary and the line between work and professional begins to blur. However, Do-Woon's abusive ex Jang Hyuk makes it hard for him to love again.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.*

Gloria wakes to find that she has become the infamous evil stepmother of a cute little werebunny?! She has mysteriously entered a fantastical world of knights and werebeasts, but not as its main character. Now, she must prove that she is not the terrible person everyone thinks she is. It won’t be easy, but she has help. The World Tree’s butterfly guardians will aid her in winning the trust of her new husband and stepdaughter. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Sol Song has a uniquely quirky taste in men: they absolutely must have long hair. Otherwise, she sees them as literal "stone heads," devoid of facial features. So, when her first love—and the only long-haired guy on campus—shows up with a buzz cut, she's devastated. But as they start to reconnect and emotions deepen, Sol must discover whether she likes Okseok for who he truly is or just for his hair.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Seon-U Kang, a high school student, single-handedly takes down a group of illegal loan sharks who show up at his house. While being treated at the hospital, he encounters a mysterious man who offers him an invitation to a suspicious secret fighting tournament with a massive cash prize. The prize money is his only hope to save his family. Seon-U must survive in the combat ward at all costs! Will he be able to defeat all other fighters and become champion? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: Daughter-In-Law to the Mad Dog of Honor
description:
When Isabella woke up, she remembered everything—being poisoned by her in-laws and losing everything at their hands before dying. To avoid being married to the Rosemunds after her parents’ deaths, Isabella will do anything to become the daughter-in-law of Duke Barmouth, the feared "Mad Dog" of the empire. Worried for Isabella’s safety, Lord Barmouth treats her coldly to make her change her mind. But Isabella is set on melting the hearts of everyone at the Barmouth duchy to escape death.

(Source: Tapas)

Arts major Il Yoo is trying to force his way into music major Lee-Won On's proximity, but little does he know that he was inadvertently the cause of Lee-Won's heartbreak three years prior. One thing leads to another and the two begin to draw inspiration from each other for their respective graduation projects. 

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes seven extra chapters.*

Getting transported into a novel once? Unusual. Twice? Welcome to Ji-an Han’s reality. Her second possession lands her in the body of a noble lady with an unfortunate reputation—the court fool. While still adjusting to this twist of fate, the enigmatic Crown Prince Iskan enters the scene with an unsettling proposition: "Take me as yours," he says, "I’ll become your most cherished possession." Between her reputation as a fool and a prince whose motives remain unclear, can Ji-an navigate this complicated new reality?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yeon is the sole survivor of a devastating fire that took everything from her: her home, her status, and her family. Cast aside by the society she once called her own, she learns to survive in isolation, forging her own path. One stormy day, she is drawn by the sorrowful cries of an unusual creature, only to find a mysterious boy with snow-white hair and piercing amber eyes lying in the rain. She names him "Bibi," after the soft, sorrowful sounds he was making when she found him. Bibi remembers nothing of his past or how he came to be on earth…all he knows now is that he feels an undeniable connection to the sky, and a fierce determination to keep Yeon by his side by any means necessary. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

The omega crown prince of the Kingdom of Wistad has been living in hell ever since the day he was tricked into imprinting on Duke Amandaris. This is because while an alpha’s pheromone is supposed to be enticing and irresistible, it is nothing but unbearable stench to an omega that has already imprinted. However, the crown prince finally sees a glimmer of hope when he hears that there is an extremely affluent foreigner in the kingdom who is capable of undoing an imprinting. Unfortunately, this rare information doesn’t come for free, so can the prince pay the right price to the man who has it all? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Unlock: The Nerd Boy's Double Life
description:
Yujin has a hopeless crush on his cool and handsome sunbae, Choi Beom. But thanks to Yujin's shy personality, he can't even make eye contact with Beom and even pulls all-nighters because of the questionably sexy dreams he has about them. One day, Yujin accidentally gets trapped in his grandpa’s invention, a machine designed to unlock human potential. Due to a malfunction, Yujin splits into two personas: a nervous nerd and a shameless flirt. Now it's nerd versus flirt in a chaotic battle for Beom’s heart! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Let Me Fix the Male Lead
description:
Keyboard warrior "Die-hard Diana Fan" has spent her life defending her favorite novel character from fans of the horrible male lead Ian Kloud. That is, until she dies and finds herself reincarnated into the novel as Eloise, Ian's first wife! At first, it seems like the worst possible fate, but what if this is an opportunity? If Eloise can mold Ian into the ideal husband for her beloved Diana, she can give her the perfect ending. Unfortunately, she finds that it may be harder than she thinks...

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I Have Never Abandoned the Tyrant
description:
I transmigrated…twice. As Rari, I doted on Thierry so that I wouldn’t die at his hands later. But I was murdered anyway and, seven years later, I woke up as Princess Alicia Ashtad. Thierry became a ruthless tyrant in that time and, when he shows up in Ashtad Kingdom, I agree to leave with him to protect it. Now in Thierry’s palace, I must conceal my past life and, worse, someone wants me dead…again! Thierry may be the least of my worries. 

(Source: Tapas)

According to prophecy, only wisdom—or “Ji-Hye”—can heal the division tearing the Moon Kingdom apart. Doo-Shik, the youngest prince of the rabbits, leaves the moon to find Ji-Hye and save his kingdom. Immediately upon arriving on Earth, he encounters Ji-Hye Seo, a young man on a quest of his own. Ji-Hye’s quest... is to find big D. Can the duo overcome lies, disapproving family, and constantly getting distracted by the bedroom to rescue the moon?!

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: It Wasn't Love at First Sight
description:
Eun-Jae Seo, a not-so-fortunate member of a wealthy conglomerate family, goes on a blind date with Si-U Yun, whom her grandfather arranged for her to marry. Initially wary of Si-U due to his bad reputation, Eun-Jae starts warming up to him as Si-U confesses he fell in love with her at first sight. She ends up falling deeply in love with him. The two seem to be a happy couple, until Si-U begins to reveal his secrets to her after their wedding. 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

The Blooming estate was in an uproar when nineteen year old Rowena Blooming suddenly went missing, only to be discovered without any recollection of what happened. Rowena was the most confused, left with no memories, but the faint lingering traces of a feeling, or dream she had. Soon, she discovers that something else is lingering around her: a specter of a man who only she can see and hear that identifies itself as Enoch Claude, a member of the notorious Margraves house of Claude. Enoch also claims he is hailing from four years into the future, and is entangled with Rowena in this past timeline as an incorporeal spirit that can occasionally make contact with her, physically and emotionally. The caring Rowena attempts to help Enoch get back to his own life, while his presence as her guardian spirit grows stronger by day.
While the ghostly lord with a dark past is clearly hiding that the two of them are acquainted in the future on bad terms, he grows closer to the Rowena of the past, as they discover more about the reason for their entanglement. Why was Enoch sent back to be her guardian spirit? What is the secret he is hiding? What new future lies for this pair, divided by time? 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Many people dream of being reborn as a princess in another world. And Ha-Ri, an ordinary woman, finds herself in that exact situation… or so she thought. Instead of flowy hair and the beautiful face of a princess, she has stubby limbs and shiny black toe beans. Yup, she’s been reincarnated in a palace in another world as a dog. And a talking one, at that! Will she be able to survive as the pet of the emperor rumored to be a ruthless tyrant? Will she ever be able to turn into a human? Find out in this humorous story about a little talking puppy living in a fantasy world!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

*"You shall live and suffer for eternity, trapped within your armor, prisoners of time."*

Enoch's life is turned upside down when his entire family is slaughtered overnight by the cursed knights. The knights wander, sentenced by the witch's curse to a fate of endless empty slaughters. Enoch trampled under their trail of blood, burns for a vengeance that outlasts, outdoes eternity. Who will be whose fate? Who is the one that orchestrates their conflicting fates?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: The Regretful Villainess Is Happily Divorced
description:
After waking up as the villainess in a dark fantasy romance novel, Marlena was destined to be nothing more than the cold male lead’s scorned wife. Wanting no part in his cruel love story, she demanded a divorce. But just as she begins to enjoy her new life, both her ex-husband and the second male lead start chasing after her! 

(Source: Manta)

display_title: I Will Take the Easy Way Out
description:
After the tragic fates of her first three lives, Serena is determined to cruise through her fourth one. But to Serena's dismay, she's been reincarnated as a villainess hated by everyone, including her husband! Serena just wants to get a divorce and quietly start fresh, but with a talking bunny doll begging her to save the world and her husband suddenly acting more caring, nothing seems to be going to plan. When life has her cornered, will Serena be able to take the easy way out?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: A Simple Guide To Surviving as a Stepmom
description:
When a girl abused by her father wakes up in a novel as Luella Masimelle, the cruel stepmother of the protagonist Hirah, she is determined to make things different. To do this, she proposes a contractual marriage to Duke Huppert to make him Hirah's guardian, but the duke surprisingly seems genuinely interested in her. And with the once timid Hirah also starting to open up and show affection to her, Luella begins to wonder if she'll finally have a happy family... Or is it all too good to be true? 

(Source: Tapas)

Se-Hwa Lee deals drugs to pay off his debts, but his life is disrupted when he is taken in for questioning by military officer Tae-Jeong Ki, who is investigating the drug ring. Their relationship soon becomes sexual, and Se-Hwa realizes that the key to his freedom might be found in bed with Tae-Jeong.

(Source: Manta)

Yoon Hee-Woo is blessed with a slim build, a pretty face, and an irresistible charm. There’s just one problem: despite being the toppiest top in the history of tops, everyone insists on treating him like a bottom! His sex life? A tragic comedy of mistaken positions. But one day, fate (or maybe just some shady tech) gifts him a mysterious hypnosis app… Watch out big guys with bigger egos - Yoon Hee-Woo is on the prowl. Bottoms up! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ji Tae-Bom, a gifted exorcist in training, enrolls in the academy with his devoted friend Chun Hae-Su.Though they’ve always been close, Tae-Bom starts noticing an awkward distance between them. Just as the shift begins to weigh on his mind, he wakes one night to an eerie touch and soft lips brushing against his skin—only to find Haesu, flushed and possessed, staring at him with an unfamiliar intensity....

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Notes: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.*

Romance rekindles amidst urban crisis.

"Team Zero"" is a covert investigation unit unrecorded in any documents. During her pursuit of a monster terrorizing Seoul, Captain Yeo-Heun Jeong encounters her estranged first love, Ji-An Kang. Forced to work together, they uncover unsettling truths about the city's mysteries and their own pasts.

(Source: Manta)

When Airi is reincarnated as a noble’s daughter, she expects an easy life—until her family goes bankrupt and she’s forced to work as a maid for the Grand Duke. While chasing a young lord, she stumbles into a hidden chamber and is trapped for what feels like 100 days. But when she escapes, twelve years have passed, and the world is at war with monstrous beasts. Now, Airi must navigate a broken kingdom and rewrite the story of her second life.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Just who are you really, Father?

Agent Si-Jun Han is working undercover as a priest in Russia when he meets Anna, a Korean woman in the care of the church. The encounter stirs long-forgotten memories from his past, but as their relationship blossoms, the true target of Si-Jun's operation begins to emerge from the shadows...

(Source: Manta)

display_title: A Deal With My Fake Husband
description:
Princess Elysia is part of a fallen royal family. When Elysia's fourth husband died, people started calling Elysia a husband-eating witch, all due to the greedy schemes of her mother and brother hungry for her inheritances. Upon realizing this, Elysia decided to turn back time to take revenge by choosing a husband that would follow her lead. She needed a commoner to play the role of her husband as her puppet... but the man she hired to act as her husband turned out to be someone above and beyond, going beyond her wildest dreams. Elysia then had no choice but to alter her original plan.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Dan Eun-oh is an aspiring artist, and he's struggling to make ends meet. His lifeline and arch-nemesis all in one? Baek Joohyuk, the rich jerk who he grew up with. It doesn't help that the two of them go to the same university, and more often than not Joohyuk asks for sexual favors that Eun-oh ends up complying with. One day for their art club meeting ("full of jerks like Joohyuk," Eun-oh would say), Joohyuk asks—or rather, commands that Eun-oh hire a model for their nude sketches. Now, the quiet and buff model guy sure seems inexperienced and out of his depth, but even without so many words, it's evident that he seems intrigued by Eun-oh, or "Mr. Art Student," he calls him...

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Genius Grandson of House Namgung
description:
When young Hahyeon Shin’s mother sacrifices herself to give him a chance to escape the family she married into, he finds himself alone in a hostile world. His only goal is to find his mother’s family, the House of Namgung, and train in martial arts to avenge her and become a protector of the innocent. But when he is tested by the Namgung family, they discover that he is a martial arts genius with a perfect physique and the potential to become the greatest martial artist who ever lived.

(Source: Tapas)

Wu-Ju’s first meeting with Do-Yeong ended in anger. Their reunion came with fear. And suddenly living under the same roof? Total chaos. But with Do-Yeong barging into his life so boldly and shamelessly, Wu-Ju’s carefully guarded world - built on worrying about others’ opinions and pining after his hopeless crush, Hyeon-Wu- starts to crumble in the most unexpected ways. And before he knows it, Wu-Ju just might be falling for the very storm that turned his life upside down…

(Source: Lezhin US)

From childhood, Sohm has always felt queasy and unsettled whenever he looks at Geon, a boy who is almost like him but somehow completely different. The two can never meet eyes without arguing, and when their parents remarry and they suddenly become family, strict rules are put in place to keep the peace. Rule One: Go to and from school together. Rule Two: Hug for thirty full seconds before entering the house. Forced into daily embraces, their unwanted closeness begins to change in ways neither expected. Geon’s teasing eventually leads to something far more risky than bickering, and the two find themselves sharing more than they had ever intended...

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Season 2 is rated R19*

Hans wakes up as a minor character in Vantablack Ring, a game he's cleared countless times. To survive the monster attack, he decides to stick close to the hero, Kadith, only to see him immediately killed in battle. Shocked, Hans sets out to find the other heroes... but soon learns that the same fate awaits every one of them and that he seems to be absorbing their abilities. With his plans to lay low gone awry, will Hans have to become the hero and save this world himself?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Tareya DeLov awakens in a novel to find herself married to the cold and aloof Duke Anteros Mel DeLov, who's cheating on her with a mistress! Appalled, she immediately petitions for divorce, hoping to keep her share of wealth and win the public's sympathy. But as the divorce comes closer to being approved, Anteros won't leave Tareya alone, remorseful and relentlessly begging her to reconsider. Will Tareya succeed in separating from her husband? And what's with Anteros' sudden shift in attitude?

(Source: Tapas)

The filthy gaze of my perverted boss crawls over me like he's defiling my whole body. My pent-up lust was overflowing enough to soak through from just a stare like that. This reckless escape to quench my thirst... Slowly, deeply, it dragged me into depravity.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Boy-girl best friendships are hard. Will Taehyun and Jikyung's survive their stormy journey?

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: My Master Likes to be Spanked
description:
After waking up as an evil maid in a generic rated-R novel where skin-to-skin contact is needed to stop people from going berserk, the female lead is determined to change the ending of the novel so she can have it easy. For the greater good and to stop the male lead from going berserk, she "teases" the male lead a little bit. But after achieving her goal and helping the male lead get his power back, little did she know that he would get his revenge on her in the most unusual and unexpected way possible...

(Source: Tappytoon)

*“Once I’m back from the battlefield, perhaps you’ll share your heart with me then.”* 

Those were the final words of Prince Lochlan of the Routen Kingdom to his fiancée April Campbell before he rode away to war, never to return. Left heartbroken and destitute as the neglected ward of her greedy uncle and his mistress, April desires nothing more than her freedom, almost as ardently as she wants her prince to return to life. When April is brought to the royal palace for her beloved prince’s funeral, she notices something unusual about his twin brother, Crown Prince Dominic… 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Known for loving nothing but pretty faces, Kang Ji-Heon never imagined falling for someone he couldn’t recognize. When he drunkenly confesses to an unknown junior, Ji-Heon insists it was a mistake, only to be undone by Kwon Jeong-Hae’s sincere tears. What starts as a reluctant relationship soon blurs into something genuine. 

Was it really just a misunderstanding… or the beginning of a love neither of them expected?

(Source: Lezhin US)

They say size doesn’t matter… but he makes sure she feels it.

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: I Became the Young Wife of the Male Lead of a Martial Arts Novel
description:
As the transmigrated ancestor of Do-Yool, her favorite novel character, Seol-Ryeon tries to arrange everything to make his life easier. But when she reincarnates as Ye-Rin, his young bride, she finds that something has gone wrong over the years. The Frost Palace has fallen on hard times, and its people are suffering. Together with her new husband, she must right wrongs and root out the corruption that has befallen this once-great family. But how much can two young people do alone?

(Source: Tapas)

Leverticia Celsiear, a wisecracking noblewoman-turned-knight is used to taking care of herself and her younger brother. But she never expected to add the eight-year-old duke, Caius Baltail, to her protection list--until the emperor arranged their marriage. Meanwhile, she’s also got an eye on her nemesis, rival knight Anthody Everett, is tracking down the truth about her parents’ death, struggling to get out of debt, and even gets stuck in a time-distorted dimension! Whew! Good luck Leverticia! 

(Source: Tapas)

*"Sir... Promise you'll guarantee my success in return for claiming my body..."*

In the corrupted athlete training center, players are ravaged by the coach’s absolute power. Their hunger for success intensifies, and they slowly begin to crumble under the weight of their own desires.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Five years after the war, peace has settled over the victorious nation of Formapolis...until a strange series of incidents threatens to shatter it. Corpses with grotesque modifications, known only as "specimens," begin turning up in the capital. Detective Kleine, assigned to the case, is ordered to investigate every detail under the guidance of the state’s special security division. His assigned partner? Doctor Agato, a brilliant but secretive scientist from the defeated nation, whose charm seems as deliberate as it is disarming. 

As Kleine is drawn deeper into the mystery, he comes face to face with Tristan, a man with unnatural powers and a disturbing connection to Agato. The deeper the investigation goes, the more it becomes clear: this isn't just a case about dead bodies. It's a collision of past sins, buried experiments, and a bond too dangerous to name. 

*“I wanted to see you again, Professor.”* 

(Source: Lezhin US)

If there’s one thing Do Haejoo loves more than her job, it’s handsome men. But after a breakup and a career blunder that lands her a week off, her luck turns around when she finds a mysterious flyer for a cleaning service exclusively for women. The cleaner who shows up is not only competent—he's drop-dead gorgeous and awakens her dull world with his special services. Is this the beginning of Haejoo's very own love story or a messy temptation that's too hot to handle?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I Don't Want to Be a Lady
description:
I'll be the one calling the shots.
After enduring an upbringing full of torment, Lady Arianne refuses to be used as a means to anyone's end but her own. When her father moves to have her sold off as an additional mistress to the crown prince, she takes matters into her own hands by proposing a contract marriage with a duke instead!

(Source: Manta)

After 25 years, you think you’d know almost everything about your best friend. But Jeong-U has been keeping a secret or two from Yi-Seo for a while now... One, he has been harboring a crush on her for years, and two, he has been blessed with a particular talent that is hard to measure…in more ways than one! But when the two end up moving in together, everything will be revealed…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Jae-Hyeon's life was ruined by his stepmother, the woman who drove his mother to death and later caused his father's downfall. Consumed by hatred and forbidden desire, he takes revenge on her, only to die in a tragic accident. But fate has other plans... Awakening 25 years in the past, before his family’s destruction began, Jae-Hyeon must change the course of his life. Will he break free from his past, or repeat the same twisted destiny? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Annis, a knight, married Marquis Devon Pizetra out of respect for her late mother’s wish. As the lady of the house, she brought wealth to the family by successfully managing the finances. However, the incapable husband Devon spends her hard-earned money on his ex-wife, who is pregnant with his child. Devon asks Annis for a divorce but forces her to stay on the estate and continue to manage family businesses. When Annis was broken by her husband's betrayal, she encounters Rowan, an old acquaintance and fellow knight who seems to have feelings for her that’s been kept hidden for a long time.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

display_title: The Ice-Queen Class Ace Is a Masochist?!
description:
Perfect grades, perfect face, and an iron wall that no man can climb. Taeyeong is the campus Ice Queen, and Namjoo is just another guy stuck in the friend zone. But when he discovers Taeyeong’s deepest secret, a hidden masochistic streak, the power dynamic shifts. The Ice Queen doesn't want a prince, she wants someone who knows how to pull her strings. Is Namjoo ready to stop being the "nice guy" and give her exactly what she secretly craves?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Genius commoner Rose Bell is the top student at the prestigious Benkley Academy, but when Rose's perfect grade slips, she loses her scholarship. As she despairs, Jasper, the son of a duke, makes her an irresistible offer: He’ll pay her tuition in exchange for secret lessons—just the two of them.

(Source: Manta)

After seven grueling years, Jihan Yu, a support hero, is expelled from his guild. But fate throws him a curveball -- a contract with an elemental grants him the ultra-rare power of a Wind Elementalist! In a world ravaged by monsters and invaders from other realms, Jihan joins the underdog Epic Guild. Can he utilize his newfound power and strategic mind to lead the ragtag guild to greatness, all while mastering his abilities, overcoming fierce rivalries, and surviving in this chaotic world?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yeo Jooyeon has always been different. Ever since her school days, her unusually strong sexual desires pushed her to seek an unconventional career path by joining an adult toy company. For her, testing products firsthand and leaving real reviews isn’t just work… it’s pure pleasure. But amid her chaotic office life, she suddenly receives a shocking proposal from her team leader and secret crush, Lee Jungwoo:

*“Jooyeon, how about becoming our model?”* 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Chang-Gyeon, the bastard third son, clawed his way to the throne in a whirlwind of chaos and blood. Now, with his reign spiraling out of control and the kingdom teetering on the edge, his only comfort lies in one person—his childhood friend, Sam-Myeong. But what started as fondness has twisted into something darker. Chang-Gyeon’s obsession knows no bounds, and he’s willing to do anything—schemes, manipulation, even breaking Sam-Myeong’s will—to keep him close. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the Kingdom of Silla, ghost stories begin to bleed into reality, spreading fear across the land. Seolyeong, a hwarang accused of causing the terrifying occurrences, is determined to solve this mystery and clear his name. That is when he meets Jaha, a former leader of the hwarang who now harbors demonic energy. What dark secret is Jaha hiding? Without an answer, Seolyeong continues his journey to lay every wandering spirit to rest, unaware that the soul most in need of his help is close by…

(Source: Tapas)

Following the brutal Virtuous-Demonic War, the Demon Cult emerges victorious, seizing control of the world. But their triumph is shaken when the Cult’s vice-leader is assassinated in a sinister conspiracy. From the shadows emerges Ryeon-Hwi Hyeok, Crown Prince of the Demon Cult. Determined to uncover the truth and avenge his brother, he infiltrates the elite Academy of Mirages. There, he crosses paths with Seol Bi, a hidden master from the Virtuous Sect, and as the two aid each other, their relationship begins to blossom… Follow Ryeon-Hwi on his journey to conquer the Murim and become the next Demon King! 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Melvin is a complete loser whose life suddenly turns into a dating sim game. Will he rise to the challenge to become the Lord of the Harem?

(Source: Toomics)

Doesn’t every child dream of a world without grown-ups? But when a deadly virus wipes out everyone over the age of twenty, reality proves to be far more sinister than a childhood fantasy. By the time No-Eul turns eight, he is already familiar with the virus and the mysterious monsters that roam the land. When his mother passes away and his village comes under threat, he sets out on a journey to find "Utopia," a rumored safe haven said to hold the cure for the virus. But this so-called "Utopia" may not be what it seems...

(Source: WEBTOON)

Sierra's peaceful village life is disrupted when her ex-boyfriend, Duke Cassius Ideos, shows up and mistakes the child she's raising as his daughter. The thing is, the girl is her niece, not her kid! When he refuses to listen to any explanation, her only option is to follow him to his duchy and await the results of a paternity test. All Sierra has to do is keep to herself for three months, but will things remain that simple when she begins to suspect that the duke still has feelings for her?

(Source: Tapas)

*“Did I steal this man's lover?”* 

Seo In-Ho wakes up in a world that he doesn’t recognize. He cannot speak, and can hardly move, but hears voices calling out for him…only, it’s by a name he doesn’t know. Realizing that he has possessed the body of Kacius of this nation’s royal guard. The only person he can rely on is Kacius’s former colleague and lover, Albretto Noe. Determined to not only be protected by, but to protect Albretto, In-Ho begins to fall deeper and deeper into the life of Kacius, until it becomes nigh impossible to differentiate who he truly is any longer…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seven years after leaving the Herbet Empire to escape her selfish mother, Rosena Estalot returns seeking treatment for her sick son, Illion. There, she reunites with Yerhan, the third prince of the empire and Illion's father. When Yerhan proposes marriage, Rosena, reluctant to reenter high society and confront her mother again, agrees on one condition: an eventual divorce. With Rosena so set on pushing him away, can Yerhan win her heart before their marriage runs its course? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: My Status Window Went on Strike
description:
Monsters pour out of gates, wreaking havoc on the world, but Tae-Jun couldn’t care less. After seven years of failure and bullying in his hunter’s guild, he’s fired—until his dormant S-Tier power suddenly activates. Now, with newfound strength, Tae-Jun hunts monsters, exacts brutal revenge, and rises to fame. But as his power grows, so does the danger, and shadowy forces begin targeting him. Can Tae-Jun stay one step ahead and crush those who want him dead?

(Source: WEBTOON)

In a special forces unit made up of nothing but monsters in human form, Aaron Myer stands out: pretty-faced, sharp-tongued, and quietly harboring a crush on his reliable team leader, Dan Marcus. When Aaron accidentally witnesses Dan being harshly punished by a notorious superior, concern pushes him to visit Dan later that night with a simple excuse. What he finds isn’t the broken man he expected, but something far more...intriguing. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's Gunbu Danpyeonseon (군부 단편선) Collection.*

Idel Fleure was born without a scent in a noble family where fragrance defines one’s lineage, causing her to be ostracized. She escapes a forced marriage by being accepted into Euphiter Imperial University, but finds herself bound in another marriage– one to Archduke Chaeron, who is drawn to her scent that only he can smell. Chaeron proposes a contractual marriage, and agrees to take her as his wife for three years and then divorce her. Will this seemingly contractual partnership conclude as smoothly as planned, or will the Archduke’s fascination with Idel’s scent lead to a different ending? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: My Students' Guardians Are Obsessed With Me
description:
Eleanor died from overworking as a teacher in her past life, so now she's determined not to work! She teaches her brother to be the prince's aide so he can be the breadwinner instead. When he reveals his sister is the true genius, she is asked to tutor the siblings of the most influential men in the land: her best friend, a handsome duke, and the crown prince. How can she refuse?! But is a good education all they want from her? Maybe this time, her job won't ruin her life but lead her to love…

(Source: Tapas)

Frey is the anti-hero who killed his loved ones and doomed the world. But his true goal was to open the hidden route and save the heroines from their fated deaths. Reborn in the past, Frey has a chance to change destiny... until he realizes the five heroines he once killed remember everything, and this time, they want him dead.

(Source: Manta)

Min Ji-Ho’s idol career as a member of a mid-tier K-pop group member ends in emotional turmoil and disappointment. Ready to leave the industry behind for good, Ji-Ho unexpectedly finds himself filling in on a variety show…only to cross paths with Kang Tae-Yeon, the A-list actor he’s long admired. A lighthearted moment on set quickly spirals into a headline-making scandal: the first same-sex “incident” in the industry. Though the rumors fade as quickly as they came, Ji-Ho’s quiet exit is once again delayed. When an awkward reunion with former groupmate Park Hyeon-Do pulls him back into old tensions, Ji-Ho is forced to confront not just his past, but the unresolved wounds he thought he left behind with his life as an idol. In a world where appearances are everything, can Jiho uncover what he truly wants…and who he wants to stand beside him when the cameras are off?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Keeping My Boss on a Tight Leash
description:
Tangled up in some hairy business. 

Office worker Nahee is working late when she gets caught in the crossfire between her boss and a would-be assassin. She's dragged into the secret world of human-animal shapeshifters, and it turns out her boss imprinted on her?! The two can't stand being together but can no longer bear being apart! 

(Source: Manta)

Brave New World is a virtual reality MMORPG with the most expansive world in gaming history--one big enough that its users can earn a living in it. Looking to earn some cash, Tae-Sung Han pours his heart and soul into playing, even becoming master of a strong guild. All is well until a rival guild, Genesis, annihilates them and hunts Tae-Sung down. On the verge of getting caught, a mysterious old man rescues Tae-Sung and presents a new way forward...

(Source: Tapas)

Orphaned at a young age, Woo Jung-Won grew up neglected in an orphanage. One day, drowning in debt, the director decides to sell him off. Luckily, Kwon Jun-Seo, a powerful mafioso, arrives just in time—to collect his money. But when he sees Jung-Won being manhandled, something in him shifts. On a whim, he saves the poor boy. For the first time in his life, Jung-Won sees a ray of hope in his dark and bleak world. And from that moment, a flower of hope blooms within him—bright and powerful. But is that flower truly something beautiful? Or is it the beginning of something far more sinister?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Murdered Princess and the Innocent Traitor
description:
After realizing she had royal blood, Brigit's life was supposed to take a turn for the better. However, during her coming of age ceremony, she discovers that the royal family she so cherished only brought her back home as a sacrifice to further their own gains. With time wound back one year before her death, she must now uncover her ruthless family's plans and rewrite her twisted fate.

(Source: Tapas)

Pit-a-Pat’s fans ship everyone together except Tae-Joon and Min-Jae. Which should be a good thing, because they’re already dating! But the group’s youngest member, Tae-Joon, can’t help feeling insecure when everyone adores his leader so damn much. Can their love story overcome the struggles of fame and fandom?

(Source: Tapas)

It was another boring school day, or so thought Inori Takafuji until Goddess summons him and his classmates to a different world. Just as Inori gets excited for a new life, he is banished and resummoned to other worlds over and over again, each time with new, additional powers! Will there be an actual challenge and suspense befitting our super-packed hero or will the adventure be a breeze?

(Source: WEBTOON)

A life of kindness, and it all came to an end. If given another chance, will I live the same way?

(Source: Toomics)

Please, just let me sleep! Every night, the devil who haunts my dreams turns out to be... an upperclassman from my club? Who is he? No—what is he?! 

(Source: Lalatoon)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

display_title: How to Make My Tyrant Husband Love Me
description:
The notorious Empress Belita, famed for her myriad romantic entanglements!

Just when Belita is on the verge of being killed by her tyrant husband while attempting to elope with a prince from a neighboring kingdom, "I" becomes Belita. "I"-now Belita-narrowly escapes death and vows to cease her unfaithful behavior to dispel the emperor's suspicions. 

Amidst a palace rife with numerous paramours, a distrustful emperor, and the looming specter of war, can Belita survive?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

Calix Bastian, the empire’s one and only Grand Duke, harbors a secret obsession for Evan Chris, a low-ranking knight renowned for his beauty. One night, under the cover of a training drill, Calix sneaks into Evan’s room and is caught in the middle of a private act he cannot take back. Using that moment as leverage, the two begin meeting in secret, their bodies drawn together by desire. But for Calix, lust alone soon feels hollow. He wants something more, but how do you ask for love when all you've ever known is touch?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Individuals who return from death as Terminal Revenants are granted unique abilities that allow them to surpass human limits. They have the power to steal the lifespan of others. Twenty-one years ago, the worst of these revenants, Hae-su Shin, disappeared without a trace after killing 144 people and stealing everything. Now, a revenge 20 years in the making begins, aimed at capturing the most dangerous of these resurrected beings.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Ji Woo-In is a clumsy but good-hearted police officer in the Community Safety Division. At 28, he's still single, still a virgin, and constantly pressured by his family to start dating. As the only son, he finally gives in and accepts a strange charm from his mother that's supposed to help him find love. He doesn’t believe in things like that. It’s clearly a scam. Or so he thinks. The next morning, he opens his closet and finds someone sleeping inside. A beautiful stranger, fast asleep as if he’s always belonged there.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Talent doesn't always run in the family. 

In an age ruled by science, there remain almighty witches with mythical powers. However, Diana ended up lacking any of her mother's witchly talent. In fact, ever since she began training at the age of 7, her only goal was to reunite with her sister. But life never turns out how we want, does it? 

(Source: Manta)

Hyeon-Seung has gone his entire life without anyone realizing he’s a vampire - until Tae-Hee, his teammate for a group project, uncovers his secret. What’s worse, Tae-Hee is a hardcore vampire otaku, so try as he might to hide his identity, Hyeon-Seung’s identity has been laid bare. Tae-Hee promises to keep quiet, but only after bombarding Hyeon-Seung with endless questions and enthusiastic fanboying. Dazed and cornered, Hyun-Seong finally agrees to help fuel Tae-Hee’s obsession, forming a strange symbiotic relationship fueled by blood and fandom. But as the two grow closer, their relationship grows into something more…giving bloodlust a whole new meaning.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Gyeo-Ul has lucked into a marriage with a rich, handsome, and kind man. The catch? She has no idea how it happened. After an accident wipes out the past year of her memory, Gyeo-Ul finds herself living a life she doesn't recognize: Si-Hu Kang, her sworn enemy, is now her doting spouse, and he won't stop gushing over her. 

*“Wait, I have to share a bed with this guy? And kiss him, too?! Why does he keep saying he loves me?!”*

Something about this marriage doesn’t add up.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Guster Smith has dedicated 17 years of his life to being a hero - only to remain a penniless nobody in the grand scheme. So when the esteemed archmage, Lord Angel Romero, offers him a mission to once again save the world, he accepts without hesitation. But all is not as it seems, and Guster is about to find about that the archmage has quite the “staff” he uses to work his magic…and a plethora of special techniques bound to blow the knight's mind.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

The martial arts world's most dangerous mastermind finds herself reborn in the weakest possible form: a tiny toddler and holy monarch’s successor, destined to die young. But Dan-Ye Jin didn't survive centuries of martial arts intrigue just to accept defeat in diapers. Armed with ancient techniques and disarming baby charm, this mysteriously capable little girl is turning imminent death into the realm's greatest adventure. Who knew saving yourself could be so adorably dangerous?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Kang Tae-Hwa’s first crush came to him like a fever. And ten years later, that fever is still running high when he reunites with his once privileged and untouchable love, Moon Cheong-Hyeon. But the tables have turned now, as Tae-Hwa has gone from being a poor street kid to the gangster boss of his own money-lending business, and Cheong-Hyeon is his latest customer. Cheong-Hyeon knows the violent and foulmouthed Tae-Hwa is no good for him, but he is drawn back to him anyway. And hearing this, Tae-Hwa becomes determined not to lose his first love a second time... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Josh visits the gym after his girlfriend calls him fat. There, he meets the woman who almost became his stepmom but became estranged from him after his father’s death.

(Source: Toomics)

A stowaway named Lee Sesang wakes up in the middle of the ocean, aboard a cargo ship. It has already been a month since he started living there, treated like a nuisance by the crew. Branded as an unwanted intruder, he barely speaks to anyone, except for Aeri, the ship’s cook. Aeri is the only one who doesn’t outright shun him, and so, Sesang begins helping out in the kitchen, trying to pull his weight. One day, as they find themselves alone in the kitchen, Aeri suddenly smirks and says:

*"Do you even know how heavy they are? Wanna try lifting it?"*

Soft and squishy. A naughty little prank begins in the quiet kitchen..

*"Sesang, are you… really gonna touch them?”*

(Source: Lezhin US)

An immortal high school student, So-Yeong is secretly crushing on human golden retriever Hui-Jae. Mysteriously, he keeps coming into near-death danger and So-Yeong repeatedly sacrifices herself to protect him. Something begins to grow between the two, and someone doesn't like that. What will happen to their lives and fate?! 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

She always wanted to be a campus couple with someone, he just thought she was a weirdo with an impulsive streak. So what happens when what starts as a whim becomes something neither of them expected? Maybe love really does come when you least expect it...

(Source: Manta)

The rampant spread of a virus has turned most humans into grotesque beings called “the Rotten.” Amidst the ruin, Seonho leads a small group of survivors and protects his companion Haesoo, who is bullied for being weak and timid. Seonho’s group is thrilled to meet more survivors with a large stockpile of supplies—until they realize that this new group is shockingly barbaric and cruel. By far the most twisted is their leader Won, who has his dangerous eyes on Seonho. Determined to shield Haesoo, Seonho makes a deal with Won... but will any of them make it out alive? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: A Murderous Affair at 19 Sunset Street
description:
A man is found murdered in an apartment at 19 Sunset Street. The prime suspect is Leon Devonport, the victim's lover, and all evidence found on the scene of the death seem to point to him. In order to prove his innocence, Leon seeks out Benjamin Wolf, a once-famous detective who has now retired from murder cases due to an incident in his past. Benjamin had long stepped away from murder cases, but at Leon's desperate request, with a bit of flirting, he reluctantly takes the case and begins to investigate. As the investigation progresses, Benjamin uncovers hidden truths behind the case and the complex relationships between all parties involved. What is the truth hidden behind this "murder?" What is Leon hiding from Benjamin? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Undercover NIS agent Park Seonwu is disguised as a café owner in an affluent neighborhood to investigate a drug ring. When he stumbles upon a lead about a drug-fueled party, he infiltrates it under the guise of delivering coffee. However, a lapse in judgement leads him to the brink of disaster until a cafe regular Seo Yohan rescues him. As the heat of the moment escalates, Seonwu and Yohan find themselves entwined in an unexpected physical connection.
