Realizing that Yohan might have crucial information about the case, Seonwu seeks his help. Yohan, attracted to Seonwu, agrees on the condition that they become friends with benefits. Their unconventional relationship deepens, but as the investigation nears its end, Yohan abruptly cuts ties with Seonwu and seemingly dies in a car accident, leaving Seonwu heartbroken. Three years later, Seonwu, now hardened by his past, spots Yohan in footage from a new NIS sting—alive and well, under the alias "Yohan Romanov," a notorious Russian mafia member. Fueled by betrayal and unresolved trauma, Seonwu embarks on a mission to Russia, determined to confront the man who shattered his world. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Strange Tales from the Moonlit House
description:
Following a tragic accident at age 7, high schooler Yu Dan has been able to see the supernatural with his divine eye. When he finds himself haunted by an ancient being called a misfortune anomaly, Dan is led to the Moonlit House. There, he meets fox spirit Master Baek, who says the only way to avoid misfortune is to transfer it to someone else. Dan is adamant to find another path, but can he banish the calamity in time before it pulls him further into this peculiar world of dangers and spirits?

(Source: Tapas)

Alexei will stop at nothing to give his brother the life he deserves…even if it means risking his own. When the mafia thug learns that his ballerino brother Valeri, a fellow alpha, has fallen for the nephew of another family, he begs him to choose anyone else. But Valeri is in love, and nothing can stop love…except, perhaps, instinct. Left with no other choice, Alexei turns to untested waters to try and convince his brother to stay by manipulating the very nature of his being.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: In the Spirit of the Law
description:
After a mysterious accident on a scorching summer day, high school student Jaehun wakes up to a startling discovery - his soul is now sharing his body with that of an enigmatic ascetic. Over the next three years, Jaehun adjusts to life with his unexpected companion while undergoing rehabilitation. Just as he begins to settle into this strange new reality, he faces a pivotal moment: choosing his path for college. A conversation with his defense attorney father opens the door to a world he had never considered before.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Reborn into the life of a maid in a novel, Betty has one goal: to live a quiet and unassuming life. Unfortunately for her, at the end of the original novel Duke Janus ends up annihilating the world. Now, Betty must try to change the story and escape from the duke, who is growing ever more obsessed with her.

(Source: Manta)

Assassin-for-hire Cheon Seowoo. After another successful mission, Seowoo is about to make her escape. But not before taking a pretty young thing home to toy with as her reward... 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: No Retaliation from the Supporting Cast
description:
After being transported into a novel she read, Agrain tries to live a quiet life as a side character maid. But that changes when the novel’s timeline is suddenly altered and she finds herself working directly for the terrifying Duke Ingord. Agrain knows that the only way she can survive now is to do anything he asks...but what exactly does he want from her?

(Source: Tapas)

On the day of her unhappy engagement, Rayalexis Reanello is magically teleported from the misogynistic Ridam Empire to modern-day Korea. There, she enjoys 10 years of friendship and independence. But on her best friend’s birthday, Rayalexis is mysteriously transported back to her home world, where only a single day has passed. With a newfound yearning for freedom, she dumps her loser fiancé and resolves to pave her own way… until the “angel of high society,” Duke Louivan, suddenly proposes a marriage contract! Will Rayalexis succeed in bringing modern sensibility to this old-fashioned empire while surviving a year with this man?

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: How to Tame the Merciless Villain
description:
I transmigrated into the novel called "The Treacherous Sorcerer" as a supporting character who's destined to be killed by Kian, the main villain of the story. According to the original plot, Kian ends up slaughtering every single noble in the empire-including me-so I must do everything in my power to stop him and save myself from an untimely death. Kian has survived a harsh and painful past, so I will spoil him and take good care of him so that he won't turn out to be the vicious supervillain! But what have I gotten myself into? After I rescued Kian from the slave market... he's suddenly obsessed with me!
Will I be able to protect Kian and myself from a disastrous fate?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

Step into the scandalous life of a private bodyguard, where hidden desires clash with professional boundaries.

(Source: Toomics)

Sun Mooyoung, a struggling fake fortune-teller, cons clueless chaebol heir Lee Jaeyi, who’s never dated, into a bogus love reading and rakes in big cash. But when Jaeyi realizes he’s been scammed, he sues Mooyoung for the fraudster he is! As if that’s not bad enough, Mooyoung’s boyfriend bails on him after hearing about the lawsuit. Now broke and desperate, Mooyoung hatches a ridiculous plan: make Jaeyi's fake love fortune come true to get the charges dropped. Can this hapless con artist pull off a miracle—or just dig himself deeper?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eight children, each gifted with mysterious powers that could spell disaster for the world, grow up together on a remote island shrouded in a sinister and unsettling aura. What secrets are they hiding, and what future awaits them? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Lee Shin-Hui has always juggled odd jobs to support his ailing brother, but when he accidentally shatters a mysterious marble, he's dragged into a demonic realm! Just as all hope seems lost, he's rescued by a powerful dokkaebi named Ohwi, who demands Shin-Hui's soul qi to satisfy his own hunger. Trapped in a dangerous world and bound to Ohwi's desires, can Shin-Hui find a way back home, or is he doomed to become Ohwi's personal soul qi vessel forever?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The RPG “Lost Story” not only allows players to interact with NPCs but also introduces a new system to rank your closeness with them. With this update, the hero discovers that his relationship with Emma, one of the guild receptionists, is maxed out—even though that shouldn’t be possible! Despite being level 99, Emma always worries whenever he leaves, no matter how much he tries to reassure her that he’ll be fine. Meanwhile, he encounters two star-crossed lovers: the inventor Slaki and Iragneff, the avatar of a god. Can he help them be together while also coming to terms with his own feelings for Emma?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Sentenced to death for adultery, Evelyn Cordelia stands before a crowd that calls her a witch. 

 *"Only God knows the truth. I have never done anything to be ashamed of."* 

Before the blade swings, she sees someone smiling in the crowd... is it her dead husband? When she opens her eyes again, she is transported to a time long before her marriage. Who is her ex-husband who feigned his own death? Who drove her family to ruin? Who accused her of adultery and infidelity? She must find out everything, even if it means she has to become the villainness of her own story. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Catherine Caliburn, a duke’s daughter marked by tainted blood, desperately tries to end her engagement to Grand Duke Deimos Pendragon to keep her true origins a secret, but the Grand Duke has no intention of letting her go as he seeks revenge for her betrayal in his past life.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: My Brother's Boyfriend Fell for Me
description:
Reborn into a boys' love novel as the stepsister of gang leader Baek Hawon, Cha Yeonbyul is determined to prevent her death at the hands of Hawon's future lover, Yugyeom, a rival gang member. But as she ends the original Yeonbyul's twisted obsession with her own stepbrother by pretending to seduce Yugyeom, the new Yeonbyul finds herself trapped as the unlikely object of Yugyeom's affection! Will she escape the clutches of the male lead or stay caught in the middle of this gang love triangle?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Demon Who Kisses My Foot
description:
When young Maria is married off to Jacques Redford, a wealthy nobleman, she is grateful that he seems to be gentle and understanding. However, there are dark secrets to be discovered in the Redford estate, and Maria’s life takes a turn for the worse as her husband's sadistic preferences come to light. With no one left to lean on, Maria finds solace in the companionship of Jacques’ illegitimate half-brother, Lowell. Now that Lowell has returned home as a war hero, can he save Maria from her cruel fate?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: I Tried to Live an Honest Life
description:
Grandma said that good things come to those who live honestly, but my life ended in some car accident. Luckily, I was given a second chance to live an upright life! And so I found myself in the body of Everdeen Usher, a woman who fled home to avoid marrying into a ducal house. Wait, I’m a noble?! Oh crap, my fiancé’s older brother is demanding I pay back the dowry my useless father took! With all the odds against me, can I live an honest life and reach a different ending this time?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Nerd is Actually a Tyrant
description:
Before her accident, Lucette was a young woman living in modern-day Korea. So why did she wake up in the body of a little girl living in the remote outskirts of the Vladin Empire? That was the setting of the ultra-violent webnovel she was reading when she was hit by a truck! But since things have come to this, Lucette might as well get her hustle on, far away from the dangerous capital. At least, that’s what she thought before befriending a brilliant but mysterious boy named Lev. What will happen as their growing bond unveils a life-threatening secret?

*Source: Tappytoon*

Jeong-Ueom has avoided his arranged marriage for years, but with mounting pressure from the other family, he can no longer delay. Yet, his heart has already been claimed by someone irreplaceable—his younger brother, Dong-Im. Dong-Im is not only Jeong-Yeom’s forbidden love but also the one Jeong-Yeom has kept by his side, no matter the cost. In the biting chill of winter, longing for a spring that may never come, Jeong-Yeom finds himself once again drawn to Dong-Im’s room.

*“Dear brother, how does it feel? How does it feel to marry my woman?”*

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's SS Short Story Collection (SS 단편선) or the Depraved Collection in english.*

*"Mr. Hyde, I'm getting married."*

Hyde, a cold and love-averse individual, is tasked by the prince to go undercover as the tutor of Lily, the adopted daughter of Viscount Bardin, to uncover clues about illegal firearm trafficking.

*"And who will be the lucky gentleman to take your hand in marriage, my lady?"*

*"Lord Lucien Sornell, the first son of Count Sornell. Are you perhaps acquainted with him?"*

During his mission, Hyde discovers that his innocent and demure pupil, Lily, is engaged to Lucien, a notorious rake in high society. Ahh, yes. She's been adopted to be married off, so I guess now is when she comes in handy.

*"Mr. Hyde, what do you think the lord likes in a woman?"*

With her big, innocent eyes, Lily looks so pure, yet she has the delicate beauty of a painting. Her body is frail, yet she is well-developed in all the right places, and utterly adorable. For just one week, she vows to become the most beloved bride.

*"Mr. Hyde, if it’s not too much trouble, will you teach me how to do it?"*

*"Of course, Lady Lily. Teaching you is the greatest joy and pleasure I've known in life."*

Though Hyde despises getting his hands dirty and is in a constant rivalry with Lucien, he decides to masquerade as a genuine tutor, teaching Lily the refined ways of noble romance to give Lucien a taste of his own medicine. Will Hyde’s lessons turn Lily into the perfect bride, or will they uncover deeper, more dangerous secrets?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Haneul Yeon is a famous TV producer and the first to enter a same-sex marriage after it was legalized in Korea. But... he divorces two years later and has a drunken one-night stand with his childhood friend, leaving him conflicted. Six years later, Haneul takes over a show starring Yul Won, a recently divorced rising chef—also a childhood friend. When they meet again, Yul drops a major confession, but Haneul has “no taste for younger men.” Will he accept Yul's feelings or push him away? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Curse of the Full Moon
description:
After years of obscurity, rising star Sung Yi-Hyun is finally basking in the spotlight... Conquering dramas, variety shows, and the glitz of celebrity life. Then one day, he gets a single text from his longtime lover, Jang Tae-Eun:

 *“Let’s break up.”*

Ghosted. Dumped. By text. One of the three ultimate breakup sins. Furious, Yi-Hyun swears to live his best, wildest life—eating well, partying hard, and pretending not to care. But Tae-Eun doesn’t even flinch.

 *“Don’t tell me… he’s seeing someone else?”*

When Yi-Hyun storms over to confront him, he's greeted not by his ex—but by the biggest, brightest full moon he’s ever seen. And just like that, the secret he’s kept hidden for years is exposed… along with a tail and a pair of ears. Mistaken for a stray and taken in by Tae-Eun, Yi-Hyun suddenly finds himself living under the same roof as his ex— not as a man, but as a dog named Rufus. 

A sweet ex, a secret shifter, and one very suspiciously adorable dog— let the dangerously cute cohabitation begin!

(Source: Lezhin US)

A rural factory faces a new outbreak of the 'Dumfluenza' virus, and for Daeho, this could be his chance to get back at his arrogant boss lady.

(Source: Toomics)

Ahn Jae-Ha was never going to be a shaman. Not in this life. He drank, he fucked, he sinned—anything to reject a divine being his family had served for generations. But the divine being came anyway. Now Jae-Ha can’t get him out of his head. Or his body.

“You’ll come to need me,” he said. And Jae-Ha can already feel the craving setting in.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Killed for being an elementalist but brought back by the Spirit of Death, Azelda Madison is determined to survive her second chance at life. After relentless training, she meets her betrothed, Duke Shade Karloss, and fights by his side as a mercenary for five years while hiding her true identity. Unwilling to repeat the loveless marriage of her past, Azelda proposes a contract marriage with the duke. But as she gradually uncovers a hidden side to Shade, can she continue to abide by its terms?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Male Lead Proposed to Me
description:
Ciel wakes up in a novel as the villainess who torments her adopted sister and the female lead, Clara, until she’s executed for her misdeeds. Determined to avoid this fate, she becomes the sweetest sister, doing anything for Clara’s happiness. But to her surprise, her efforts end up altering the plot, eventually leading Prince Alex, the male lead, to propose to her instead of Clara! Will accepting his proposal bring Ciel the happy ending she desires? Or will it only bring her greater challenges?

(Source: Tapas)

Su Seong-Hyeon, a successful hair designer, has been secretly in love with his best friend, Jeong Jun-Yeon. One day, Jun-Yeon asks Seong-Hyeon to tutor his younger brother, Jae-Yeon. While Seong-Hyeon believes Jae-Yeon to be a Beta, he starts to faintly sense pheromones from him. Then, one day, Seong-Hyeon discovers a piece of clothing soaked in pheromones among the gifts he received from Jae-Yeon. Overcome by the pheromones, he experiences an unusual heat. At that moment, while on a call with Jun-Yeon, he ends up pleasuring himself to the sound of his voice...

*"What kind of insane Omega spreads their pheromones like this?!"*

(Source: Lezhin US)

After years of training, Kim Ryeo-Dam finally made his idol debut. Though not the most popular member of his group, he had his own reason for staying: a quiet, persistent crush on his teammate, Cha Jin-Won. One night, alone at home, Ryeo-Dam stumbled upon a spicy fanfic featuring himself and Jin-Won. The story stirred something in him, and he slipped into the bathroom for a moment of release. But just as he emerged, flustered and breathless, he came face to face with Jin-Won, who had returned early and seen everything. Jin-Won didn’t get angry. Instead, he teased, his voice laced with curiosity and something unreadable. Ryeo-Dam’s mind raced to recover, but before he could stop himself, the words tumbled out.

 *“What if we tried it... for real?”*

Regret hit him the second the words left his mouth. But Jin-Won didn’t laugh or step back. He simply leaned in and pressed a soft kiss to Ryeo-Dam’s cheek. And what brushed against Ryeo-Dam’s thigh wasn’t just Jin-Won’s leg. He was hard.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three side story chapters.*

After his divorce, Zackary Nam moves into a new apartment and finds himself surrounded by many beautiful tenants.

(Source: Toomics)

In a world where gamers are the elite, Ryuhwi is an unknown, the lowest caste of society. Yet it hasn't always been this way... After years of working as a dedicated analyst for a top gaming guild, he was framed and saw his entire life fall apart. But one day, he's given a second chance by a mysterious (and kinda cute) machine claiming to be the system itself. With the odds now in his favor, he's determined to take revenge on all those who wronged him and uproot this corrupt society! 

(Source: Tapas)

Beom Gyu-Hwa always believed he was an alpha, until one strange night turned everything upside down. Desperate to pay tuition, he accepts a high-paying gig...only to find out it’s at Sehan Hotel, a place he swore he’d avoid at all costs. Things take a turn when his body starts reacting oddly, his pheromones feel off, and worst of all, he runs into the last person he ever wanted to see... When instincts take over, Gyu-Hwa is forced to confront a truth he never saw coming. He's in heat.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes seven extra chapters.*

After her father goes missing in a mysterious accident, Soyi Yoon is left with crippling debt and no job to escape the looming threat of loan sharks. In her desperate search for a way out, she stumbles upon a strange company full of...attractive vampires? As a manager at the Containment Facility, she’s tasked with taking down violent, uncontrollable vampires. But will she be able to keep a straight head when her charming coworkers start showing a little too much interest in her?

[Original Novel](https://page.kakao.com/content/63653603)

**Original Webtoon:**  
R19: [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/63653603)  
R15: [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/63653616), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%B8%94%EB%9F%AC%EB%93%9C-%ED%82%A4%EC%8A%A4/3999)

**Official Translations:**  
R19: [English](https://tapas.io/series/blood-kiss-mature/info), [Thai](https://www.lezhinth.com/detail/blood_kiss), [French](https://www.ono.live/webtoon/18-blood-kiss), [Japanese](https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B0DJLQNKWS/)    
R15: [English](https://tapas.io/series/blood-kiss/info), [French](https://www.ono.live/webtoon/blood-kiss), [Japanese](https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B0DJLQDBVX/) 

**Note**: Based on the Otome Game "Blood Kiss" by Storytaco.

display_title: In the Hall of the Mountain King
description:
Sold off as a male bride to Marquis Oderic, who rules over the territory of Trufinnen, Everard expects to be treated as a prsioner—but in Oderic’s quiet care, he finds peace and freedom. Can love blossom in these austere halls?

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes nine extra chapters.*

display_title: Is This Your First Time as a Death Metal Siren?
description:
Being a death-metal-singing RPG fangirl is a tough job, but someone’s gotta do it. Between part-timing at an adult toy store and struggling to get her death metal career off the ground, Se-Rin spends all of her remaining time romancing her favorite video game character, the paladin Alaistar Chiffon. Then one day, fantasy romances become reality when she awakens in the game's world as a siren! However, although there are plenty of good times to be had as a sexy siren, not everything is fun and games in this fantastical world…

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Mod Note: Based on a Korean web novel, this was first published in English on POCKET COMICS (2024-01-02), but its first AniList-eligible publication was in Japanese by Comico (2024-01-13), and its Korean release was not until 2024-02-09 on Naver. Thus by AniList priority rules this is categorized as a Japanese manga.* 

Mirabel is a famed mercenary whose mother, Cornelia, had long suffered from the guilt of leaving her family, the Grand Dukedom of Criton behind. After Cornelia's failed attempts to contact her family left her distressed and led to her death, Mirable sought revenge, tracking down her grandfather, the Grand Duke Criton, and the assumed cause of all her mother's misery. After finding out that he too was betrayed, Mirabel meets an untimely death at the hands of the true culprit, only to wake up back when she was nine years old, with her mother still alive.

Determined to stop her mother's death, and seek revenge against the true villain, Mirabel sets out to make things right. But her choice to meet her grandfather makes her cross traces of her past, while she experiences a life she never knew before.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Serving a young master can be demanding in several ways, as poor Jayed learns while working as Seo Onka's bodyguard. Not only does he have to accompany Seo on all his nights of debauchery, but he's also constantly tempted by his sultry looks and body. Still, Jayed feels conflicted escorting Seo on his trip to meet his prospective fiancee in the desert. He knows this might be his last time seeing Seo alive, and not because the desert's crawling with dangerous criminals. But what he doesn't know is that things are about to heat up in a completely unexpected way... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Adrienne Trovica, the sole Grand Duchess of the Rhonta Empire, suddenly dies from a seizure and wakes up in the body of Countess Bleiah Acacia, who looks exactly like her. As it turns out, Bleiah is no ordinary woman. She was the mistress of Adrienne’s loving husband, Noevian Trovica. Adrienne, shocked by the news, attends her funeral as Bleiah to confirm the rumor. To her surprise, she sees a man crying for her at her grave. Who is this mystery man, and was everything that she knew about her husband a lie?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

"No, I refuse to die this time!"

Juliet is on a mission to find that one happy ending in the loop of tragedies woven into the very fabric of her character and the world around her. From swords to tomatoes, everything in this universe seems to be a death trap designed to create the perfect Shakespearean tragedy. Only her beloved cousin, Tybalt, comes to her aid upon noticing the time loops. Juliet wants her universe back, and Tybalt wants the real Juliet back. And now, they must work together for Juliet to find her true love in Romeo so they can both get what they want…

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

display_title: The Day the Real One Appeared
description:
Ever since falling ill as a child, Mel Slofi has had white hair. However, this trait brings her more than she bargained for when it leads her to be mistaken for the lost daughter of a duke-- even being told by the duke’s son to keep up the facade in order to protect his fragile father. But when Mel sees a mysterious woman at a grand ball who perfectly matches the photos she’s seen of the duke’s real daughter, she begins to worry that the truth may be catching up to her.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

display_title: The Cursed Princess Must Rewind the Clock
description:
Cursed from birth, Estella has lived her entire life in quarantine. One day, the first-born princess of the Blaze Kingdom is sent away as a hostage to the imperial palace, where she's meant to meet a tragic end... But wait, Estella has a secret. With memories of her past life, where she read this story as a novel, she has a chance to change her fate and survive. Her plan? Charm the ruthless Emperor Tariq Winter, uncover the secrets of the nobles, find the Hourglass of the Time Traveler, and flee for freedom!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

"Why does the Dragon King seek a rabbit?

Cheong-wan, a turtle from the Dragon King’s palace, ventures onto land to retrieve the liver of a rabbit to cure the ailing king. By sheer luck, he encounters the elusive rabbit almost immediately upon arrival. Determined to bring the rabbit back to the Underwater Kingdom, Cheong-wan is prepared to do whatever it takes. 

""And how will you convince me?""
""Sorry?""
""If I go to the Dragon King's palace, what will you do for me in return, Cheong-wan?"" 

Cheong-wan finds himself mesmerized by the rabbit Jeok-ran's playful smile and enigmatic words. He realizes that to succeed, he must go to far lengths. 

Thus begins a perilous and enchanting journey, as Cheong-wan navigates a world filled with unexpected challenges and mysterious allurements, where the stakes are as high as the depths of the Dragon King's palace."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kang Jihan’s perfect gay life comes crashing down after drunkenly making out with Moon Heeseop, the nerdiest loser in his major. Though Jihan has sworn off dating, Heeseop begins following him everywhere, thinking their kiss has made them boyfriends. And Jihan isn’t faring any better with his casual partner of one year, Ji Jinyeong, who keeps wanting something more. With two obsessive guys begging for his love, Jihan could just cut things off with them both. If only they weren’t so packing where it counts, especially the nerd! But maybe Jihan can make a three-way work...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: The S-Class Baby Princess Is Too Powerful
description:
Princess Anatrisha is only a year old, but her life is already far too complicated. Her father, the emperor, is cold and distant, and her mother is nowhere to be seen. Her older brother, meanwhile, is bullied by other nobles. Luckily, Anatrisha was an S-class hunter in her past life and is set on using her skills and magic to protect her loved ones. Can this little princess defend her right to the throne and bring her family closer together? Or will it be game over for this S-class baby?

(Source: Tapas)

A strong coach challenges her boss, sparking passion and revealing a shocking connection to a past he can’t recall.

(Source: Toomics)

In Korea’s gritty underworld, orphaned street fighter Lee Minjo and gangster-raised Cha Kangchul forge an uneasy alliance, each fighting for survival in a landscape ruled by money, power, drugs, and sex. Both are determined to catch the attention of Kwak Seokhwan, the formidable leader of the Samgeori gang. However, their aspirations are thrown into chaos when a traitor emerges within the organization, igniting a violent struggle for survival and supremacy in a brutal world where loyalty is scarce and betrayal is deadly. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yin Tae-Rim, CEO of a failing company, turns to Seo Yi-Rin, a powerful executive with a reputation for sponsoring the lovers she takes a liking to. Desperate to save his business, he makes his move, but Yi-Rin already has a new “puppy” to play with and shows no interest. Instead, she passes him along. Not to a colleague. Not to a rival. To her husband.

That’s how Tae-Rim ends up in front of Jin Ha-Kyung, the cold and unreadable head of a major company. Ha-Kyung listens, watching him squirm through an awkward explanation. Then, with a slow smile tugging at his lips, he makes a proposal that stops Tae-Rim cold.

 *"Forget my wife. Try me."*

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: My Husband is Weak by Day, Strong by Night
description:
Meredith is the illegitimate daughter of a duke. Scorned by her own family, she is shocked to hear that they have arranged a marriage for her—with no other than the Emperor of Valtzein. She soon learns that His Majesty has been placed under a curse and is weak during the day, returning to his former self only at night. When he tries to kill her on their wedding night, she strikes a deal with him—she will find a way to use her healing magic to break him free from the curse, in return for a divorce. But the emperor has other thoughts—he's slowly fallen in love with her, and he won't let her go without a fight. 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

My serenade, my Kieron. 

During one of his conquests, the heartless Archduke Kieron discovers Melusine, a mermaid in captivity. Their bond deepens, but according to legend, mermaids must kill their lovers to return to the sea. Melusine cannot bear to harm Kieron and leaves instead. What cruel fate awaits the lovers? 

(Source: Manta)

Ravaged by a powerful demon that comes to him every night, Count Erwar del Diav has been enduring the pains and pleasures of their relationship in silence. His despair deepens when he learns this is the consequence of a curse placed on him by an unknown person. Meanwhile, Erwar’s powerful yet possessive friend, Grand Duke Kaijack, arrives at the Diav Estate to take Erwar back to the capital. Although he longs to escape the clutches of his friend and the demon, Erwar can do little to gain his freedom. And yet, everything is also not as it seems...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Seo Do-Gyeom, the young master of a mansion, and Yoon Seo-Won, the housekeeper's son, share a secret bond despite their different social statuses. After a kiss, Seo-Won falls in love, but Do-Gyeom abruptly leaves to study abroad. Five years later, Seo-Won, now an adult, is about to leave the mansion when Do-Gyeom returns and offers him a role as his pheromone partner.

(Source: Lezhin US)

I'm returning to college, and I'm in dire need of a girlfriend, but I have no experience with women. Can anyone give me some lessons?

(Source: Toomics)

Enya and Tarhan are forever bonded once Enya helps Tarhan's family find peace after a tragic accident. However, their bond is challenged when Tarhan goes from a distrusted outsider to the strong and popular vice chief of Agilea. In a society where a healthy body is considered one's greatest asset, Enya is treated with scorn because of her limp. On top of that, her place as Tarhan's lover is threatened when the princess of an ally tribe offers a marriage alliance in times of impending war. Will Enya and Tarhan's love prevail despite the numerous obstacles in their rocky path?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Five years ago, academy teacher Song Yeo-Dan looked out for troubled student Yun Jae-Won. But when Jae-Won began mistaking that concern for something more, Yeo-Dan knew he had to draw a firm line. Now, Jae-Won is back, and he's older, sharper, and more relentless than ever. As time goes by, Yeo-Dan can no longer ignore how much has changed. The boy who once trailed after him like a shadow now stands before him as a man, and Yeo-Dan isn't quite sure how long he can keep denying the spark.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Freelance photographer Felix accidentally walks into the wrong hotel room and meets Uriel, who mistakes him for a hired companion. After a chaotic misunderstanding, they become strangely connected. Felix starts having drowning nightmares and, as he investigates, discovers unsettling truths about Uriel and the origin of his dreams, pulling him into a web of mystery and danger.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hee-Jin Yoon, former crown prince and current king of Yeon, seems to have everything. While he can no longer claim the imperial throne, he can’t be robbed of the achievements that brought him there. If he has any regrets, it is that he left his fiancée behind, never to be seen again. Ordered to wed, he quickly finds he has more questions than answers. Why marry now? Who ordered his wife to assassinate him? Why does she seem so familiar? And what happened to her memory?

(Source: Tapas)

Despite his terrible luck in life, Ted was a top livestreaming musketeer in the fully immersive VR game, "Face Chronicle." But his bad luck made him stumble upon a conspiracy where major guilds were illegally taming boss monsters to get ahead. They were far from happy when Ted threatened to expose them, so they coerced him into deleting his game character, which forced him to start over. Can Ted turn his luck around by starting all over from level one? Or will his bad luck ruin his last shot?

(Source: Tapas)

Lucien, the notorious eldest son of House Hevonshire, is suddenly forced into a political marriage after years of scandalous behavior disgrace his family. On the eve of the wedding, he indulges in one last night of excess and accepts a drink from a mysterious stranger. Soon after, Lucien loses control of his body and is claimed by a man whose intentions seem anything but coincidental. When morning comes, Lucien is left with fragmented memories, a lingering presence, and the unsettling realization that someone has been waiting for him far longer than he ever knew.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Leveling Up in an Exclusive Dungeon
description:
Guilds are there to protect hunters, right? Right...? Nope. All they seem to protect is their own interests. As they monopolize hunting grounds, the monsters, and even the XP points, Jinhyeok, our MC and a hunter without guild affiliation, is left bouncing from one part-time job to another just to scrape by. What he needs is an opening. A shot. A crack in the system. Then the universe provides one. In his attic. What?! 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

The powerful Duke Reynal von Fenicaesar is known as the empire’s hero and the Emperor’s right hand, but his greatest secret is that he was born with both male and female reproductive organs! Under the guise of a sabbatical, he attempts to fulfill his desire to conceive his own heir. However, this proves to be more difficult than expected as ordinary seed isn't enough to impregnate him. Reynal searches for a man with superior seed to father his child, but is the perfect partner closer than he realizes? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.*

Tae-Jin lived much of his youth as an idol trainee, and there was only one person he could trust: his actor boyfriend, Hae-Kyeong. But if comparison is the thief of joy, then Tae-Jin was robbed blind, as Hae-Kyeong couldn’t go a day without comparing Tae-Jin to his former lover. Years later, after Tae-Jin and Hae-Kyeong have broken up, the former is finally set to make his debut… There’s just one problem: Jae-Rim, the ex of Tae-Jin’s ex, is their new center star! As the two step into the spotlight together, they soon become embroiled in a rumor that the two of them have beef; while Jae-Rim claims that it’s all Tae-Jin’s fault, Tae-Jin claims it’s just one big misunderstanding. To resolve the feud and save their group, the two are forced to take extraordinary measures and engage in some not-so-idol behavior...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Eun-Seom is the transfer student everyone is talking about. With his striking blonde hair and the dangerous rumors that follow him, he’s impossible to miss. But Iseo, with a gentle nature, doesn’t judge people by their looks or rumors, and finds Eun-Seom rather interesting. When they are assigned seats next to each other, Iseo tries to be friendly, but Eun-Seom remains on high alert. However, between shared desks and stolen glances, a quiet bond begins to form.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Freshman Ji Yulmu looks like the ultimate bookworm: thick glasses, baggy clothes, and a quiet, studious vibe. But inside her little green notebook? Nothing but filthy fantasies and kinky stories she’d never dare say out loud. That is, until her campus crush, upperclassman Jeong Wook, finds it. Instead of judging her, he’s thrilled, and he wants to “talk” about her writing. Now Yulmu is getting dragged into Wook’s mysterious X-Games club, where nothing is as innocent as it looks… and everyone, from Cha Ji-un to Seon Inhyeok, wants to play.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sung Nam-Gung can’t hold down a job, and he’s lost yet another one after injuring artist Min-Tae Kyeon during a routine package delivery. But Sung’s in luck—Min-Tae’s been looking for a new model, and Sung has the perfect combo of gloomy personality and chiseled body. As Sung spends night after night under the hands of Min-Tae, both their families begin to suspect the other’s motives. Will the artist and his muse be able to escape the destinies their families have laid out for them?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

Eleanor Mecklen was never more than a political pawn who married into the prestigious House Mecklen of the Barden Empire. Under the scrutiny of her mother-in-law, Duchess Carolyn, Eleanor endured endless humiliation. But when Carolyn meets an untimely death, Eleanor is accused of murder and sent to the executioner’s block. But death does not claim her. Instead, she reawakens at House Mecklen. Armed with the knowledge of what’s to come, Eleanor has a second chance to seize her fate.

(Source: Tapas)

A legendary martial artist, after countless reincarnations, awakens in the body of Jin-Ho Seok, the neglected bastard of a powerful merchant family. Once downtrodden and suicidal, Jin-Ho transforms into an unstoppable force, stunning his family with unmatched martial arts skill. As his reputation soars, Jin-Ho’s newfound strength sets him on a path to reshape his destiny and claim his place in a world that once cast him aside.

(Source: Tapas)

Yoon is a broke student working tirelessly to turn his life around and get through medical school. Though they're estranged, Yoon can’t look away when his father’s debts catch up to him. In exchange for his father’s life, Yoon agrees to work for the gang after he graduates, losing all freedom outside of his classes. With all that time together, Yoon can’t help but get to know Tae-Beom. And he hates to admit it, but the attraction he feels for the boss might go beyond just pheromones… 

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: The Dungeon Raid is Just a Side Quest
description:
Isca is a promiscuous dark wizard who scrapes by doing guild quests. In a dungeon, he meets Sian, a beautiful priest hiding his looks, and Khalit, a demon prince seeking his lost powers.

Sparks fly, jealousy brews, and an accidental quest to save their world begins!

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The Fake Saintess bears Tainted Robes
description:
Alicia Sorcelion is a Noble Lady of the Empire, whose only sin was believing in love. When a doctored prophecy matches her likeness, Prelate Libenthius, a religious leader of the Empire's Central Pantheon, conspires to take advantage of Alicia, puppeting her as the "Saintess" of the empire and betrothing her to the Crown Prince, Viktor Lawrence. 

While she is praised by the masses,she conceals her apparent lack of divine power, and lives a secluded and lonely life, only finding solace in her love for Viktor, who she believes to reciprocate her feelings. After ViKtor becomes Emperor, he reveals that he too was using her as a pawn in his ambitious plans, and with the appearance of a new "True Saintess" appears, Alicia is branded as a traitor and "False Saintess" in the eyes of the public, eventually sentenced to burn at the stake as a witch and traitor of the Empire. 

Given another chance at life from the heavens, she opens her eyes in the past, with evidence of living a tragic future branded on her. Determined to avoid the prophecy at all costs, she aims to become a religious servant of the Empire, immune to the prophecy and the influence of her traitors. However her journey is not so easy, as her fate is tangled with a helping Cleric, Edwin, and her past tormentors continue to enact their conspiracy from her past future. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

As his strongest knight, Lindelle helped the emperor ascend the throne. But at his coronation, she coughs up blood–a side effect of her contract with the dragon Laroque, who promised to grant Lindelle any wish if she can find the dragon’s real body. Meanwhile, Laroque’s magic is destroying Lindelle’s body, and the only way to heal is to fulfill the contract. But the emperor’s word is law–and he says Lindelle can’t leave until he finds a cure! 

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Hector’s renowned father, a celebrated sculptor, dies just before unveiling his magnum opus - Minor: David. While reviewing his late father's estate, Hector stumbles upon a mysterious villa - inside, he finds a young man named Enoch...someone he's never seen nor even heard of. The moment Hector lays eyes on him, he realizes that Enoch was the very muse for his father's masterpiece. Driven to madness, Enoch must escape his grasp through a mad game of hide and seek, or face the beast that lies within the nature of man. 

(Source: Lezhin)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's SS Short Story Collection (SS 단편선) or the Depraved Collection in english.*

After a hit VR dating sim takes the world by storm, a game company rushes to develop its adult-only follow-up. When the original tester falls ill, Jung Soohyun steps in—only for Kim Dowon to accidentally log in on the same account, triggering a system error that traps them both in the game. The only way out? Raise Dowon’s Affection to 100%. But according to the strategy guide, the most effective method is… sexual touching. Things get complicated after they sleep together, and just as tensions rise, a new romanceable character—Lee Jaehee—appears. Now Soohyun has to choose a path to escape—but who will he clear the game with? *(Source: Lezhin US)*

---

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/target)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://www.lezhinus.com/en/comic/romanced_him), [Japanese](https://www.beltoon.jp/detail/target), [French](https://www.lezhinfr.com/detail/bt_1111223), [T.Chinese](https://www.bomtoon.tw/detail/target)

##### Note: All official translations are uncensored, except for Japanese.

In a world where yokai once clashed with gods and humans, Joo Hwang, a 22-year-old with no skills except seeing ghosts, lands a job at Oddity Office. Tasked with reviewing souls for reincarnation, she soon learns the spirit world is far stranger than she imagined.

(Source: Toomics)

When Amelia is about to die in the hands of her master, her desire to survive manifests into magic, sending her back 5 years into the past. Now a maker of magical goods after killing her master, the fugitive wizard finds her talent garnering the unwanted attention of scouts — and even the king.

(Source: Manta)

A fateful rescue binds bookstore clerk Liel to Iuppiter — but Liel isn’t who Iuppiter thinks. As undercover agent Kashal Platt, his mission is to take down Iuppiter’s father’s crime syndicate. So when Iuppiter pursues him with love, Kashal sees a chance to get closer to his target. Can he achieve his goal in the next 24 hours?

(Source: Manta)

After years of being cooped up at home, Ah-Yeong finally lands a job as a café manager—thanks to a friend—and moves into her first apartment. Wanting to be a friendly neighbor, she brings cookies to the guy next door… only to discover he’s none other than Wujin, the student she used to tutor ten years ago! What starts as a casual reunion soon turns into regular dinners and cozy evenings together. But one night, while Ah-Yeong is distracted prepping dinner, Wujin accidentally knocks over a box—and out rolls a very intimate gift from her friend: a dildo. Mortified, Ah-Yeong scrambles to hide it, but Wujin just smiles and says,

*“As your former student, I feel it’s only right I help out.”*

Excuse me?! When did this shy little student grow up—and how did this become that kind of tutoring? This definitely wasn’t in the lesson plan…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Violetta, striving to support her sister after losing their parents, encounters Theobald, an enigmatic aristocrat who irrevocably alters her life. Taking on the role as Theobald's maid, Violetta navigates treacherous waters filled with political intrigue and forbidden desires. As Violetta and Theobald's relationship deepens amidst a backdrop of betrayal and manipulation, Violetta grapples with her conflicting loyalties and the moral ambiguity of her role as both confidante and pawn in a dangerous game.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Asil, a poor noble, enters the academy as the top student, determined to restore his family’s honor. Instead, he becomes the target of relentless bullying. Seeking justice, he confronts Valery, only to face an even harsher fate. Reduced to Valery’s pawn and isolated from everyone, Asil searches desperately for a way out. But Valery’s growing obsession only tightens the chains around him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

The legendary con artist in the pleasure city of Ardel, Sue Rolanne, is hired by an aloof duke to pull off the ultimate grift: deceive the king. To infiltrate high society, the pair stage a sham marriage and what began as a “contract couple” turns into a high-stakes, kingdom-wide con.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Gangster Joo-Geon Kang, aka “Black Kite,” gets more than he bargained for when he shows up at Jae-Joon Min’s clinic looking for a certain intimate surgery at his boss’s request! Unable to resist this intimidating guy and his excellent manhood, Jae-Joon gets himself into trouble after a few nights of bliss and has to get out of town fast. He’s on the hunt for the father who abandoned his mother at her time of need. But Black Kite isn’t going to let him get away that easily. Better watch out, Doc!

(Source: Tapas)

In a world where interdimensional gates unleash monstrous threats, a rare few are born with extraordinary powers. These gifted individuals are known as Espers and Guides. Choi Kyuhyuk is officially classified as an S-class Esper, but there’s a catch. His self-regeneration ability is so weak that he's been downgraded to S-minus. People call him a “half-baked” Esper, and the name has stuck ever since. After sustaining a serious injury, he has been reassigned to a desk job in the Guide Line Department, where he now trains rookie Guides. Life was relatively peaceful until one very specific problem arrived. Yeon Soo-Jung, a Guide Kyuhyuk once saved as a child and treats like family, has just come of age. And now, he wants to initiate a sex guiding session with Kyuhyuk. Worse still, Soojung makes his intent painfully clear:

 *“Just sleep with me once. Let me give you the sex guiding, please.”*

Sure, guiding is essential for Espers to stabilize their powers. But the idea of doing it with him sends Kyuhyuk into full panic mode. 

 *“Wait, Soo-Jung. I'm really not mentally prepared for this yet...”

“But sir, your erection says otherwise.”*

Caught between professional ethics and personal chaos, Kyuhyuk now faces the most awkward guiding session of his life. And it’s with the one person he never expected.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes four side story chapters.*

Neris is forced into an engagement by her father, but when she arrives at the Duke’s estate, her sister is already there, demanding the Duke for herself. As the Duke shows interest in Neris, she discovers her sister has returned from the past, determined to take everything—including her fiancé.

(Source: Manta)

Welcome to Hoseon: The land of myths and spirits, where monsters take human form and exorcists come with assault rifles! For wandering spirit hunter Gal Park, sniffing out and dispatching disgruntled monsters and spirits is all part of the job – no matter if they prey on the wicked or the innocent alike. But everything becomes a little more complicated when he crosses paths with his former comrades at the Bureau of Exorcists. Not to mention, there’s something afoot in the Dragon King’s Underwater Palace, and a mysterious red-haired girl who can see right through spirits in disguise…

(Source: WEBTOON)

When the going gets tough, the tough get going. But what if sooner or later, we hit a ceiling and can’t soar any higher? For Ho-Ji Park, a young sports climber with grand ambitions, it’s difficult to accept that our limitations are set in stone. When her mother passes away from a tragic accident, Ho-Ji begins to see a literal manifestation of her limits in the form of a dark barrier across the sky. Years later, together with former climbing idol A-Seong Chae, Ho-Ji begins the ultimate climb of all– the ascent past all limitations.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

*“You don’t know how long I’ve waited, Danny…all while staring at this name on my arm.”* 

After moving to the small town of Edendale with his son, single father Danny begins to be frequently visited by Stan. After the visits become more and more unnerving, Danny begs Stan to stop - to no avail. Claiming the two are fated to be together, Stan will do whatever it takes to fulfill his destiny…come hell or high water. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Estella Ignacio has blossomed into a beautiful and alluring young woman, something all too apparent to Matias Monsetrat, the man Estella has been secretly in love with since they were young. But before they can even tell each other their true feelings, their bodies become more honest than their minds. As they both give in to their carnal desires, they are plagued with doubts and insecurities about losing each other. Will their love end in a nightmare or a dream come true?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Geumdan Danpyeonseon (금단(禁斷) 단편선) Collection.*

The Avians are said to be descendants of a great and powerful flying beast. Unfortunately, the gifts bestowed upon the Avians have regularly put them at war with the human empire. When a failed attack on the palace leaves the hybrid Vio in captivity, he meets Lou, the illegitimate princess of the empire. Can these two "half-breeds" bridge the gap between their species?

(Source: Tapas)

The bewitching wife of my former classmate, and her daughter who is growing more and more into a mature woman... Yeong-Jin starts to work as a private tutor at his high school friend Darren's house. Upon finding out about the secrets of the mansion, he starts an uncontrollable relationship with the ladies of the mansion.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

When graduate student Jeyeon arrives at Linderk Castle, she expects to uncover hidden masterpieces — not visions of ruin or the dangerously alluring Count Einbern. He holds the key to these treasures, but his lingering gaze and cutting words threaten to unravel everything — starting with her.

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes a prologue.*

At forty, Jeong Han-Seong finally begins the college life he’s dreamed of, enrolling as a nontraditional student after years in the corporate world. Mistaken for a professor by his much younger classmates, he struggles to find his place, until a helpful senior, Baek Cheong-Bin, steps in. With Cheong-Bin’s guidance, campus life starts to feel less overwhelming… but there’s something about the way this senior looks at him that feels anything but ordinary.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: In the Shadow of the Serpent
description:
In a world where malevolent spirits roam freely, Jeong Wol has spent his entire life pretending not to see them. Having witnessed countless evil entities since childhood, he believes that ignoring the supernatural is the only way to survive. That fragile resolve shatters when he becomes entangled in a mission led by the Disaster Squad and loses his life in the process. Or so he believes.Jeong Wol awakens to find himself alive once more, bound by a mysterious pact with Sa Hyeon, a black serpent whose presence radiates both danger and allure. Granted immortality in exchange for an unknown price, he is forced to confront the very world he tried so desperately to deny. 

Is this second life a blessing that spared him from death, or a curse that will drag him deeper into the serpent’s shadow? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eden City—a place where all the world's pleasures converge. Using her deceased twin's diary, Sarin searches the city for a certain man. During her search she encounters Owen, the king who rules over Eden City. Despite his oppressive demeanor and scrutinizing gaze, Sarin chooses to stay by his side. However, Sarin herself is hiding a secret...

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Bound by Duty, Torn by Pride
description:
Falsely accused through a shadowy adversary’s deliberate scheme, Dominic, the patriarch of house Winters, faces the imminent downfall of his entire family. As he struggles to find a way to save his family name, a secretive and highly dangerous proposal is made—one that demands his body as collateral...

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.*

No matter how great her date may be, Rajung's love could never coexist with their body hair. The passion and excitement of a new relationship died instantly when she saw "hair": a hairy chest, hairy legs, the five o'clock shadow, etc. It's like losing your appetite when you find hair in your food; it doesn't matter how good the dish is or if it's to your taste. At this rate, there's a good chance Rajung will die without ever seeing a man's penis, let alone having sex. Then her best guy friend, without batting an eye, said to her:

*"Guess I should pluck all my pubic hair and show you mine."*

(Source: Lezhin US)

I-Jun ended things with his ex, Ha-eon, believing he was only after money. Two years later, Ha-eon reappears, broken and desperate, begging for another chance. Unable to resist his pretty face and body, I-Jun agrees to meet every Wednesday, but their encounters quickly become more complicated. Doubts and old wounds resurface, leaving I-Jun to wonder—can their toxic bond ever heal, or is it doomed to repeat itself?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Secret of the Lovely Duchess
description:
After seven years trapped in the Devil Grand Duke’s dungeon, Luculia is finally free, but her savior is not the prince she imagined. Davierre Montefeltro, a temperamental duke, unexpectedly takes her in. As Luculia adjusts to life outside the dungeon, mysteries swirl around Duke Davierre’s intentions. Can Luculia find happiness at last, or is this new life just another dungeon?

(Source: Tapas)

Roelle Chloe has never been able to feel emotions. Even during her past life, living as an outcast in the back alleys of the capital, the empire's most hated mage didn't shed a single tear. And dying at the hands of her father didn't improve her inability to feel empathy. But after being given a second chance at life after death, Roelle realizes that she might be able to use her magical gifts to change her bitter fate. From friendship to romance, and even family... Can Roelle use her blood magic for good while learning to love and be loved? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: I Thought I Was the Real Daughter
description:
Selena's whole world is turned upside down when Sienna, the daughter of a maid, suddenly claims that she's the real daughter of Count Estarion. Sienna remembers everything about Selena's childhood, making everyone believe that she's the real daughter. Her once supportive brother and father, who are everything to her, turn cold and kick her out of the house. Even her close friend and fiance turn their backs on her. With nowhere to go, she is saved by the only person who treats with her kindness, Eideun Calypso, a war hero who was once a lowly slave. He asks Selena to be his private tutor and teach him high society etiquette. Why is Eideun being so generous to her? Will Selena be able to find out the truth about her identity? Will she take revenge on those who betrayed her trust?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

Despite his ordinary skills, Sir Shake, captain of the guard, dedicates his life to defeating the demons and bringing about an era of peace with the immortal swordmasters. However, when Shake finally succeeds and also becomes a swordmaster, he dies, only to reincarnate 20 years later as Asher. He's shocked to find that his comrades have vanished and demons are rumored to have returned. In the midst of all this chaos, can Asher find his former allies and vanquish the enemy for good? 

(Source: Tapas)

In a world divided into three realms, the floating islands of Paradise, the surface of Eden, and the subterranean depths of Proserpina, Meove clings to a single hope: escaping to the sky with Haluk. Their love is the only light in the dark, but it is quickly extinguished when a sudden revolution tears through the underground. In the blink of an eye, the life they knew is gone, leaving Meove to navigate a treacherous new destiny where Paradise feels further away than ever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Demia Lawrence, the daughter of a fallen baron, secretly marries her childhood friend Dyrtehen Romerby. But contrary to her expectations, her married life is filled with mental abuse from Dyrtehen and physical abuse from her mother-in-law. She becomes increasingly overdependent on Dyrtehen who, almost right after the wedding, leaves for the capital for business and doesn’t return for five years. Meanwhile, Demia discovers that her mother-in-law is plotting to assassinate her and flees from the Romerby House. After much hardship, she arrives at Evan Hasworth’s house, another childhood friend. But Evan, once a sweet boy, has grown to be a mature man seemingly hostile to her for reasons unknown…

Will Demia successfully escape the claws of Romerby and resolve the misunderstandings with Evan?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

Beom-Yeol has spent every Christmas alone, a shy virgin whose only thrill is secretly admiring Jun Sang, the tough gangster who protects his little shop. And this year is no different...or so he thinks. While indulging in a slightly too vivid fantasy about Jun Sang, Beom-Yeol suddenly comes face to face with a strange creature he has never seen before. The being introduces himself as Ddobomi No. 8291, also known as ""the God of Lust"", and claims he has come to help Beom-Yeol with his tragic lack of a love life. His gift? A pair of Bluetooth underwear that links Beom-Yeol’s senses directly to the most intimate parts of whoever he touches. With this outrageous invention and a long standing crush inches away, Beom-Yeol might finally escape his lonely Christmas curse. 

The real question is… will he survive the experience?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Kim Yu-Jun never imagined his longtime coworker - and secret crush - Kim Jeong-Hyeon would suddenly confess that he’s fallen for a man. Shocked and unsure how to react, Yu-Jun is even more taken aback when Jeong-Hyeon asks him to be his “practice partner” for dating. What begins as a harmless experiment soon grows complicated as their everyday moments blur the line between acting and feeling. In the soft rhythm of shared glances and after-hours conversations, Yu-Jun starts to wonder if he’s the only one pretending. Sometimes, love arrives quietly like two clock hands brushing past each other, almost in sync.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jihan is a sincere gentleman who wants nothing else than to help those around him. So when Soonae needs somewhere to crash, he decides to be a good samaritan and let her stay at his house. But don't worry - Soonae is more than willing to repay the favor...

(Source: Lezhin US)

An Suha and Chanyeong have been friends since childhood. However, An Suha's feelings have long transitioned from their simple platonic friendship. An Suha feels an immense attraction to Chanyeong's hands and, as an adult he's reached a point where he has been secretly pleasuring himself using Chanyeong's hands while he sleeps.

In a world where Omegas are almost nonexistent, childhood friends Jun-Hyeok and Hyeon-Ho are both labeled Alphas. But as they grow closer in their final year of high school, Jun-Hyeok begins reacting to Hyeon-Ho’s pheromones in ways that shouldn’t be possible. As confusion turns into longing, the two must navigate feelings that defy instinct, classification, and everything they’ve been taught about love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After being dumped by his boyfriend of 10 years, Jooyeong starts fresh at the only place that will hire him: a failing academy full of flunking students. When the director asks him to go on a show called "The King of Home Cooking" and promote the academy, Jooyeong dutifully agrees. What he doesn't expect is to run into Jonghan, the show's producer and his high school classmate who was much more than a friend. Their chance encounter sparks a heated fling behind the scenes, but all the while, the unresolved tension between them lingers like a ghost from the past... 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Unseon Kang’s master has been killed before his very eyes – and now he is the only one alive who knows the secrets that his master wrote about. Anyone he meets could be an enemy who will stop at nothing to gain those secrets. Now he must try to navigate a world in which he can trust nobody while trying to obtain martial arts skills that will help him grow stronger. Will he be able to keep his secrets out of enemy hands and avenge his master’s death?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Reclusive and withdrawn, Tae-jeong has spent years shut away from the world, surviving in the quiet suffocation of his own room. But when his father is suddenly hospitalized due to a car accident, even that fragile isolation begins to crumble. Grief and fear twist together inside him, leaving only one outlet, an uneasy rush of desire that both calms and consumes him. 

Enter Eun-won, the golden boy who has everything Tae-jeong doesn’t: confidence, charm, a life untouched by loneliness. He looks at Tae-jeong with disdain, pity, and something darker, an attraction he refuses to name. As the line between disgust and desire blurs, both are drawn into a dangerous intimacy born from guilt, curiosity, and longing. 

What begins as comfort becomes compulsion, and behind locked doors, Tae-jeong and Eun-won learn that even the most broken hearts can crave, and destroy, in the same breath.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Tender-hearted Jerenia is married to the most uncaring and disrespectful husband, Vincent Mercier. Her in-laws undermine and abuse her daily, but Jerenia believes that if she bears a child, she could be respected as part of the dukedom. After trying for seven years, she finally conceives a child, only to find out that Vincent's been cheating on her with her childhood friend, Erica. Vincent conspires to kill his wife, but surviving the murder attempt has turned Jerenia into a woman of vengeance.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

Jae-Ui and Mu-Yeong, used to be in the same club but grew apart until they unexpectedly crossed paths nearly ten years after graduation. During their college days, Mu-Yeong had always admired his senior, Jae-Ui, harboring feelings that went unnoticed. Now, as adults, Mu-Yeong is excited to reconnect and warmly approaches Jae-Ui. However, Jae-Ui doesn’t share the same enthusiasm. Instead of welcoming their reunion, he seems distant and reluctant to engage in conversation. Despite Jae-Ui’s cold demeanor, Mu-Yeong persistently tries to bridge the gap between them. But as their interactions continue, Jae-Ui reveals a deeply personal and painful secret, one that explains his reluctance to reconnect. As the past resurfaces and hidden emotions come to light, their relationship takes an unexpected turn, leaving Mu-Yeong to question whether some distances are truly impossible to overcome.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's SS Short Story Collection (SS 단편선) or the Depraved Collection in English.*

display_title: I Swallowed the Martial Arts Villain
description:
Forty years ago, monster-filled towers appeared, unleashing chaos across the world. Heroes, empowered by spirits, rose to combat the beasts. Jae-Ha Min, a soldier turned civilian investigator, dreams of becoming one of these heroes despite his low aptitude. Everything changes when he accidentally bonds with the spirit of the Heavenly Demon. Now with a powerful mentor inside him, Jae-Ha embarks on a journey to master his newfound abilities and help the demon return home.

(Source: Tapas)

San once found comfort in Hee-Min’s kindness. Years later, he confesses the love he has kept hidden, not to win Hee-Min over but to finally walk away with closure. To his surprise, Hee-Min accepts his feelings without hesitation. Struggling to trust something that feels too easy, San finds himself torn between doubt and longing. He yearns for a kind of love he has never learned how to receive. A tender and tangled love begins between a black-haired beast still learning how to be human, and the man who never turned him away.

(Source: Lezhin US)

24-year-old web novel writer Yeong Won isn’t interested in love, but she can’t help admiring her roommate’s handsome boyfriend, Mu-Il Shin. But Mu-Il suddenly dies, and Yeong receives a mysterious package containing a robot vacuum. The vacuum introduces itself as an AI copy of Mu-Il, and claims that he was murdered. Now, Yeong must navigate life with a digital version of the one man she couldn’t resist, as she’s pulled into a mystery far stranger and more personal than any of her novels.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Heavy are the shoulders that bear the burden of a household. To keep his waning clan afloat, leader Mujin Baek has no choice but to leave his homeland and venture out into the martial arts realm. When he passes the entrance exam of the Northern Sky Union with flying colors—leaving behind one unconscious opponent in the process—Mujin soon finds that the realm is not the noble place he once envisioned. With his powerful frost-style qi, however, he sets out to make a chilling mark amidst the fiery maelstrom engulfing the realm.

(Source: WEBTOON)

When Jae-Jeong Sin’s dad rents out part of their house, he loses his favorite room, and gains a grudge. The tenants? A single mom and her daughter, A-Rin Woo. Things spiral when Jae-Jeong discovers their parents are having an affair. And, turns out, A-Rin just learned about their affair too. Bound by this dirty secret, Jae-Jeong and A-Rin grow closer, even as resentment simmers. As secrets pile up and tensions rise at school, the two form a dangerous pact: if their parents won’t stop the affair, they will.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

display_title: No Mercy from the Reborn Lady
description:
Cassia Hall's life shatters when her brother's lover—her best friend—betrays her. In a twist of fate, she returns to the past and vows revenge, but keeping her brother from falling in love with the villainess proves difficult. As hope fades, an unexpected hero arrives: Grand Duke Cain, who was executed for treason in her past life. As she uncovers the truth about their intertwined fates, Cassia realizes he may be the key to altering her destiny.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/64335106), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%ED%9A%8C%EA%B7%80%ED%95%9C-%EC%98%81%EC%95%A0%EC%97%90%EA%B2%8C-%EC%9A%A9%EC%84%9C%EB%9E%80-%EC%97%86%EC%8A%B5%EB%8B%88%EB%8B%A4/4124)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://tapas.io/series/no-mercy-from-the-reborn-lady/info), [Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=S156181)

display_title: The Portrait of the Late Prince
description:
Ten years ago, Ines was commissioned to paint the portrait of the wayward prince of Vertone Kingdom. Fast forward to present day, Ines is taken prisoner by Nathan, leader of the revolutionary party, who demands that she draw a portrait of this elusive prince as she remembers him. As Ines protests, the tension between them escalates and Nathan desires more than just a painting from her.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Best friends for 17 years, Yeoreum and Noeul always kept things platonic—despite Noeul’s not-so-secret crush. But one impulsive birthday wish crosses a line they can’t uncross. Now Noeul’s acting like nothing happened, while Yeoreum is slowly losing it. Can their friendship survive the fallout, or is this the summer that changes everything?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ronaldine is an ambitious woman. When she finds herself as an orphan in a novel she once read, she decides to use her knowledge from the real world to become the best secretary anyone could ever have. Little did she know that her skills would take her all the way to the royal palace--where she becomes the tyrant emperor's personal secretary. Ronaldine fears for her life and wishes to quit her job, but it seems that she is the only person who can calm down the emperor from going on a murderous rampage. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

display_title: The Maid No Longer Desires her Master
description:
Lynn has never had an easy life. A beautiful girl with pale silver hair resembling that of the Empire's princess, she is sold to work in the Dukedom of Ereuputh. Elizabeth, the duke's daughter, harbors jealousy towards the princess and takes pleasure in causing Lynn to suffer. Despite enduring in silence, Lynn's life takes a turn when Martin, the young master of the dukedom, returns. He shows her kindness and she falls for him, knowing that it will only lead to heartbreak. Unable to resist, Lynn shares a passionate night with him, unaware that Martin is not the kind boy she used to know. For he's had a taste of her, and he will never let her go... 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

Orphaned at a young age, Estelle Serenity couldn't have made it without her childhood friend Rickert. People say there's no such thing as platonic relationships between a young man and a woman, but Estelle truly believes their sacred friendship will last forever... that is until one night at the masquerade, Estelle hooks up with a charming stranger. When she wakes up the next day in bed with none other than Rickert, Estelle must decide whether she'll protect her friendship or give this new thing a try... But Rickert seems to have other ideas, like a wolf drooling after a clueless ewe...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hae-soo used to be a reporter for the City Department, who read a proper life and enjoyed helping those in need through his articles. That is…until he was transferred to the Entertainment Department and became the worst performing reporter there. As he felt more and more desperate to come up with a good story, his former colleague hooked him up with the tickets to an after party, where he met the hottest celebrity, Kang Min-woo. During the party Min-woo takes interest in Hae-soo and makes him an interesting proposition that could potentially benefit the both of them. However as Hae-soo begins to help Min-woo and go along with his plans, he can’t help but feel that Min-woo wants more than just an acting partner. Hae-soo can’t turn Min-woo down because he needs the scoop! What does Min-woo want with Hae-soo? How will Hae-soo protect his life between his crumbling job and his shady informant?

Woof! Life sure has gotten tough for Ho-San...but just when he's about to end it all, his savior comes knocking. When his fluffy-eared, tail-wagging guest offers the answer to all of his problems, all Ho-San needs to do is say yes...to the dress?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jin Yeong-Won, an unregistered special forces sergeant, has deliberately avoided using his abilities as a Sentinel for years. But when his hidden power is exposed, he is forcibly transferred into a classified unit where Sentinels are weapons, not choices. There, Yeong-Won meets Captain Myeong Hae-Jun, an A-rank Guide assigned to stabilize him. From the start, Yeong-Won resists, haunted by the trauma of the day his powers first awakened. He refuses to fight as a Sentinel, believing that using his ability again will only drag him back into that nightmare. Command does not agree. Orders come down for Hae-Jun to deploy Yeong-Won into active combat, regardless of his condition. Then one night, air raid sirens pierce the base. As explosions echo overhead, Yeong-Won is thrown back seven years, forced to relive the moment that broke him. 

With danger closing in and trust still unformed, both men must decide whether survival is possible without confronting the past head-on. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's Gunbu Danpyeonseon (군부 단편선) Collection.*

For her lover of 10 years, belle of the ball Julia Rapiere played the part of a sheltered flower in a greenhouse. That is, until he betrayed her by having an affair with her trusted maid. Bent on revenge, Julia reveals her true colors, and the demure flower transforms into a fearsome monster.

(Source: Manta)

Everyone on campus knows the rich and handsome Jung Woo-Jin, so when a guy like that offers to buy him a meal, Kang Seo-Ju agrees immediately and that might have been the biggest mistake of his life. When Seo-Ju regains consciousness, he finds himself stranded on a deserted island with just Woo-Jin, unsure of how much time has passed. Woo-Jin confesses to being hopelessly in love with him and is determined to make Seo-Ju his, regardless of how Seo-Ju feels. But as their entanglement grows, Seo-Ju starts to wonder if this truly is their first time meeting. 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Han-Jun is the weakest hunter alive. While others wield powerful skills, he’s stuck with a useless copy-paste ability and mocked by everyone around him. Cursed during the Great Calamity, he has only five years left to live… but Han-Jun refuses to give up. When a chance discovery reveals his skill’s hidden potential, everything changes. As he rises through the ranks, a new calamity begins to stir. Time is running out, and Han-Jun may be the world’s last hope—an unlikely hero with a power no one saw coming.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Su-Bin’s love life? A total dumpster fire. Every guy he dates is just another disappointment, and even the fortune teller he goes to for advice tells him his love life is cursed. As a muscular bottom, Su-Bin has about 0% appeal to the tops in his area…and the men he does manage to date? Yep, trash. Every. Single. Time. And so, Su-Bin swears off dating for good…until his literal dream guy walks into his life. He’s hot, he’s charming, and he’s totally Su-Bin’s type. But can he really be trusted, or is he just another beautifully wrapped disaster?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes seven extra chapters.*

display_title: For the Princess Who Will Disappear
description:
You’re saying that I, a barmaid who grew up on the streets, might be the princess…?! After pawning off a necklace, Sasha finds herself embroiled in a game of politics and enters the Imperial Palace as the long-lost Princess Anastasia. The secretive romance between Sasha, a shrewd and daring back-alley-raised “princess,” and the stern Duke Lascan, fiancé to the missing princess who vows to stay by Sasha's side, unfolds!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

In a society where only alphas and omegas matter, beta Kim Min-Jun has spent his life being overlooked. Everything changes when elite alpha Bae Yu-Ri, desperate to escape his role, asks Min-Jun to act as his stand-in. What begins as a simple business arrangement slowly turns intoxicating, as Min-Jun discovers how it feels to be the one giving orders and Yu-Ri finds himself responding like the omega he always wished he could be. In a world with such strict social hierarchies, can they resist the pull of a desire that breaks every rule?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

Opposites attract, but can they handle the heat?

Guide Ye-Hyun must oversee the volatile Aesper, Hae-Sung, or face suspension after a drunken mishap. With Hae-Sung’s fiery temper and drug issues, their partnership is off to a rough start—but their synergy is unmatched. Can these polar opposites find common ground before everything falls apart?

(Source: Manta)

Eleanor, a baronet's daughter, is left raising her child alone after hearing of her lover Cassius’s death in the war. Unknown to her, Cassius survives by making a pact with a dragon and returns as a war hero. His sudden return upends her world, forcing them to confront hidden secrets and unresolved feelings. Together, they must navigate their complex past and an uncertain future, embarking on a journey of love, sacrifice, and resilience.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS) 

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

Hong Yoon is on the brink of death after a sudden motorcycle accident when he comes face to face with Lee Tae-Shin, a grim reaper from the underworld. Yoon pleads desperately for his life, but Tae-Shin responds with cold indifference—until he realizes that Yoon is the one person he once helped out of genuine compassion in a past encounter. Bound by that rare act of grace, Tae-Shin reluctantly postpones Yoon’s death. To justify this decision, Tae-Shin appoints Yoon as his temporary assistant. But the role comes with a heavy price: Yoon must regularly transfer yang energy to Tae-Shin through intimate physical contact. Though hesitant, Yoon agrees, knowing it's the only way to survive.

As the line between duty and desire blurs, both man and reaper are forced to confront their past, their bond, and the strange pull growing between them in the space between life and death.

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: Love is a Sport: Victory, Gold Hunters!
description:
Sun-Woo is an Olympic gold medalist and Korea’s pride in air shooting. He has everything under control until fencing rookie Seong-Han asks for a handshake to “borrow his winning energy.” After that, Seong-Han takes gold, and Sun-Woo crashes spectacularly. Convinced his energy was stolen, Sun-Woo confronts him, and Seong-Han claims there is only one way to return it. What begins as a heated rivalry between two athletes quickly turns into something far more dangerous. In the Olympic Village, competition is not the only thing raising the tension.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.*

*"You always wanted to run away. I'm giving you that chance."*

For Gyuyoung Han, a girl who lived her entire life destitute, meeting Ikseon Lee was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Soon.
