Gyuyoung came to rely more and more on Ikseon, the man who gave her everything and anything she wanted.-- Despite knowing full well that she shouldn't. Gyuyoung couldn't help herself... By the time she realized what was happening. Ikseon had already breached her innermost feelings.

*"Why? You Thinking of running away after paying off your debt?"*

Then he started to reveal his desire to keep her.

(Source: Netcomics)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Leon Winston, Captain of the Western Command's Domestic Intelligence Division in the Kingdom of Riphon, is both feared and revered. Known as the Vampire of Camden for his ruthless treatment of rebels, he strikes terror into both allies and enemies alike. But beneath his noble and elegant exterior lies a man consumed by a dark desire, one that burns as fiercely as his rage against the rebels. Sally Bristol, the unassuming maid in charge of the interrogation room, is the one who awakens this uncontrollable craving, fueled by the scent of her blood. And after a rebel spy mentions her name, Leon realizes he no longer has to suppress his violent desire for her. Will Sally be able to beg her way out of Leon's deathly grasp, or will she succumb to the bloodlust he can't resist?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Han Soo-Ah grew up with everything a girl could need. Or so she thought, until she realized she was no more than a tool at her father’s disposal. The best she could do for herself was live up to the expectations that sat heavy on her shoulders. She’s resigned herself to such a life, until a fateful encounter in a music store changes things forever. Will the man at the piano be able to restore what Soo-Ah doesn’t even know she has lost…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Baek Dam treats contract worker Yeon-Il like a chew toy: dumping work on him, humiliating him, even exposing his alcohol-related trauma in a drunken slip. So when Dam wakes up bound in an unfamiliar place, a dog collar locked around his neck and a bowl of kibble shoved in front of him, he realizes the leash has changed hands. Cornered by a cold, unreadable Yeon-Il, Dam is forced into the role of “Yeon-Il’s dog.” As control tightens, desire and resentment twist together, and suddenly the rules of dominance and control are no longer so clear.

(Source: Lezhin US)

I was a runaway orphan working three jobs to survive. I was always exhausted, but at least I had money. One day, I overheard some girls talking about Crown Princess Heine, a novel known for its risqué scenes. But before I could read it, I died! Soon, I transmigrated into the book as the villainess, Annette Ethelred. Annette is hated by everyone because she tried to kill Heine, but I'm not going down that route. I'm going to keep my head down, make money, and check out all the hot guys!

(Source: Tapas)

Emperor Carlos Afforny suffers from an awful curse that causes him to smell a foul stench from everything and everyone at all times. In a desperate attempt to break the ever-worsening curse, he summons Ersala, the apprentice of the Grand Witch, to the imperial palace. However, lacking experience, she fails to fully lift the curse leading to the stench vanishing for the emperor but only when Ersala is within his vicinity. Moreover, with Ersala being able to use magic only once a year, it seems she is tied to the emperor, almost quite literally, until she can attempt to lift the curse again.

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://www.tappytoon.com/en/book/fragrant-magician), [French](https://www.delitoon.com/detail/daf_1000793), [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/171438)

Orphaned at a young age, Yu Yoohui has always had the worst luck, even dying at a young age from a rare disease. But then, she awakens in the Joseon dynasty during the cruel reign of Lee Yoon, the most ruthless king in history. Now trapped in the body of a lowly servant, Yoohui is forced to serve the infamous tyrant, but nothing is as it seems within the palace, with secrets, lies, and dangerous desires running rampant. Can Yoohui survive the king's wrath and change the course of history, or will the bloody past consume her?

(Source: Lezhin US)

All Yeon-Woo wanted was to befriend the cute underclassman sitting next to him in class. But when his friendly gesture is met with an icy glare, he's left baffled. Things only get worse: elevator doors slammed in his face, sticky notes slapped on his back… What is this, elementary school?! Fed up with the childish pranks, Yeon-Woo decides he’s had enough. But just as tensions peak - bam! They're assigned to the same group project. And in the middle of Yeon-Woo’s fury...he suddenly bursts into tears?! What does this kid have against Yeon-Woo, and what will Yeon-Woo have to do to make things right?

(Source: Lezhin US)

At work, Na-Hee is a quiet woman who hates attracting attention. But at home, she posts selfies in lingerie on an anonymous app and enjoys the thirsty compliments she gets. Unfortunately, these two worlds clash when the new hire at work, Yi-Heon, finds out about Na-Hee's scandalous hobby. Claiming he can only get excited by looking at her naughty pics, he promises to keep her spicy secret if she continues posting them. Although he only acts pervy on the app and keeps things professional at the office, Na-Hee isn't sure if she can separate work from pleasure the same way...

(Source: Tappytoon)

From the outside, Taesung and Haeun look just like real siblings. They were certainly raised that way, living together in the same house since they were kids. But here’s the secret: they aren’t actually related. Haeun’s just been living with Taesung’s family since her parents went to live abroad, and that’s the way it’s been for the last 15 years. They’re basically real sister and brother at this point…until one day, Taesung comes to learn a prank from his friends. Grab a girl’s sides, and you can tell from her reaction what she really thinks of you. Taesung tries this out on Haeun that night, eager to see how she reacts…and accidentally ends up grabbing her boobs. Uh-oh. But just what is up with Haeun’s reaction? She’s blushing, squirming, not saying anything… Is this how you would normally act in front of your brother? Things come to light, and Taesung’s starting to look at his “sister” a little bit differently now…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Benjamin Barker, a special agent at the CBI, attempts to apprehend Ian Basti, the boss of a major crime syndicate, only to be overpowered and captured. As Ian's prisoner, Benjamin is subjected to countless forms of sexual torture and even abandoned by his fellow agents. Despite this, he decides to stay by Ian's side to learn more about the inner workings of the organization and their drug operations. Will Benjamin survive this ordeal, or will the mob boss's grasp suffocate his escape plans?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Koh Yang-Seo, the star center fielder for the Servals, always treated his junior teammate, Kang Ha-Joo, like a younger brother—until he discovered Ha-Joo’s secret: he’s gay. When Yang-Seo catches him using a dating app, he becomes overly protective, determined to keep an eye on his innocent junior. But his watchful eye leads to unexpected closeness: the same team, the same field, and now... the same bed?!

Wait a second. Something’s definitely off here...!

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Notes: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.*

*"I wish you were my boyfriend instead."*

After returning to college following his mandatory military service, Seong Junhui quickly becomes the center of attention on campus thanks to his good looks. Though he has no shortage of admirers, he finds himself tangled in a reckless affair with Suyeon, a bold and persistent girl who pursues him despite already having a boyfriend. But just as their secret meetings continue, someone new catches Junhui’s eye… Can these hidden rendezvous ever turn into something more? Or will they remain nothing more than fleeting moments of passion?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The tale of Princess Ines is a tragic one. Born a royal of the Zener Empire, she is reviled and neglected as a child born out of wedlock. To compound her misfortune, Ines is married off to Grand Duke Ryan of Eleanor, a renowned war hero of the Lezan Empire who fought against Zener. Ryan proves a stern and distant husband to Ines, and she soon determines that she must fight for a life of dignity – if not in Eleanor, then elsewhere. Thus begins a marriage of emotional reserve and regrets…

(Source: WEBTOON)

When Detective Yoon Yeoul tries to catch a groper on a crowded train, he instead nabs Jeon Tae-Heon, a prosecutor at the Seoul District Prosecutor's Office. After a rocky first meeting, they hope to never see each other again, but are then unexpectedly made the faces of a PR collaboration between the police and prosecutors. As they navigate their new roles, all kinds of tension flare between them. With sparks flying and their pride at stake, can Yeoul and Tae-Heon put aside their differences and unravel the mystery behind their puzzling new assignment?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A secret prison... A place for those who deserve it... or maybe not? Welcome to the detainment zone.

(Source: Toomics)

Chloe thought Luke's revenge was just, as her own father had killed his father. That is why when she is brought back to the past, she decides to accept her tragic fate. But suddenly and unexpectedly, Luke's most trusted Knight approaches her. 

 *"He won't be able to kill you, so escape as if you're dead."* 

She is convinced by Luke and decides to flee with him, thinking there will no longer be any obstacles as long as she fakes her own death, until... 

*"Your life belongs to me."* 

Chloe and Luke's paths cross again when they meet as the insomniac emperor and the pharmacist who concocts his sleeping pills. With a completely new identity, Chloe no longer looks the same, yet Luke is instinctively drawn to her. Will Chloe be able to escape death and become happy again? 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

display_title: How I Became an SSS Rank Delivery Hunter
description:
Seo Tae-Ja, a deliveryman for ‘Brother’s Noodle House,’ finds himself transported to another world—where he becomes the first-ever deliveryman in a land of magic and chaos!

(Source: Voyce)

Mun-Hak, the bassist of Earth Square, has always stayed away from fans, especially with his leader’s strict “no groupies” rule. But when a flirty fan named Jae-Hui catches his eye, Mun-Hak can't say no. What starts as a fleeting encounter soon spirals into a risky, passionate affair that could ruin everything.

(Source: Manta)

Kang Sungwoon, a debt-ridden college student, gets entangled with a dangerous man, Soh Bohmee, at his part-time job. When offered a high-paying job with a group of superhumans, Sungwoon accepts but becomes a target of a rival organization. As he flees their attacks, he and Bohmee cross paths again. 

(Source: Manta)

*"You will win this round if the male contestant cums."*

In-Ho gets invited to a dirty death game through a suspicious woman, Tae-Ri. Putting his life on the line as a wager, he enters the game with an enormous prize at stake. The do-or-die game begins!

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Lim Tak-Hee is a court lady who has remained by the crown prince’s side through sleepless nights since they were children. As time passes, familiarity turns into affection, and the two are now more intimate than ever. That is, until the crown prince meets his new wife. Tak-Hee becomes anxious as she watches the crown prince, who couldn’t sleep without her, treat the crown princess with kindness. What will happen when her anxiety turns into envy, and then obsession?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Bomtoon’s and Lezhin’s Saekgwi Danpyeonseon (색귀 단편선) Collection or Dirty Demon Collection in English.*

Choi Joo-Ha is a professional baseball player for the Hunters when his high school hoobae, Park Do-Jin, joins the team. The two spent their youth kissing, but didn't go any further than that. One day, Dojin drags Joo-Ha into a bathroom stall, lamenting how they never did more and is determined to make up for lost time. Will Ju-Ha be able to balance both his personal and professional life, or will Do-Jin's brash behavior shove them both into the public eye? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

On her first day of college, Ho-eun joins a campus club—only to find herself surrounded by charming, shamelessly bold upperclassmen. All she's asked to do is read a book out loud. It seems simple enough… until she realizes exactly what she's reading. Flustered and unsure how to react, Ho-eun is caught between embarrassment, confusion—and a strange thrill she can’t quite explain. The way they look at her, the way they tease her... it awakens something unfamiliar. She wants to run, but something holds her in place. After all, her graduation depends on this club. Will she manage to escape the clutches of her dangerously perverted sunbaes, or will she be pulled deeper into their twisted game?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.*

Zeus is reincarnated as a lowly human, Je-U. To go back to Olympus, he needs to conquer all the goddesses...

*"Just you wait. It's easy to make you mine once I set my mind to it!!"*

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

display_title: Love is a Sport: Hit Balance
description:
German tennis national coach Yuf Gnabry never expected to be charmed at the Olympics until he met South Korea’s rising star Son Rayeon. After a single practice match with her, Yuf is blown away by her familiar playstyle and her relentless pursuit of his attention. On the court, Rayeon is a prodigy, but off the court, she is a woman with a dangerous desire. One night, Yuf finds Rayeon waiting for him in front of his room with a mischievous smile. Can Yuf resist the rising star who refuses to take no for an answer?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.*

Go-Eun Lee is unlucky in love. She poured her money, heart, soul, and money (did we mention money?!) into her ex-boyfriend...who repaid Go-Eun by cheating on her. Despite the hurt, she decides to leave the past in the past. Now love is the last thing on her mind. But for CEO Woo-Hyuk Baek, Go-Eun is always the first thought on his mind. Now that she's single, it's his chance to make a move! As if work isn't hectic enough, why not throw a little romance into the mix?

(Source: Tapas)

Kail Black, a soldier stationed at an Antarctic research base, is assigned to support investigations into unexplained supernatural phenomena. But one morning, he wakes to a nightmare. The base has been overrun by monstrous organisms, and everyone is gone except for one man, Revo Keypling, who calmly introduces himself as a researcher. With no memory of what happened, Kail struggles to understand the disaster unfolding around them. But something even more disturbing begins to haunt him. Every night, he dreams of Revo, their bodies intertwined like wild animals, the visions so vivid that they leave him breathless when he wakes. And in those dreams, Revo always whispers the same chilling line, “Right here, this is where our baby will be born.” 

Trapped in an isolated base, surrounded by impossible creatures, Kail begins to wonder which is more dangerous, the things lurking outside, or the man smiling beside him with secrets of his own.

(Source: Lezhin US)

As the only daughter of Count Grave, Abella has been pampered and permitted to be as wild as she pleases. Now, she’s ready to channel her reckless charm into winning over Claude, her loyal but infuriatingly proper knight. With a glint in her eye and mischief on her tongue, Abella unleashes a series of salacious demands that are completely improper but undeniably tempting. Claude has always adhered to his lady's whims, so will her sultry orders finally unravel his sense of propriety?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Geumdan Danpyeonseon (금단(禁斷) 단편선) Collection.*

When portals to other worlds unleash monster-filled dungeons across Earth, humanity awakens to new supernatural powers. Meet Ash: an S-Class hero cursed with a truly massive gift. Blessed (or burdened) with a radiant, colossal holy member, Ash has become the ultimate solo player. After all, who could possibly handle him? Enter Roose: a mysterious villain with the power to nullify abilities…and apparently, the only one capable of taking Ash on (and in)! Ash’s holy sword is ready, but can he win Roose’s heart as well as save the day?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.*

display_title: Surviving as an SSS-Class Alternate Character
description:
It is the year 203X, and Junwoo is a pro at "Over the Fantasy," a virtual reality game. One of his secret strategies is to keep an alternate character for extra inventory space to store his main characters' shiny items. But one unlucky day, a server error traps him inside the game—and as Dio, the classless alternate character! The situation seems dire, but he has an inventory teeming with SSS-class items to help him survive in this fantasy world. They should be enough to keep him going... Right?

(Source: Tapas)

One fateful night, in a haze of alcohol, Woo-Jin finds himself in a passionate one-night stand with a mysterious man named Matteo. The next morning, he discovers a shocking truth—Matteo is training to become a priest! This holy man challenges Woo-Jin's guilty conscience, stirring up emotions that go beyond mere attraction. As guilt battles desire, Woo-Jin is pulled into a whirlwind of forbidden feelings. Could Matteo be his salvation?

(Source: Lezhin US)

One day, I realized I had been reincarnated as the protagonist’s friend in a tragic novel—one where I was doomed to die while trying to save the heroine. Determined to change my fate, I decided to tell the heroine everything… but for some reason, my words were censored, as if the universe itself was blocking spoilers! Frustrated, I stormed into the forbidden forest and shouted my secrets into the void—venting my anger at the male lead while I was at it. It should’ve been fine. No one was supposed to hear me. Yet somehow, rumors spread like wildfire that the powerful Duke Vishvaltz was… into men?! Now, he’s launching a full-blown investigation to find the source of the absurd gossip.

*“…Your voice is quite unforgettable.”*

…Yep. My life is officially over.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Locked Up by My Mad Dog
description:
After dying and being reborn as Elizabeth, a character from a dark fantasy novel, the new “Elizabeth” begins to navigate her new life. Set to be married to the empire’s crown prince, the new Elizabeth can’t believe her luck. But just as she’s getting ready for a life on easy street, the dark secrets of the previous “Elizabeth” begin to come to light. Learning that Elizabeth keeps a slave known as her “dog,” Elizabeth feels she should set him free. But little does she know that pulling on this thread will unravel far more than she could ever imagine.

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: I Am The Obsessive Emperor's Talented Pharmacist
description:
Hailey is an obscure palace pharmacist in the BL guideverse rofan novel "Ties of Obsession," which is what the reader vaguely recalls upon waking up in her body. Even without Hailey's memories, the new Hailey thwarts the evil head pharmacist's attempt on Emperor Damion's life and is rewarded with the position of his personal pharmacist. Although the contract Damion makes her sign is a lifelong one, it pays a crazy high salary, and her patient's handsome face is a nice perk. What Hailey doesn't foresee is Damion getting attached to her before meeting his gay lover from the original novel!

(Source: Tappytoon)

San-ho has been crushing on Eui-Hyun since their high school days, so ending up at the same college as him feels like fate. The problem is, Eui-Hyun doesn’t remember him at all. Still, San-Ho’s not about to give up that easily. But how long can his one-sided puppy love last if Eui-Hyun keeps looking the other way?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes four side story chapters.*

Eve, trapped in the cursed Tower of Babel, endlessly dies and revives as she struggles to escape and uncover the truth.

(Source: Toomics)

Following the long, draining grind of her corporate life, Heeju feels as though her very soul is weathering away under the weight of endless deadlines and office politics. Just as she reaches her absolute breaking point, a mysterious, sleek flyer catches her eye, seemingly appearing out of thin air: \[Women-Only Healing Massage Shop – OPEN EVENT!\] Intrigued by the promise of a sanctuary away from the world, Heeju decides to indulge in a rare moment of self-care. However, once she steps inside the quiet, dimly lit studio, she realizes this is no ordinary spa. As the session begins, the therapist’s touch transcends simple muscle relaxation, delving into the deep-seated exhaustion she has kept buried for years. What starts as a professional treatment soon evolves into a series of clandestine, intimate sessions designed to awaken her dormant senses. In this hidden space, Heeju’s secret desires are finally addressed, leading her into a world of exquisite, private pleasure.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: How To Send a Friend to Nirvana
description:
After the tragic death of their childhood friend, Kang Chung-Woo, Ha Se-Jun, and Eun Bin decide to grant Myung Yu-Hyeon's last wish by performing a séance so they all can hang out for the final time. Much to their surprise, the séance works, and Yu-Hyeon's spirit comes back. But he wasn't exactly honest about his steamy last wish... Now, he has to possess one of his friends to make it come true. Will fulfilling Yu-Hyeon's last lusty desire send him to nirvana? Or does he have even more wishes?!

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Winner of the 14th Mr.Blue Contest.*

Carefree and house-free, Seo-Ha has spent a long time mooching off of guys in trade for some sex and fun. One day, he runs into Jae-Won, a rich and quiet guy who seems to be willing to lend a helping hand with no strings attached…but are we sure that there’s no strings pulling at Seo-Ha at all?

(Source: Lezhin US)

During a time of uneasy peace following the war between Remrock and Dublin, the appearance of a Dublin soldier shakes the Remrock town of Cassnier. Layla, living in Casnier with her father, unexpectedly crosses paths with the soldier on her way home and slowly begins to learn more about him.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Surviving as the Crown Prince's Childhood Friend
description:
When Ella finds a sickly young boy suffering from a mysterious illness in a cave, she brings him home, only for her to discover a special healing power that helps him recover. Six years later, Carl has grown into a striking young man, but to Ella, he remains like a brother… or so she thinks. Though childhood friends, what Ella doesn’t know, is that Carl is the lost crown prince of the Easton Empire, believed to have perished in a fire… and is only biding his time to make things right again. But Carl has another secret–his feelings for Ella go far beyond family…

(Source: WEBTOON)

Geunyoung Yoon is a shaman…sort of. A man collapses during one of his ceremonies, and he is immediately drawn to him. The man turns out to be a centuries-old dokkaebi named Hwee who is convinced that Geunyoung is the reincarnation of his long-sought lover. Geunyoung quickly grasps that playing along means sleeping with the hot dokkaebi a lot and scoring riches. Jackpot! But as time goes on, Geunyoung’s lies start catching up to him, sending him scrambling to recover what's most important. 

(Source: Tapas)

Hyejun, a feisty female bodyguard, is hired by the young Jaehyun, but when she walks into his house, it’s full of… more guards. But instead of protecting him, they're keeping him there. To hide her true identity as his personal guard, she goes undercover by pretending to be his girlfriend. One day, their undeniable attraction pulls them together to share a kiss. Now, as the lie seeps into their reality, having a strictly professional relationship is becoming less of an option.

(Source: Tapas)

Wealthy Alpha and hotel CEO Si-Hu meets gentle-looking Beta and music student Ye-Jun during a moment of burnout. What starts as curiosity turns into an ongoing relationship. But as Ye-Jun grows bolder, their roles begin to blur—and Si-Hu finds himself wondering who is really in control.

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes ten extra chapters.*

display_title: A Guy and a Girl Stuck in an Elevator
description:
One sweltering summer day, the two people end up trapped together in the company’s elevator. As the heat inside becomes unbearable, they begin removing their clothes one by one…

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/uplmscg/episode/toon/8140), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12213843), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/elevator), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/5700000014), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000069303), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=250241) 

**Official Translations:**       
English ([Toomics](https://toomics.com/en/webtoon/episode/toon/8140), HoneyToon), [Japanese](https://toomics.com/ja/webtoon/episode/toon/8140), [Portuguese](https://toomics.com/por/webtoon/episode/toon/8140)

display_title: Rise of the God of War
description:
Parahumans. Nectar. Aetherol. These things have changed the world in short order, none more so than parahumans. Their unimaginable power makes them the top priority of every organization, legitimate or otherwise, all over the world. Even so, Geon Yoo couldn’t have predicted the situation he was coming home to. Having killed his parents in pursuit of his sister, it’s clear the Seven Star Syndicate will stop at nothing to get what they want from her. It’s their bad luck that they made it personal.

(Source: Tapas)

Jeong Tae-se, a 26-year-old musical prodigy hailed as the “Second Beethoven,” is celebrated for his brilliant compositions and arrangements. But when a crippling creative slump threatens his career, he unexpectedly finds a new muse: Seol-ah, a mysterious woman he encounters during her attempt to end her life. Struck by the raw, haunting emotion she evokes, Tae-se becomes dangerously obsessed. Convinced that she holds the key to his artistic revival, he spirals deeper into a twisted fixation—blurring the lines between inspiration and possession.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.*

*“If I can’t have you, no one can.”* 

Hestia killed her beloved brother Ian with her own two hands. Three months later, he reappears in front of her seemingly unharmed; however, he has seemingly lost all his memories and become an almost completely different person. Everyone in the kingdom welcomes him back with open arms, but only Hestia suspects some foul play at work. Has her brother really changed? Or Ian not who he seems? 

(Source: Lehzin US)

display_title: My Husband and I Cannot Live in the Same World
description:
Mellie never fooled herself into believing she was more than a mere burden. Since childhood, she had been a leech to House Felton who relied on her mother’s friendship with the former Duchess Felton. Even so, it was inevitable that she came to harbor feelings for her most cherished playmate, Young Master Edric. But things start to change when Edric gets engaged. The former duchess begins treating her coldly, and her childhood friend insists that she remains by his side forever. Mellie has never had agency over her own life. But surely Edric has her best interests in mind, right...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Lieutenant General Leto Okeanos, the Mad Dog of the Navy, runs a tight ship… except when it comes to matters of the heart. He’s met his match in Captain Noah Bello, a fiery subordinate and old flame. When Leto blocks her long-awaited promotion, Noah challenges him to a duel. The wager? A wish granted to the winner. Leto wins and proposes marriage. Caught between duty, desire, and Navy politics, these ex-lovers must decide: is their love a second chance... or a disaster waiting to sink them both?

(Source: Tapas)

Ji Geon-Woo has been a thief since childhood, surviving with quick hands and sharp instincts. He isn’t greedy, stealing is simply a means to an end. One day, he sets his sights on a priceless necklace owned by Lee Ye-Shin, a troubled rich heir. To get close, Geon-Woo infiltrates Ye-Shin’s home as a bodyguard. At first, Ye-Shin appears reckless and self-indulgent, but Geon-Woo soon realizes he is deeply lonely, suffering from chronic insomnia. As their relationship blurs, Ye-Shin grows possessive, and Geon-Woo finds himself wanting to protect him, rather than just stealing from him. But when Ye-Shin discovers Geon-Woo’s true intentions, their fragile connection shatters. Now, Geon-Woo must make a choice, walk away with the necklace or stay for Ye-Shin. Meanwhile, Ye-Shin realizes that the only thing he truly wants isn't wealth, but Geon-Woo himself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

She was forced to marry. Now, her husband wants a divorce. Leah retreats to a secluded villa to regroup—only to be saved from danger by a mysterious leopard. But the wild creature is no ordinary beast; he’s Januk, a shape-shifting imperial prince, and taming him might be the start of something wild.

(Source: Manta)

Prosecutor Baek has built his career by manipulating evidence and witness testimonies with the help of a gangster. His success catches the attention of higher-ups in the prosecution, who now want him to clean up his act and arrange a marriage with a woman from a respectable family. Seeing this as the perfect opportunity to discard the gangster who has been clinging to him, Baek accepts the proposal. However, the gangster - who has long harbored feelings for Baek and aided him in his illicit dealings - feels a deep sense of betrayal and rage upon hearing the sudden news. Now, with resentment festering, their once-covert partnership threatens to unravel in ways Baek never expected…

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's SS Short Story Collection (SS 단편선) or the Depraved Collection in english. Chapter count also contains prolouge.*

One fateful night, Sung-Hoon, a music professor, and his family suffer a devastating accident. While their son, Hyun-Woo, escapes relatively unscathed, his parents are not so lucky. Months later, Sung-Hoon wakes up. It turns out, his perfect life wasn’t quite so perfect. Will he finally escape his wife’s control? Or does Hyun-Woo have his own plans for his father?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

display_title: There's Something Wrong About My Man's Morals
description:
After a fateful encounter as children, Evonne and the outcast prince, Theo, can’t deny their deep connection. However, their lives are torn apart when Evonne’s family is wrongly accused of treason, leading to their ruin. Cursed and forced to disguise herself as a man, Evonne struggles to survive until Theo finally finds her and uses all his power as emperor to take her with him. Together, they’ll start a journey facing challenges that’ll test their love as they try to start a life together. 

(Source: Tapas)

Count Scrooge Caroldt was once an imperial tutor who betrayed Crown Prince Calsion and was executed, and I woke up in his body! I decided to change my fate by properly guiding the prince and years later, on the night of his coming-of-age ball, I was finally going to retire and live happily ever after. That is, until Calsion ripped up my resignation letter and forced his desires on me...! Now he wants to make me his consort?! I just wanted to retire in peace! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

The light that fell from the heavens shared a gift with its creations, seeking connection. But humans and their dark hearts would corrupt the very essence of the gift, turning their desires and themselves into twisted, misshapen monstrosities. Yet, there was hope. Heroes would arise--heroes, who would not only stare into the abyss but fight the horrors in it. The gift was golden, but darkness festered within. Now, murky whispers tug on the edge of our consciousness, daring us to make the pact... But with who?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

After years under a military dictatorship, a new government rises, led by S-rank Sentinel Jeong Eden, a revered national hero. But in the courtroom where he stands as the victim of an attempted murder, his gaze remains fixed on one man: Lee Garam, the accused deserter who once served as his Guide. As the trial unfolds, the truth behind their bond begins to surface, blurring the line between betrayal and devotion..

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's Gunbu Danpyeonseon (군부 단편선) Collection.*

display_title: Beyond the Walls of the Duke's Mansion
description:
Aristasha, the noble lady of House Verdic, is adored by both the Iron-Blooded Duke, Evan, and his sword-master brother, Leon. Yet despite her status and beauty, and the years since she first made her debut, she has never taken a lover. Curious about passion and eager to explore the pleasures denied to her, she secretly arranges to meet a gigolo—only to be intercepted by Evan himself. 

*“If you wish to learn, and I refuse to let a stranger touch you… wouldn’t it be best if I taught you myself?”*

From that night on, the men she once saw as brothers begin to look upon her with something far more seductive than mere protectiveness.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Marriage of Convenience to an Obsession
description:
Olga devotes a thousand days in prayer for her husband to sit on the throne, only to be killed at the hands of her cheating husband. The goddess brings her back as her half-sister for a second chance at life, but she still finds herself at the risk of marrying her murderous and adulterous ex-husband once again. Her only hope is to propose a marriage of convenience to the Beast of the Duchy, but a strange turn of events leaves the reluctant duke little choice but to accept the offer. Now, the unlikely newlyweds face struggles on both ends – avenging Olga’s death and figuring out how to share a bed together.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Isaac Carter, the underboss, and soon to be the next leader of the mighty outfit “Rustynail”, is informed that he is going to be training Phil Rustynail, the Boss’s secret son. What he couldn’t tell was that he was Isaac’s one-night stand... To make matters worse, the Boss is considering Phil as the successor to the crown of the world’s most powerful crime family...!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note:Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.*

Raymon has it all: perfect looks, a prestigious family, and unrivaled abilities in the workplace. But beneath his flawless exterior lies a chaotic love life, with a string of unsatisfying, fleeting encounters. His search for the perfect partner ends when a janitor named Winter seemingly saves him from a stalker's attack. Drawn to Winter’s striking looks and submissive nature, Raymon proposes a FWB situation, to which Winter eagerly agrees. At first, their relationship seems ideal, but Raymon soon realizes the terrifying truth - Winter has been his stalker all along. Now trapped in a deadly game, Raymon finds himself pretending to love Winter in a desperate bid to survive. Winter, unhinged and obsessively devoted, will stop at nothing - even murder - to keep Raymon all to himself. And so begins a dangerous, seductive battle of control, where love and dominance blur into a deadly obsession. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

Ever feel like the legal system's punishment just isn't enough? Tae-Pil Kim knows that feeling better than anyone. Ever since he was slapped with ten years in prison for retaliating against two burglars who killed his wife and left his son in a coma, he stopped having faith in the kind of justice the judicial system could bring. But one day, he’s given the opportunity to become a Punisher-- a government-authorized vigilante who acts according to the Code of Hammurabi. The bad guys better watch out now, because Tae-Pil is determined to give them a taste of their own medicine…

(Source: WEBTOON)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: The Obsessive Stud Scammed Me into Marriage
description:
Our female lead had the martial arts skills to beat down any man, but never had the chance to date or even touch a man in her past life. After an untimely death, she is transmigrated into the childhood body of Iona, a noble lady in a Fantasy Romance novel world, where her fate is to wed and live with one man. 

 *"No way! This time, I'm dating around!"* 

Determined to escape marriage, she befriends a crying boy she finds in her garden who shares a similar fate, and light-heartedly agrees to marry him to cheer him up. After Iona is all grown up and ready to mingle with all the gorgeous men in the empire, a certificate of engagement finds her, showing that she is already engaged to none other than Carvain Tenebreth, the ninth crown prince of the empire. The crying boy had scammed him into becoming his Crown Princess! 

Iona, even running away from home, pushes for divorce, while her obsessive husband is hot on her tail, determined to wife her. Will Iona be able to enjoy a free love life, or end up tied to her obsessive prince for life? 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

display_title: I Will Leave the Villainess Position
description:
It’s at her first ball that Carmilla falls in love at first sight with Bernhard. Despite his reluctant attitude, Carmilla ties the knot with him and believes she would be happy forever as long as she got rid of his lover. But her husband’s disdain continues even throughout her pregnancy, causing Carmilla to lose her precious child. On the way back from seeing Bernhard’s lover, Carmilla’s carriage topples and she dies. Perhaps that was her fate for being the villainess in the love triangle. But suddenly, she finds herself back in time when she has yet to marry Bernhard. Could this be her second chance to rectify things? She decides to change her fate and no longer succumb to the strict rules of her family as well as her cruel first love.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10883382), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1962127460), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/goodbye_villainess), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/leave_evil_girl), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000064224), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/65398538), [Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/Im_leaving_the_evil_girl)

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://mechacomic.jp/books/194548)

Seon-Min seems like an ordinary college student, but behind closed doors, she lives a secret life as her professor's plaything. When Yu-Jin, the student she tutors, discovers her darkest secret, everything begins to fall apart. Seon-Min's campus life begins to unravel, plunging her once-stable existence into chaos.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sung Hye-Min, a senior associate at B-SAM (Bureau of Supernatural Ability Management), is on the verge of completing his final task for promotion when he’s suddenly assigned a rookie, Lee Jee-Yoon.

*"I pulled a few strings to get in here so I could see you."*

*"...You pulled strings to land this job? Why?!"*

With his long-awaited promotion at stake, Hye-Min must navigate the chaos of mentoring this unexpected rookie from the above...!

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.*

Jiyoo unexpectedly reunites with her first love, Noah, on a film set after 10 years apart. Sparks fly and they share a passionate night, rekindling old feelings. Jiyoo hopes for a deeper relationship, but Noah remains a mystery. Just as their ambiguous relationship starts to unfold, a new star, Hyeseong, enters the scene, shaking things up even more. Will Jiyoo and Noah find their way back to each other, or will Hyeseong change everything?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

37-year-old Danny should have died in a car crash, but when he finally came to, he was 23 again.

(Source: Toomics)

To cover her father’s hospital bills, Ji-Wan agrees to become Tae-Seong's legal wife for three years; a marriage of convenience with one condition, one billion won once the contract ends. Bound by strict terms, the contract prohibits any contact throughout their marriage. Three years pass, and two weeks before the contract expires— Tae-Seong suddenly shows up at her door convinced that Ji-Wan is the love of his life. Now, with her payout on the line and Tae-Seong clinging to a love that never existed, will Ji-Wan still be able to walk away with the life she planned?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Desperate to escape his hellish grandmother’s house, Hyeonwu scrapes together every penny he can to finally live on his own. But his dream of independence doesn’t last long. His cheap new apartment already has a terrifying long-term resident, a restless virgin ghost who refuses to leave. Just when Hyeonwu thinks he’ll have to move out, the ghost makes him an unexpected offer. If he helps fulfill her secret bucket list, she promises to peacefully move on to the afterlife and vacate the apartment. This chilling and charming story follows a broke young man and a mischievous ghost as they team up to tackle her final wishes, one haunting favor at a time.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Kwon Ji-Uk's monotonous daily life takes an unexpected turn at a club meeting when he becomes drawn to a mysterious new freshman. Captivated by the freshman's sweet looks, Ji-Uk tries to approach him, only to be met with a cold and dismissive attitude. Annoyed by the response, Ji-Uk resolves to teach the freshman a lesson in his own way. However, things take a shocking twist that Ji-Uk never saw coming. The next morning, Ji-Uk wakes up covered in someone else’s fluids, staring at an unfamiliar ceiling, only to realize he’s now trapped in an unimaginable and humiliating situation.

*“You're all the same...how you let your urges take over...”*

Once a domineering and fearsome figure who thrived on intimidation, Ji-Uk finds himself powerless against the alluring yet dangerous freshman, Park Ju-Yeon. With no clue about Juyeon’s true intentions or the deadly game that’s about to unfold, Ji-Uk is dragged into a personal hell designed just for him.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

When it comes to passing the civil service exam, there’s only one name that matters: Han Miryu! For a thousand years, Miryu has been a legendary instructor, helping countless Guardians secure civil servant positions. Yet, she harbors a secret weakness she can’t share with anyone—Won Daehan, the only student who, despite her efforts, still failed the exam. To protect her reputation, Miryu devises a desperate plan: drain the excess yang energy from Daehan’s body. With only three days left until the big exam, the ultimate question remains—will Daehan finally pass the Guardian recruitment exam?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Yongyongjukgetji Danpyeonseon (용용죽겠지 단편선) Collection.*

*“You told me to remember your scent wherever I go, so I did. You still smell sweet."* 

In childhood, Hee-Won had treated Gun-Woo like a pet dog. Now after years of separation, Gun-Woo has reappeared as a subordinate in Hee-Won's company. But no matter how fiercely he's pushed away, Gun-Woo lingers like a puppy with gentle eyes.

(Source: Manta)

When Hwieon survives his brother’s demonic attack, a grim reaper leaves him one cryptic mission: find the living Hungerwraith. Now a reluctant ghost-hunting streamer, he crosses paths with Gyeol — the worst possible ally, and the one person he can’t seem to walk away from.

(Source: Manta)

Grace Gurton has her eyes on Richard Spencer, captain of the rugby team. Despite his narcissism, she can't help but pine for him. Then one day, Grace gets an unexpected adoption offer from Richard's aunt, Mary Montague. Can Grace navigate her feelings for Richard now that she’s part of the family?

(Source: Manta)

The slave she thought was dead has returned—as a king. Now, he takes her as his concubine to destroy her kingdom and avenge his past. 

*"My love wounds him. His love condemns me."*

(Source: Manta)

*"You’d keep wearing lingerie for me if I did what you asked?"*

Yun Hee-Il’s secret fetish is uncovered by his close friend Hyuk, who uses it to tease him and push the boundaries of their relationship. But over time, Hee-Il starts to feel a strange attraction toward Hyuk, the only one who seems to understand his hidden side...

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.*

One day, the disgraced child actress Sara Gwon takes her own life, only to wake up… ten years in the past? Except now, she is successful, radiant, and adored by all. What happened? How did she go from public enemy number one to national sweetheart? And more importantly, can her fate truly be rewritten this time?

(Source: WEBTOON)

On the brink of a major update, the lead developer of a full-sensory VR game uncovers a fatal bug and is pulled into the world he built. Trapped inside a stage that responds to touch, breath, and desire, he’s offered a single way out: complete a cryptic quest from an unseen presence. As the game blurs sensation and control, survival means surrendering to rules far more intimate than code.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Lavielle's life turned upside down when she lost her entire family. With nowhere to go, when a kind marquess offered to take her in, she was more than grateful...until she learned it came at a price. Forced to endure nightly torment, Lavielle begs for someone-anyone-to save her. Her prayers are answered when Lucien appears, claiming to be the Marquess's son... But is he truly who he says he is? Can he really be trusted? And, most of all, can Lavielle finally tempt her salvation?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Kim Dabin harbors a secret desire for BDSM. He's already exploring this world with Jung Cane, a charismatic idol and professor, when his longtime friend Ra Yun unexpectedly confesses his own love for kink. Caught between two irresistible men, Dabin’s confusion leads to a reckless escape—only to wake up after a car accident with an outrageous offer on the table. He’s given six months to live with both Cane and Yun, switching between them weekly, indulging in their seductive games as they fiercely compete for his heart. As the tension heats up and the lines blur between passion and possession, Da-bin must make the hardest choice of his life: which man will claim him for good?

From glimpses of lace peeking through to the teasing sway of her hips, every encounter fuels his fantasies. (Source: Lezhin US)

Bul-Do Jeong was once a legend of the Korean underworld. But after a decade in prison, he walks free into a world that no longer plays by the old rules. The streets are run by a new wave of criminals known as the “MZ Gang” who are louder, flashier, and far more reckless. Though he intended to leave his past behind, he’s pushed to the edge when the youngbloods hurt those around him. Now, it’s time the city remembered who ruled these streets.

display_title: The Witch in the Emperor's Quarters
description:
After enduring years of unjust abuse from her adoptive family, Isabella White finally manages to escape White Manor. In the midst of her peril, she unexpectedly discovers she is a witch. Her newfound powers are witnessed by her sister's fiancé, The Grand Duke Xenos. Instead of taking her back, he offers her a deal: her powers in return for revenge—through marriage. What will she uncover on her path to vengeance?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Demon King Astrea tasked 72 worthy Demon Lords with destroying the world. Demon Lords--a title only given to those who passed Astrea’s test. Each was given powers befitting their title. Kharos, the ruler of madness and greed, was no exception. But his granted power was less than satisfactory. He received the power of "Gacha"—a luck-based ability with an abysmal pull rate. With this power, Kharos must do his best to engulf the world with madness and greed!

(Source: Tapas)

Lim Seo-Jun, a college student, is popular with guys but struggles with his lack of popularity among the opposite sex. At the opening assembly, he tries to get closer to the girls, but they all flock around Yun-Woo, a fellow student who has just returned from a break. Envious of Yoon-Woo's charm, Seo-Jun drinks too much and passes out. When he wakes up, he finds Yun-Woo unusually affectionate—and feels something strangely stiff in a very unexpected place.

*"Seo-Jun hyung, can you feel it?"*

(Source: Lezhin US)

 *Note: Part of Bomtoon’s and Lezhin’s Saekgwi Danpyeonseon (색귀 단편선) Collection or Dirty Demon Collection in English.*

Rositte is a "reincarnated one," someone who recalls their past life from another world, but is framed for the murder of Duke Luchiaden. She goes back in time right before his death to save him and is shocked when he says she might be the emperor's lost daughter, foretold to be the last reincarnated one! However, Carina, another reincarnated one, insists she's the true daughter. Will Rositte be able to uncover the truth about her origins, or will Carina be crowned as imperial princess instead? 

(Source: Tapas)

Adrian Vernity would only ever scowl at his classmate Liz Plomento whenever he saw her. So imagine Liz's shock when she wakes up 5 years in the future, married to Adrian! Not only that, as Emperor and Empress, they are expected to consummate their marriage. Can Liz find a way out of this royal mess?

(Source: Manta)

Alisa Benin has loved stories since her days at the Academy, so when she finds herself magically transported into the entries of her new diary, she gives the prince a story to soothe his tears. In these entries, Emperor Louis Ferdinando II is but a child, looking for friends. But in the present, Louis is perplexed by Alisa. Just who is this woman who has entered his dreams and, in doing so, altered his past? As Alisa comes to his aid, Louis will have to decide: Is this fairy friend or foe?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: This Time, the Tears Were Mine
description:
A noble lady unwanted by her family. A prince unwanted by his country. There was a reason why they gravitated toward each other. Andrea always dreamed of Prince Charming coming to her rescue. And she thought she found him in Kahir--the abandoned Prince of Ragenia. But when her stepsister schemes to marry her off to an old and perverted marquis, Andrea decides to take advantage of his love by seducing Kahir and asking him to run away with her. Believing her words, Kahir does away with the dirty marquis. However, his love for Andrea turns into hatred he realizes that she had used him to escape the unwanted marriage. Andrea soon regrets her actions, but Kahir wants nothing of her. Will the star-crossed lovers be able to find their happy ending?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

display_title: I Shall Conquer the Unruly Beasts
description:
When Sione was married off to the Emperor of Belfator, 16 years her senior, she didn't think things could get any worse. But then, the unthinkable... His Majesty was murdered! Could one of his loyal beasts have done this? Can she tame the three cursed men before her? However, before long, they each make a proposal: Marry me. Now left to protect a young stepdaughter, Sione must choose. Will she marry the Dog, the Snake, or the Eagle?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

After a long day at work, all she wanted was a moment of rest on a park bench. But when she closed her eyes, she awoke in a different place—and now, whenever she goes to sleep, she wakes up, trapped in a tiny room with a towering man whose wild, animalistic presence sends a shiver down her spine. Every night, she finds herself beneath him, powerless against the pleasure and confusion he brings. Is it a dream? A different world? Or something in between? As the boundary between reality and fantasy begins to blur, a strange and all-consuming romance unfolds—one that defies time, reason, and her very sense of self.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

Six years ago, novelist Jung Seon lost everything, including his young son and his marriage. To escape the grief, he moves to a quiet rural village for a teaching gig, where he forms an unexpected, deep bond with an orphan named Hyeon-Wu. Just as they grow inseparable, Hyeon-Wu vanishes without a word on the eve of his adulthood. Two years later, he suddenly reappears as a charismatic stage actor, ready to script a new, intense chapter in their lives.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Behind his beautiful face, Wui-Jeong hides a vicious nature. Seeing how easily others misunderstand Hae-Jin because of his intimidating appearance, Wui-Jeong bullies and uses him throughout their youth. As adults, they meet again by chance. Hae-Jin tries to walk away, only to be trapped by Wui-Jeong’s cruelty into a night he never consented to.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes nine extra chapters.*

Kwon Joonhyuk, the class president infamous for his terrible personality, gets caught up with Min Dohyun at the freshman party. What starts as a seemingly harmless gathering takes a dark turn when Joonhyuk wakes up in Dohyun’s place, his hands tied to a bedframe. Now, it’s time to uncover the perfect student’s secret little hobby.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.*

On his very first day at the Grace estate, newly hired butler Obetheron is caught off guard. Quiet, withdrawn, and cruelly ignored by both her family and the staff due to her frail body, Lady Emma is nothing like the noble beauty he's heard about. Moved by her loneliness, Obetheron remains devoted, resisting temptation and serving her with sincere care. Emma, in turn, begins to notice the gentle strength behind his loyalty...and one day, she makes a bold request: “Would you do anything - not for the House of Grace, but for me?” A slow-burning romance between a forgotten noblewoman and the butler who sees her for who she truly is, how will their forbidden love unfold? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Undercover cop Im Sae-Byeok has one job: use his baby-faced charm to infiltrate a university and get close to Ma Leo, the elusive grandson of a notorious gang boss. But on day one, he gets blackout drunk and wakes up next to a mystery man he definitely doesn’t remember. Things only get messier when he discovers he’ll be living under the same roof as both Leo and Leo’s overly clingy best friend, Son Yi-Gang. With cockblocks, close calls, and suspiciously attractive housemates at every turn, Sae-Byeok’s mission quickly spirals into chaos. Operation Leo might just be his wildest assignment yet.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Once a member of a powerful gang, Gu Tae-Won is now broke, homeless, and on the run. With nowhere left to turn, he finds himself on the edge—literally—contemplating his life atop a bridge. Just when things seem hopeless, a well-dressed stranger approaches with a surprising offer:

*“You need some money, right? I can help you.”*

Tae-Won doesn’t refuse the offer to spend one night together with this strange man…but can he trust the hand that’s pulling him back from the brink?

(Source: Lezhin US)

 *Note: Includes three side story chapters.*

One sunny day day, a portal burst open in the garden, and Kwon Jae-Jin got caught up in the chaos. His limbs were torn off, and he died...

…Or so he thought. 

When he wakes up, he finds himself back on the first day of his captivity—with Seo Wui-Wu between his legs, tugging at his pants. Jae-Jin stares down at the familiar face, one he had come to resent over the four agonizing years of his previous life. Back then, he had believed he was merely a victim, dragged into an unfamiliar place and forced into submission. But this time is different. Now, Jae-Jin knows exactly how Seo Wui-Wu thinks, what moves him, and—most importantly—how to control him. With the promise of guiding as bait, Seo Wui-Wu will be his to manipulate. As Seo Wui-Wu’s breath grows heavy and his dark hair falls messily over his forehead, his hungry gaze flashes with dangerous excitement. Who will truly hold the reins in this second chance at fate?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hyunsoo, set to graduate from art school, misses his final nude croquis exam. As a result, his professor, Yujin Song, gives him an F. Desperate, Hyunsoo pleads with Professor Song, who finally allows him to retake the test alone. And the model is Professor Song herself.

A mystery hangs over the remote island of Manwol. The locals have all perished after being turned into monsters in an experiment by the imperial army. But Geumran, a young deaf girl, inexplicably survives, recovering her hearing and gaining incredible strength. Though she kills all of the soldiers in cold blood, Geumran soon learns that the same fate that befell the villagers awaits her too. Finding those responsible for the experiments thus becomes her only hope for survival... and vengeance.

After an eventful night full of tears and a live concert, Gyeom finds himself tangled up in a hot night with aspiring musician and rising star, Yo-Han. Inspired after a mind-blowing night, Yo-Han decides to look for new band members to join him in producing a new album. But when he once again encounters the mysterious boy who stole his heart with his tears, Yo-Han refuses to let him go and suggests Gyeom join his band as a bassist. Will these two be able to create a new playlist for their lives?

(Source: Tapas)

Gyo-ha and Jun-oh were once each other’s first love, but they eventually broke up due to sexual incompatibility. Ten years later, Gyo-ha, now an investment professional searching for fresh opportunities, stumbles upon a dating app called “AM2”—and unexpectedly reconnects with Jun-oh. Wanting more than just nostalgia, Gyo-ha proposes a casual fling—an offer Jun-oh eagerly accepts. However, as Jun-oh's feelings grow stronger, he begins to fear that history might repeat itself, and that his affection will only push Gyo-ha further away. Caught between nostalgia and desire, can they truly keep things casual, or will their unresolved emotions threaten to change everything?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After escaping from the white room, Sam is given the choice to enter another one and is offered a hefty sum as a prize.

(Source: Toomics)

Cho Yeon, a shaman-in-training, climbs a haunted mountain where seven women have gone up and been returned with no memory. She meets a mischievous, hopelessly horny ghost who’s more interested in romance than haunting. Unable to seal him, they strike a deal: he helps her gather spiritual energy, and she’ll help him avoid becoming a vengeful spirit. But every time he aids her, they must get intimate. When a mysterious man appears knowing her past, Yeon’s journey becomes even more complicated.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Cheon Jia, the vice president of a large corporation, is preparing for a shareholders’ meeting. Worried that her timid personality will cause her to make a mistake, she consults a fortune-teller, only to learn that she must sleep with a man who possesses the energy of the clouds in order to ensure a smooth career advancement! Fortunately, Jia notices this energy in Sang Kwon-un, a man who’s trying to turn a new leaf by applying to be her personal bodyguard. Jia initially approaches him with an ulterior motive, but as they sleep together, will she begin to…fall for him?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Raised as brothers in an orphanage, Ba-Woo and Joseph take opposite paths—Joseph becoming a priest and Ba-Woo becoming an underground fighting champion. However, when Joseph awakens as the great demon Lucifer and massacres the residents of their orphanage, their brotherly relationship turns into one fueled by revenge. In order to bring Joseph to justice, Ba-Woo sets off on a relentless pursuit of him and his cult. As threats mount and doubts creep in, can Ba-Woo’s powerful fists and allies overcome Joseph’s overwhelming supernatural powers and influence?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Strange things have been happening to Lee Yuan lately. Fainting spells, waking up with strangers in his bed, lost memories…for someone who wants to live an uneventful life, he sure has been busy lately. That’s when his friend Do-Yoon makes a confession: though he may look normal, Do-Yoon is in fact a reaper sent to earth to retrieve a ghost who refuses to move on. And just who should that ghost be possessing? You guessed it! The only way to send a spirit up to the afterlife is to satisfy its needs, and Do-Yoon is determined to suck the spirit right out of Yuan in more way than one…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hoseon has suffered from the war Jang started for far too long, and hope has grown scarce, but pharmacist Do-Ha Shin is determined to save as many lives as he can until the very end. Except, he wasn’t expecting to manifest as an omega at his age, and he wasn’t expecting to wake up surrounded by Hoseon’s army. He can’t remember the face of the alpha who found and brought him here, and he never got his name. Now, saving the lives of these soldiers could mean saving the life of his love.

(Source: Tapas)

In a kingdom rotting from within, Rey, an Arcanist whose magic serves the city's power players, scrapes by in a dusty bookstore with one-night stands as his only relief. After one intense night with two men, one of them won’t leave. Behind his refined mask lies a decadent hunger — and Rey knows it's poison, but he can't stay away.

(Source: Manta)

While on a school trip aboard a ship, Teacher Jihan has a strange dream about a goat man. He steps onto the deck to clear his head, only to be swept away by a huge wave. When he comes to, he finds himself on "Goats Island," where he meets Sea Bass and his friends—who all can’t remember a thing. As Jihan and Sea Bass fall head over hooves for each other, it becomes clear that their friends are “kidding” around with the truth, leaving Jihan to wonder what billy-big secrets they’re hiding.

(Source: Tapas)

Damian is a powerful duke with a demihuman condition that makes him averse to human scents. So when he sees Kanna—a girl sold into slavery by her own family—at an auction, he cannot resist buying her. Will this attraction grow into love, or remain a mere carnal instinct?

(Source: Manta)

Julia returns home after spending 12 years in a convent to find that Benjamin, the boy taken in by her father, has inherited her father’s earldom. She’s drawn to the kind and charming Benjamin, so when he asks to enter her room late one night, she finds herself unable to resist...

(Source: Manta)

He's the perfect man- except when it comes to a certain crucial aspect. One day, an unexpected significant enhancement changes everything.

(Source: Toomics)

Mi-reu is an imugi who failed to ascend to heaven because she was betrayed by a human. After centuries of honing her sword of vengeance, she finally reincarnates and meets Keum Juyong, who carries the soul responsible for her demise. But for some reason, she keeps getting entangled in Juyong’s game instead! Will Mi-reu successfully get her sultry revenge?

(Source: Lezhin US)
