Remember when high school drama felt way more serious than it really was? Well, in Taeyang City, there’s a little more on the line than gossip and hurt feelings. It’s more about loose teeth and broken jaws! With every high school in town ruled by a gang of hard-knock delinquents, the top dogs fight for dominance and the elusive title of “Myeongwang,” the greatest high school fighter of them all. At first, transfer student Ujae wants nothing to do with this, but he is soon dragged back into gang life to settle a score with the notorious Sunrise gang…

(Source: WEBTOON)

Upbeat witch doctor Kina Witchwood receives an ominous prophecy: she will face her execution in six months, but not before encountering three men--one she cannot refuse, one she cannot persuade, and one to whom she will vow her life. Though she tries to defy fate, she soon finds herself appointed as the emperor's personal physician and thrust into the heart of the imperial palace's trecherous political intrigues. 

(Source: WEBTOON)

At 28, Seo Yeon-Ho reunites with Ju Geon-U, his childhood first love, with only one thing on his mind: revenge. Determined to expose Geon-U's weaknesses, Yeon-Ho dives back into his life, only to find that his former crush has become a famous actor. But instead of gaining the upper hand, Yeon-Ho ends up being endlessly teased and outplayed by the very man he swore to take down…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Welcome to an LA Korean spa that accidentally turned into a holy ground for hot, chaotic gays! Enter Eden, a swoon-worthy CIA agent with the body of a Greek god, and Romeo, a mafia boss whose hands are as dangerous as they are... skilled. Both men lock eyes on one unsuspecting target: Su-Min, a sweet and slightly flustered Korean student working as a scrub master. Caught in a steamy love triangle full of slippery situations, shirtless standoffs, and suspiciously sensual scrubbing, Su-Min becomes the prize in a ridiculous showdown between brawn and finesse. Will Eden’s all-American muscles win him the boy? Or will Romeo’s sinful charm steal Su-Min’s heart (and maybe his towel)?

One spa. Two rivals. Three very questionable intentions. In the end... can’t they all just share the love?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Alpha Han Woo-Yeon's only goal is to find the love of his life, omega Ji Eon-Hyeong, marry him, and spend the rest of their days in blissful happiness. When they finally cross paths again, eight years later, it feels like fate since Eon-Hyeong has also been waiting for their reunion. But there’s one major problem... The delicate omega he remembers is gone, and in his place is a big, strong, strapping alpha who towers over Woo-Yeon. Can true love overcome such an unexpected twist of fate? Or is Woo-Yeon destined to lose his first love forever?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After yet another rejected novel, a failing romance author finds herself mysteriously transmigrated into her own story! It would be one thing if she inhabited the body of her main character, but she instead finds herself in the shoes of the cruel villain of the story, Hawn-Hee Kang! Can this "relationship newbie" break up the engagement that'll lead to this villainess' untimely demise?

(Source: Tapas)

After an attempt to steal a magical relic goes very wrong, Eve not only loses a friend but also her freedom. She is forced to summon a monster and enter a fighting arena with other imprisoned slaves. Years go by, and Eve has finally honed her skills and plans to exact her revenge on the man who captured her when a group of sky pirates looking for relics suddenly appears. In that moment, she makes the choice to escape with the pirates on their ship and sets off on a tumultuous journey to find her true path in life.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ju-Han is a devout deacon who regularly volunteers at an orphanage where Seong-Mi resides. Drawn by curiosity, Seong-Mi visits the church, only to stumble upon a shocking sight—Ju-Han, the very picture of restraint and virtue, consumed by his own forbidden desires, punishing himself in secret. A dangerous temptation begins to take root.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Yeonu plans to end her secret affair with her boss, but an unexpected twist traps her in a bond she can't escape.

(Source: Toomics)

Award-winning cartoonist Keum Suk Gendry-Kim demystifies the inscrutable North Korean leader 

A woman falls over a thin black line, slicing her in two—half becoming North Korea, the other half becoming South. From the Island of Ganghwa, a seemingly idyllic rural paradise just an hour outside of Seoul, North Korea sits mere miles away, visible from cartoonist Keum Suk Gendry-Kim’s home and studio. It looms over her while she walks her dogs through the rice paddies. Artillery fire, helicopters, and sirens from a nearby military base paint her acoustic landscape. Gendry-Kim has written extensively about the pain and heartbreak experienced throughout Korea’s recent history in her award-winning books Grass and The Waiting. In My friend Kim Jong-Un, Gendry-Kim looks not to the past, but to the present—to the man currently responsible for upholding the national divide. 

Retracing his rise to power and uncovering his human side, Gendry-Kim explores the life of the supreme leader of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea: from his birth to his international education, his tastes and hobbies, and his relationships. Gendry-Kim weaves her personal accounts from this process throughout the book, in her signature approach to personal nonfiction by including interviews with former South Korean president Moon Jae-in, North Korean defectors, researchers, journalists, Kim’s former chef, and a friend from his boarding school days in Switzerland. 

My Friend Kim Jong-Un carries a message of peace and attempts to make sense of an awful chapter in Korean history. Translated by the award-winning Janet Hong, My Friend… is a cautionary tale and education on what makes a dictator, at a time when these lessons are more relevant in the West than ever. 

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

Every single day, Chong-Suk is killed in whatever way his creator, Bae-Soo, pleases. How is it possible to die multiple deaths? Well, with the technology of Wonderland Black Cage, anyone can live out their wildest revenge fantasies! Humiliated by your crush? Let your fury fly free in the WBC app! But all good things come at a price. The more Bae-Soo plays, the more Chong-Suk adapts. And with the app’s AI secretly guiding Chong-Suk’s every move, who’s controlling who?

(Source: Tapas)

After a traumatic incident in high school left Se-Jin with emotional scars (and a three-year delay), all he wants now is to quietly graduate from Korea’s top university with decent grades. But what was supposed to be his easiest class turns into a paired project from hell, and who just so happens to be his teammate? The overly friendly, overly handsome Wu-Hyeon, of course! Not only is this guy clingy like lost puppy, but there’s something about him that puts Se-Jin on edge… Why does Wu-Hyeon seem so familiar, and how does he know so much about Se-Jin…? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

display_title: I Refuse the Regrets of a Traitor
description:
Abandoned by her ex-husband Douglas, Cassia rises to become a wealthy merchant. However, when a penniless Douglas returns begging for forgiveness, she gives him one last chance — only to fall into his trap and lose everything. But just when all seems lost, Cassia is granted a second chance to change her fate.

(Source: Manta)

For over half his life, Gye Neul has devoted himself to the Baekya crime syndicate, serving as the personal ashtray for Yong Inyeop, the boss's son. With a body marked by cigarette burns and a tongue stripped of taste, Neul has resigned himself to this cruel existence. His only solace is that Inyeop has never violated his body further. But one day, an order sends Neul on a business trip, forcing him to confront a bloody past.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Carefree chaebol Seo-Hee Lee agrees to marry her university acquaintance Seung-Hyun Chae in a strategic marriage—only to realize too late that his mother is the stuff of nightmares for a daughter-in-law. Can Seo-Hee survive her toughest challenge yet and perhaps even find true love?

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The Ash Salmon Quenches the Beast Monarch's Desire
description:
The eldest daughter of House Northmoont, Helse, shoulders the responsibility of her family as the stand-in lady while her father is bedridden. However, she faces increasing pressure from rival families vying for Northmoont's power. One day, Helse decides to offer herself as a hostage to the Kartago, known as the brawny descendants of wolves. There, she discovers that the wolves have strong desires and practice sharing unmarried women among their men! Between the wolf monarch and a virgin noblewoman unfolds a captivating romantic fantasy, where two individuals from contrasting cultures explore their connection through physical intimacy.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

display_title: A Girl I Used to Know
description:
Melanie is a family friend who used to live with Sam since his childhood, who he had a crush on. After moving out of Sam's family home, Melanie returns one day as a married woman. 

(Source: Toomics)

Step into a world where no fantasy is off limit, and no desire too delusional... Follow stories of guys getting exactly what they want, however they want it, whoever they want it with.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Esteemed Lady of the Tea Garden
description:
After being unadopted three times, Camellia is determined to stand on her own and applies for a position at the famous Bloomberry Tea Garden.

Though there are unsavory rumors surrounding the owner, Brandon Worthing, the people of his estate treat her surprisingly well, as if she's a noble lady instead of a mere employee.

But regardless of these puzzling circumstances, Camellia flourishes in her new role as a tea maker, moving people's hearts with her special blends. Little does she know that there's a reason why Brandon hired her, and that their history goes back much further than she thought...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Three different couples, three unique love stories—each beginning in their own unexpected way.

Song Kichan & An Hyejin
A battle of pride started by a petty argument. Wait… did they just accidentally start dating?! A classic friends-to-lovers romance.

Seo Kijun & Shin Ahyoung
After passing out after a night of drinking, Kijun wakes up with more than one gap in his memory. First, how did he get home? And second, why is one of his classmates lying in bed with him? What happened last night?!

Ha Taewook & Yang Hyein
An exciting first date! And what better to bring two young lovebirds closer together than a cafe pager? A heartwarming love story between a girl with an explosive libido and a pure-hearted boy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Perpetually the lowest-ranked salesman, Giseok faces termination due to poor performance. His only way out? Becoming the top salesperson. Desperate, he turns to pillow deals, the ultimate sales taboo. Can he overcome temptation, jealousy, and office politics to rise to the top?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After an embarrassing run-in with auctioneer Luca Orsini at a Carnevale party, art restorer Dojin finds himself entangled in an unexpected restoration project. As secrets unfold and hidden motives come to light, Dojin must navigate a web of deception, art, and an unspoken connection that keeps pulling him back...

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The New CEO and I - Five Years After the One-night Stand
description:
Raised by conservative educator parents, Ji-Soo could never dream of straying far from their high moral standards. However, there was that one time when she had a passionate one-night stand with a cute stranger she met while clubbing with her friends. To her great surprise, she runs into him five years later as her company's newly appointed CEO!

(Source: Manta)

Maeng Byeongtae has it all — a privileged background, a flawless physique, and more than enough where it counts. As a personal trainer, women were just passing distractions, good for relieving tension and nothing more. But everything changes when Seo Jihye walks into his gym. A new client. A married woman. The kind of trouble Byeongtae usually avoids without a second thought. And yet, something about Jihye — her quiet poise, the way loneliness clings to her — begins to shake his resolve.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Myung-Sun lives for lazy days, dating apps, and dodging work at his family’s BBQ joint. He’s on the hunt for a buff guy to fulfill his fantasies—so when a ripped part-timer appears, it feels like fate. But when they both turn out to be tops, things start getting heated!

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Hit Me One More Time, Teacher
description:
After crashing her ex's wedding, high school teacher Si-Yeon drowns her heartbreak in a hotel bar, only to end up in a reckless one-night stand with a charming young man. Although she’s ready to forget the night ever happened, she's thrown into chaos when he appears at her school as her new coworker. As if that wasn't bad enough, he turns out to be Ha-Jun, a former student she taught years ago. While Si-Yeon struggles to keep her walls up, Ha-Jun boldly closes the distance, refusing to let their past—or their night together—stay buried.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ha-Min was the quiet, chubby kid with a hopeless crush on his friend’s older brother. Years later in college, he's slimmed down and unrecognizable. When Tae-Rim starts treating him with the same gentle warmth as before, Ha-Min finds his feelings rushing back.

(Source: Manta)

An unprecedented virus spreads across the world. After deserting the military upon learning the truth behind its human experiments, Tae-an is captured once again. When he wakes up, the first thing he sees is the gentle smile of the laboratory director watching him. Trapped inside an obsession he cannot understand, Tae-Han begins to slowly break.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's Gunbu Danpyeonseon (군부 단편선) Collection.*

After breaking her heart 10 years ago, Minjoo’s first love returns, wanting her to bear a child for him.

(Source: Lalatoon)

Hye-Sung just hasn’t been the same since the accident. For one, his best friend, No-Eul, can’t help but notice Hye-Sung's new tentacles, among other things. Actually, Hye-Sung seems like an entirely different person every other day...and this alternate personality is a lot more forward about his desires for No-Eul. No-Eul would do anything for his best friend, but does that include dating the alien inside him?!

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Chapter count includes 5 side story chapters.*

There's no place like home...

Having grown up in a nursing home, Sheena wished for nothing more than to be reunited with her family. But when she finally returns home after 9 years, she finds herself feeling like a stranger in her own house as things take an eerie turn.

(Source: Manta)

Reincarnated as the heroine of a novel she once read, Veronica seeks revenge against her tyrannical father. Amidst a web of intrigue, she cautiously aligns herself with the enigmatic Prince Lowen and Duke Evan, who happen to be the murder suspects of her previous homicidal death. As Veronica carefully carry out her plan of revenge, she also finds herself drawn to Lowen and Evan, unraveling hidden truths of her past life. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: based on a Korean web novel, the comic was first published by POCKET COMICS in English (2024-04-23), but its first AniList-eligible publication was in Japanese by Comico (2024-06-12), and its Korean release was not until 2024-10-22 on KakaoPage. Thus by AniList priority rules this is categorized as a Japanese manga.*

Baek Heon, the ruthless CEO of the criminal syndicate Yusu, finds himself under investigation by prosecutor Seol Ji-Hun for allegedly plotting to assassinate a congressman. Inside the interrogation room, Baek Heon becomes instantly captivated by Ji-Hun and makes a chilling decision. If he’s going to hell, he’s taking this good-looking prosecutor down with him. Ji-Hun’s life is soon upended. Framed for crimes he didn’t commit, he ends up behind bars, his once-promising future shattered. But Baek Heon isn’t done yet. For a man who confesses his deepest desire is to ruin a prosecutor, he’s more than ready to drag Ji-Hun into his world of obsession and poison—and Ji-Hun might just be daring enough to see how far he’ll fall.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Boss raids are an amazing opportunity for hunters. That’s why Gun-Woo Lee agreed right away when he was asked to join. An intense battle ensued, but Gun-Woo and his guild mates got the Boss’s health down to 30 percent. However, that triggered an effect, and now the Boss is about to explode in three minutes. Gun-Woo and his guild mates sense that they won’t be able to defeat the Boss in time, so they decide to escape. As they were about to get out, Gun-Woo was betrayed and trapped inside the dungeon…

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

In his school days, Baek Kiho was an easy target, overweight, quiet, and even cursed with a name that classmates mocked as “Piggy Ho.” Years of relentless bullying drove him to drop out, leaving only scars and shame behind. But time changes everything. Kiho shed the weight, changed his name to Heeseong, and built a new life where no one could recognize the boy he once was. Then fate delivers an unexpected blow: his first love, Cheon Bokyeong, reappears. The very same Bokyeong who once despised him now approaches warmly, unable to connect Heeseong with the outcast she knew in the past. Torn between the longing he still feels and the terror of exposing his past, Heeseong hides the truth and lets their fragile relationship grow. But secrets have a way of surfacing and for Heeseong, the fear of losing both love and dignity weighs heavier than ever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Between My Wife's Elder Sister and My Wife's Younger Sister
description:
When Noah, a struggling web novelist, finds himself in an unexpected marriage with Jane, one of three sisters who once tormented him, his life takes a chaotic turn. As Jane is sent overseas for work, her empty home becomes a playground for her two sisters— Lisa, a sultry divorcee, and Emily, a bold college student. The odd cohabitation stirs unexpected emotions as Noah is torn between Jane’s provocative allure and Emily’s carefree spirit. As old feelings resurface and new temptations arise, Noah is caught in a tangled web of desire, guilt, and forbidden attraction. Will he find clarity amidst the chaos, or will he be forever trapped between the two sisters?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Yoon-Su coaxes new kid Yi-Shin into joining him for Sports Day. Yi-Shin finds him annoying, but once he realizes he always has him on his mind, he decides to transfer back to Seoul. Yoon-Su, in tears, promises to visit, but 3 years pass since his last text. Yi-Shin, feeling used, decides to use him back.

(Source: Manta)

Se-Jin, a dedicated high school teacher, reunites with Ju-Hwan, the school’s temporary chairman—and her first love. After an unexpected night, she tries to leave it as a memory. But Ju-Hwan suggests a three-month “bedmate” relationship, and Se-Jin finds herself sinking deeper into feelings she meant to forget.

(Source: Manta)

In war-torn Alea, there is endless destruction over the search of “Shelkrino,” a dangerous ancient artifact. Thus, Durand’s father Tomas, a member of the Sky Congress, kept a piece of Shelkrino hidden in his body for years. Eventually, evil comes knocking at their door and Tomas has to sacrifice himself to save both the artifact and Durand. Enraged by the death of his father, Durand takes the risk of awakening his abilities as a summoner by using Shelkrino. With this newfound power and the help of his comrades, Durand sets off on a path to avenge his parents and put an end to the war once and for all.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Seong Serim grew into womanhood without having ever felt love from a man. No matter how she used her body or her words, it never seemed to be enough. So when she meets Cha Juhyeok, who cares for her despite his cold demeanor, she is instantly smitten. Fast forward years later, and she is the successful CEO of her own entertainment company. One of her actors, Ha Yeonwu, will do anything to please his boss…anything. With two men vying for her attention, their touches both intoxicating, how is Serim supposed to choose? Well, maybe she doesn’t have to… 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ichigar, the king, returns to the city without his Guardian. During an investigation following an assassination attempt, he notices Eli, a slave. Despite Eli’s protests, he orders him to be his personal Guardian. As Eli tries to find a way out of his duties, this only attracts the king’s attention.

(Source: Manta)

Deoksun Kim, a 111-year-old mogul, built a thriving food empire, but her one regret was never experiencing true love. Miraculously reincarnated as 25-year-old Dohui, she sets out to fulfill her dying wish—only to be betrayed by her lover and lose everything. Fueled by vengeance, she soon faces an impossible ultimatum: fall in love within 111 days or suffer eternal torment in Hell. With time running out, will Deoksun seek revenge or take another chance at love?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

High schooler Gyu-Bin Ji, a psychic who can read minds, meets Byeol Yu, a mysterious new classmate. The twist? Byeol is actually a human-hating alien in disguise, sent to decide humanity’s fate! As unexpected sparks fly between them, Gyu-Bin must win Byeol's heart—and save Earth! Will he make it?

(Source: Manta)

While working undercover at Heaven's Harvest Sect, a cult devoted to a so-called god of abundance, journalist Jang Gi-Jun expects the usual lies and fanaticism. Instead, he finds Hui-Sae, a young and eerily serene cult leader forced to "share blessings" through his own body, offering himself to frenzied followers in rituals disguised as salvation. Convinced he's on to a bigger scoop that expected, Gi-Jun watches the lines blur between devotion and exploitation, quickly realizing that the cult’s darkest secrets may lie not in its doctrine, but in what it demands of the one they claim is divine.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Lily’s family chose to sacrifice her freedom, but the infamous Duke Blake has set a trap to ensnare her heart instead. Lily is sent to the duke’s estate like an innocent lamb for slaughter...although Lily’s love already belongs to a handmaid named Anna. At the estate, an uneasiness gnaws at her mind...is there anyone in the world who truly loves her back?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Obstetrician Im Seo-in’s recurring dreams of an unknown man contrast sharply with her passionless marriage. After a car accident, she awakens in 15th-century Joseon as Lady Park, reliving a life eerily mirroring her own, entangled in betrayal and hidden secrets. Meanwhile, divorce attorney Yoo Han-hoon, inexplicably drawn to her, discovers their fates have intertwined across lifetimes. As past and present collide, Seo-in must break the cycle of tragedy or remain forever bound to a cursed fate.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hyunsoo is given the chance to live with his teenage crush. Will he be able to keep his hands to himself?

(Source: Toomics)

Ma Do-Jun is a virgin ghost who wants to transcend into nirvana and part ways with the mortal world forever. The only problem, however, is that the regret of not having lost his virginity before his death is too strong! After spending decades stuck on earth with nowhere to be, he hears a rumor regarding a girl. This girl had sent countless virgin ghosts to nirvana by taking their virginities. Ma Do-Jun decides to pay the girl a visit only to find out she's not such an easy target nor will she cooperate with his mission! Instead, she whips Do-Jun into shape and shows him a world he's never seen before!

(Source: Lezhin US)

 *Note: Part of Bomtoon’s and Lezhin’s Saekgwi Danpyeonseon (색귀 단편선) Collection or Dirty Demon Collection in English.*

Swimming is defined as the art of moving through water using one’s limbs. Yet sometimes, no matter how hard one fights to keep going, they find themselves adrift in a vast ocean; isolated, with no home - and no one - to turn to. This is the story of two men who swim against the currents to reach each other. But as the two dive deeper into the waters of love, will they be swept away by the everpresent tides of change? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

A manipulative man uses vulnerable women for his own gain, hiding behind kindness. Will the true cost of his actions come to light?

(Source: Toomics)

Yuri can’t remember. After a fall on the stairs, her memory has gone blank. But as she starts to put the pieces back together of her former life, she stumbles upon the fact that she apparently dated five guys at once! Now, one by one, she has to figure out who her true love actually is…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Mong-Ryong, a brilliant and stunningly handsome secret royal inspector in Joseon, is sent on his first mission with full confidence. But his destination? None other than Namwon, a region plagued by the notorious pervert governor, Byeon Hakdo.

While trying to expose corruption, Mong-Ryong finds himself in serious trouble—he’s about to be forced into serving the lustful governor. Just when things look dire, a strapping local official, I-Bang, catches his eye.Thinking quickly (and a bit shamelessly), Mong-Ryong grabs I-Bang and declares,

 *“Take responsibility! You’re the one who made me like this!”*

If he’s going to fall into a man’s arms, he figures, he might as well choose the better-looking one.

What starts as a scheme to escape danger soon spirals into chaos, confusion, and unexpected sparks. Will this rookie inspector survive Namwon’s corruption… or lose his heart in the process?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eliana Rose was supposed to have her happily ever after when she married a handsome baron. But after the wedding, she learns the truth about her new husband: he’s in love with another woman. Even worse, the baron’s mistress is none other than his own adopted daughter, Lady Charhen. Heartbroken and betrayed, Eliana devises a master plan to secure her rightful place in high society and save her family. Her path forward is treacherous, but to secure a fortune, a lady must be bold.

(Source: Tapas)

Welcome to the world of stand-up! 

What's the anatomy of a joke? Should you cross the line between funny and offensive? How do top comedians hone their craft, and how did stand-up start in the first place? Dive into the world of humor with your first ever webtoon guide to stand-up comedy! 

(Source: Manta)

Feeling down? Stop by Cunimaru – a cozy shop where souls waiting for reincarnation gather to reminisce about their happiest memories. Savor a warm cup of tea and join Ji-Un Lee, Cunimaru’s new owner, as she embarks on a journey of healing, both for herself and her new friends, while unraveling the mysteries of this whimsical afterlife retreat.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

After his parents remarry, Na-Rim finds himself harboring a forbidden crush on his new stepbrother, Se-Wun. One day, he overhears Se-Wun’s “ideal type” is someone who knows their way around the bedroom - which causes Na-Rim, who doesn’t even have any experience with love or relationships, to panic. Hoping he can teach himself, he impulsively buys a box of sex toys. But when his friend Tae-Hyeon discovers them during a visit, he’s baffled by Na-Rim’s plan…only to make an outrageous offer instead: “Why not practice with me?” Does practice really make perfect, or is Na-Rim’s hope for some action a lost cause?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A mysterious man from the past, one who owes me his life. Yet... just the sight of him... is suffocating.

(Source: Toomics)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

Freshly unmoored from college life and hiding a leave of absence, Yeong-In stumbles into the orbit of Ji-Heon—a solitary bookstore owner who seems to understand him like no one else. But when love blooms, Ji-Heon lays down one unshakable truth: “I want to watch my lover with someone else.” Desperate not to lose the only person who’s ever truly seen him, Yeong-In agrees to a love that hurts—until pain and pleasure begin to blur. In a relationship built on imperfection, how much can you give before you lose yourself completely?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A young girl sold into servitude is given the name "Seo-hye" by Kwon Yoon, the noble son of a powerful family. Despite her lowly status, Seo-hye finds herself drawn to Yoon’s gentle nature, and he, too, begins to fill the void left by his parents’ untimely deaths with her presence. As their forbidden affection blossoms in secret, fate deals a cruel hand. The sudden announcement of Yoon’s arranged marriage shatters the fragile bond between them, setting in motion a tale of love, longing, and the inevitable heartache that shadows their lives.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes a side story.*

*"The empire is at peace only when an empress with brilliant golden locks is at the side of the emperor."*

In the Empire of Oriet, every reign is marked by the birth of a single blonde woman who is worthy of being the emperor’s consort. Thanks to this multiple century-long legend, the empire has prospered. However, unable to obtain a blonde consort, the current emperor was forced to marry a vicous dark-haired empress. Without their blonde beauty, the empire is facing its slow decline. Meanwhile, the second prince, Carlix, loses in the race to become the next emperor. Forced into a marriage to a woman who doesn’t even show up to their wedding, Carlix is made even more furious after being publicly disrespected by her father, the duke. But then, as if by fate, Carlix stumbles upon a stunning blonde beauty. Will he be able to seduce her and steal her throne?

*“Give unto me your heart and body…”*

(Source: Lezhin US)

After suffering frightening spiritual symptoms, Park Sin-Wu undergoes a shamanic ritual and meets Bi-Yeon, the spirit he’s destined to serve. Bi-Yeon is beautiful, demanding, oddly affectionate… and insists that their “union” is the only way to protect Sin-Wu. But as Bi-Yeon grows clingier and Sin-Wu’s doubts deepen, he can’t tell if this god is his guardian or something far more dangerous.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Brian returns to Korea after studying in the US. He is now a baseball player, while his childhood friend is his team's cheerleader.

(Source: Toomics)

Theirs was a purely physical relationship until one of them decided they wanted more.

(Source: Toomics)

It’s bad enough that Team Leader Jeong-Hyun Baek has a thing for his omega subordinate, but when that subordinate is all tangled up with Jeong-Hyun’s beta boss? This love affair can’t possibly end well…

(Source: Tapas)

A succubus has granted me a second chance at life. Each time I sleep with a new girl, she tells me a crucial future event that could change my fate.

(Source: Toomics)

People don’t really change—they just come to understand who they truly are. And sometimes, all it takes is a single day.

(Source: Toomics)

Ho-Joong, the Indomitable Champion, was at the peak of his career as a mixed martial arts fighter when a shoulder injury forced him into early retirement. He then spiraled into a life of addiction and gambling, eventually hitting rock bottom. Burdened with a debt of 700 million won, his wife, who had been managing the interest payments, finally gives up and leaves with their son. When his creditors threaten to take his organs as payment, Ho-Joong encounters a mysterious stranger. The stranger offers Ho-Joong a chance to participate in the "Brutal Cup", the largest underground fighting competition. Unaware of what awaits him, Ho-Joong accepts the offer. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Taenyeo has always been curious about sex but has never had the chance to experience it firsthand. Then, out of the blue, she meets a drop-dead gorgeous man she’s never seen before who insists they're married. To her surprise, he's eager to get to know her...starting with a very physical approach. Intrigued, Taenyeo decides to go with the flow, but things get complicated when another classmate catches her eye. He's equally stunning, with intense eyes and a perfect physique. Torn between two equally attractive men, Taenyeo faces the dilemma of choosing one...but why not try them both before making a decision?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Once a top-tier idol, Ju-Won is now forced to watch as his juniors steal the spotlight. Desperate to save his dying career, he tracks down the high-profile sponsor backing the industry’s rising rookies: Madam Noh. But the woman behind the power isn't interested in the usual games. Stripped of his pride and faced with her cold, direct demands, Ju-Won must decide how far he’s willing to go to stay in the limelight. The stage has changed, and the only audience that matters now is her.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A secret community app exclusively for alphas and omegas—no betas allowed. During the hectic rush hour, a provocative post appears on its anonymous board: "Omega in heat, currently loose on the train to \*\* at XX station. As they say...the early bird gets the worm. Good luck hunting!" As nearby alphas eagerly join the hunt, Haeyoung, caught off guard by an unexpected heat, finds himself trapped in a dangerous game of pursuit. With predators closing in, can he escape before it's too late? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's SS Short Story Collection (SS 단편선) or the Depraved Collection in English.*

When the empress discovers Ji Cheong's feelings for the emperor, he silences her with his blade, sealing his fate as a traitor. Tortured and prepared to die, he faces the emperor with a final lie-that he tried to violate the empress. But instead of execution, he wakes in an unfamiliar palace, trapped behind walls of thorns…

(Source: Lezhin US)

To save her noble family from ruin, Nadia Sordi agrees to an arranged marriage with a stranger. When she goes to meet her future husband, she mistakenly believes it to be a man named Yuri, who convinces her to follow him home. Meanwhile, Pyotr, Nadia's actual prospective partner, arrives late and finds the scantily-clad Katerina waiting for him instead. By the time the four realize they've each met the wrong person, they've already come too far to change...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Despite the constant mistreatment, Ethan still considers himself lucky to be dating Helen, his gorgeous girlfriend. However, his repressed masculinity surfaces every night when a different side of him awakens.

(Source: Toomics)

The phototaxis of living creatures — their instinctive response to light.

After the death of Chairman Jeong Ilhwan of DS Group, the only one left by his side is his cherished young omega lover, Yu Cha-Yeon. Determined to seize full control of the organization, Choi Tae-Mu decides that taking even Jeong’s bonded partner as his own will solidify his power. But Cha-Yeon isn’t what the rumors promised. Far from the mute seductress people describe, he seems strangely innocent—soft in a way Tae-Mu can’t quite understand. And when Cha-Yeon’s heat cycle begins, Tae-Mu gives in to impulse…and sets their fates on a dangerous course.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sae-Yi is happy with Siwan, her sweet, considerate boyfriend. But Zi-Ho, a charming guy from her past, doesn’t bother hiding his interest in her, and she has to admit she feels energized in his presence. Still, she guards her heart. But as her boyfriend becomes increasingly distracted with work and his coworker keeps poking her nose into their relationship, Sae-Yi fears the worst. Feeling lonely even when they’re together, Sae-Yi starts to wonder “what if?” as her heart wanders toward Zi-Ho.

(Source: Tapas) 

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

Choi Kang, a key figure in the notorious “Seven” crime syndicate, reunites with his estranged stepbrother, Choi Leehan. Before they have a chance to mend their fractured bond, Leehan reveals his true identity: an undercover officer determined to dismantle the organization and free Kang from his criminal life. But behind his seemingly noble offer lies a hidden agenda. What could he truly be after?

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.*

display_title: My First Kiss With the Evil Butler
description:
Lady Isla Allandis, a noble lady on the brink of her social debut, is desperate to escape a contractual marriage. She encounters a handsome nobleman, Martin, seemingly the answer to her prayers. Eager for their first kiss to be flawless, Isla seeks guidance from Jade, her trusted butler. As they embark on 'practice kiss,' Isla and Jade feel the tension rising between them. Little does Isla know, Jade harbors secrets of revenge and a past shrouded in shadows.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

display_title: It Wasn’t Supposed to Be Like This
description:
Overwhelmed by the endless affection of her overly clingy boyfriend Se-in, Roha finally decides to call it quits. But when Se-in keeps acting like nothing ever happened, she starts to wonder…are they really broken up, or still together somehow? In the middle of her confusion, Yeonjun suddenly moves in as a boarder - young, hot and secretly in love with Roha for the past ten years. Between an ex who won’t let go and a long-time admirer living under her roof, Roha’s love life is about to spiral completely out of control. It really wasn't supposed to be like this...

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.*

Eun Pyo-Eum, the leader of the failed idol group Moses, is desperate for a comeback. When a mysterious sponsorship deal offers him a lifeline, there’s just one problem: he has chronic erectile dysfunction. Seeking help from the nation's top urologist, Professor Han Girip, Pyo-Eum finds that standard medicine won't cut it. To fix his condition, he agrees to participate in Girip’s new experimental therapy...a treatment that quickly turns into a series of (quite literally) shocking encounters.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Tired of my life, I decided to end things. But when I woke up, I was in the body of a successful good-looking dude... What the...

(Source: Toomics)

Hailed as the Pure-White Princess, Princess Celine bears a dreadful curse. When she comes of age, her white hair will turn scarlet, and her kingdom will drown in blood. Resigned to her fate, she meaninglessly drifts through life until she meets the enigmatic yet gentle Duke Weinberg, who awakens her desire and rekindles her will to live. But as their bond deepens, so do her doubts. Who is he truly? What lies behind his love? And what will become of her kingdom that's bound to her cursed fate?

(Source: Tapas)

After a nasty breakup, Su-Yeon can’t stop thinking about the awful things her ex said to her. Is she really that bad in bed? Luckily, she recently reconnected with Ki-Hyuk, her older brother’s handsome friend, and he has advice to offer on all kinds of things–including how to have fun in the bedroom.

(Source: Manta)

Prince Cho Yi-Hyeon is forced to remain in the imperial palace of a foreign land for three long years. The emperor awaiting him, Tae Won, is rumored to be a merciless despot, yet he greets Yi-Hyeon with unexpected innocence and charm. But that gentleness doesn’t last. Beneath the smile lies obsession, and Tae Won’s growing fixation leaves Yi-Hyeon frightened and confused. Separated from his family and slowly losing himself, Yi-Hyeon begins to fade.

Can love - or survival - exist under an emperor’s twisted devotion, in a palace swallowed by a moonless night?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes seven extra chapters.*

Born to rich parents. Eun-Yeong seemingly had a perfect life, but all she ever wanted was her parents' approval. Then one day, an encounter with one of her father's employees drags her deep into an endless pit of desire... She knows this can only lead to her own destruction, but can't seem to walk away...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Ethan, an author of children's books, travels to a coastal village rumored to be home to mermaids in search of inspiration for a new story. After an unexpected fall into the sea, he stumbles upon a mysterious pearl—one that grants him the ability to breathe underwater. Excited by his discovery, Ethan eagerly plans to use it as the basis for his next book. But that night, the true owner of the pearl emerges from the depths. The mermaid forcefully claims what is his—and offers Ethan a deal he can’t refuse…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sometimes, there's that one person you've always dreamed of... And as luck would have it, now I get my chance.

(Source: Toomics)

I was out shopping for books one day when I was suddenly attacked! But a heaven-sent woman by the name of Chrisya Saldo took it upon herself to save me. She's beautiful, strong, and independent--I want to see her thrive, but she's being forced to marry to save her family business. I can't let some man lock her away--I am Diane of House Harp! My mother is a marquess! I have resources, I have money! Don't worry--I'll save you, my angel!

(Source: Tapas)

Jang Gwon-U, the illegitimate youngest son of the powerful Myeonghwa Group, is its one glaring stain—a troublemaker with devilish good looks but little else to recommend him. By his constant side is Hong Se-Ha, his ever-loyal, and workaholic, secretary. She has always genuinely and wholeheartedly assisted him and stood by his side. Against all logic, Se-Ha wanted him. No matter what. But a whispered, "Kiss me," blurs their boundaries, intertwining their bodies. Will Gwon-U and Se-Ha succeed in obtaining their captivating happily-ever-after?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

It all starts beneath a treadmill with a suspicious stain that definitely does not belong there. Yonggeun Fitness is one of the most popular personal training gyms in Seongwang-gu District, and its night class in particular is so sought after that male members compete fiercely to get in. When the building’s owner, Seon Bin, discovers a strange residue left behind after one of these late night sessions, he begins to investigate what really goes on after hours in Seongwang-gu. What he uncovers is far from ordinary training. The so called night class turns out to be a secret hotspot where workouts are merely a cover for something far more indecent. Furious that such shameless behavior is happening under his roof, Seon Bin vows to put an end to it no matter what it takes.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ace Lampard has it all- looks, charm, grades, and the attention of the entire school. He sits at the top of every social and academic ladder. That is, until a new transfer student, Colin McCarthy, unexpectedly takes the top academic spot and turns everything upside down. Colin is shy, awkward, and completely out of place. After Ace steps in to protect him from bullies, Colin becomes infatuated and starts following him in secret. When Ace catches on, Colin prepares himself for rejection. Instead, he hears something completely unexpected.

 *“Be my Secret lover, Colin...”* 

What begins as a strange proposal slowly unravels into something much more dangerous. He isn’t just an ordinary student with a crush. He has a reason for being here, and Ace is only the beginning.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Struggling to make ends meet, Kang-I works endless part-time jobs until one evening at a high-profile party leads to a reckless one-night encounter with a rude chaebol heir who mistakes him for someone else. Planning to enjoy it once and walk away, Kang-i is stunned to realize the man is actually his childhood friend, the one he parted from on bitter terms years ago. This time, the past refuses to stay buried, and what was meant to be a fleeting reunion turns into an intense game of obsession, desire, and feelings neither of them ever resolved.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Princess of the powerful Daham Group, Je-In lives in luxury—until icy, mysterious Chung-Jo becomes her bodyguard for reasons he won’t reveal. Forced to live under the same roof, cold walls crack and dangerous sparks fly. Guarding her was never part of his plan. Falling for her? Even less.

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes one prologue chapter.*

Michael is put in charge of Nara Bank's VIPs, but word has it that he offers them more than just the bank's savings accounts.

(Source: Toomics)

Fed up with being treated like a child, Ye-Seo Han asks her husband, Ji-Heon Seo, for a divorce on the day she graduates from college. Although Ye-Seo wanted to move on from her first love, Ji-Heon refuses and instead offers to truly show her what being husband and wife is all about.

(Source: Manta)

Haru swore off dating colleagues, but still agrees to see Seungwon three times when he asks. But when she’s released from the hospital after an accident, Haru is asked to watch over Jungwoo, who was in the same incident. As she and Jungwoo warm up to each other, Haru finds her thoughts straying to him when she's with Seungwon. As if her life wasn’t complicated enough already!

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

display_title: Seductive Curves: The Waxing Shop Managers
description:
Jinchul Choi hesitates when his friend, the waxing shop owner, asks him to be a model for staff training. Tempted by the generous pay, he agrees to participate. However, when he discovers that all the trainees are women, he can't help but get aroused during the waxing session…

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/uplmscg/episode/toon/8248), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12213872), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/5700000015), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000069279), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=250233), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=jrdr), [Qtoon](https://www.qtoon.co.kr/toon/list.mg?tcode=991y), Metoon

**Official Translations:**  
English ([Toomics](https://toomics.com/en/webtoon/episode/toon/8248), HoneyToon), [B.Portuguese](https://toomics.com/por/webtoon/episode/toon/8248)

Memories of a rainy day... the day my life came to a halt. And on a rainy day... my life may take a turn...

(Source: Toomics)

Revered by his comrades, Seo Seung-Bum was once a man of unwavering strength. But when Hwang Jii-Hyuk uncovers his darkest secret, Seung-Bum becomes powerless against him. Stripped of control, he is forced into a world of torment—drugged, violated, and reshaped under the guise of twisted pleasure. As Ji-Hyuk’s cruel obsession spirals deeper, Seung-Bum struggles to grasp what his captor truly wants. Trapped in a cycle of pain and desire, he fights to survive each day… not knowing if escape is even possible.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

display_title: I Vow to Take the Tyrant's Throne
description:
Joo-Hyun Mo, CEO, has a big day ahead, and is awaiting her big break, when she gets into a car accident. She wakes up, but is reborn as the third daughter of the evil emperor, Mezan Nox. Without a clue as to why this has happened, Mo lives as Gloria for seven years before she finally gains a clue into a magic portal that could help her go back to her world. She is determined to play the part of docile sister to evil father and mini-me daughter, Isabelle, while also looking up to her oldest half-sister, Dorothy. With the help of a prince from another country Rubilion's Autus, she finally passes through the portal, only to be met by an even more impossible deal: she must sell her soul and succeed in seeing her father fall to his miserable death, just as the real Gloria wished before she died. She has one shot to succeed, and to go back to her own world.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

An ex-boxer’s condition makes him irresistible to women, turning his boxing gym into the stage for intense encounters.

(Source: Toomics)

*“Once I grow up, I am going to marry you, Yi-Chan!”*

From childhood, Seo Eu-Na adored his next door neighbor Kang Yi-Chan with absolute devotion. He followed him everywhere, chased off anyone who tried to get close to him, regardless of whether they were male or female, and declared him his future husband to anyone who would listen. To Yi-Chan, he was just a clingy little brother figure, unbearably persistent and impossible to shake off. So the moment he entered university, he disappeared from Eu-Na's life entirely, convinced he had finally escaped. Three years pass, and Yi-Chan returns from military service relieved that the nightmare is over. Until the first day of class. There, in his major lecture, sits a bright eyed freshman, smiling directly at him. Seo Eu-Na. He has grown up, followed him to the same university, and looks more determined than ever. This time, Yi-Chan might not be able to run.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*"Sunbae…! I want you now!"*

This is it. After having a hopeless crush on him for three years...it's all finally over. Or so I thought.

*"I’ve changed my mind. Go out with me."*

Three years of rejection, and all it took was one night in bed? Unbelievable. Furious, I walked away…and didn’t look back. But now, that arrogant sunbae has reappeared, asking for my help.

*"No need for money. Why don't you convince me with your body instead?"

"Are you sure you won’t regret it?"

"Are you any better in bed now?"*

What started as a challenge—payback for the man who once crushed my pride—quickly turns into something far more dangerous. This time, who will be the one in control? Let’s find out.

(Source: Lezhin US)

I decided to leave my hometown to start a new life in the city. But never could I have known what it had in store for me... 

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: Devouring the Goose Dad Next Door
description:
Yoon-Cheol, a 36-year-old “goose dad” living alone while his wife and daughter study abroad, has endured two years of solitude—but what’s truly driving him mad are the relentless moans coming from the apartment next door. After months of tortured nights, he finally loses it and bangs on his neighbor’s door mid-climax. Bad idea. Seung-Hoon, a bold and mischievous 24-year-old college athlete, isn’t the least bit sorry—in fact, he’s now hell-bent on teasing the uptight older man even more. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes 5 side story chapters.*

Jane's father dies, leaving her to live with her stepmother who seems to invite various men over to their house during the day.

(Source: Toomics)

Once a princess, Ethelyn died at the hands of the merciless Duke Ripherius. Now reborn as a maid in his household—and worse, as his secret lover—she finds herself the object of his twisted affection. But as she plots her escape, one question haunts her: what if her death was never what it seemed?

(Source: Manta)

display_title: When the Curse Strikes at Midnight
description:
Only a small fraction of the world gets a flashy, impressive power, but even that’s more common than not having one. Before she knows it, Joori Ahn is almost through her twenties and still powerless. She tells herself that’s better than getting a weird one—something the universe must have taken as a challenge. This isn’t just any weird power; this is a curse! Except, if her clothes transforming in front of her crush gets him to finally notice her, who could blame her for testing the waters?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes seven extra chapters.*

After being struck by lightning, Ted wakes up to a new life and a new body.

(Source: Toomics)

When the timid Winter accidentally sends Joo-Han a nude meant for her boyfriend, an unexpected connection is formed between them, eventually culminating in them living together. 

Will this unlikely pair be able to live together in peace—and perhaps even love?

(Source: Manta)

Yoon Ji-Ha, a struggling actor who’s been dreaming of winning people’s affection for six years, has never even passed an audition. Haunted by a mysterious illness that foretells misfortune, he feels increasingly isolated. But when Song Chae-Heon, a secretive, powerful agency director, offers to make him a star, Ji-Ha is torn on what to do. Despite Chae-Heon’s arrogance, Ji-Ha feels an inexplicable pull toward him. What does Chae-Heon truly want, and why is he fixated on Ji-Ha’s potential?

(Source: Tapas)

Lee Su-in has lived a life full of hardship, with no family and barely enough to get by. One day, she's suddenly swept into a contract marriage with Cha Dojun: CEO of the powerful LN Group and her childhood acquaintance. Having secretly harbored feelings for him for years, Su-in thought just being his wife would be enough; but Dojun is cold, distant, and doesn’t even step foot into their newlywed home. When Su-in finally reaches her breaking point and decides to end the marriage, Dojun begins to change…little by little. Could the love she dreamed of finally begin to bloom?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jeong Nan-Woo, a world-renowned violin prodigy, overcame a troubled childhood to rise to global fame. Yet despite his success, he remains trapped in layers of emotional darkness he can’t seem to escape. Enoch Milligan, a charming Hollywood heartthrob known more for his looks than his acting skills, is desperate to prove himself as more than just a pretty face. The two seem to share nothing in common—until a film project brings them together. Enoch is cast as the lead in a movie based on Nan-Woo’s life and insists on shadowing him to prepare for the role, ignoring Nan-Woo’s initial discomfort. As Enoch stays by his side—warm, passionate, and unexpectedly gentle—Nan-Woo’s walls slowly begin to crack. The closer they grow, the more Nan-Woo begins to rediscover beauty, trust, and a light he thought he’d lost forever. Sometimes, healing begins with simply letting someone in.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Leo goes on a holiday to a cabin resort with his two female childhood friends, Misty and Jody, but becomes snowbound.

**Original Webtoon:**     
[Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/uplmscg/episode/toon/7913), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12158486), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/5700000009), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000069286), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=250236) 

**Official Translations:**  
English ([Toomics](https://toomics.com/en/webtoon/episode/toon/7913/), HoneyToon), [S.Chinese](https://toomics.com/sc/webtoon/episode/toon/7913), [T.Chinese](https://toomics.com/tc/webtoon/episode/toon/7913), [Spanish (LA)](https://toomics.com/mx/webtoon/episode/toon/7913), [Italian](https://toomics.com/it/webtoon/episode/toon/7913), [Spanish (ES)](https://toomics.com/es/webtoon/episode/toon/7913), [B.Portuguese](https://toomics.com/por/webtoon/episode/toon/7913/), [French](https://toomics.com/fr/webtoon/episode/toon/7913), [German](https://toomics.com/de/webtoon/episode/toon/7913), [Japanese](https://toomics.com/ja/webtoon/episode/toon/7913/), [Thai](https://www.lezhinth.com/detail/thwt_4014)

In the 22nd century, even in a world where reproduction is no longer possible, humanity still craves sex. Akana runs a shop called LOVE & JOY in a city overflowing with artificial pleasures, catering to every kind of desire with no judgment. From obsession and public exposure to the darkest, most secret cravings, she’s here to make your wildest kinks 200% real.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The magic tree that grows in Tate's hometown always existed as a safeguard from evil entities and creatures. That is, until Tate came across a runaway slave and began nursing him back to health. Suddenly, this strange man's presence causes a chain of even stranger events to occur, including an attack on the town's magic tree!

(Source: Tapas)

For generations, the power of the Imugi has been passed down to the nation’s sacred Oracle—a divine protector of peace and balance. But for the young Oracle Ho-Yeong, that power remains dormant. Cast aside as a failure within the palace, he finds solace only in Chi Woo, the noble heir of the prestigious House of Chi. One night, Ho-Yeong stumbles upon Chi Woo in a forbidden tryst—and with it, awakens a feeling he's never known. As secrets unfurl behind silk screens and sacred duty collides with dangerous desire, Ho-Yeong's path as the Oracle may lead to more than just prophecy… it may unearth a destiny no one saw coming.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeon-geon Baek has harbored a crush on his best friend, Eihwa Yoon, for years, but he’s finally had enough rejection. Determined to get away, he starts planning his leave to study abroad. He’s spent too many years hiding behind castle walls built of secrets. However, the more he tries to distance himself, the more his secrets are pulled out into the open.
Maybe when it’s over, things will be better, and maybe… he’ll be able to have what he’s always wanted. 

(Source: Tapas)

Sally is a beautiful girl, fresh out of college, who wants nothing more than to have sex. On her journey, she meets fourteen men with whom she fails to have sex, but on her fifteenth try...

(Source: Toomics)

After breaking up with a boyfriend who disrespected her career, Ji-Won spends a drunken night with a man who seems like a stranger. But he turns out to be a figure from her past – and now he's back in her life in a way she never expected, for better or worse.

(Source: Manta)

The talented and hardworking Bitt Geum learns her fiancé cheated—just a month before their wedding! Desperate and furious, she proposes to rookie developer Haneul to spite her ex, only to find out he’s the brother of her company's CEO. Just how will this chaotic office relationship turn out?

(Source: Manta)

19 years ago, Jung-Won took in a scrawny girl named Hye-Jun, seemingly abandoned in the middle of the road, out of pity. It began as mere compassion, but what he couldn't have realized back then... was that this pitiful girl would become the woman who would steal his heart.

(Source: Manta)

Bom is trying to move on from her first love by focusing on work and her budding new relationship with her friend, Dongwook. But something seems... off. She can’t seem to give him her heart. When her ex, Joonyoung, suddenly comes back into her life, the cracks truly begin to show. Dongwook’s affection warps into obsession. But just as Bom starts to question how things ended up like this, a mysterious camera arrives on her doorstep with the promise of magical snapshots that will reveal the truth.

(Source: Tapas)

There are animals that were abandoned by Dangun and live secretly in the human world. Narae, an ordinary high school student, discovers their existence... A modern version of Beauty and the Beast with comedy and exorcism action. 

*‘Will the project of becoming human, for the animals that could not become human, be successful?'* 

(Source: Naver, translated)

Halo, the greatest musician of his time, gets into a car accident on his way to the Grammy Awards. When he comes to, he finds himself in the body of a young Korean boy named Noh Hae-Il. He is left in a place where the surroundings and the times are different. After confirming that Noh Hae-Il's English name is Halo, he feels a strong sense of destiny. Halo enters Hae-Il. He demonstrates his genius even in this era.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Lee Myeong-Jun, Vice Chairman of Hyundo Group, lost his daughter to the Iljin group. For revenge, he adopts Yoon Ga-Ram, a psychopathic North Korean defector. She is a sadistic human weapon born after North Korea's drug experiments. A psychopath girl who killed everyone at the lab and escaped North Korea alone. Yoon Ga-Ram has just been released from a juvenile detention center in South-Korea. 

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

Kang Hyeon, who was ashamed of his poor family, cut off ties with those around him and studied desperately to achieve success, but eventually he realized that his ideals were wrong. To make matters worse, Hyeon, who has cancer, gets run over while trying to save someone who fell on the subway tracks, and returns to the past while listening to the melody of a symphony. Hyeon, who was determined not to live the same life as before, realizes that he has tremendous musical talent... 

(Source: Naver, translated)

"Unique Ability: Resurrection"
“What is this? This damn sweet Munchkin skill?”
But Kang Hyun didn’t know.
What does it mean to not die, even if you die, even if you want to die…
A man who became the most notorious hunter on Earth with an immortal body!
For the sake of humanity, no, for the sake of humanity’s survival, Today, I alone will be resurrected! 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Kang Jin-hoo gains an extraordinary ability to foresee the future after a life-changing accident during his military service. Armed with this unique power, he dives into the world of investments, targeting companies and financial markets to amass wealth and become the world’s top investor. But his vision extends beyond just making money. Kang Jin-hoo’s foresight begins to influence the global economy, political systems, major corporations, and even the course of globalization itself. Now, with his sights set on reshaping the world of finance and beyond, he is about to rewrite the rules of the future.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Wang Dam left his hometown and came to Seoul without a plan. In order to receive settlement funds, he had to be the top student in his entire school! However, the school he was transferring to was a so-called 'hard-working' school filled with the worst students who only bothered him when he studied... Will Wang Dam be able to become the top student in his entire school in the worst environment?

(Source: Naver, translated)

202X. In the back alleys of Seoul, South Korea… He looked down at the heroes under his feet—the heroes who adorned themselves in a variety of colorful clothes, as if they were K-pop idols on TV. Those heroes? They were crawling beneath him, their gaudy outfits smeared with dirt. That was the true nature of being a hero. He hoped the individuals before him learned that lesson well. It was time to ensure they never forgot it. As a magical girl, he swung his hammer down. This is a bright story. The story of a man reclaiming his light.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

During his innocent and ignorant high school days, Suyeong had a very awkward first kiss with his first love, Chaeri. Before he could resolve the misunderstanding, Chaeri transferred to another school, and years passed by, with his first love buried in his heart. After completing his military service, Suyeong goes to an opening party and encounters Chaeri, who had come in as a transfer student. He is swayed by Chaeri’s advances and realizes he’s in for a surprise…

*”What would you do if I gave you a chance to make up for it?”*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
“Why do you keep asking if we’re dating? We’re just holding hands, we’re not dating!!” It’s a slice-of-life romantic comedy about couples who aren’t really couples!

display_title: Surviving in a Romance Fantasy Novel
description:
I, Seo Tae-Pyung, ended up transmigrating as the younger brother of the heroine in the fantasy romance novel Celestial Love. As romantic as this place is supposed to be, I was too busy just trying to adapt to my new life. Romance? Yeah, right. My goal was to keep a low profile and live quietly… But then… “How could you make the crown princess fall for you of all people?!” At that point, I had no idea. I was only just beginning to scrape the surface of this bizarre turn of events…

(Source: Kakao Page, translated)

Seol Moo-dok, a master of Hyeon-gyeong who became the lord of the North Sea Ice Palace at the age of four, was in a state of sorrow after his lover died. He realized that his dead lover was reincarnated through the legendary flower, Yeonri-hwa, and wandered around until he fell into another world... 

(Source: Naver, translated) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

National Intelligence Service black ops agent Suhyeok is tasked with assassinating Nanayama, the Yakuza leader heading a drug trafficking organization in Korea. To his surprise, the target is a captivating woman named Anna, who appears disconnected from any violence. Sensing something amiss with his mission, Suhyeok embarks on a path of vengeance against both the National Intelligence Service, which has betrayed him, and Nanayama, who massacred his comrades. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

The bullied loser Kim Jae-Hyeok receives 'Top 1 Fighting Tutoring'!

Kim Jae-Hyeok is a high school student who has been living in despair under the torment of bullies. He's good at studying, but he'd rather be good at fighting.

Then, as if by fate, a 'fighting tutor' comes into his life!

(Source: Naver, translated)

The long-term public service exam candidate, Minseo, finds himself trapped in the game, “Raising Lena” as he tries to escape his grim reality. In the game, Minseo becomes a character named Leo, and he must navigate through a world with three different scenarios to accomplish his mission of turning the protagonist, Lena, into a princess. However, the game “Raising Lena” boasts an overwhelming level of difficulty due to enemies who are set to thwart Minseo with their immense power and influence. Will Minseo be able to complete the game by making Lena a princess and return to reality?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Actually, I didn't want to be a teacher. I gave up my dream and was about to take responsibility for the path I chose, when a cocky boy said, "Would you like to lend me a light?". My life as a teacher seems to be going awry as I get entangled with this cocky kid who has genius talent, overflowing wealth, and fame. A story about school life intertwined with dreams, talent, and love.

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: Become a Legend as an All-Rounder
description: Kim Tae-Seok, who worked on a construction site, receives a notice of passing the document screening for the major company El Sung. At the same time, a message pops up in front of him: 'You have entered the path to becoming a regular employee tutorial. Would you like to proceed?' Follow Kim Tae-Seok's struggle to become the legendary all-around employee in this corporate adventure!

Only music sustained me from the maddening pain. If only I could hear my music... with my own ears... Even as my soul was falling apart, I prayed to God... and prayed again. Ludwig van Beethoven, considered the greatest composer in human history, closed his eyes like that. And 180 years later in Seoul. The saint of music, known as an immortal genius, has been reborn. And then he began to hear the voice of an angel. "Dobin... Dobin..."

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Yeon-Hwa dreams of mingling with a snake every night. She started having that dream on the day she saved a snake that was about to die. Then, Yeon-Hwa is captured by the villagers and offered as a sacrifice to the snake god Mu-Gae. Yeon-Hwa pleads with the snake god, saying she wants to live, but Mu-Gae immediately realizes that she is the Yeon-Hwa who saved him.

 *“I want to be with you, Yeon-Hwa. I want to touch you.”* 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: First story of RIDI's Dopamine Danpyeonseon (도파민 단편선) Collection.*

The scenery before the eldest son of the family head looked like it was from 500 years ago, during the Joseon Dynasty.

*“To go back, I have to be with a widow?!”*

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Since the old days, mystical creatures have existed to help humans. However, now that the times have changed, they suddenly receive a warning from their god: "Prove that you are still needed." 

While grappling with how they can assist humans in the modern era, these creatures decide to send their younglings to the human world to seek answers. 

Meanwhile, university student Park Geu-Ru, who lives his miserable days commuting for five hours to school due to a sudden move, accidentally ends up making a bet with the goblin Si-Han... 

This is a story about the daily life of these young mystical creatures, exploring the human world in order to avoid their own extinction. 

(Source: Kakaopape, translated)

display_title: A Bowl of Salty, Gnarly Dice
description:
Do you think you can conquer the entire martial arts world with just one bowl of Jajangmyeon? The protagonist dreamed of becoming the best Chinese chef, but was sent to the Song Dynasty in China! However, when he woke up, there was no martial arts at all, and all that was left was the cooking skills he had learned in his previous life. But these dishes... the response is very good! In this life , will he be able to captivate Jungwon with Jjajangmyeon and live a successful second life?

(Source: Naver, translated)

“If I were given another chance...” 

10 years after the apocalypse began on Earth, while he faced imminent death, Yoohyun was filled with regret. Just then, a bright light descended upon him. When he opened his eyes, he was greeted by an unfamiliar scene. Not only had he reincarnated as a non-human race called “Teller,” but he had also traveled back in time by 10 years! 

“Now that it has come to this, I’ll live my best life this time! ” 

Unlike his previous life, where he was solely focused on survival, he is now determined to lead a successful life. In this new life he has gained, will Yoohyun truly be able to become the protagonist? 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Im Da-Jun became the leader of the runaway family after being kicked out of his house. Yeon-Woo, who he took in by chance, ends up in a knife assault in Yeonsu-gu, Incheon. The one who stopped Yeon-Woo from getting his revenge against the chaebol chairman was Yun Ga-Min, whose dream is to become a good student. Meanwhile, Na Hwa-Jin takes an interest and watches over them...

display_title: The Saint Dreams of a Secret Love
description:
Leah suddenly becomes a saint. She lives in seclusion in the temple attached to the Academy where she is temporarily entrusted before being announced to the world as a saint after 50 years, but then meets a man in the Academy's quiet Third Library and has a secret meeting...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Hamaru works as a detective at a livestock company. One day, he goes on a business trip to Japan at the recommendation of his boss, but the place is a Yakuza crime syndicate. While struggling to survive there, he gradually realizes his talent for using a sword. A detective who has stepped into the shadows challenges the top of the underworld in order to survive.

(Source: Naver, translated)

An American third-generation chaebol, with an attractive appearance and a devilish man who is always surrounded by people, Leon has been living a debaucherous life, seeking new stimulation. After his father's unbearable scolding, he came to an unfamiliar land of Korea and was tied down by the company, living a boring daily life. Then, he meets Woo-Joo, a new bodyguard who is supposed to watch over him. The sculpted face is just his style, and his unusual atmosphere piques his curiosity, which leads him to play mischievous pranks. However, Woo-Joo is not afraid of his owner, Leon, but rather does not follow orders well and even shows a ferocious attitude...!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

display_title: A Rookie, Also an Actor With 10+ Million Viewers
description:
Mu-Yeong spent his childhood under his stepfather’s oppressive rule, a life that felt like living in hell. A mysterious voice in the living hell showed him the way to survive. 

*“Live someone else’s life instead of yours.”* 

That’s how his acting journey began… Was it a survival instinct? Even when he did well, he excelled too much. Through acting, Mu-Yeong gained a new life. This is the story of Mu-Yeong, the overwhelming acting genius, embarking on a challenge in the entertainment industry! 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*The creaky cooperation between Su-Hwa, a goblin who hates humans, and Lee-Ho, who loves humans, begins.*

Su-Hwa, a brush goblin who lost her family and power due to human betrayal. When she meets the foolish grand prince Lee-Ho by chance, she finds that her strength has been restored and decides to grant his wish to fully restore her strength. The wish of the foolish young man Lee Ho, who laughs and calls himself the neighborhood drummer, is to reveal the truth about his mother's death. The shaky cooperation between Su-Hwa, who hates humans, and Lee Ho, who loves humans, begins, but as they spend more time together, memories of her past life begin to come to Su-Hwa's mind little by little. Those are also painful and painful memories related to Lee-Ho...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: Became a Childhood Friend of the Mid-Boss
description:
Do Kyunwoo is the black sheep of his renowned swordsman family. He cannot even catch a rabbit on his own. On his first day of fifth grade, he meets a tranfer student and recalls his past life. He had reincarnated into the world of a game he used to play called \[Brave Hearts\]. He was already frustrated that he had reincarnated as a loser, but on top of that, the transfer student is an intermediate/mid-tier boss who will destroy the world! 

*“Why are you being so nice to me?”* 

*“Because I want to be friends with you.”* 

Do Kyunwoo’s plan is to become friends with the transfer student in order to prevent the end of the world! In order to survive in this new world and to reach an ending he desires. He becomes best friends with the mid level boss.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*“You’ll get hurt if you’re close to him.”
“I don’t know why he’s so unlucky.”
“Yeonjae, I’m scared of you…”*

Lee Yeonjae, avoided by everyone as if just being near him beings misfortune. Even he thinks it’s weird. Why do bad things only happen around me? I wonder how it feels to live a life of being loved and not hurting those around me. But, was even wishing for that too much? —Bam!! After an accident, I woke up in a strange place facing a mysterious entity.

*“Strange. You should’ve died according to your fate, so why are you still alive?”*

One truth I learned after meeting that entity is, I can avoid misfortune if I act like someone else. To survive, I have to become an actor.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A fantastic duo of a political master and a complete novice! I’m Gu Yeongjin, a six-term congressman — the pinnacle of South Korea’s political world, the nation’s hope! One fateful day in 2008, betrayed by my closest aides, I faced a special investigation and chose to end my own life. When I opened my eyes… it was Seoul, 10 years in the past?! Now a ghost, no one can see me or hear my voice. No one... except one person, Cha Jaerim, a 25-year-old Level 9 civil servant. No connections, no money, stuck in miserable circumstances... But look at that ambition, that fire in his eyes... I like it! Fine. I’ll make him my partner.

*“You need to go into politics.”*

And I’ll get my revenge. A political genius ghost, Gu Yeongjin, teams up with a clueless rookie, Cha Jaerim, for the ultimate combo in

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Kang Tae-han, known as the Heavenly Demon (Cheonma), whose power once reached the skies, returns to his original life after 60 years!

*“Wow… in such a blessed era, and my body’s in this state?”

“Your body’s screaming for help, but are you not hearing it?”*

The physical and mental recovery project of the old-fashioned, grumpy(?) Heavenly Demon Kang Tae-han begins!! For the exhausted office worker drowned in alcohol and overtime, for the athlete whose body is broken and performance is failing, for the head of the family crushed under the weight of life, for modern people filling themselves with fat just to survive— All you weary souls of modern life, come get a massage!

(Source: Naver, translated)

"Kang Sung-Won" loved me since I was a child and I don't even remember. I'm still too young to talk about love and I'm not sure. Sung-Won always expresses love confidently. Will there be a change with Sung-Won's pheromones? If I only express as omega, then I'll be able to accept everything naturally...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

display_title: Life in a One Room Apartment With the Saintess
description:
I'm back, Saintess." "Welcome, Warrior." The Saintess always welcomes me with a smile when I open the door after returning home after a hard day. The Warrior and the Saintess meet again after crossing dimensions. The ordinary and calm daily story of two men and women who create a future together in a small single room.

(Source: Onestory, translated)

display_title: My Grades Will Fall if There's No Male Lead
description:
*"It's amazing enough that I've reincarnated, but now I'm stuck as an extra in a romantic comic?!"*

Han Ji-seo, a K-high school student, has unexpectedly become an extra who is perpetually ranked second in a romantic comic. No matter what she does, she's always second in her class and has no significant role... What luck! Thanks to this, Ji-seo has been living her days without worrying about studying. However, she suddenly ends up with the lowest score on a surprise quiz. What's different this time is the absence of Joo Yi-won, the male lead who is always ranked first! To get into university, the male lead must be present at school. The goal is to ensure the male lead's perfect attendance! Now, Ji-seo will start her plan to maintain the male lead's peaceful school life!!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: In the Words of the Beloved Sun
description:
One shall become a king, and the other shall become a sacrifice for the king. On the day Crown Princes Tae Chan-Ryang and Tae Ho-Wol were born, a prophecy descended from the heavens. Who will be the one to survive?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Eunuch Lee Cheolsu is a secret power figure who controls the affairs of the empire at will. He possesses absolute power, wealth, and even strong martial arts skills... but what does that mean? If he can't do "that"! Through a reincarnation technique, Cheolsu returns to the time before he became a eunuch. He has one goal in mind: to become an alpha male and enjoy life with the most beautiful women!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Kyuhyun accidentally comes out when he unintentionally sends a photo of himself kissing his (ex-)boyfriend to a group chat. Panicked, he thinks, "I'm screwed. Someone already saw it." Unable to sleep properly and filled with fear, he walks into the lecture hall, only to meet Kibum’s intense gaze. "Hey, what time does your class end today?" That simple question marks the beginning of more frequent encounters between them. As they spend more time together, Kyuhyun’s fear gradually turns into excitement, and the atmosphere between them starts shifting in an unexpected direction. "Go out with me. I'll become the person you love." 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

display_title: Although He Is the #1 Healer on the Server, He Cannot Heal
description: *Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

*"Is this really Joseon?! Even so, we must save lives!"*
