display_title: I'm a Martial Arts Supporting Character, Can You Raise Me?
description:
In my past life, I struggled through countless part-time jobs, only to suffer a head injury in an unexpected accident. But when I opened my eyes, instead of a hospital ceiling, I see a traditional Eastern-style house? That’s right! I’ve reincarnated into the novel "The Noble Sons of the Namgung Clan," the very book I was reading before I died! Of all places, I woke up in a crazy story where people drop like flies… And worse, I’m a villainous side character who gets abandoned by her family and is the first to die a meaningless death! Fine. With all the experience I gained from my past-life jobs, I’ll escape this house before I meet my doom. Wait, what? Every time I show off my skills, the main characters start falling for me? The cold-hearted older brothers, the vengeful cult leader, even the tragic crown prince—all of them are getting tangled up with me! If the story follows the original plot, everyone is doomed to a bad ending... Alright! If it’s come to this, I’ll save them all. A well-raised side character can save many lives!!

(Source: Naver, translated)

As a member of the HN Group's secretary pool, Seo Yu-Jin prides herself on being able to handle all sorts of difficult situations. One day, the company president himself gives Yu-Jin a new assignment, to become the personal assistant for Jin Tae-Oh, the president's younger brother. Yu-Jin doesn't know anything about the third-son of the Jin family, but she has a bad feeling about this… 

"It won't be a hard job. Just keep him out of trouble." 

Yu-Jin should've ran away when she heard those words, but the president offered her too much money to refuse! When she meets him at the airport, her first impression of him seems good… so they say he's like a wild beast? Now it's up to her to tame that wild, ruthless, but loyal animal! 

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

Jay, the protagonist, is influenced by the donor's memories and habits after a heart transplant. He coincidentally meets Arthur, the donor's ex-lover and a member of a criminal organization, and gets involved in the underworld. He can only return home if he remembers where the items stolen by Owen, the heart donor, are located... A rival organization constantly engages in sabotage and a series of incidents and accidents ensue. Jay and Arthur gradually become closer as they overcome crises together. Will the two be able to return to their daily lives safely?

The strongest weapon ordered from the future has arrived.

Kim Jun, director of the Agency for Defense Development. In 2024, after a terrorist attack, he meets a tragic end while protecting the South Korean military secret, the ADD chip. However, upon regaining consciousness, he finds himself presented with an unexpected opportunity. He is reborn in the body of his friend Jeon Hyeon-Seung, who died in 1998! Using the ADD chip implanted in his body, Kim Jun gains access to future technologies.

 *"If you give me the chance... I'll create it for you within three months."*

Use future technology to create the ultimate weapon to overcome the IMF crisis!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

*"You guys use fists, not guns!"*

Shin Hae-Soo, a specialist in excessive suppression, gains the ability to go back 60 minutes. On the day my father passed away, I intuitively knew. This was a murder disguised as suicide. Hae-Soo becomes a detective to catch the culprit who killed his father. And one day, along with a mysterious accident, he suddenly gains superpowers! A huge shadow gradually reveals itself as he solves criminal cases and pursues the organization!

A necromancer is a profession considered the noble of nobles, with less than 1,000 in the population worldwide! I was born with a diamond spoon, no, a necromancer spoon in my mouth! ...Or so I thought.

*"I'm just a defective necromancer."*

\[Using skill, "Summon Ordinary Skeleton" (E-rank).\]

You'd think a necromancer should be able to summon liches, Dullahans, or death knights. But nope, I can only summon skeletons. But then one day, suddenly...

\[Hidden condition achieved!\]
\[Condition: The 10,000 Uses Rule\]
\[Your rank has upgraded to D-rank!\]

I achieved the hidden condition and gained the ability to raise my skeletons. From E-rank to S-rank! The story of Joo Donghoon unfolds, the world's only cursed necromancer, who's speeding toward becoming a ranker!

After obtaining a candle with the power of hypnosis, Seon-U hypnotizes Su-A, who raised him and is like his mother. Seon-U, who had a crush on Su-A, inches his hands towards her privates…

Jijon City Jijon High School. Yeo Chan-Wook, the school's most tyrannical and unstoppable child, falls in love with his ideal type at first sight. But his ideal type is... Jijon High School's top otaku, Han Yu-Ri?! Because of his heavy-duty glasses, Chan-Wook can't recognize Yu-Ri. To make matters worse, the two become mentors and mentees as part of a school-based learning program. With detection a sure death, Yu-Ri's dangerous double life begins!

Will Yu-Ri be able to graduate safely without Chan-Wook discovering his identity?

Da Seulgi is a timid female college student who becomes a \[libertine/philanderer\] when she drinks alcohol. She heard a rumor that you’d have to participate in company dinners to get good grades in a compulsory liberal art class with the College of Physical Education. To maintain her top rank, Seulgi was forced to go to the drinking party and kept silent in her seat amidst the noisy environment, catching the eye of ‘Oh Bora’, a popular student from the college of physical education. Bora asks her why she didn’t touch her glass and she quickly answers in surprise.

“Ah, I’m a lightweight!”
“What? Did you say ‘nice’? Awe~some! You should’ve said so before!”

She misunderstood, getting caught in the atmosphere of the college students. She got drunk and… seduced Bora who was helping her in her drunken state! A give & take love comedy between an introverted timid nerd, Seulgi and a confident extrovert, Bora.

(Source: Peanutoon, translate)

We have developed love since our school days. As college students, we finally had the first experience we had been enduring, and our future as a couple seemed to be filled with only happiness. “We were definitely lovers in our past life… !” The moment I ejaculated for the first time, memories from my past life rush into my head, and I learn the shocking truth about my lover in the past! What will happen to our future now?!

display_title: It's Voice Phishing, but It's a Life Reversal
description:
*"I'll change your future!"*

A chance to turn your life around, a guaranteed service promised by a voice phishing scam! Kang Juhyuk, a once beloved national actor who has fallen from grace and into poverty, lives in a dark, single-room apartment in misery. One day, an unidentified smartphone is sent to Juhyuk, leading to a series of events that will completely change his life.

*"The voice phishing calls I'm getting... are they selling the future?"*

(Source: Naver, translated)

For an orphan, Lee Goyo is a lucky child. She was rescued along with a prosecutor’s son in a kidnapping 14 years ago and became the adopted daughter of ex-prosecutor Lee Uitaek. However, she didn’t have a sweet life, but a life of hellfire. In exchange for being with Lee Uitaek and his son, she became their doll and dog. 

“Lee Uitaek told me to seduce you.”

 “If I tease you, will you come?”

 “What do you think we’ll do all night long?”

 “…I guess I was thinking too grandly. In the end, it was just going to be a meaningless night.”

 In order to survive, she had to continue proving her worth even if it meant seducing KJ Finance’s president, Kwon Jaeheon, a man she had no relationship with. 

 “What I want is… A life of freedom. 

No matter how hard she struggled, she couldn’t escape that hell on her own.

 “Promise me one thing. Promise that you’ll save me from them.”

 I would even eat a poisoned apple.

 “I told you that I’d give it to you even if it killed me. Don’t you trust me?”

 At that moment, that crazy and dangerous man seemed like a savior leading her to paradise in Goyo’s eyes.

Ashley thought she and her husband were in love, but he abused her and she died giving birth to a child. Before she could take revenge on him, she opened her eyes and found herself in a pre-marriage phase with him. She felt like she was going to live that hellish life again, so she looked for a replacement husband for her. Ashley went straight to visit Duke Esperad Camedici, who was rumored to have been afflicted by a curse after his fiancée died under mysterious circumstances. 

 *"I'm Ashley, I would like to ask Your Grace to marry me."
"Does what you said mean that you wish to die now?"
"Do you think the misfortune that has befallen me is a joke?"*

Ashley knows that he will become emperor, so she tries to win his heart. Moreover, she has finally replaced her husband, and yet he is still arguing with her. Will Ashley be able to take revenge across time and space and succeed in replacing her husband?

display_title: Today's Lucky Item Is an Ahjusshi

Moon Geun-Young has the worst luck imaginable, relying entirely on fortune apps to navigate life. His world takes an unexpected turn when he meets Team Leader Kang Joon-Suk, a man blessed with incredible luck.
Every time Geun-Young tries to get intimate, strange interruptions seem to arise. However, with Joonsuk, he finds himself having surprisingly enjoyable nights... that is, until he learns.... *"Who knew he was married?"*
Will Geun-Young be able to resist the subtle temptations of Kang Joon-Suk, who keeps inching closer—even at work?

7 years ago, Ki-Tae fell for actor Shin-Woo by chance and became obsessed with him. After stalking him alone for several years, he won the lottery and planned to kidnap Shin-Woo with the money he earned. He hid his real name and got a job as a manager, getting closer step by step, and finally kidnapped Shin-Woo and brought him back...

Yoo Jinwon, a specialist in surgical operations, receives a request to perform a secret surgery from Seong Wooje, the chairman of South Korea's largest corporation, the Seongil Group. At long last, the opportunity for revenge has arrived! Can Yoo Jinwon not only conquer Seongil Seoul Hospital but also seize control of the entire Seongil Group with just a scalpel? display_title: Other Than My Friend's Sister, Something Else
description:
Seula has endured a long-standing crush, thinking that being friends would be enough. But when she learns Areum has accepted her boyfriend’s proposal, she breaks down. To soothe her torn heart, she gets drunk and calls her, confessing her feelings. The next day, she wakes up naked next to Areum’s sister, Daun! Chaos began to invade the world. One day, a gate suddenly appeared in the world, and monsters poured out. Humanity stood on the brink of destruction. The world of martial arts, "Eun," the world of magic and knights, "Einheart," and the world of the demons, "Gehenna," were connected, and superhumans swept away the monsters. Due to the betrayal of his colleagues and the superhumans from other worlds who disliked his actions, Lee Ro-Woon lost everything, becoming a wreck and falling into the abyss. Just when he was about to give up, he was transported to a sealed world as a vessel of chaos, where he encountered three absolute powers. Having finally fled her troubled past, Hae-Joo enrolled late into the Film & Theater Department, hoping for a fresh start in college. She envisioned a future brimming with promise, but soon realizes she can't outrun her past forever. Caught between her childhood friend and her rekindled first love, Hae-Joo wrestles with conflicting emotions. Eun-Seok, her longtime friend, proposes a fake dating scheme to mask his own feelings and shield her from Jay's advances.

Sergeant ‘Bucky’, a war hero belonging to the ‘Empire of the Sun’. He serves as an example to the imperial soldiers through his loyal loyalty to the emperor and his excellent martial arts, but in fact, his ultimate goal is to take revenge on the emperor by causing the downfall of the empire. Can Bucky achieve revenge against a massive empire? 

(Source: Naver, translated)

One day, out of nowhere, a charming princess appeared in the life of Claire, the mistreated protagonist of an unknown author's work. Princess Yuri, without any prior connection, unexpectedly proposed that Claire marry her brother—known as the empire's most eligible bachelor. Overwhelmed by the princess's stubbornness, which not even the emperor could sway, Claire found herself in a contract engagement with the second prince.

*"I just want you to play along until Princess Yuri is satisfied. I'll make sure you're compensated accordingly."*

As Claire waited for the contract to end, Prince Raymond began to approach her. Why would someone who is only tied to her by a contract...?

*"I don't want to let you go. I feel like locking you away so you can't leave."*

For Claire, who fears both giving and receiving love, the wave of affection from her potential in-laws has only just begun.

Determined to confront Hwanyoung, the man involved with his ex-lover, he’s instead greeted by a disturbing sight—ghosts surrounding Hwanyoung. Convinced the man might be a killer, Jaehyuk starts tailing him. When caught in the act, he impulsively claims to have feelings for Hwanyoung, leading to an unexpected night together. If hair color’s the problem, just dye it! If he lacks charisma, then we’ll practice! Operation: Act Like a Northern Bastard is a go. But.

"Walking away without looking back, speaking coldly while standing close... What even is this?"
"This is what will work on Her Highness the Fourth Princess."
"You’re saying Her Highness actually likes this kind of behavior?"
"Absolutely."
"This just makes me look like an overly aggressive jerk."

Though skeptical, Baileon goes along with Didier’s plan. But Odette remains unmoved, Baileon forces a bitter smile—And then the damn Northern Duke shows up. She may look like a soft cotton-candy bunny on the outside, But inside, Marienne Didier is a beast, dead-set on getting her favorite character his love story. Will she succeed? 

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

"Just think of it as a bad dream. A very painful and terrible dream."
"But if our time together held any value at all."

Thump thump thump thump.

Simultaneously, beyond the blood-red earth, numerous flags rose amidst a hazy dust.

"Uaaaaaah!"

Na-Rin, who did not want to be alone on her birthday, looked through SNS to find someone to meet and then came across her childhood friend Han-Gyeol, who she had lost contact with after confessing to her. He even discovers that his biological mother switched him with the Dukes' son, and he subsequently hates the true Dukes' son, Gaillont. However, the more he conceals the truth and tries to eliminate Gaillont, the more he sinks into the abyss. Only on the verge of death does he acknowledge his ugly inferiority complex and close his eyes in regret.

As promised, the demon brought me to the "Demon World" where no one knew me, and said that I would live in his "castle" where I could live in abundance and peace. However, his family, the demons, existed in the castle, and they said that they would decide by majority vote whether it was okay for me to live in the castle...

display_title: Conquering the Game With the Strongest Webnovel Characters
description:
My father, who passed away leaving behind only a key, was a web novelist specializing in munchkin stories. Ten years later, the virtual reality game ‘The Another World,’ based on one of his works, became a platform of opportunity from basic livelihood to striking it rich and achieved unprecedented success. 

Kim U-Ju, the author's child, lived a grueling life without any special advantages. He accidentally discovered that a key-shaped merchandise item from his father's estate was being traded at a high price. Immediately, he used the key to open a limited edition book in his father's study and received a special gift within the game. U-Ju accepted the gift, and afterward, the Great Demon King Lucia, a character from his father's web novel, appeared. The Demon King Lucia granted U-Ju powers, but the overwhelming strength left him in an awkward position, unable to even complete simple daily quests. After much deliberation, U-Ju brought in another work, Killer Zero, to eliminate the source of the power, the Demon King. However, Jason, a limited edition power user from ‘The Other World’ who sensed something amiss, burst in, leading to a confrontation. 

Can U-Ju, armed with the strongest web novel characters, truly stand against the mightiest in the game?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: My First Love From the Future

Soo-ah is about to marry a sweet man named Hamin. In front of her is Lee Gyeom, whom she has been crushing on for 19 years.

“If you marry him, you will die.”   
Surprised by the situation, Soo-ah keeps him at arm's length, but he begins to intrude into her life.   
“Why are you doing this now? 

Once, I loved him so much, but he hated me so much.   
Now, the man who promises to marry me and loves me only for me, Hamin.   
And the woman who is loved by both of them, Sua.

One day, a handsome man wearing a martial arts outfit appears in front of the manager of the martial arts idol group 'Gupilbang', Jeom-So-Ui. Just as she was growing weary of the endless comparisons, she happened to receive an art award that brought her some attention, and so Inha began to pursue the path of art. Eight years later, she reunites with Yejun... only to find that he, too, is now doing art. Believing it's inevitable that she'll once again be compared to him, Inha starts making plans to distance herself from Yejun. A coming-of-age romance about Inha, who harbors a dislike for Yejun.

While walking down the street in a daze, she's hit by an oncoming car and wakes up to find her memories of the past ten years gone, her childhood friend acting as her guardian. Guardian? display_title: As Far as I Can Go With My Friends
description:
I need to get married. But men aren't exactly lining up to meet me, and there aren't many prospects in this small town. 

Actually, there is one.
My childhood friend, Cha I-hyeok.
He whispers in my ear in a devilish tone. 

“I guess you don't have a choice, you'll have to marry me.”
Is he a man? Sure. He's a good-looking guy, but we're like family. 

“Are you crazy? No. I can't marry you.”
“Why not?”
“If we get married, we'll have to do... things at night. How can we do that with you and me?”
“Well, we can try it out.”
“Try what?”
“Kiss… or have sex.” 

Before I could scold him for his insanity, I-hyeok kisses my lips roughly.
The moist, hot feeling is unfamiliar.
His lips, nibbling on mine, swells slightly.
And it's not just his lips that's swelling. I can feel him get hard, pressing against my flesh. 

“Huh....”
We are friends.
No…
We were friends.
Friends don't kiss like this. 

What are we now, then? 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

display_title: How to Extend a Marriage Contract
description:
Emily, the only daughter of an earl, is looking for a marriage partner to inherit the title. Kyle, the captain of the Order of the Holy Knights, appears before her at just the right time. 

‘I need you,’ he says, ‘and you need a suitable husband.’ 

The two agree to pretend to be married for the duration of the contract. But Emily falls for Kyle during their fake marriage, and soon the three years are over and their contract comes to an end. However, Kyle returns from an expedition with an unexpected case of amnesia. 

‘So does that mean he doesn’t remember the marriage contract?’ Emily thought, realizing that if Kyle knew, he would be horrified.

Chris, a detective specializing in serious crimes, has been pursuing the culprit of a murder case for 10 years. During his investigation, he is unexpectedly saved by Anton.  
"Who are you, really?"  
"If you're curious, spend the night with me."  
Everything about their relationship is suspicious, yet Chris finds himself irresistibly drawn to Anton.

[Original Webtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/black_s)

Hee-Soo receives a mysterious note by courier that makes writing curses on others come true. Even cash comes out every time you curse! Hee-Soo curses Hyun-Woo, the man she has a crush on, to force him into a romance with her. However, things don't go as planned, and things go wrong. The situation worsens even further than before, and when someone appears after the note, Hee-Soo is forced to cross a river of no return...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Sol-Bi, who was asked to look after the house while her mother went on a trip to Europe, comes down to her parents' house. While watering the garden, she starts talking to Hee-Yeon, a divorced woman who lives next door, and Sol-Bi feels a thrill towards the affectionate Hee-Yeon. From that day on, the two become closer, and Sol-Bi's feelings for Hee-Yeon grow with each passing day. One day, the two go to an amusement park together with tickets that Hee-Yeon's daughter Ji-Min got. While enjoying a date while riding the rides, snacking, and laughing, when the first snow falls, Sol-Bi confesses to Hee-Yeon that she wants to be her lover by kissing her...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

 *Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology (\[GL\] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).*

The wedding of Im Na-Rim, my first love from six years ago, and Iri-Un, my best friend of 13 years. Iri-Un, the groom who had everything perfect, suddenly leaves Na-Rim, and Tae-Shin and Na-Rim are thrown into the past together, six years in the past!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

A large man in the dark sky. A demon. Something in the shape of a bat. He was feared and worshipped by everyone for a long time, but now no one remembers him. He has been forgotten. But he still exists and watches over us. Today, twenty years after Baekjungnal, the long-awaited sacrifice of "him" is finally offered.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type Fall Anthology (\[BL\] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 가을).*

Stop the resurgence of the Sinwolmun, a group seeking to rule the world through demons! 

Late at night, in a noisy gambling house, a ruffian bets on the family's stolen sword. The legendary Seven-Star Sword, said to control demons, is revealed. Moments later, the Sinwolmun's disciple, Sacheonpaehwang, appears from nowhere. The gambling house is devastated, corpses strewn about. Since that day, the martial arts world has been plagued by a series of gruesome and brutal incidents. The Inryungjo, a martial arts investigation agency specializing in arresting unsolved cases, is dispatched to the scene of these unsolved cases. Recognizing the emergence of a vast dark force, they hunt down its source. Meanwhile, Hui-Yeon, disguised as a man and joining the Inryungjo to avenge her family, is caught on the first day by the group's leader, Beom-Yeop. However, for some reason, Beom-Yeop forces Hui-yeon to remain in the Inryungjo.

Can the Inryungjo prevent the resurgence of the Sinwolmun, once thought lost to legend?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Determined not to let it go, Yeong-won chased after her, where she met the man known as her ‘sponsor’ and, in a fit of anger, kissed him forcefully. description:
Jae-yi Lee, who had a crush on his classmate Yun-na Lee,   
musters up a lot of courage to confess, but doesn't get a response. When he meets Lina again the next day,   
Lina has changed and looks like a different person...?

Izar, a boy from the slums who became a guard knight after falling for a young lady of a ducal house. But their happy days are short-lived, as he suddenly learns that the young lady is going to be married. Unable to bear losing her like this, something dark begins to boil within Izar…

display_title: How I Became Friends With My Female Friends
description:

Since childhood, Saenghyuk had dreamed of becoming independent early. After graduating high school, he dedicated himself solely to learning a trade, and at a young age, he managed to secure both a shop and a living space in Docheon-dong, a once-thriving commercial area.
However, unlike his childhood memories—when the place was even used as a movie set—Docheon-dong had now become a ghost town, completely deserted. The reason? Rumors of a female ghost running across ceilings had emptied out the nearby residential area.
Sure enough, strange and eerie events begin unfolding in Saenghyuk’s own home, as if a ghost were present… and soon, he starts having strangely erotic dreams, the kind only a teenage boy would have…

Woochan, a cooking YouTuber, decides to go car camping with his friend and lover, Hyunwoo, to create new content.
After successfully finishing their livestream and just as they’re about to fall asleep, a sudden earthquake strikes!
Outside the car is a dark cave, and in the pitch-black darkness, countless tentacles reach out to swallow them whole… Can they escape this place? Or will they even survive long enough to try?

Seo-Jin, who is obsessed with men but is constantly wooed by women, goes to see a famous shaman with her best friend Yeon-Hee. The shaman tells her that Seo-Jin does not have men's clothing but is popular with the same sex, while Yeon-Hee has a peach blossom arrow and is popular with the opposite sex, but is jealous and envied by the same sex. After confirming their opposing fates, the shaman gives them an amulet that will alleviate their luck. She also prophesies that this amulet will change their fates. Seo-Jin is half-believing the shaman's words and forgets about the amulet, throwing it in a corner of the house. However, Yeon-Hee thoroughly believes in the amulet and always carries it with her, trying to prove its effectiveness to Seo-Jin...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology (\[GL\] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울)*

“In search of Love”, a national project to encourage marriage that only people aged 24 or older, and who have been single for more than a year can participate in. 11 men and women who gathered to find true love, start to move based on their mental and physical attraction. Living together in place filled with different types of energy away from any surveillance camera!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

display_title: Even If It Becomes Nothing Like That
description: Mia, who lost her fin and became a human due to falling in love with a human, sets out on a journey to find a way to turn back into a mermaid. Then one day, Mia encounters mermaids who have turned into monsters.

A young woman, Ariel, is on the run from her brother and lord, Arik. Threatened by an assassin arranged by Arik, she is rescued by a mysterious knight named Verita, and together they flee. To escape Aric's ever-threatening shadow, Ariel learns to fend for herself with Verita's help. Along the way, Ariel learns to lean on Verita even when she feels vulnerable, and to be honest with herself about her feelings... 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Suhwa's family is in crisis due to her husband's misfortune. While Suhwa's future looks bleak due to the mountain of debt that has fallen on her, the twins Sowon and Leewon who live next door propose a contract. In exchange for paying off the debt, she will work as their housekeeper. However, Suhwa is troubled by the contract as it requires her body rather than being an ordinary housekeeper, but she decides to accept the twins' contract anyway in order to protect her young son. Although she is a married woman with a child, she gradually becomes accustomed to and familiarizes herself with the twins...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Eun-Ho, who is popular for his pretty face and tall stature, is having a flower-like youth, but... is a repeater. Unable to just sit by and watch Eun-Ho like that, his mother asks Seong-Jun, Eun-Ho's childhood friend and one year older, to tutor him. Eun-Ho goes to Seong-Jun to thank him and run an errand for side dishes... 

...Huh? What are you doing now?

(Source: Bookcube, translated)

Jae-Hyeon, an ordinary college student, has been suffering from unpleasant dreams recently. A very unpleasant dream where a giant 'red snake' appears and stares at him or squeezes his body to the point where he can't breathe. The day after having the dream, he always gets a headache that feels like he's going to burst, but when he goes to the hospital, they tell him that there's nothing wrong with his body. Then one day, Jae-Hyeon, who was on his way to his studio apartment, collapses on the street and receives help from Soo-Yeon, a senior he's not close with. From that day on, Soo-Yeon actively approaches him, saying he wants to be close with him, but Jae-Hyeon can't bring himself to push him away...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Do-Jun, who has never been with a girl, accidentally witnesses an unwanted scene in the projection room and receives a fellatio in exchange for keeping his mouth shut. In fact, she had an untold story about sleeping with several male part-timers… But there’s also a sudden participant! Do-Jun who falls for her the more and more close he gets to her… She, whose emotions aren’t clearly visible, is starting to gravitate towards the affectionate man… And the sudden co who’s trying to take Do-Jun away by dedicating herself to the very beginning for her revenge! Let their passionate romantic battle at the movie theater commence!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

*“I could entrust my unfinished work to you. Will you continue writing it?”*

Graduate student Park Min-Woo inherits the legacy of a world-renowned scholar. The great challenge of a third-rate university humanities student begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Lian, a thirty-year-old who runs a perfume business in the US. While looking for an assistant, she meets Eun-Seo who is studying abroad in the US. From the first time they meet, the much younger woman who flirts with him is funny, but they go to a hotel together. However, at the hotel, Eun-Seo reveals an unexpected secret and slowly strangles Lian, who is terrified. 

How will the fatal yet inescapable relationship between Lian and Eun-Seo develop?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

*A man who is mistaken for the lover's live-in boyfriend is the new team leader?!*

Chi-Won and Ji-Hyeok first met at a hotel after an uncomfortable incident. While considering each other as 'the person they want to avoid the most' and 'the most interesting person,' they meet by chance at the company. And that too as a direct supervisor and a subordinate! 

A cute story of love that ends in a tumultuous battle of dislikes!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

display_title: I Became a Chef to Save a Different World
description:
“Please come with me and save the world.”

While enjoying a holiday, chef Yoo-jung’s peaceful life is suddenly interrupted by a mysterious man.

Introducing himself as an otherworldly being, ‘Nemo’ asks Yoo-jung to cross over to the world beyond the shoe cabinet and help him save it.

No matter how many times Yoo-jung refuses, this man… is unbelievably persistent. And to make things worse—has he really survived his whole life eating nothing but stones?

Feeling sorry for him, Yoo-jung prepares various dishes, feeding and taking care of him for days—until one day, Nemo suddenly disappears.

Before long, Yoo-jung steps through the passage to the other world.

Will Yoo-jung be able to find Nemo again?

(Source: Naver, translated)

This place is a guest house. Staying here, you come across lives of many different type of people. Also, many things happen. Ah, damn… I’m fucked…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
*Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.*

In the Joseon Dynasty, Kunnomi, a herbalist in a small village, dreams of marrying his childhood friend Okbun. One day, Kunnomi discovers a place where the expensive herb "resurrection plant" grows wild, and is excited at the prospect of making a lot of money from it, but falls off a cliff and nearly dies. On the verge of death, Kunnomi accidentally eats the resurrection plant that a fox spirit has been carefully tending for 100 years, and both his life and his groin are restored.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/big_dick_guy), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/big_dick_guy)

Tired of the same routine every day, Kang Eun decides to give it all up. Disillusioned by her stressful job and a boyfriend who only offers sex without any foreplay, she leaves everything behind and returns to her seaside hometown. When she hears that she'll be helping her parents run their boarding house, her childhood friend Chan can't hide his excitement. Seeing how much Chan has grown since they were kids stirs something unsettling in her. As a strange tension begins to form between them, the only remaining tenant, Yuhyeon, returns to the house—and Kang Eun finds herself falling for him, captivated by a charm completely different from Chan's...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

To start his life anew, Noah finds a new place to live where no one knows him. But even in this new place, people are waiting for him, falling in love with him and wanting to make him their own. And on top of that, Amon's sudden appearance brings discord into Noa and Nayeon's relationship.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Miae, who suffers from “hypersexuality,” has sex with anyone whenever her desires become overwhelming. While getting involved with various men, such as a part-time bookstore employee, a gym coach, and a taxi driver, she begins to feel something she has never experienced before with Jinseop, whom she met at a company dinner. Miae’s body wants to have sex with him, but she is afraid he will discover her true self. She also does not have the courage to break her own rule: never sleep with people around her, especially coworkers. Because of that, Miae deliberately keeps her distance from Jinseop and returns to her promiscuous lifestyle. But in the end, Jinseop catches her in that side of herself.

Choi Ko-un, who loves his girlfriend so much he feels like he could die, and Han Song, who feels a bit shy about her overly affectionate boyfriend but still enjoys his love, are a happy couple. Their only worry is a small one: "What costume should we try tomorrow?" Today, they had another sweet and passionate time together. But suddenly, Han Song starts to feel bothered by thoughts of her ex-boyfriend and the opinions of people around her. She begins to wonder, "Will Ko-un ever change too...?" and starts feeling a little worried.

Once I start, I go all the way.

Jung Da-In, a national gymnastics team member from Korea's Chego High School, investigates the suicide of his childhood friend Lee Eun-Ju, caused by drugs. He uncovers a massive conspiracy tied to Eun-Ju's death. He discovers that a significant number of athletic club students are addicted to drugs that dramatically enhance performance, and have become pawns for the drug distributors. Da-In begins his relentless pursuit to uncover the truth behind Eun-Ju's death and to eradicate the source distributing these drugs within the school...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A newly emerging religion with a mysterious purpose, Ilgakgyo, and its educational facility called Lumbini. The children of Lumbini refer to it as paradise. In this unbelievable paradise where strange events unfold, and the shocking occult thriller experienced by the protagonist Yeong-Do, who finds himself there.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Screen City, where actors can step directly into the world of a movie. There, the universally acknowledged top actor Nam Woo-Ju is constantly being killed off by Woo Ju-Yeon, who invaded the film, and is pushed out of the protagonist role. Unable to help but feel malice towards him, Nam Woo-Joo begins to confront the movie terrorist Woo Ju-Yeon...

 *“What the hell is your reason for doing this to me, Woo Ju-Yeon...!”*

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

battlefield with honor, but in the end,

he had returned to the past when he was thirteen.

Anyone can see that he is an ordinary job seeker and a well-informed person. An unexpected job confirms that the mediocrity that has been his lifelong complex is an area where talent shines, and he decides to become a killer. In the crisis killer industry, which is an ecosystem that is different from the common sense of the world, can an ordinary, ordinary killer informant really become the best?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

*“What did I deliver?!”*

To escape the hardships of life, he takes on a high-paying delivery job, but gets caught up in an unmanageable incident and meets retired legendary biker gang members.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*“When the fog thickens, they’ll come, with faces that are exactly the same as before.”* 

Seo-Uri, who has lived her entire life as the daughter of a murderer, heads to her maternal grandmother’s rural village after hearing news of her grandmother’s death. There, she encounters a ghost incident that is exactly the same as the one her mother experienced 18 years ago.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Lee Heon-Seo (Female, 24), a college student who turned into a pigeon overnight. Unable to find a way to return to being human again, Heon-Seo stays at the house of her male friend Ban Hwi-Hyeol in the same neighborhood for the time being and continues her life as a pigeon...

 *"What do you think, Lee Heon-Seo? Is life as pigeon fun?"*

(Source: Naver, translated)

The news of the destruction of the Earth, which had been circulating as nothing but nonsense, came out on the convenience store TV. At that moment, he lost consciousness with sound of a bang. He woke up a few days later and the city had already turned into ruin. *"Where am I...? And who am I?"* An old man who had died and a tattoo shaped like an eye appears in the male protagonist’s lost memories. In search of his memories, he heads to the shelter with the female protagonist, but will the two protagonists be able to survive the 465 days before the Earth is supposed to be destroyed?

The Buddha of Fighting descends to the human world!

An incident occurs in which demons escape from hell and hide in the human world. Son Oh-Gong, on the orders of the Jade Emperor, descends to the human world to capture the escaped demons. Concerned that the demons, startled by his extraordinary magical powers, will escape, he decides to hide in the body of an ordinary high school boy, Ryu Ha-Seon.

 *"From now on, I am the Buddha who will return victorious from battle, the Fighting Buddha, the Fighting Buddha, the Fighting Buddha, descends to the human world!"*

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Live broadcast prison fight match of unrepentant criminals for the entire nation! 

(Source: Naver, translated)

Lee Seung-Hwa, a transfer student, arrives in the quiet rural village of Guam-ri. He beats class president Woo Ho-Young without warning and announces to his classmates: "Woo Ho-Young's father, Woo Sang-Cheol, is a murderer who killed two people, including his own father." With everyone turning their backs on him, Woo Ho-Young meets someone who understands him and begins to heal his wounded heart.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Teddy Magazine editorial intern, Yoo Ji-yoo.
One day, right before the magazine's deadline, the main article falls through.
Then comes a special mission from the editor-in-chief, notoriously known as the "witch."

The task? An exclusive interview with the photographer Jake (JAKE), who is secretly returning to Korea!
But at the airport, the Jake I meet is someone I know...

"Do-hyung oppa?"
"And you're just standing there while I'm about to be devoured by the witch?"

His familiar low voice and signature musky scent.
But unlike before, everything about him feels awkward.
When he speaks to me or his touch brushes against me, my toes tingle for some reason.

When he beckons me with a playful smile, asking why I’m not coming into his arms already,
at that moment, he is no longer just "my brother’s friend."

"You’re so cute when you talk."
"…Uh. What should I say to that?"
"You’re so beautiful I want to kiss you."

Yoo Ji-yoo’s sweet romance with the dangerous Seo Do-hyung and her one and only drop.

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/167860)

How many failed unrequited loves have you had? Then, a campus advertisement caught my eye. A 5 million won couples grant was offered if you find a partner through the app! Join the dating app trial and get a prize! Win prizes and love! A tangled love triangle unfolds through the dating app "First Win."

Ju Si-Young, who even took a leave of absence to become a killer, is finally about to make his historic debut....! But everyone in this neighborhood seems to have lost their minds. What's wrong with this neighborhood? At this rate, I might lose my mind too...?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

This is our first time in the military, so we’re clumsy soldiers! Chaotic military stories that happen because we’re so clumsy.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Suddenly, a demon enters my daily life and covets my soul. I am an ordinary human being, but my 'goodness' is top-notch, so it is worth corrupting. As I become entangled with the demon, I keep getting involved in unbelievable things... The good man's hunt for evil spirits begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Nam Yeon-Seo, the goddess of the prestigious Cheonghan University. Pretty and adorable, Yeon-Seo is a kind and lovable con artist, and every boy in school adores her. But one day, when a strange man starts hanging around Yeon-Seo, her best friend Hwang Seon-Mi grows anxious.

 *"You two must never meet! That man is too good for Yeon-Seo to date... There's no other reason!!!"*

(Source: Naver, translated)

After moving to Neulbom Garden, the only inheritance of her husband, So-Hee begins to have nightmares. She discovers a photo of a mysterious female student in the mansion, and after that, the people she meets lose their lives one after another and become suspects in murder cases. What kind of case will So-Hee have to solve in Neulbom Garden?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Jae-Won, who grew up lonely under his parents' neglect, encounters Rio, a boy who was raised as nothing more than his father's plaything, during the inheritance process after his father's death. Out of resentment toward the father who ignored him, Jae-Won decides to take in Rio—the one his father cherished—and use him to his heart’s content. Was it because Rio had monopolized his father’s love? At times, Rio’s insolent attitude grates on Jae-Won’s nerves, stirring up unfamiliar emotions he can't quite understand… 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Nisha, who wants to live an ordinary life, hears rumours of a serial killer around her. One full moon night, she discovers a man dragging a bag containing a person down a dark alley. She tries to run away, but ends up losing consciousness... When Nisha wakes up, the man suddenly flashes his red eyes and speaks with a slightly excited expression. 'You're not human, are you?'

[Original Webtoon](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/fullmoon_accident)

Jae-Han, a once promising newcomer webtoon artist, has found his path to adult BL (black and white) a long and arduous one. With his self-esteem plummeting from repeated failures, one day, swept up in the atmosphere, he ends up kissing Jun-Woo, the boy next door. What Jae-Han initially thought was nothing special, a simple kiss, unleashes a powerful narrative arc. Their relationship, in which they engage in repeated physical contact despite not being lovers, spirals into a delicate spiral, but the arrival of a new producer throws things into a new direction...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Can love and life be remodeled?

Our heroine, Ji Kanghee, was born and raised in a motel.
She hates the small rural town where everyone is like family, so she leaves behind her first love, Cheon Yeonsu, and escapes.

After years of struggling, falling, and climbing back up, she finally feels like she's found success, a career, and maybe even love. But then, she hears a rumor—her first love, Yeonsu, the one she thought would long for her forever, has found someone to marry.

From the depths of her heart, she sends him a sincere blessing, but she can’t shake the overwhelming urge to confirm it for herself.
Does this girlfriend really exist? And what are Yeonsu's true feelings?

By a twist of fate, the construction site where she's now the project lead is located in H-town, the very place she swore she’d never return to after leaving.
Amid interactions with old classmates and townsfolk, she starts to sense that Yeonsu might still have feelings for her—and to her surprise, she doesn’t entirely dislike it.

Before she knows it, both her love and her life are undergoing a full remodel.

Michaela, once a new bride, was beaten to the brink of death and forced into marriage with a foreign royal by her cruel stepfather. Neither side desired the union, and Michaela's husband, Leon, never even glanced her way. She was exiled to a remote, dilapidated countryside. Years passed, and Leon found someone he truly loved and dreamed of marrying. Seeking a fresh start, he sets out to find Michaela and request a divorce. But will she agree so easily?

display_title: Hold Me When the Full Moon Rises
description:
Blair, known for being promiscuous, is cursed to suffer from a fever if he does not have sex on the day of the full moon. The curse started when he was young and was captured by wolves in the forest and returned, and Blair believes it was the young wolf he met at that time who did it. While searching for someone to relieve his fever as usual, but coming up empty-handed, Blair is hugged from behind by a strange man. With his shirt off, his long hair, and his obvious suspiciousness, this man claims to be Blair's companion...?

 *"I found you, my companion."*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

display_title: I Became a Fake Family With My Boss
description:
Jung Yu-na, a working aunt(?) who lives a strong life raising her niece Ji-an in place of her older sister and her husband who lost their lives in a hit-and-run accident.
One day, Kang Eden, the new CEO of the asset management company where Yu-na works, takes office.
From the worst first meeting to the mistakes that keep happening!
Yu-na has been renewing her days of being miserable since meeting Eden…

Meanwhile, Eden, who needs a family for his business in the Middle East,
proposes to Yu-na and Ji-an, who have been constantly catching his eye, to become his fake family,
and the three of them start living together to become the perfect family.
Unlike their first meeting, which was unpleasant,
Yu-na and Eden gradually fall for each other as they keep seeing different sides of each other…

They just wanted to be a fake family, but somehow they even fall in love?!
Will Eden and Yu-na be able to become a real family?!

Kang Ha-Young's daily grind at her family-run SME is Overtime, overtime, overtime! Why does she have to do all the work...? Min Tae-Hun, a contract employee who could free her from the dreaded overtime, appears before her! But this employee seems suspicious...? Why did someone with such high specs come to our company? Huh? Is he gay? No, bi? Or maybe a womanizer!? They say you should avoid trouble, but she's curious about that man, Min Tae-Hun.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*"A realistic story scarier than a ghost"* 

The main characters of each story are caught up in the horrors that gradually emerge in their daily lives, and struggle to escape the nightmarish situations created by modern civilization.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*"I want to build this together. Within the time we share."*

Six young people still clumsy at love. Within the relationship of lovers, they understand each other, share their thoughts, and finally learn to truly see themselves.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Love in Body/ at manhwawebsiteDo Ye-ji', an 84kg extremely obese person who has been on a diet for many yearsOn Christmas day, the sight of her clothes falling apart was broadcast live and she became the subject of public ridicule as a woman with a ripped stomach.Love in Body' was an opportunity for Yeji, who could do nothing but cry.If you fill your heart with love, you will never gain weight?!Will Yeji be able to graduate from dieting?Maybe you like !

Image consultant Jess Han, a troublemaker in Hollywood who specializes in saving irredeemable losers. Jess, who has lived his 30 years with nothing but pride, passion, and competitive spirit, has a new request from the hotel industry king Luke Leonard, who is suffering from scandal. It was okay that he decided to take on his work at the request of his close friend Alan. This man is surprisingly a formidable opponent. Jess, who has lived his whole life with his wits, is also dragged around by Luke, who has a dirty personality, unlike his known image. As he runs, flies, hangs upside down, gets a nosebleed, and eventually falls from the second floor while dreaming of revenge, Luke and he fight like a war every day, but at some point, a strange atmosphere begins to flow, and when he comes to his senses, they are kissing, and when he comes to his senses, (Luke) is saying that they are dating...

*“Sorry to ask, but… Do you know who my lover is?”*

For a moment, he is shocked by the love affair that began without him knowing, but he suddenly enters full-blown love mode, but at that moment, the whole story of the tragedy that happened to the Leonard family is revealed... 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Mok Na-Young, five years older than him, and Do-An, five years younger. They tied the knot after dating for just six months, and they're adoring each other every day! Na-Young, who enjoys every day of her newlywed life, is suspicious of her husband. With that face, she's saying he's her first love? With that body, she's experiencing everything for the first time?

The heart-pounding story of Na-young and Do-an's married life, a couple with a difference in age and gender.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

No friends, no motivation, no special talents. Wounds, grievances, and a sense of lack. Cheon-Hui and Jun-Hwi, the school’s resident outcasts, join forces to start a club. But this club…

 *“No popular kids allowed.”*

(Source: Naver, translated)

display_title: The Perfect Man Has a Secret
description:
A man who is flawless in every way—looks, physique, personality, and professional ability. Jihan is truly perfect. Miju has secretly been in love with her boss Jihan, but just when it seems she has no chance at all, she hears the news that Jihan has been transferred to the head office. Feeling like she has no more time to hesitate, she decides to confess her feelings… However, things don’t go as she expected, and in the midst of it all, she realizes something. This perfect man seems to be hiding something!

One day, a self-destructive organ is created in the brains of teenagers. A life-threatening negotiation begins with adults who do nothing to save the dying children.

The Empire’s only Swordmaster, Raviruth Penhac, is afflicted with a strange condition—he's possessed by spirits every night. While running a mercenary group on the frontier, one day he scouts a genius boy named Sel. Raviruth, who had never shown interest in any woman, suddenly starts reacting—to Sel.

*"What the hell is happening? No way. There's no way I like guys!"*

But Sel, who joined the mercenary group while hiding her true gender, starts to become conscious of Raviruth as he gets closer to her…

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Lyricist Choi Woo-Rim, but now an unknown who can't make money as a lyricist. Choi Woo-Rim is busy working as a company employee during the day and a lyricist at night to make a living. Then one day, Woo-Rim meets his favorite celebrity, Ki Yoo-Seong, who planted in his mind the dream of becoming a lyricist. Ki Yoo-Seong is a man... completely different from what I thought!

(Source: Naver, translated)

I thought I would be born a beta male and live an ordinary life until I suddenly manifested as an omega. After living my life that changed completely overnight, I gave up judo, which was so precious to me, and became the exclusive bodyguard for an omega family. Even so, I thought I would live quietly like this and die. Until I got into an accident with my employer’s son. No, until I realized that I got pregnant because of that one incident.

 *“Is there anyone else besides us who knows this?”*

Before I could even accept the fact that I was pregnant, the person proposed to me as calmly as if offering me a glass of water. 

 *“Mr. Ho Jun-Kyung, will you marry me?”*

The problem is that the person proposing is not the child’s biological father, but his older brother. Jun-Kyung’s life, which had been ordinary, becomes a drama overnight when it becomes entangled with him.

*"I just want to beat Myung-ho once."* 

Song Baram, who has wandered in the shadows overshadowed by the star of a famous gym, Myung-ho, finally gets the chance to compete against him, a match he has long yearned for. After a relentless struggle, Song Baram achieves a miraculous victory, but Myung-ho is left unable to open his eyes again. 

Following this unfortunate incident, Song Baram quits boxing and returns to his hometown of Yongmun, where he fights to protect the only thing left to him: the 'Rose Gym'...

Cheongwol, a shaman who uses his rituals as a pretext to seduce men, takes on a peculiar request from Yu Baek, a notorious beauty and known lover of men.

*"You want me to summon a spirit that has already passed on?"*

They say Yu Baek has wasted away after losing his first love. Who would have thought such grief could be carried in such a beautiful body?

Cheongwol intends to flatter him, coax him, and collect his fee while secretly playing the part of Yu Baek’s lover to seduce him.

*"No, no… pull yourself together, Cheongwol! This isn’t me!"*  
*"What’s wrong? You look as if you’re… in heat."*

But what began as mere performance suddenly turns real when the summoning succeeds. Cheongwol’s body betrays him, moving on its own, and he finds himself drawn into Yu Baek’s dangerous desires…

On-Woo, an art student about to graduate, meets Hae-Won, a classmate who takes a liking to his paintings. Beyond the mere act of looking at him, Hae-Won begins to draw closer to On-Woo, and On-Woo can't resist him. Unable to predict what the outcome will be...

(Source: Bookcube, translated)

Cheol-Yong, who has been struggling to become an idol with his extraordinary talent since he was young. However, after repeated failures, he has come to terms with reality and is now working part-time at a sushi restaurant. He meets famous composer Ruth at a house where he went to deliver fish by chance, and while he thought he would get a chance, he ended up getting entangled in a bad relationship instead. Cheol-Yong is in a situation where he could end up getting sued because Ruth, who was composing music on his clothes, suddenly starts to touch him and hits his head with a trophy. Not only that, Ruth continues to make disparaging remarks, which is really annoying. This is a do-or-die situation. An angry Cheol-Yong hands out a 'Singing Contest' poster. He proposes to Ruth that if he wins, he will not sue him and that he should give him a song. On the day of the final battle, when Cheol-Yong sharpens his sword, goes up on stage, sings, and comes down, Ruth says... "I will sue you." Instead of saying, "I will make you a star. A trot star!" Trot?! Me, who was an idol trainee?!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

display_title: Princess-nim, Please Take My Misfortune Away!
description:
When you go on a picnic, the bus always causes trouble, and when you go on a trip, your accommodation always loses power. Even if you eat a group meal, you can only get an upset stomach on your own. Junmok is a person who is unlucky to be born with. Still, when I entered college, I decided to experience many things I had never done before, and I also wanted to have a strong relationship with the handsome and cool Alpha! Innate luck did not improve just because you entered a prestigious university. It's especially strange when you get involved with Gongju Lim, the famous person on campus and the protagonist of rumors.

Seo Hyo-Min, an actor with a handsome face and outstanding acting skills, but who has been in obscurity for a long time. One day, he receives a business card from someone who is interested in him. The owner of the business card is Kang Soo-Heon, a third-generation chaebol known as a sponsor for new male actors. Hyo-Min was worried that he might be the sponsor of a perverted old man, but Soo-Heon appeared in front of him, and he was handsome. When Hyo-Min confessed(?) that he was a virgin, Soo-Heon became interested...

 *"Should I be affectionate at first or... should I be so affectionate that he loses his mind?"*

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Jeong Eui-Jun, an entertainment reporter for a gossip magazine, is commissioned to investigate Gu Hyun-Seong, a second-generation chaebol who started out as a child actor. During the sluggish investigation, Eui-Jun impulsively sleeps with Hyun-Seong. Worse, he's caught being a reporter! Eui-Jun imagines the worst possible outcome. But Hyun-Seong, with a sly smile, makes a new proposal...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Gyeongseong, a city of desire and turmoil. Within it blooms a flower that never smiles: the courtesan Lee Seon. After ten years, she reunites with Han Seo-Jin, the man who took everything from her. Agonizing pain. Painful memories that resurface with every passing moment. The only way to end it is to take revenge on Han Seo-Jin. Fate turns to a curse, and flowers bloom upon hatred. They inflict wounds, indulge in passion, and fall together once more. In Gyeongseong, the city of tragic romance.

display_title: A Youth Observation Journal: Wings Before the Nest
description:
Han Yi-Sol, a high school freshman who loves birdwatching, is joined by Choi Ro-Woon, the unlucky top student in the entire school, and In Jeong-Min, who has been attending the same academy since middle school and has become her best friend. 

*"One side treats me too harshly, and the other side overprotects me...!"*

This is an observation of the love and friendship of young people just about to leave the nest.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The side stories for *Sketch.* 

*Note: Chapters 104-141.*

A series of short tales, with twists and turns, all bundled into one!

(Source: Toomics)

Im Si-Hyuk had everything going for him, looks, confidence, and a life that ran exactly the way he wanted. That is, until his trendy Gen-Z girlfriend dumps him without mercy, leaving cracks in the perfect image he built for himself. Drowning his pride at a company dinner, Si-Hyuk somehow gets drunk off a single cocktail and ends up spending the night with Do Geon-Woo, a part-time worker who just happened to find him in that state. What should have been a one-time mistake quickly turns complicated. 

 *“I only kiss someone I am dating.”

“…Fine, just don’t push me away.”*

Geon-Woo is nothing like the people Si-Hyuk usually deals with, calm, firm, and impossible to read. As he keeps appearing in Si-Hyuk’s life, that once predictable routine starts to spiral into something far less controlled. In the middle of this unexpected romance alert, can Si-Hyuk really go back to the life he had before?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After their battle with vampires and recovering from the aftermath, Keith and First are moving forward. Keith has been appointed chairman of his family’s company, and First is still working as an agent. Amid it all, they’ve finally acknowledged their love for each other. How will they manage to navigate their new status, and alone time, while dealing with family and obligations?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Superheroes of Class F: Rebooted
description:
Can’t be the superhero? Be the supervillain.

Welcome to Leaders Academy for the Superhumanly Gifted! As Korea’s most elite superhero institution, we aim to bring out the best in our students and encourage them to use their powers for the good of— Pardon? Class F, you say? Apologies, but we don't talk about Class F here.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: Love is a Sport: Outfield Base Running
description:
Selected for the Olympic baseball team, Sae-Ram enters the athletes village only to reunite with his former youth teammate, Ji-Ho. Despite years of silence, they are assigned as roommates based on their history. Ji-Ho has always harbored a hidden interest in Sae-Ram and quickly seizes the opportunity. Under the guise of sports massages, his touch grows increasingly bold and intimate. Seeing a heated side of the man who once only teased him, Sae-Ram feels his heart begin to race. Is this just intense team bonding or the start of a dangerous game?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Can we survive a 2nd pandemic?  
When Jaehyun notices a bizarre phenomenon, he is rather dismissive of it. That is, until he discovers that his own long-term girlfriend Seoeun is suffering the same affliction. What in the world is going on, and why is everyone so desperate to eat plastic, at the expense of their very lives?

One day, Mia, a mermaid with big dreams of romance, is reeled out of water by Jack, the coarse captain of the Heaven Pirates. To her disappointment, Jack looks nothing like the blond Prince Charming of her dreams, but Mia can't help but find herself mesmerized.

(Source: Manta)

College life should have been simple, but living with Woo-Hee is torture for Jin-Ha. His closest friend is now the object of every forbidden thought, and the walls of their dorm can no longer keep his desire at bay. When one reckless night strips away the safety of silence, the truth between them comes alive in heat and hunger. What was once friendship transforms into something far more intimate, where every touch carries the weight of years of longing.

(Source: Tappytoon)

When lifelong criminal Seung-Ji finds herself betrayed by her old boss, she joins an upstart smuggling business to lay low. Her goal is to find the opening to take advantage of the business to score cash and flee the city, but a wrench by the name of Yeong-Won is thrown into her plans. Inexperienced and naive, Yeong-Won is working in her aunt’s stead as Seung-Ji’s superior. Falling in love is a luxury for people in their line of work, but Seung-Ji’s desire for financial gain might be changing into a desire for something that she can’t afford...

By day, Mr. Han is just an ordinary manager. By night, he's the Big Boss!

display_title: The Villainous Princess Saves the Damn Knights (Pre-serialization)
description:
I transmigrated into a fantasy novel where the male protagonist, in his attempt to save the world, loses his comrades one by one, leading to eventual destruction. My role is a villainous princess with an excessively innocent mind. I obsess over the male lead, pick fights, and eventually die in a demon attack, thus plunging the reputation of the knight order the male lead belongs to into ruin... 

'Oh, this isn't a knight order, it's a rabble!' I looked around at the disheveled knights with a dumbfounded expression. 

"Sir, Are you properly contracted? What about overtime pay? Is there any compensation in case of accidents? How about medical support for mental stress and physical injuries?"  
"Why are you suddenly asking this, Your Highness?" The male lead asked me suspiciously. Well, I once obsessively pursued him, so I understand his wariness.   
"You should call me 'Administrator' instead of 'Your Highness'."   
"No, that's..."   
"Kashia Astrid, as of today, you've been assigned as the administrative supply officer for the Azure Radiance Knights." I smiled sweetly at the bewildered male lead.   
"Also, please rest assured, I'll no longer obsess over you anymore." His looks? Obsession? Sweet and bitter romance? What use are those when the world is on the brink of destruction!   
"If you keep this up, I might accidentally send a letter of complaint to the Emperor about this matter." Playing the villainess, I even slapped him in the commander's office.   
"Hey, do you want us to wash your socks too? Do you lose your hands? Huh?" I even confronted the absurd military culture.   
"Don't be discouraged, it's not your fault." I comforted the mentally shattered future saviors. 

"Hurrah for the Administrative Supply Officer!"   
"You're our savior!"   
"Hail, Kashia!"   
...Why did our knights turn into my fan club? And on top of that...   
"The Administrator will never leave us. Do you understand?" Why did even the stoic male lead lose his composure?!

[Promotional Novel/Webtoon](https://page.kakao.com/content/64007540/viewer/64038114)

description:

“Perhaps just a casual sleepover, you know… that sort of thing?”

Hyun-oh fell silent for a moment at Lee Yeon’s question.
His expression remained unruffled, calm yet simultaneously darkened with a flicker of anger.

“If that’s all within your limits… Well, fine. I suppose that’ll do.”

Lee Yeon’s eyes narrowed. Even though she’d brought it up first, hearing it from his mouth felt like a final blow, stabbing her heart deeply.
Hyun-oh reached out his hand. Lee Yeon flinched, but as always, she didn’t pull away.

“You’ve changed a lot, Jeong Yi-yeon.”

The hand that had been caressing her cheek brushed her ear and slowly trailed downward. The fingertips that had been tracing her skin slowly dug into the space between her nape and the collar of her shirt.

“Think about sleeping with me too.”

---

"Hey, Nam Dohyeon. Call me Noona," she demands. To her surprise, Dohyeon actually stammers it out, looking flustered and endearingly shy. "You've been staring at me for a while now. Do you like me?"

Noah Hewer appears before Song Yu-jin, who longed for a normal life.

To Yujin, everything—taking classes with Noah, living in the same house, working on group projects together, and hanging out with friends—feels like a miracle.

You, who helped me find the colors I lost in this world. In this land that is familiar to me but unfamiliar to you, we met again, though you may not know it.

At first, I thought it was just a fleeting connection.
But then, we met again in a completely unexpected way.

"How should I interpret this painting?"
"I need you."

I was a dancer who had lost her sight,
and you were someone who had to use even me.

"There's no love in this marriage."

So, he arrogantly said, there would be no reason for him to love me.

A marriage where I shouldn't dare hope for love.
But a marriage where I had to deceive everyone by pretending to love.

I slowly nodded.

"Remember. Why am I with this man?"

The grim truth I learned three years ago, the betrayal that burned my whole being.
The tragedy of that day that sent me plummeting into an endless abyss.

I've replayed it dozens of times, whipping myself.

"God. Never... let me regret the path I've chosen."

So, marrying that man,
acting in love, wasn't difficult.

*

But.

"Please... kill me.
" What should I do? "I have no intention of letting you go until I die,"

the man declared, clutching my slender neck.

"If you're guilty, it's that I love you so desperately." It was

n't until after the play that I finally realized,

"Ah... God has abandoned me."

It was a perfect condemnation.

Because I want to see something even hotter.”

Team Leader Jeong Jaejin of JS Asset Management’s Hong Kong branch fund management team—
and the time I spend having thrilling video meetings with him twice a week.
How did things ever end up like this…?

Inside a video-call window I hadn’t managed to close,
I came face-to-face with my boss, Jaejin, completely naked.

“Look at those proportions. Is he, like, around 190 cm?”
“Wow… his ass.”
“…And.”

“My god. They say the bigger the better, but that is *way* too big—even if it’s big!”
“Are you sexually harassing me right now?”

I’d been caught.
Just as I was trembling with anxiety at the dizzying truth—that I’d teased someone so far above my pay grade—

“If you’re sorry, then let me see, too.”
“W-What… see what?”
“What do you think. You. Naked.”

“Please turn off the screen-recording function.”

However, I plan to establish a royal harem and produce a legitimate heir to carry on the royal bloodline.” After careful selection, three men were chosen: Kael Romus, from Lakia’s most powerful noble family and a childhood friend of Queen Leticia. Harkan, the knight who has served her faithfully on the battlefield. Elody Riers, a royal descendant of the defeated nation of Zamel, offered to her as a token of surrender. 

These men became Leticia’s royal consorts. Leticia couldn’t understand what was happening. “Your Majesty, it’s alright. The wetter it is here, the easier the insertion will be.” “R-Really?” “So allow me to make it even wetter. 

"You must plant your seed.” Even the one who was meant to become the kingdom’s chancellor... “No, my liege. Call me disloyal, tear out my hair—I don’t care. Thinking, “Since I got the seasoning for free, maybe I’ll cook something for a change,” she ambitiously sets out to make a rolled omelet.
